```cpp
namespace {
unsigned g_frame_times = 0;
u64 g_vif1_transfers = 0;       // DMA to VIF1 started: a game's frame of geometry, usually one each
}  // namespace

void SetFrameTimes(unsigned every) { g_frame_times = every; }

/* --frame-times: the frames since the last line, and how fast they went. */
void FrameTimes(u64 frame) {
    using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
    static Clock::time_point last = Clock::now();
    static u64 last_frame = 0, last_transfers = 0, last_lost = 0, last_idle = 0, last_worker_us = 0, last_gs_us = 0;
    if (!g_frame_times || frame < last_frame + g_frame_times) return;
    const u64 lost = LostVblanks(), idle = IdleNanoseconds(), worker_us = Vif1BusyMicroseconds();
    const u64 gs_us = GsBusyMicroseconds();
    const Clock::time_point now = Clock::now();
    const double seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - last).count();
    char job_text[1024] = "";
    if (seconds > 0)
        std::snprintf(job_text, sizeof job_text, "%s, GS thread busy %d%%",
                      worker_us != last_worker_us
                          ? (", VIF1's worker busy " +
                             std::to_string(int(100.0 * double(worker_us - last_worker_us) / 1e6 / seconds + 0.5)) + "%")
                                .c_str()
                          : "",
                      int(100.0 * double(gs_us - last_gs_us) / 1e6 / seconds + 0.5));
    last_worker_us = worker_us;
    last_gs_us = gs_us;
    // The EE's waits for the worker, when it waited at all.
    static u64 last_join = 0, last_behind = 0, last_full = 0;
    u64 join = 0, behind = 0, full = 0;
    Vif1WaitMicroseconds(&join, &behind, &full);
    if (seconds > 0 && (join != last_join || behind != last_behind || full != last_full)) {
        const auto share = [&](u64 us) { return int(100.0 * double(us) / 1e6 / seconds + 0.5); };
        const std::size_t used = std::strlen(job_text);
        std::snprintf(job_text + used, sizeof job_text - used, ", EE waiting: joins %d%%, frames %d%%, room %d%%",
                      share(join - last_join), share(behind - last_behind), share(full - last_full));
    }
    last_join = join;
    last_behind = behind;
    last_full = full;
    static u64 last_gpu_us = 0;
    const u64 gpu_us = GpuBusyMicroseconds();
    if (gpu_us != last_gpu_us && seconds > 0) {
        const std::size_t used = std::strlen(job_text);
        std::snprintf(job_text + used, sizeof job_text - used, ", GPU busy %d%%",
                      int(100.0 * double(gpu_us - last_gpu_us) / 1e6 / seconds + 0.5));
    }
    last_gpu_us = gpu_us;
#ifdef PS2HOST_VULKAN
    if (ps2gpu::Display* display = WindowDisplay()) {
        const ps2gpu::Display::Pacing p = display->TakePacing();
        if (p.presents && seconds > 0) {
            const std::size_t used = std::strlen(job_text);
            std::snprintf(job_text + used, sizeof job_text - used,
                          ", presents %.1f/s every %.2f ms (jitter %.2f, longest %.1f)", double(p.presents) / seconds,
                          p.mean_ms, p.jitter_ms, p.longest_ms);
        }
    }
#endif
    static u64 last_guesses = 0;
    u64 guesses = 0, wrong = 0;
    Vif1Guesses(&guesses, &wrong);
    if (guesses != last_guesses) {
        const std::size_t used = std::strlen(job_text);
        std::snprintf(job_text + used, sizeof job_text - used, ", %llu status reads guessed (%llu wrong in all)",
                      (unsigned long long)(guesses - last_guesses), (unsigned long long)wrong);
    }
    last_guesses = guesses;
    // Frames here are vertical blanks; a game that cannot keep up draws a
    // picture every other one (or less), which the VIF1 transfers show.
    {
        const std::string cpu = timeline::ThreadCpu();
        if (!cpu.empty()) {
            const std::size_t used = std::strlen(job_text);
            std::snprintf(job_text + used, sizeof job_text - used, "; CPU: %s", cpu.c_str());
        }
    }
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[frames] %llu-%llu: %.2f s, %.1f frames a second, %.1f VIF1 transfers a second%s\n",
                 static_cast<unsigned long long>(last_frame), static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame), seconds,
                 seconds > 0 ? double(frame - last_frame) / seconds : 0.0,
                 seconds > 0 ? double(g_vif1_transfers - last_transfers) / seconds : 0.0,
                 ((lost != last_lost ? ", " + std::to_string(lost - last_lost) + " vertical blanks lost (the EE busy through them)"
                                    : std::string()) +
                 (idle != last_idle && seconds > 0
                      ? ", EE idle " + std::to_string(int(100.0 * double(idle - last_idle) / 1e9 / seconds + 0.5)) + "%"
                      : std::string()) + job_text).c_str());
    last_lost = lost;
    last_idle = idle;
    last = now;
    last_frame = frame;
    last_transfers = g_vif1_transfers;
}
bool UntilFrameReached() { return g_until_reached; }

// F12 (or L3+R3): the next frame captured whole, for looking into what it
// drew - captures/<time>-frame<N>/ beside the PC settings: the picture at
// the internal resolution and at the PS2's, every drawing pass, GS local
// memory and the GS trace of the frame.
std::atomic<bool> g_capture_request{false};
long long g_capture_frame = -1;
std::string g_capture_dir;

void StartCapture(u64 frame) {
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    fs::path base = SettingsPath().empty() ? fs::path("captures") : fs::path(SettingsPath()).parent_path() / "captures";
    char name[64];
    const std::time_t now = std::time(nullptr);
    std::tm tm{};
    localtime_s(&tm, &now);
    std::snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%04d%02d%02d-%02d%02d%02d-frame%llu", tm.tm_year + 1900, tm.tm_mon + 1,
                  tm.tm_mday, tm.tm_hour, tm.tm_min, tm.tm_sec, static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame + 1));
    const fs::path dir = base / name;
    std::error_code error;
    fs::create_directories(dir / "passes", error);
    if (error) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[capture] no directory %s: %s\n", dir.string().c_str(), error.message().c_str());
        return;
    }
    g_capture_dir = dir.string();
    // Two frames: a game drawing a picture every other blank (Burnout 3)
    // draws nothing in one of them.
    g_capture_frame = (long long)frame + 2;
    GpuCaptureBegin(frame + 1, (dir / "passes").string());
    gs::Gs& g = gs::TheGs();
    // The frames' GS stream (replay.bin), for --gs-replay: memory as it is
    // now, the GPU's drawing in it, the registers, then what comes.
    SyncGs();
    g.Finish();
    if (g.on_memory) g.on_memory(0, 16384, false);
    g.BeginRecord(std::fopen((dir / "replay.bin").string().c_str(), "wb"));
    if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen((dir / "trace.txt").string().c_str(), "w")) {
        g.trace_out = f;
        g.trace = true;
        std::fprintf(f, "[gs] ---- frame %llu (a capture)\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame + 1));
    }
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[capture] frame %llu to %s\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame + 1),
                 g_capture_dir.c_str());
}

void FinishCapture(u64 frame) {
    gs::Gs& g = gs::TheGs();
    SyncGs();
    g.EndRecord();
    if (g.trace_out != stderr) {
        g.trace = false;
        std::fclose(g.trace_out);
        g.trace_out = stderr;
    }
    const std::string screen = GpuCaptureScreen(g_capture_dir);
    g.Finish();
    if (g.on_memory) g.on_memory(0, 16384, false);      // the GPU's drawing, back in memory
    if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen((g_capture_dir + "/gsmem.bin").c_str(), "wb")) {
        std::fwrite(g.memory.data(), 1, 4u << 20, f);
        std::fclose(f);
    }
    if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen((g_capture_dir + "/info.txt").c_str(), "w")) {
        std::fprintf(f, "frame %llu\n%s\nresolution setting: %s\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame),
                     screen.c_str(), Setting("resolution", "original").c_str());
        std::fprintf(f, "files: screen.bmp (as drawn, at the internal resolution), screen_1x.bmp (the PS2's "
                        "640x448), passes/ (each target as a pass left it, at 1x), gsmem.bin (GS local memory "
                        "after the frame: engine/tools/gsmem.py), trace.txt (the frame's GS packets and "
                        "primitives), replay.bin (the frames' GS stream: --gs-replay, PS2HOST_REPLAY_GPU, "
                        "PS2HOST_REPLAY_SCALE, PS2HOST_REPLAY_STOP_PRIM)\n");
        std::fclose(f);
    }
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[capture] saved %s\n", g_capture_dir.c_str());
    g_capture_frame = -1;
}

void RequestCapture() { g_capture_request = true; }

void FrameDone(u64 frame) {
    FrameTimes(frame);
    timeline::Frame(frame);
    SampleFrame(frame);
    Vu::SnapshotFrame(frame);
    // Time passes: unmasked, PATH3 sends what it still holds (in turn with
    // VIF1's, whose state PATH3's is).
    Vif1Run([] {
        if (!g_path3_masked && !g_path3_held.empty()) ReleasePath3(true);
    });
    if (g_until_frame && frame >= g_until_frame && !g_until_reached) {
        g_until_reached = true;
        StopRequested() = true;
        ForEachContext([](lifted::Context& each) { each.budget = -1; });
    }
    const bool dump = !g_frames_dir.empty() && g_frames_written < g_frames_limit && frame >= g_frames_from &&
                      frame % u64(g_frames_every) == 0;
    // Nothing here reads the GS this frame (no picture to the CPU, no dump,
    // no trace): the GS thread ends the frame itself where the frame's
    // packets end - the GPU's frame, the window's picture - and the EE goes
    // straight on (it waited for the GS and the GPU at every frame before).
    // PS2HOST_CAPTURE_FRAME=N: as F12 at frame N (a scripted run's).
    static const long long capture_at = std::getenv("PS2HOST_CAPTURE_FRAME") ? std::atoll(std::getenv("PS2HOST_CAPTURE_FRAME")) : -1;
    if ((long long)frame == capture_at) g_capture_request = true;
    if (g_capture_request.exchange(false) && g_capture_frame < 0 && GpuPrimary()) StartCapture(frame);
    const bool capturing = g_capture_frame >= 0 && (long long)frame == g_capture_frame;
    const bool cpu_reads_gs = dump || (g_dump_frame >= 0 && (long long)frame == g_dump_frame) || g_trace_frame >= 0 ||
                              capturing;
    if (!cpu_reads_gs && GsFrame(frame)) {
        DbcFrame();
        if (!PumpWindow()) throw GuestExit{0};          // the user closed the window
        return;
    }
    // What reads the GS from here on - the picture, the GPU's frame, the
    // dumps - sees it with all of the frame's packets taken.
    JoinVif1();
    SyncGs();
    if (capturing) FinishCapture(frame);
    if (g_dump_frame >= 0 && (long long)frame == g_dump_frame) {
        gs::Gs& g = gs::TheGs();
        g.Finish();
        if (g.on_memory) g.on_memory(0, 16384, false);      // the GPU's drawing, back in memory
        const std::string path = (g_frames_dir.empty() ? std::string(".") : g_frames_dir) + "/gsmem_" +
                                 std::to_string(frame) + ".bin";
        if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb")) {
            std::fwrite(g.memory.data(), 1, 4u << 20, f);
            std::fclose(f);
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[gs] local memory after frame %llu written to %s\n",
                         static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame), path.c_str());
        }
    }
    if (g_trace_frame >= 0) {
        // From the end of the frame before to the end of six frames on: the
        // game draws a picture across several.
        if ((long long)frame + 1 == g_trace_frame) gs::TheGs().trace = true;
        else if ((long long)frame == g_trace_frame + 5) gs::TheGs().trace = false;
        if (gs::TheGs().trace) std::fprintf(gs::TheGs().trace_out, "[gs] ---- frame %llu\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame + 1));
    }
    DbcFrame();
    PresentFrame();
    if (WindowClosed()) throw GuestExit{0};             // the user closed the window
    GpuShadowFrame(frame, dump ? g_frames_dir : std::string());
    if (!dump) return;
    char name[64];
    std::snprintf(name, sizeof name, "/frame_%06llu.bmp", static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame));
    if (gs::TheGs().WriteBmp(g_frames_dir + name)) ++g_frames_written;
    // VU1's memories beside the picture, for engine/tools/vudis.py.
    for (const auto& [file, span] : {std::make_pair("/vu1_micro.bin", Vu1().micro), std::make_pair("/vu1_data.bin", Vu1().data)})
        if (FILE* out = std::fopen((g_frames_dir + file).c_str(), "wb")) {
            std::fwrite(span.data(), 1, span.size(), out);
            std::fclose(out);
        }
}

bool Vif1Guessable(u32 address, u32 size) { return size == 4 && address == kGifStat; }

bool Vif1Guess(u32 address, u32* value) {
    if (!Vif1Async() || address != kGifStat || g_guessing_off || !g_gif_shadow.known) return false;
    // Read again straight away, the game waiting for it to change: it waits
    // for the worker.
    if (g_guessed_last == address) return false;
    g_guessed_last = address;
    const u32 guess = g_gif_shadow.value;
    ++g_guesses;
    Vif1Run([guess] {
        const u32 actual = *Register(kGifStat);
        if (actual == guess) return;
        g_guessing_off = true;
        if (g_wrong.fetch_add(1) < 8)
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[vif1] GIF_STAT guessed 0x%08X, held 0x%08X: no more guesses\n", unsigned(guess),
                         unsigned(actual));
    });
    *value = guess;
    return true;
}

void Vif1Settled(u32 address, u32 value) {
    if (address != kGifStat) return;
    if (g_check_guesses) {
        // What real time would have answered: a guess, or a wait for the worker.
        if (g_gif_shadow.known && g_guessed_last != address) {
            g_guessed_last = address;
            ++g_guesses;
            if (value != g_gif_shadow.value && g_wrong.fetch_add(1) < 32)
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[check] GIF_STAT would have been guessed 0x%08X, holds 0x%08X\n",
                             unsigned(g_gif_shadow.value), unsigned(value));
        } else {
            g_guessed_last = 0;
        }
        g_gif_shadow = {true, value};
        return;
    }
    if (g_guessed_last == address) g_guessed_last = 0;
    GifShadowFromMemory();
}

void Vif1Guesses(u64* guesses, u64* wrong) {
    *guesses = g_guesses.load();
    *wrong = g_wrong.load();
}

void SetCheckGuesses(bool on) { g_check_guesses = on; }

void DmaChannelEnded(u32 channel) {
    SetDStat(d_stat | (1u << channel));
    PostDmac(channel);
}

void InstallDevices() {
    Memory& m = GuestMemory();
    for (const Channel& ch : kChannels) {
        if (ch.base == 0x1000B000u || ch.base == 0x1000B400u) continue;     // the IPU's (ipu.cpp)
        const u32 chcr = ch.base, madr = ch.base + kMadr, qwc = ch.base + kQwc;
        m.OnWrite(chcr, [ch, madr, qwc, chcr](u32, u64 value) {
            if (!(value & 0x100)) return;                       // STR not set
            Memory& memory = GuestMemory();
            // The text only when it is logged: a DMA start is thousands a second.
            const std::string key = std::string("dma ") + ch.name;
            const bool traced = gs::TheGs().trace && (ch.base == 0x10009000u || ch.base == 0x1000A000u);
            const bool describe = traced || Noting(key);
            char text[256] = "";
            if (describe)
                std::snprintf(text, sizeof text,
                              "DMA %s started: CHCR=0x%08X MADR=0x%08X QWC=%u TADR=0x%08X (completed at once)",
                              ch.name, unsigned(value), unsigned(memory.Read(madr, 4)),
                              unsigned(memory.Read(qwc, 4)), unsigned(memory.Read(ch.base + kTadr, 4)));
            if (traced) std::fprintf(gs::TheGs().trace_out, "[dma] %s\n", text);
            if (ch.base == 0x10009000u) ++g_vif1_transfers;
            const std::string walked = ch.walked ? Walk(ch, u32(value), describe) : std::string();
            if (describe) Note(key, ch.walked ? std::string(text) + ": " + walked : std::string(text));
            *Register(chcr) &= ~0x100u;                         // done
            SetDStat(d_stat | (1u << ch.status_bit));
            PostDmac(ch.status_bit);
        });
    }
    m.OnWrite(kDStat, [](u32, u64 value) {
        const u32 written = u32(value);
        SetDStat((d_stat & ~(written & 0xFFFFu)) ^ (written & 0xFFFF0000u));
    });
    Vif1().on_mask_path3 = [](bool masked) {
        if (gs::TheGs().trace)
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[vif1] MSKPATH3 %d, %zu PATH3 words held\n", int(masked), g_path3_held.size());
        u32* stat = reinterpret_cast<u32*>(GuestMemory().Translate(kGifStat, 4));
        // Unmasking lets PATH3 take its turn: the packet group it is in goes
        // through before a mask can stop it again.
        *stat = masked ? (*stat | kGifStatM3P) : (*stat & ~(kGifStatM3P | kGifStatFqc));
        g_path3_masked = masked;
        if (!masked) ReleasePath3(false);
    };
    Vif1().on_direct = [](u32 word) { GsWord(2, word); };
    Vif1().on_direct_block = [](const u32* words, u32 count, u32 from) {
        if (!g_path2_filter || from == gs::Gs::kNoSource) return GsWords(2, words, count, from);
        static std::vector<u32> copy;
        copy.assign(words, words + count);
        g_path2_filter(copy.data(), count, from);
        GsWords(2, copy.data(), count, from);
    };
    Vif1().on_trace = [](const char* what) {
        if (gs::TheGs().trace) std::fprintf(gs::TheGs().trace_out, "[vif1] %s, %zu PATH3 words held\n", what, g_path3_held.size());
        // FLUSHA waits for PATH3 to finish: unmasked, all it holds goes.
        if (!g_path3_masked) ReleasePath3(true);
    };
    // VU1 behind VIF1; its XGKICKs are GIF PATH1.
    Vif1().vu = &Vu1();
    Vif1().double_buffered = true;
    Vif0().vu = &Vu0();
    Vu1().on_kick = [](u64 low, u64 high) { GsQword(1, low, high); };
    Vu1().on_kick_block = [](const u32* words, u32 count) { GsWords(1, words, count); };
    // The GS's privileged registers: what is displayed. A 64-bit store reaches
    // both words; each passes the whole register on.
    for (u32 reg : {0x12000000u, 0x12000020u, 0x12000070u, 0x12000080u, 0x12000090u, 0x120000A0u, 0x120000E0u}) {
        for (u32 half : {0u, 4u}) {
            GuestMemory().OnWrite(reg + half, [reg](u32, u64) {
                GsPrivileged(reg, GuestMemory().Read(reg, 8));
            });
        }
    }
    // The FIFO takes whole quadwords; the store's last word hands all four over.
    // With VIF1's worker, in turn after what it has (memory.cpp lets the
    // store through without waiting).
    m.OnWrite(kVif1Fifo + 12, [](u32, u64) {
        const u32* fifo = Register(kVif1Fifo);
        const std::array<u32, 4> words{fifo[0], fifo[1], fifo[2], fifo[3]};
        if (Shadowing()) {
            // Commands of a word, as the FIFO's quadwords are here: MSKPATH3's
            // effect followed, the others leaving GIF_STAT be; anything else,
            // and what it leaves is not known.
            GifShadowFromMemory();
            g_guessed_last = 0;
            for (u32 word : words) {
                const u32 cmd = (word >> 24) & 0x7F;
                if (cmd == 0x06) ShadowMask((word >> 15) & 1);
                else if (!(cmd <= 0x05 || cmd == 0x07 || cmd == 0x10 || cmd == 0x11 || cmd == 0x13))
                    g_gif_shadow.known = false;
            }
        }
        Vif1Run([words] {
            for (u32 word : words) Vif1().Word(word);
        });
    });
    m.OnRead(kGsCsr, [](u32, u64 stored) {
        static u64 field = 0;
        field ^= 1u << 13;                          // FIELD alternates each frame
        return (stored & ~u64(1u << 13)) | field | (1u << 3);   // VSINT pending
    });
    m.OnRead(0x1000F000u, [](u32, u64) { return u64(IntcStat()); });     // INTC_STAT
    m.OnWrite(0x1000F000u, [](u32, u64 value) { ClearIntcStat(u32(value) & 0x7FFFu); });
    InstallTimers();
    InstallIpu();
}

}  // namespace ps2host
```

```cpp
#include "ps2host/disc.h"

#include <cctype>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

u32 Le32(const u8* p) { return u32(p[0]) | u32(p[1]) << 8 | u32(p[2]) << 16 | u32(p[3]) << 24; }

std::string Upper(std::string s) {
    for (char& ch : s) ch = char(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)));
    return s;
}

// A directory record's name without its version (";1") and trailing dot.
std::string Bare(std::string name) {
    const auto semicolon = name.find(';');
    if (semicolon != std::string::npos) name.resize(semicolon);
    if (!name.empty() && name.back() == '.') name.pop_back();
    return Upper(name);
}

}  // namespace

Disc::~Disc() {
    if (file_) std::fclose(file_);
}

namespace {

// The image a .cue sheet names in its first FILE line, beside the sheet.
std::string CueImage(const std::string& cue_path) {
    std::FILE* cue = std::fopen(cue_path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!cue) return "";
    std::string text;
    char chunk[4096];
    for (std::size_t n; (n = std::fread(chunk, 1, sizeof chunk, cue)) > 0;) text.append(chunk, n);
    std::fclose(cue);
    for (std::size_t at = 0; at < text.size();) {
        std::size_t end = text.find_first_of("\r\n", at);
        if (end == std::string::npos) end = text.size();
        std::string line = text.substr(at, end - at);
        at = end + 1;
        line.erase(0, line.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
        if (Upper(line.substr(0, 5)) != "FILE ") continue;
        std::string name = line.substr(5);
        name.erase(0, name.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
        if (!name.empty() && name[0] == '"') {
            const std::size_t close = name.find('"', 1);
            name = name.substr(1, close == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : close - 1);
        } else {
            name = name.substr(0, name.find_first_of(" \t"));
        }
        const std::size_t slash = cue_path.find_last_of("/\\");
        return slash == std::string::npos ? name : cue_path.substr(0, slash + 1) + name;
    }
    return "";
}

const u8 kSync[12] = {0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00};

u8 ToBcd(u32 v) { return u8((v / 10) << 4 | (v % 10)); }

}  // namespace

bool Disc::Open(const std::string& path) {
    if (file_) std::fclose(file_);
    file_ = nullptr;
    memory_.clear();
    std::string image = path;
    if (image.size() > 4 && Upper(image.substr(image.size() - 4)) == ".CUE") {
        image = CueImage(path);
        if (image.empty()) return false;
    }
    file_ = std::fopen(image.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!file_) return false;
    _fseeki64(file_, 0, SEEK_END);
    size_ = u64(_ftelli64(file_));
    DetectFormat();
    return true;
}

void Disc::Use(std::vector<u8> image) {
    memory_ = std::move(image);
    size_ = memory_.size();
    DetectFormat();
}

// A raw image: every sector starts with the sync pattern, and sector 16 - the
// volume descriptor, on every PS2 disc - says the mode.
void Disc::DetectFormat() {
    data_offset_ = 0;
    u8 head[16];
    if (size_ >= 17 * u64(kRawSectorSize) && ReadBytes(16 * u64(kRawSectorSize), 16, head) &&
        std::memcmp(head, kSync, 12) == 0 && (head[15] == 1 || head[15] == 2))
        data_offset_ = head[15] == 1 ? 16 : 24;
    sectors_ = u32(size_ / (data_offset_ ? kRawSectorSize : kSectorSize));
}

bool Disc::IsCd() const {
    // A CD holds at most about 360,000 sectors (80 minutes); a DVD image is raw-less.
    return data_offset_ != 0 || sectors_ <= 360000;
}

bool Disc::ReadBytes(u64 offset, u64 length, u8* out) {
    if (offset + length > size_) return false;
    if (!memory_.empty()) {
        std::memcpy(out, memory_.data() + offset, size_t(length));
        return true;
    }
    if (!file_ || _fseeki64(file_, s64(offset), SEEK_SET) != 0) return false;
    return std::fread(out, 1, size_t(length), file_) == length;
}

bool Disc::Read(u32 lsn, u32 count, u8* out) {
    if (u64(lsn) + count > sectors_) return false;
    if (!data_offset_) return ReadBytes(u64(lsn) * kSectorSize, u64(count) * kSectorSize, out);
    // Raw: read the whole run at once, then keep each sector's data.
    std::vector<u8> raw(std::size_t(count) * kRawSectorSize);
    if (!ReadBytes(u64(lsn) * kRawSectorSize, raw.size(), raw.data())) return false;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        std::memcpy(out + std::size_t(i) * kSectorSize, &raw[std::size_t(i) * kRawSectorSize + data_offset_],
                    kSectorSize);
    return true;
}

bool Disc::ReadPattern(u32 lsn, u32 count, u32 pattern, u8* out) {
    if (pattern != 1 && pattern != 2) return Read(lsn, count, out);
    if (u64(lsn) + count > sectors_) return false;
    const u32 size = PatternSize(pattern);
    // 2340 starts at the header (offset 12), 2328 after the subheader (24).
    const u32 from = pattern == 2 ? 12 : 24;
    std::vector<u8> raw(kRawSectorSize);
    for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        u8* dst = out + std::size_t(i) * size;
        if (data_offset_) {
            if (!ReadBytes(u64(lsn + i) * kRawSectorSize, kRawSectorSize, raw.data())) return false;
            std::memcpy(dst, &raw[from], size);
            continue;
        }
        // An .iso: a Mode 2 Form 1 sector made around its data.
        std::memset(raw.data(), 0, raw.size());
        const u32 address = lsn + i + 150;          // the 2-second lead-in
        raw[12] = ToBcd(address / 75 / 60);
        raw[13] = ToBcd(address / 75 % 60);
        raw[14] = ToBcd(address % 75);
        raw[15] = 2;
        raw[18] = raw[22] = 0x08;                   // subheader submode: data
        if (!Read(lsn + i, 1, &raw[24])) return false;
        std::memcpy(dst, &raw[from], size);
    }
    return true;
}

bool Disc::Find(const std::string& path, File* out) {
    // The primary volume descriptor, sector 16, holds the root directory's record.
    std::vector<u8> sector(kSectorSize);
    if (!Read(16, 1, sector.data()) || sector[0] != 1 || std::memcmp(&sector[1], "CD001", 5) != 0)
        return false;
    File directory{Le32(&sector[156 + 2]), Le32(&sector[156 + 10])};
    std::string rest = path;
    for (char& ch : rest) if (ch == '/') ch = '\\';
    while (!rest.empty()) {
        while (!rest.empty() && rest[0] == '\\') rest.erase(0, 1);
        if (rest.empty()) break;
        const auto end = rest.find('\\');
        const std::string part = Bare(rest.substr(0, end));
        rest = end == std::string::npos ? "" : rest.substr(end);
        // Scan the directory's records for this part.
        const u32 sectors = (directory.size + kSectorSize - 1) / kSectorSize;
        std::vector<u8> data(size_t(sectors) * kSectorSize);
        if (!Read(directory.lsn, sectors, data.data())) return false;
        bool found = false;
        for (u32 at = 0; at < directory.size;) {
            const u8 length = data[at];
            if (length == 0) {                  // records never cross a sector boundary
                at = (at / kSectorSize + 1) * kSectorSize;
                continue;
            }
            const u8 name_length = data[at + 32];
            const std::string name(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&data[at + 33]), name_length);
            if (name_length > 1 || (name_length == 1 && name[0] > 1)) {
                if (Bare(name) == part) {
                    directory = File{Le32(&data[at + 2]), Le32(&data[at + 10])};
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            at += length;
        }
        if (!found) return false;
    }
    *out = directory;
    return true;
}

bool Disc::ReadFile(const std::string& path, std::vector<u8>* out) {
    File file;
    if (!Find(path, &file)) return false;
    out->assign(size_t(file.size + kSectorSize - 1) / kSectorSize * kSectorSize, 0);
    if (!Read(file.lsn, u32(out->size() / kSectorSize), out->data())) return false;
    out->resize(file.size);
    return true;
}

std::string Disc::BootPath() {
    std::vector<u8> cnf;
    if (!ReadFile("SYSTEM.CNF", &cnf)) return "";
    const std::string text(cnf.begin(), cnf.end());
    for (std::size_t at = 0; at < text.size();) {
        std::size_t end = text.find_first_of("\r\n", at);
        if (end == std::string::npos) end = text.size();
        const std::string line = text.substr(at, end - at);
        at = end + 1;
        // BOOT2 = cdrom0:\SLUS_210.50;1
        const std::size_t equals = line.find('=');
        if (equals == std::string::npos) continue;
        std::string key = line.substr(0, equals);
        key.erase(key.find_last_not_of(" \t") + 1);
        if (Upper(key) != "BOOT2") continue;
        std::string value = line.substr(equals + 1);
        value.erase(0, value.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
        value.erase(value.find_last_not_of(" \t") + 1);
        const std::size_t colon = value.find(':');
        return colon == std::string::npos ? value : value.substr(colon + 1);
    }
    return "";
}

Disc& GuestDisc() {
    static Disc disc;
    return disc;
}
```

`host/src/dma.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * Source DMA transfers, walked at once (dma.h).
 */

#include "ps2host/dma.h"

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

#include "ps2host/memory.h"

namespace ps2host {

std::uint32_t g_dma_source = 0;


namespace {

constexpr std::uint32_t kScratchpad = 0x70000000u;

std::uint32_t Address(std::uint64_t tag) {
    const std::uint32_t address = std::uint32_t(tag >> 32) & 0x7FFFFFF0u;
    return (tag >> 63) ? kScratchpad | (address & 0x3FF0u) : address;
}

void Send(std::uint32_t from, std::uint32_t quadwords, DmaOutcome& outcome, const DmaBlockSink& words) {
    Memory& m = GuestMemory();
    // Main RAM or the scratchpad, as DMA reads them: one pointer for the lot
    // (a word at a time through Read cost a tenth of a frame). Anything with
    // register hooks goes word by word.
    const std::uint32_t physical = from & 0x1FFFFFFFu;
    const bool plain = physical < 0x10000000u || (from >> 28) == 0x7;
    const std::uint8_t* p = plain && quadwords ? m.Translate(from, 16 * quadwords) : nullptr;
    if (p && reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p) % 4 == 0) {
        words(reinterpret_cast<const std::uint32_t*>(p), 4 * quadwords, from);
    } else {
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < 4 * quadwords; ++i) {
            const std::uint32_t value = std::uint32_t(m.Read(from + 4 * i, 4));
            words(&value, 1, from + 4 * i);
        }
    }
    outcome.quadwords += quadwords;
}

}  // namespace

DmaOutcome SendDma(DmaChannelState& ch, const std::function<void(std::uint32_t)>& word,
                   std::uint32_t max_tags, bool tags) {
    return SendDmaBlocks(ch, [&word](const std::uint32_t* words, std::uint32_t count, std::uint32_t from) {
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            g_dma_source = from + 4 * i;
            word(words[i]);
        }
    }, max_tags, tags);
}

DmaOutcome SendDmaBlocks(DmaChannelState& ch, const DmaBlockSink& word, std::uint32_t max_tags,
                         bool tags) {
    DmaOutcome outcome;
    const std::uint32_t mode = (ch.chcr >> 2) & 3;
    // Normal mode, or a chain resumed with QWC still owed: data from MADR first.
    if (ch.qwc) {
        Send(ch.madr, ch.qwc, outcome, word);
        ch.madr += 16 * ch.qwc;
        ch.qwc = 0;
    }
    if (mode != 1) {
        outcome.ended = true;
        return outcome;
    }
    // TTE: the VIFs take a tag's upper half as VIFcodes; the GIF does not. Sent
    // there, the zeros ahead of a packet misaligned its GIFtag - Resident Evil
    // Outbreak starts PATH3 with TTE set in a scene after a door, its frame's
    // register packet (ZBUF's depth clear among them) was lost, and the scene
    // was drawn against a depth buffer never cleared: black.
    const bool transfer_tags = tags && ((ch.chcr >> 6) & 1), irq_ends = (ch.chcr >> 7) & 1;
    std::uint32_t depth = (ch.chcr >> 4) & 3;       // ASP: call stack depth
    Memory& m = GuestMemory();
    while (outcome.tags < max_tags) {
        const std::uint64_t tag = m.Read(ch.tadr, 8);
        ++outcome.tags;
        ch.chcr = (ch.chcr & 0xFFFFu) | (std::uint32_t(tag) & 0xFFFF0000u);     // TAG
        if (transfer_tags) {
            const std::uint32_t high[2] = {std::uint32_t(m.Read(ch.tadr + 8, 4)), std::uint32_t(m.Read(ch.tadr + 12, 4))};
            word(high, 2, ch.tadr + 8);
        }
        const std::uint32_t qwc = std::uint32_t(tag) & 0xFFFFu;
        const std::uint32_t id = std::uint32_t(tag >> 28) & 7;
        const std::uint32_t after = ch.tadr + 16;
        bool end = false;
        std::uint32_t data = after;
        switch (id) {
            case 0: data = Address(tag); end = true; break;                         // refe
            case 1: ch.tadr = after + 16 * qwc; break;                              // cnt
            case 2: ch.tadr = Address(tag); break;                                  // next
            case 3: case 4: data = Address(tag); ch.tadr = after; break;            // ref, refs
            case 5:                                                                 // call
                if (depth == 0) ch.asr0 = after + 16 * qwc;
                else ch.asr1 = after + 16 * qwc;
                if (depth < 2) ++depth;
                ch.tadr = Address(tag);
                break;
            case 6:                                                                 // ret
                if (depth == 0) end = true;
                else ch.tadr = (--depth == 0) ? ch.asr0 : ch.asr1;
                break;
            case 7: end = true; break;                                              // end
        }
        Send(data, qwc, outcome, word);
        ch.madr = data + 16 * qwc;
        if (end || (irq_ends && (tag >> 31) & 1)) {
            outcome.ended = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    ch.chcr = (ch.chcr & ~0x30u) | (depth << 4);
    return outcome;
}

}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/fileio.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The IOP's file I/O service (server 0x80000001), on the host: files on the game
 * disc ("cdrom0:\\DATA\\CARS.BIN;1") read from the user's disc image.
 *
 * The protocol, as Burnout 3's EE-side library (0x0010FFA0-0x00112F9C) speaks
 * it: every request starts with
 *   0x00  a semaphore the EE created for this request
 *   0x04  the EE address of the result word
 *   0x08  the result's size (4)
 * then the procedure's arguments from 0x0C. The RPC's own answer only
 * acknowledges the request (nonzero); the IOP does the work, writes the result
 * and signals the semaphore, and the EE waits on that. Here the work is done at
 * once, so the semaphore is signalled before the EE gets to wait on it.
 *
 *   procedure 0  open   flags 0x0C, mode 0x10, path 0x14 (1,024 bytes) -> descriptor
 *   procedure 1  close  descriptor 0x0C                                -> 0
 *   procedure 2  read   descriptor 0x0C, EE buffer 0x10, size 0x14      -> bytes read
 *   procedure 4  lseek  descriptor 0x0C, offset 0x10, whence 0x14       -> position
 *
 * Procedure 0xFF initialises the service: its 8-byte answer begins with the
 * module's release, four characters ("2800"), which newer libraries check
 * against their own before any request (Resident Evil Outbreak's sceOpen fails
 * without it); the second word is 0.
 *
 * Any other procedure is noted and fails (-1); they are added as games need them.
 */

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "ps2host/disc.h"
#include "ps2host/host.h"
#include "ps2host/memory.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

constexpr s32 kNoSuchFile = -2, kBadDescriptor = -9;

struct OpenFile {
    Disc::File file;
    u32 position = 0;
};

std::map<s32, OpenFile>& Files() {
    static std::map<s32, OpenFile> files;
    return files;
}

u32 At(const std::vector<u8>& data, std::size_t offset) {
    u32 value = 0;
    if (offset + 4 <= data.size()) std::memcpy(&value, &data[offset], 4);
    return value;
}

s32 Open(const std::vector<u8>& data) {
    if (data.size() < 0x14) return kNoSuchFile;
    const char* begin = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&data[0x14]);
    const std::string path(begin, strnlen(begin, std::min<std::size_t>(1024, data.size() - 0x14)));
    // "cdrom0:\\DATA\\CARS.BIN;1": the device, then the path on it.
    const std::size_t colon = path.find(':');
    const std::string device = colon == std::string::npos ? "" : path.substr(0, colon);
    const std::string rest = colon == std::string::npos ? path : path.substr(colon + 1);
    Disc::File file;
    if (device.rfind("cdrom", 0) != 0 || !GuestDisc().IsOpen() || !GuestDisc().Find(rest, &file)) {
        Note("open " + path, "file I/O: open " + path + " (not found)");
        return kNoSuchFile;
    }
    static s32 next = 3;
    Files()[next] = OpenFile{file, 0};
    Note("open " + path, "file I/O: open " + path);
    return next++;
}

s32 Read(const std::vector<u8>& data) {
    auto found = Files().find(s32(At(data, 0x0C)));
    if (found == Files().end()) return kBadDescriptor;
    OpenFile& f = found->second;
    const u32 buffer = At(data, 0x10);
    u32 size = At(data, 0x14);
    size = std::min(size, f.file.size > f.position ? f.file.size - f.position : 0u);
    // Whole sectors from the disc, then the bytes asked for out of them.
    const u32 first = f.position / kSectorSize, last = (f.position + size + kSectorSize - 1) / kSectorSize;
    std::vector<u8> sectors(std::size_t(last - first) * kSectorSize);
    if (size && !GuestDisc().Read(f.file.lsn + first, last - first, sectors.data())) return -5;
    Memory& m = GuestMemory();
    const u32 skip = f.position - first * kSectorSize;
    if (u8* out = m.Translate(buffer, size); out && size) {
        std::memcpy(out, sectors.data() + skip, size);
    } else {
        for (u32 i = 0; i < size; ++i) m.Write(buffer + i, sectors[skip + i], 1);
    }
    f.position += size;
    return s32(size);
}

s32 Seek(const std::vector<u8>& data) {
    auto found = Files().find(s32(At(data, 0x0C)));
    if (found == Files().end()) return kBadDescriptor;
    OpenFile& f = found->second;
    const s32 offset = s32(At(data, 0x10));
    const u32 whence = At(data, 0x14);
    const s64 base = whence == 0 ? 0 : whence == 1 ? s64(f.position) : s64(f.file.size);
    const s64 position = std::max<s64>(0, base + offset);
    f.position = u32(position);
    return s32(position);
}

std::vector<u8> FileIo(u32 procedure, const std::vector<u8>& data) {
    if (procedure == 0xFF) {                                  // the service's initialisation
        std::vector<u8> answer(8, 0);
        std::memcpy(answer.data(), IopRelease(), 4);
        return answer;
    }
    s32 result;
    switch (procedure) {
        case 0: result = Open(data); break;
        case 1: result = Files().erase(s32(At(data, 0x0C))) ? 0 : kBadDescriptor; break;
        case 2: result = Read(data); break;
        case 4: result = Seek(data); break;
        default:
            Note("fileio " + std::to_string(procedure),
                 "file I/O: procedure " + std::to_string(procedure) + " (not implemented: fails)");
            result = -1;
            break;
    }
    // The result where the EE asked for it, then its semaphore: the work is done.
    if (const u32 where = At(data, 0x04)) GuestMemory().Write(where, u32(result), 4);
    const s32 semaphore = s32(At(data, 0x00));
    if (semaphore > 0) SignalSemaphore(u32(semaphore));
    return {1, 0, 0, 0};
}

}  // namespace

void InstallFileIo() { RegisterRpcServer(0x80000001u, FileIo); }

}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/gpu_bridge.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The GPU GS renderer (engine/gpu, engine/docs/GPU.md) driven by the host's GS
 * model, in one of two modes.
 *
 * --gpu-shadow: beside the software GS, and checked against it. Every
 * primitive the software GS draws is also handed to ps2gpu with the state it was
 * drawn with. Textures are decoded from the software GS's local memory (with
 * --gpu-shadow-rtt, a texture that is a GPU target is sampled from the target
 * instead); depth buffers start each frame as local memory has them. At the end
 * of each frame every target drawn into is read back and compared with local
 * memory, and the agreement is reported.
 *
 * --gpu: instead of the software GS. The GS model still takes every GIF packet,
 * register and image transfer, but draws nothing (Gs::rasterize false); the GPU
 * draws, and its images stand for regions of local memory.
 *
 * Local memory is kept twice: the GS model's, which the CPU reads and writes,
 * and a copy on the GPU (GsRenderer::Memory*), which images are swizzled into
 * and out of by a compute shader; per 256-byte block the bridge knows which
 * copy is current. Each GPU image (a target or depth buffer, with the blocks
 * it covers) knows whether the GPU has drawn what memory lacks (gpu_newer) or
 * memory has changed under it (stale). Before the CPU reads or writes local
 * memory - a transfer, a local copy, a CLUT load, a texture decoded, the
 * picture shown - the GPU images over it are swizzled into the GPU's copy and
 * the blocks the CPU lacks come back to it; after it is written, the images
 * there are stale and reload, from the GPU's copy once the CPU's writes have
 * gone over. A target drawn under another width or format than one it
 * overlaps (Burnout 3's reflection buffers, the race's blur passes in its
 * depth buffer's memory), or a depth buffer drawn into as colour, is
 * reconciled the same way - all of it on the GPU, waiting for nothing. An image stands for the
 * rows drawn into so far, not all the scissor allows: Burnout 3's depth buffer
 * starts where its frame buffer's 448 rows end, and a 512-row reach would have
 * each depth write make the frame stale. A texture that is a target is sampled
 * from the target itself. Other textures are decoded into a cache keyed by
 * their registers, TEXA and their CLUT, dropped when memory under them is
 * written or the GPU draws over them.
 *
 * Known difference: the GPU's blender rounds where the GS truncates, so a
 * blended pixel can be 1 brighter (invisible; in shadow runs, Burnout 3's frame
 * copy doubles it into the 16-bit display buffer).
 *
 * Without PS2HOST_VULKAN the options report that they are unavailable.
 */

#include <algorithm>
#include <bitset>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <list>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <tuple>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#define XXH_INLINE_ALL
#include "xxhash.h"

#include "ps2host/gs.h"
#include "ps2host/profile.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"
#include "ps2host/timeline.h"
#include "ps2host/settings.h"
#include "ps2host/texture_pack.h"

#if PS2HOST_VULKAN
#include "ps2gpu/display.h"
#include "ps2gpu/gs_renderer.h"
#endif

namespace ps2host {

namespace {
std::vector<u32> g_pipeline_hints;      // SetGpuPipelineHints
}  // namespace

void SetGpuPipelineHints(const u32* keys, std::size_t count) { g_pipeline_hints.assign(keys, keys + count); }

#if PS2HOST_VULKAN

ps2gpu::Gpu* WindowGpu();       // window.cpp: the window's device, when there is one

namespace {

using gs::u32;
using gs::u64;

u32 Bits(u64 value, int low, int count) { return u32((value >> low) & ((1ull << count) - 1)); }

/* Bits a pixel of a format takes in local memory (the 8H/4HL/4HH formats live
   in 32-bit pixels). */
u32 PixelBits(u32 psm) {
    switch (psm) {
        case gs::PSMCT16: case gs::PSMCT16S: case gs::PSMZ16: case gs::PSMZ16S: return 16;
        case gs::PSMT8: return 8;
        case gs::PSMT4: return 4;
        default: return 32;
    }
}

bool Is16(u32 psm) { return psm == gs::PSMCT16 || psm == gs::PSMCT16S || psm == gs::PSMZ16 || psm == gs::PSMZ16S; }

/* The blocks a buffer's first `rows` rows take: whole rows of pages (32 blocks
   each), FBW pages wide. */
std::pair<u32, u32> Blocks(u32 fbp, u32 fbw, u32 psm, u32 rows) {
    const u32 page_rows = Is16(psm) ? 64 : 32;
    const u32 begin = fbp * 32;
    return {begin, begin + std::max(1u, (rows + page_rows - 1) / page_rows) * std::max(1u, fbw) * 32};
}

u32 To16(u32 c) {
    return ((c >> 3) & 31) | (((c >> 11) & 31) << 5) | (((c >> 19) & 31) << 10) | ((c >> 31) << 15);
}

u32 From16(u32 c) {
    return ((c & 31) << 3) | (((c >> 5) & 31) << 11) | (((c >> 10) & 31) << 19) | ((c & 0x8000) ? 0x80000000u : 0);
}

struct Extent {
    u32 x1 = 0, y1 = 0;             // the furthest pixel drawn, exclusive
};

/* Local memory's 512 pages (8 KB, 32 blocks each), as a set. */
using Pages = std::bitset<512>;

/* A GPU image standing for a region of local memory (--gpu). */
struct Owned {
    u32 fbp = 0, fbw = 1, psm = 0;  // FBP (ZBP) in 2048-word units, FBW, PSM
    bool depth = false;
    u32 width = 0, height = 0;      // the image
    // The blocks it stands for: the rows used so far (drawn into, or sampled),
    // of all it could hold; of those, the ones the GPU has drawn into.
    u32 begin = 0, end = 0, full_end = 0;
    u32 drawn_end = 0;
    // The blocks drawn into since it last went to GPU memory: what another
    // image over them must wait for (not all it was ever drawn over - the
    // race's depth buffer is cleared to 512 rows once a frame, over the glow
    // buffers after its 448, and drawn into below 448 ten thousand times).
    u32 dirty_begin = ~0u, dirty_end = 0;
    u32 x1 = 0, y1 = 0;             // how much of it the GPU has drawn
    bool gpu_newer = false;         // drawn on the GPU, not yet in local memory
    bool stale = true;              // local memory changed since the image was loaded
    bool stale_beyond = false;      // ...in rows past `end`: stale when it grows into them
    int why = 0;                    // what made it stale: 0 new, 1 memory written, 2 a draw over it, 3 another's write-back
    bool by16 = false;              // ...only ever a 16-bit view's drawing (Burnout 3's depth into the frame's alpha)
    // The rows a reload brings back (stale ones), [stale_row0, stale_row1):
    // a reload was the whole image, and the race's blur passes, drawn into
    // the first rows of its depth buffer's memory, had its 640x448 reloaded
    // a thousand times a second for a few rows each.
    u32 stale_row0 = 0, stale_row1 = ~0u;
    // The same by page, as finely as known: what changed under the image
    // since it was loaded, and what it drew since its last write-back. A
    // texture sampled from it needs neither unless the pages it reads are
    // in them (the race's road reads 16 texels of a 1024x256 view over its
    // depth buffer, while drawing Z into other pages of it - 200 reloads,
    // each with the depth buffer's write-back, a picture).
    Pages stale_pages, dirty_pages;
    // The page rectangle last drawn (x0, x1, y0, y1, inclusive), all of it
    // in dirty_pages while `rect_dirty`: most primitives land inside it.
    u32 rect[4] = {};
    bool rect_dirty = false;
    u64 reloads[4] = {};            // reloads, by why
    u64 drawn_serial = 0;           // when the GPU last drew into it (Bridge::serial)
    u64 checked = 0;                // Bridge::newer_epoch when Use last looked at the others
};

/* A texture decoded into the renderer (--gpu). */
struct Cached {
    u64 renderer_key = 0;
    // A texture pack's replacement (texture_pack.h): drawn instead, or its
    // file still being read (looked for again each time it is drawn); as of
    // the pack's generation (Tab turns it on and off).
    bool replaced = false, pack_pending = false;
    texture_pack::Name pack_name;
    u64 replacement = 0;            // the renderer's image for it (texture_pack::Image::id)
    u64 pack_generation = 0;
    u32 begin = 0, end = 0;
    bool valid = false;
    u64 decoded_serial = 0;         // Bridge::serial when decoded
    u64 content = 0;                // a hash of its blocks when decoded
    bool decoded = false;
    // The images whose blocks it can share (all they could ever cover), as of
    // `owned_seen` images: images are only ever added, and live as long as
    // the bridge.
    std::vector<const Owned*> over;
    std::size_t owned_seen = 0;
    std::list<u64>::iterator lru;
};

struct Bridge {
    std::unique_ptr<ps2gpu::Gpu> gpu;
    std::unique_ptr<ps2gpu::GsRenderer> renderer;
    bool primary = false;
    // --gpu-shadow-rtt: a texture that is a GPU target is sampled from it, as
    // the GPU will have to on its own.
    bool targets_as_textures = false;

    // Shadow: the texture last decoded, by what decides its contents, and the
    // memory drawn into since.
    std::tuple<u64, u64, u64, u64> texture_state{~0ull, 0, 0, 0};
    u64 texture_key = 0;
    std::map<u32, u32> since_decode;  // start -> blocks
    bool drawn_into(u32 bp, u32 blocks) const {
        for (const auto& [start, count] : since_decode)
            if (start < bp + blocks && bp < start + count) return true;
        return false;
    }
    std::map<std::tuple<u32, u32, u32>, Extent> drawn;  // this frame's targets
    u64 frames = 0;
    double agreement_sum = 0;
    std::string dump_dir;           // a dump asked for, made at the next frame with drawing
    std::set<u32> depth_seeded;     // depth buffers loaded from local memory this frame

    // Primary.
    std::map<std::tuple<u32, u32, u32, bool>, Owned> owned;
    std::unordered_map<u64, Cached> textures;
    std::list<u64> texture_lru;     // most recent first
    // The textures over each page (32 blocks) of local memory, for what a
    // write there invalidates: scanning all 2,048 on every write was 3% of a
    // race. Elements of `textures` stay put until erased.
    std::vector<std::vector<Cached*>> texture_pages = std::vector<std::vector<Cached*>>(512);
    void IndexTexture(Cached* t, bool add) {
        for (u32 page = t->begin >> 5; page <= ((std::max(t->end, t->begin + 1) - 1) >> 5) && page < 512; ++page) {
            std::vector<Cached*>& list = texture_pages[page];
            if (add) {
                list.push_back(t);
            } else {
                auto found = std::find(list.begin(), list.end(), t);
                if (found != list.end()) {
                    *found = list.back();
                    list.pop_back();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    u64 next_texture = 1;
    u64 serial = 0;                 // counts GPU draws, so a texture knows if one went over it
    // Bumped when an image starts holding drawing memory lacks, or reaches
    // further: until then, an image Use has checked against the others needs
    // no second look (tens of thousands of draws a frame go to one target).
    u64 newer_epoch = 1;
    // Local memory is kept twice: the GS model's (the CPU's) and the
    // renderer's (the GPU's), which images are swizzled into and out of. Per
    // 256-byte block, which copy is current.
    enum : u8 { kSame = 0, kCpuNewer = 1, kGpuNewer = 2 };
    std::vector<u8> blocks = std::vector<u8>(16384, kSame);
    u64 downloads = 0, uploads = 0;  // blocks copied GPU -> CPU, CPU -> GPU
    // Why blocks came back to the CPU (PS2HOST_GPU_LOG): 0 a texture decoded,
    // 1 the GS model reading, 2 the GS model writing.
    int cause = 1;
    u64 downloads_by[3] = {};
    // A transfer's blocks it writes in part where the GPU holds them newer:
    // its pixels there patched into the GPU's memory once it is done
    // (ApplyPatch), not the blocks brought back first (the CPU would wait for
    // every draw before them).
    struct Patch {
        gs::Gs::TouchSeen transfer{};
        std::vector<u32> blocks;            // sorted
    } patch;
    u64 patched_words = 0, patches = 0;
    std::map<u32, u64> texture_downloads;   // by the texture's TEX0 PSM << 16 | TBW
    u64 write_backs = 0, reloads = 0, decodes = 0;
    u64 unchanged = 0;              // textures invalidated whose texels proved the same
    u64 gpu_decodes = 0;            // textures decoded on the GPU from its copy of local memory
    u64 replacements = 0;           // a texture pack's in their place (texture_pack.h)
    // The CLUT, in rows of 16 entries (bit r for row r): which the GS model
    // holds as loaded (a load from blocks the CPU has), which the GPU's copy
    // holds (loaded from GPU memory, where the GPU drew them, or sent over).
    // Every row is at least one of the two. A GPU load bumps its rows'
    // generations, which key the textures read through them.
    u32 clut_cpu = 0xFFFF, clut_gpu = 0;
    u64 clut_generation[16] = {};
    u64 gpu_clut_loads = 0;
    // PS2HOST_GPU_DUMP_FRAME=N (and PS2HOST_GPU_DUMP_DIR): during frame N, each
    // target as it stood when drawing moved on to another, as a BMP, with a
    // line per pass on stderr - to see which pass of a frame goes wrong.
    u64 frame = 0;
    long long dump_frame = -1, dump_last = -1;    // the frames whose passes are dumped
    bool Dumping() const { return (long long)frame >= dump_frame && (long long)frame <= std::max(dump_frame, dump_last); }
    std::string dump_passes = ".";
    std::tuple<u32, u32, u32> last_target{~0u, 0, 0};
    u32 pass = 0;
};

Bridge* g_bridge = nullptr;

// Bumped by whatever could change what OnDraw works out for a primitive from
// its registers alone - an image's staleness, memory synced, a write-back, a
// CLUT load, a texture decoded or released, an image made or reloaded, a
// draw outside the blocks its target had dirty: while it stands still, a
// primitive with the registers of the one before draws as that one did
// (OnDraw's fast path).
u64 g_mutations = 0;

/* Whether the CLUT has rows the GPU's copy lacks. */
bool b_clut_rows_cpu_only(const Bridge& b) { return (b.clut_cpu & ~b.clut_gpu) != 0; }
std::map<std::string, u64> g_decode_kinds;      // PS2HOST_GPU_COUNT

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ --gpu

}  // namespace

u64 GpuBusyMicroseconds() { return ps2gpu::GpuBusyNanoseconds() / 1000; }

namespace {

/* Blocks [begin, end) whose copy on one side is behind the other's brought up
   to date, in runs: `to_gpu` the GPU's from the CPU's, else the CPU's from the
   GPU's (which waits for the GPU). */
void Coherent(Bridge& b, u32 begin, u32 end, bool to_gpu) {
    end = std::min(end, 16384u);
    const u8 behind = to_gpu ? Bridge::kCpuNewer : Bridge::kGpuNewer;
    u8* bytes = gs::TheGs().memory.data();
    const u8* blocks = b.blocks.data();
    for (u32 i = begin; i < end;) {
        // To the next block behind (memchr, sixteen at a time and more: a
        // reload looks over all of an image's blocks, ~300 times a picture,
        // and finds none behind, or few).
        const void* found = std::memchr(blocks + i, behind, end - i);
        if (!found) break;
        i = u32(static_cast<const u8*>(found) - blocks);
        u32 j = i;
        while (j < end && b.blocks[j] == behind) b.blocks[j++] = Bridge::kSame;
        if (to_gpu) {
            b.renderer->MemoryWrite(i, j, bytes + std::size_t(i) * 256);
            b.uploads += j - i;
        } else {
            // The CPU waits for the GPU here: on the profiler's timeline, by why.
            static const char* const kWhy[3] = {"GPU to CPU: a texture", "GPU to CPU: a read", "GPU to CPU: a write"};
            const u64 from = timeline::On() ? timeline::Now() : 0;
            b.renderer->MemoryRead(i, j, bytes + std::size_t(i) * 256);
            if (from) timeline::Span(kWhy[b.cause], from, timeline::Now());
            static const bool log_writes = std::getenv("PS2HOST_GPU_WRITE_LOG") != nullptr;
            if (log_writes && b.cause == 2) {
                const auto& t = gs::TheGs().last_transfer;
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[gpu] blocks %X-%X back to the CPU for a write: bp %X bw %u psm %02X at %u,%u %ux%u\n",
                             unsigned(i), unsigned(j), unsigned(t.bp), unsigned(t.bw), unsigned(t.psm), unsigned(t.x),
                             unsigned(t.y), unsigned(t.w), unsigned(t.h));
                for (const auto& [key, o] : b.owned)
                    if (o.begin <= i && i < o.full_end)
                        std::fprintf(stderr, "[gpu]   over image %s %X/%u/%02X %ux%u blocks %X-%X (to %X), dirty %X-%X\n",
                                     o.depth ? "Z" : "C", unsigned(o.fbp), unsigned(o.fbw), unsigned(o.psm),
                                     unsigned(o.width), unsigned(o.height), unsigned(o.begin), unsigned(o.end),
                                     unsigned(o.full_end), unsigned(o.dirty_begin), unsigned(o.dirty_end));
            }
            b.downloads += j - i;
            b.downloads_by[b.cause] += j - i;
        }
        i = j;
    }
}

/* `o` stale for `why`, in the rows over blocks [b0, b1) (all of it, past its
   blocks or by default). */
void MarkStale(Owned& o, int why, u32 b0 = 0, u32 b1 = ~0u, const Pages* pages = nullptr, bool by16 = false) {
    ++g_mutations;
    if (pages) {
        o.stale_pages |= *pages;
    } else if (b1 != ~0u && b0 < b1) {
        for (u32 p = b0 / 32; p <= (b1 - 1) / 32 && p < 512; ++p) o.stale_pages.set(p);
    } else {
        o.stale_pages.set();
    }
    u32 r0 = 0, r1 = ~0u;
    if (b1 != ~0u && b0 < b1 && b1 > o.begin) {
        const u32 page_rows = Is16(o.psm) ? 64 : 32, row_blocks = std::max(1u, o.fbw) * 32;
        r0 = (std::max(b0, o.begin) - o.begin) / row_blocks * page_rows;
        r1 = (b1 - o.begin + row_blocks - 1) / row_blocks * page_rows;
    }
    o.by16 = (o.stale ? o.by16 : true) && by16;
    if (!o.stale) {
        o.stale = true;
        o.why = why;
        o.stale_row0 = r0;
        o.stale_row1 = r1;
    } else {
        o.stale_row0 = std::min(o.stale_row0, r0);
        o.stale_row1 = std::max(o.stale_row1, r1);
    }
}

/* A step of the bridge's on the profiler's timeline (PS2HOST_PROFILE), by name. */
struct TimelineStep {
    const char* name;
    u64 from;
    explicit TimelineStep(const char* what) : name(what), from(timeline::On() ? timeline::Now() : 0) {}
    ~TimelineStep() {
        if (from) timeline::Span(name, from, timeline::Now());
    }
};

/* What the GPU drew into an image, swizzled into the GPU's local memory - on
   the GPU, nothing waiting. */
void WriteBack(Bridge& b, Owned& o) {
    ++g_mutations;
    Timed timed(Section::GpuSync);
    const TimelineStep step("sync: a write-back");
    o.gpu_newer = false;
    o.dirty_pages.reset();
    o.rect_dirty = false;
    if (o.dirty_end <= o.dirty_begin) return;
    // Only the rows drawn into since the last write-back: the image's other
    // rows may be stale - another image drew over them since, and memory has
    // that, not this.
    const u32 page_rows = Is16(o.psm) ? 64 : 32, row_blocks = std::max(1u, o.fbw) * 32;
    const u32 first = (o.dirty_begin - o.begin) / row_blocks * page_rows;
    const u32 last = std::min(o.y1, (o.dirty_end - o.begin) / row_blocks * page_rows);
    // Blocks the CPU wrote go over first: the image covers them only in part.
    Coherent(b, o.dirty_begin, o.dirty_end, true);
    if (gs::TheGs().trace)   // in a capture's trace: an image written back to memory, which rows
        std::fprintf(gs::TheGs().trace_out, "[gpu] write-back %s %X/%u/%02X rows %u-%u cols %u\n", o.depth ? "Z" : "C",
                     unsigned(o.fbp), unsigned(o.fbw), unsigned(o.psm), unsigned(first), unsigned(last),
                     unsigned(o.x1));
    const bool done = o.depth ? b.renderer->DepthToMemory(o.fbp, o.width, o.height, o.fbw, o.psm, o.x1, last, first)
                              : b.renderer->TargetToMemory(o.fbp, o.fbw, o.psm, o.x1, last, first);
    if (!done && gs::TheGs().trace) std::fprintf(gs::TheGs().trace_out, "[gpu]   (nothing to write back)\n");
    if (done) {
        ++b.write_backs;
        std::fill(b.blocks.begin() + std::min(o.dirty_begin, 16384u),
                  b.blocks.begin() + std::min(o.dirty_end, 16384u), Bridge::kGpuNewer);
    }
    o.dirty_begin = ~0u;
    o.dirty_end = 0;
}

/* Before the CPU reads or writes local memory [begin, end): what the GPU drew
   there comes back to it; written, the GPU images there must reload. */
void ApplyPatch(Bridge& b);

void Sync(Bridge& b, u32 begin, u32 end, bool write, const Owned* except = nullptr) {
    ++g_mutations;
    ApplyPatch(b);
    for (auto& [key, o] : b.owned)
        if (&o != except && o.gpu_newer && o.dirty_begin < end && begin < o.dirty_end) WriteBack(b, o);
    {
        Timed timed(Section::GpuSync);
        const TimelineStep step("sync: memory for the CPU");
        Coherent(b, begin, end, false);
    }
    if (write) std::fill(b.blocks.begin() + begin, b.blocks.begin() + std::min(end, 16384u), Bridge::kCpuNewer);
    for (auto& [key, o] : b.owned) {
        if (&o == except) continue;
        if (!write || end <= o.begin || o.full_end <= begin) continue;
        if (begin < o.end) {
            MarkStale(o, 1, begin, end);
        } else {
            o.stale_beyond = true;
        }
    }
    if (write && begin < end)
        for (u32 page = begin >> 5; page <= ((end - 1) >> 5) && page < 512; ++page)
            for (Cached* t : b.texture_pages[page])
                if (t->begin < end && begin < t->end) t->valid = false;
}

/* An image transfer about to write blocks [begin, end) (Gs::on_write): the
   blocks it writes in part come back from the GPU first, those it writes
   whole need nothing of what was there - a read-back waits for all the GPU
   has queued, and a race's texture uploads into blocks the GPU drew over
   cost a wait each (1,400 of ~6 ms in a minute of racing, 4 KB each). */
void SyncWrite(Bridge& b, u32 begin, u32 end, const u8* cover) {
    ++g_mutations;
    ApplyPatch(b);                          // one before it, if it never finished
    u32 first = end, last = begin;          // the blocks written
    for (u32 i = begin; i < end; ++i)
        if (cover[i - begin]) {
            first = std::min(first, i);
            last = i + 1;
        }
    if (first >= last) return;
    // What the GPU images drew over them into the GPU's memory first (on the
    // GPU, nothing waiting): written back later, it would land over these.
    for (auto& [key, o] : b.owned)
        if (o.gpu_newer && o.dirty_begin < last && first < o.dirty_end) WriteBack(b, o);
    // Blocks written in part where the GPU's are newer: the transfer's pixels
    // patched into the GPU's when it is done, the blocks still the GPU's.
    b.patch.transfer = gs::TheGs().last_transfer;
    for (u32 i = first; i < last; ++i)
        if (cover[i - begin] == 1 && b.blocks[i] == Bridge::kGpuNewer) b.patch.blocks.push_back(i);
    for (u32 i = first; i < last; ++i)
        if (cover[i - begin] && !(cover[i - begin] == 1 && b.blocks[i] == Bridge::kGpuNewer)) b.blocks[i] = Bridge::kCpuNewer;
    for (auto& [key, o] : b.owned) {
        if (last <= o.begin || o.full_end <= first) continue;
        if (first < o.end) MarkStale(o, 1, first, last);
        else o.stale_beyond = true;
    }
    for (u32 page = first >> 5; page <= ((last - 1) >> 5) && page < 512; ++page)
        for (Cached* t : b.texture_pages[page])
            if (t->begin < last && first < t->end) t->valid = false;
}

/* The pending patch (Bridge::Patch): each pixel of the transfer's rectangle
   that lies in a block it waits for, its bytes in its word (the CPU's copy
   has them, the transfer written) under the pixel's mask - 32, 24 or 16
   bits, a byte, a nibble - into the GPU's memory. */
void ApplyPatch(Bridge& b) {
    if (b.patch.blocks.empty()) return;
    const gs::Gs::TouchSeen t = b.patch.transfer;
    std::vector<u32> blocks;
    blocks.swap(b.patch.blocks);
    std::sort(blocks.begin(), blocks.end());
    blocks.erase(std::unique(blocks.begin(), blocks.end()), blocks.end());
    u32 bytes = 0, base_mask = 0;
    switch (t.psm) {
        case 0x00: case 0x30: bytes = 4; base_mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu; break;          // CT32, Z32
        case 0x01: case 0x31: bytes = 3; base_mask = 0x00FFFFFFu; break;          // CT24, Z24
        case 0x02: case 0x0A: case 0x32: case 0x3A: bytes = 2; base_mask = 0xFFFFu; break;
        case 0x13: bytes = 1; base_mask = 0xFFu; break;                           // T8
        case 0x14: bytes = 0; base_mask = 0xFu; break;                            // T4
        default: return;                    // (Touch sends no others here)
    }
    const u8* memory = gs::TheGs().memory.data();
    std::map<u32, u32> masks;               // word -> its mask
    for (u32 y = t.y; y < t.y + t.h; ++y)
        for (u32 x = t.x; x < t.x + t.w; ++x) {
            u32 nibble = 0;
            const u32 address = gs::Memory::Address(t.bp, t.bw, x % 2048, y % 2048, t.psm, &nibble);
            if (!std::binary_search(blocks.begin(), blocks.end(), address / 256)) continue;
            const u32 shift = bytes ? (address % 4) * 8 : (address % 4) * 8 + 4 * nibble;
            masks[address / 4] |= base_mask << shift;
        }
    std::vector<u32> words;
    words.reserve(masks.size() * 3);
    for (const auto& [word, mask] : masks) {
        u32 value;
        std::memcpy(&value, memory + std::size_t(word) * 4, 4);
        words.insert(words.end(), {word, value, mask});
    }
    b.renderer->MemoryPatch(words.data(), masks.size());
    b.patched_words += masks.size();
    ++b.patches;
}

/* A target or depth buffer about to be drawn into or sampled: up to date with
   memory and whatever else the GPU drew over its blocks. */
Owned& Use(Bridge& b, u32 fbp, u32 fbw, u32 psm, bool depth, u32 width, u32 height, u32 rows) {
    // Tens of thousands of draws a frame go to the same target as the one
    // before: that one, without the map (its elements stay put).
    static Owned* last = nullptr;
    static std::tuple<u32, u32, u32, bool> last_key;
    const auto key = std::make_tuple(fbp, fbw, psm, depth);
    if (!last || key != last_key) {
        last = &b.owned[key];
        last_key = key;
    }
    Owned& o = *last;
    if (!o.width) {
        o.fbp = fbp;
        o.fbw = fbw;
        o.psm = psm;
        o.depth = depth;
        o.width = width;
        o.height = height;
        std::tie(o.begin, o.end) = Blocks(fbp, fbw, psm, rows);
        o.full_end = Blocks(fbp, fbw, psm, height).second;
        o.drawn_end = o.begin;
        o.stale_pages.set();
    } else {
        const u32 end = Blocks(fbp, fbw, psm, rows).second;
        if (end > o.end) {
            o.end = end;
            o.checked = 0;
            if (o.stale_beyond) MarkStale(o, 1);     // rows drawn over before it reached them (stale or not)
        }
    }
    if (!o.stale && o.checked == b.newer_epoch) return o;
    ++g_mutations;
    // Another image's drawing over these blocks reaches this one through memory.
    for (auto& [key, other] : b.owned)
        if (&other != &o && other.gpu_newer && other.dirty_begin < o.end && o.begin < other.dirty_end) {
            const u32 b0 = other.dirty_begin, b1 = other.dirty_end;
            WriteBack(b, other);
            MarkStale(o, 3, b0, b1, nullptr, Is16(other.psm));
        }
    o.checked = b.newer_epoch;
    if (o.stale) {
        // Loaded from the GPU's local memory, the CPU's writes there first -
        // and its own drawing not yet there: an image goes stale for rows
        // another drew over while newer than memory in rows of its own.
        if (o.gpu_newer) WriteBack(b, o);
        Timed timed(Section::GpuSync);
        const TimelineStep step("sync: an image reloaded");
        ++b.reloads;
        Coherent(b, o.begin, o.full_end, true);
        const u32 r0 = std::min(o.stale_row0, o.height), r1 = std::min(o.stale_row1, o.height);
        if (gs::TheGs().trace)   // in a capture's trace: an image brought back from memory, and why (Owned::why)
            std::fprintf(gs::TheGs().trace_out, "[gpu] reload %s %X/%u/%02X why %d rows %u-%u\n", depth ? "Z" : "C",
                         unsigned(o.fbp), unsigned(o.fbw), unsigned(o.psm), o.why, unsigned(r0), unsigned(r1));
        // A 32-bit image stale only from a 16-bit view's drawing over it (the
        // race's depth into the frame's alpha): its own colour kept where only
        // alpha changed (ReloadKeepsColour) - not a picture as memory holds it.
        b.renderer->ReloadKeepsColour(o.by16 && !Is16(o.psm));
        // Depth buffers come back whole: the renderer keeps one a target
        // size over the same memory, and a part of one reloaded left the
        // race's garage a few pixels off the software GS.
        if ((r0 == 0 && r1 >= o.height) || depth) {
            if (depth) b.renderer->DepthFromMemory(o.fbp, o.width, o.height, o.fbw, o.psm);
            else b.renderer->TargetFromMemory(o.fbp, o.fbw, o.psm, o.width, o.height);
        } else if (r0 < r1) {
            if (depth) b.renderer->DepthRowsFromMemory(o.fbp, o.width, o.height, o.fbw, o.psm, r0, r1 - r0);
            else b.renderer->TargetRowsFromMemory(o.fbp, o.fbw, o.psm, o.width, o.height, r0, r1 - r0);
        }
        b.renderer->ReloadKeepsColour(false);
        o.stale_row0 = 0;
        o.stale_row1 = ~0u;
        o.stale_pages.reset();
        ++o.reloads[o.why];
        o.stale = o.stale_beyond = false;
    }
    return o;
}

/* The pages of `o` under its pixels [x0, x1) x [y0, y1) (64x32 a page, 64x64
   16-bit). */
Pages PagesOf(const Owned& o, u32 x0, u32 x1, u32 y0, u32 y1) {
    Pages pages;
    const u32 shift = Is16(o.psm) ? 6 : 5, fbw = std::max(1u, o.fbw);       // a page's rows: 64 or 32
    x1 = std::min(x1, fbw * 64);
    x0 = std::min(x0, x1 ? x1 - 1 : 0);
    x1 = std::max(x1, x0 + 1);
    y1 = std::max(y1, y0 + 1);
    for (u32 py = y0 >> shift; py <= (y1 - 1) >> shift; ++py)
        for (u32 px = x0 / 64; px <= (x1 - 1) / 64; ++px) {
            const u32 page = o.begin / 32 + py * fbw + px;
            if (page < 512) pages.set(page);
        }
    return pages;
}

/* After the GPU drew into `o`, pixels [x0, x1) x [y0, y1): memory and the
   other images over those blocks are behind. */
void Drew(Bridge& b, Owned& o, u32 x0, u32 x1, u32 y1, u32 y0) {
    const u32 shift = Is16(o.psm) ? 6 : 5, fbw = std::max(1u, o.fbw), row_blocks = fbw * 32;    // a page's rows: 64 or 32
    y1 = std::min(std::max(y1, y0 + 1), o.height);
    y0 = std::min(y0, y1 - 1);
    // Already newer than memory over these pages: the others over them were
    // made stale then (any reloaded since wrote this one back first).
    const u32 cx1 = std::min(x1, fbw * 64);
    const u32 cx0 = std::min(x0, cx1 ? cx1 - 1 : 0);
    const u32 r[4] = {cx0 / 64, (std::max(cx1, cx0 + 1) - 1) / 64, y0 >> shift, (y1 - 1) >> shift};
    const bool in_rect = o.rect_dirty && r[0] >= o.rect[0] && r[1] <= o.rect[1] && r[2] >= o.rect[2] && r[3] <= o.rect[3];
    // Inside the rectangle the last draw outside it marked (most primitives):
    // newer than memory there already, its blocks and pages dirty, the rows
    // it reaches drawn - only the pixels drawn so far and the serial move
    // (as below, the rest unchanged; a write-back clears the rectangle).
    if (in_rect) {
        o.x1 = std::max(o.x1, std::min(x1, o.width));
        o.y1 = std::max(o.y1, y1);
        o.drawn_serial = ++b.serial;
        return;
    }
    const u32 db = o.begin + r[2] * row_blocks;
    const u32 de = o.begin + (r[3] + 1) * row_blocks;
    const Pages pages = PagesOf(o, x0, x1, y0, y1);
    const bool inside = o.gpu_newer && db >= o.dirty_begin && de <= o.dirty_end && (pages & ~o.dirty_pages).none();
    o.gpu_newer = true;
    o.x1 = std::max(o.x1, std::min(x1, o.width));
    o.y1 = std::max(o.y1, y1);
    o.drawn_end = std::max(o.drawn_end, Blocks(o.fbp, o.fbw, o.psm, o.y1).second);
    o.end = std::max(o.end, o.drawn_end);
    o.dirty_begin = std::min(o.dirty_begin, db);
    o.dirty_end = std::max(o.dirty_end, de);
    o.dirty_pages |= pages;
    std::memcpy(o.rect, r, sizeof r);
    o.rect_dirty = true;
    o.drawn_serial = ++b.serial;    // textures over it decoded before this are out of date
    if (inside) return;
    ++g_mutations;
    ++b.newer_epoch;
    for (auto& [key, other] : b.owned) {
        if (&other == &o || de <= other.begin || other.full_end <= db) continue;
        if (db < other.end) {
            MarkStale(other, 2, db, de, &pages, Is16(o.psm));
        } else {
            other.stale_beyond = true;
        }
    }
}

/* The pages of target `o` a primitive sampling it as a TW x TH texture can
   read, by its texture coordinates (a texel more each side, for bilinear
   filtering); false where that is not known - the region modes, a texture
   wider than the buffer, a vertex with Q not above 0. Perspective-correct
   coordinates inside a triangle are weighted means of its vertices' S/Q and
   T/Q (weights the barycentrics times Q, all positive), so they lie between
   the vertices' least and greatest. */
bool SampledPages(const Owned& o, u64 clamp, u32 tw, u32 th, const ps2gpu::GsVertex* v, std::size_t n, Pages* out) {
    const u32 wms = u32(clamp & 3), wmt = u32(clamp >> 2 & 3);
    if (wms > 1 || wmt > 1 || tw > std::max(1u, o.fbw) * 64 || !n) return false;
    float s0 = 0, s1 = 0, t0 = 0, t1 = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (!(v[i].q > 0)) return false;
        const float s = v[i].s / v[i].q, t = v[i].t / v[i].q;
        if (!std::isfinite(s) || !std::isfinite(t)) return false;
        if (i == 0 || s < s0) s0 = s;
        if (i == 0 || s > s1) s1 = s;
        if (i == 0 || t < t0) t0 = t;
        if (i == 0 || t > t1) t1 = t;
    }
    // Texels [lo, hi) of `size`: the whole span where REPEAT would wrap.
    const auto span = [](float c0, float c1, u32 size, u32 mode, u32* lo, u32* hi) {
        const float a = std::floor(c0 * float(size)) - 1, b = std::ceil(c1 * float(size)) + 1;
        if (mode == 0 && (a < 0 || b > float(size))) {
            *lo = 0;
            *hi = size;
            return;
        }
        *lo = u32(std::clamp(a, 0.0f, float(size - 1)));
        *hi = u32(std::clamp(b, float(*lo + 1), float(size)));
    };
    u32 x0, x1, y0, y1;
    span(s0, s1, tw, wms, &x0, &x1);
    span(t0, t1, th, wmt, &y0, &y1);
    *out = PagesOf(o, x0, x1, y0, y1);
    return true;
}

/* Target `o` about to be sampled as a texture, over `pages`: brought up to
   date (Use) only if what it lacks lies there - changed under it since it
   was loaded, or drawn by another image the GPU has not written back. */
void Sample(Bridge& b, Owned& o, const Pages& pages) {
    bool needed = o.stale && (o.stale_pages & pages).any();
    for (auto it = b.owned.begin(); !needed && it != b.owned.end(); ++it)
        needed = &it->second != &o && it->second.gpu_newer && (it->second.dirty_pages & pages).any();
    if (needed) Use(b, o.fbp, o.fbw, o.psm, false, o.width, o.height, 1);   // sampling grows nothing
}

/* A 64-bit hash of `size` bytes (a multiple of 8). Four independent lanes,
   folded at the end: one chain of multiplies waits on each before it, and
   textures are hashed hundreds of thousands of times a run (only compared
   within a run, so the values themselves are free to change). */
u64 Hash(const unsigned char* data, std::size_t size) {
    // XXH3 (as texture_pack.cpp has it): a re-uploaded texture's blocks are
    // hashed each time it is used again (Burnout 3 sends its textures every
    // picture) - several times as fast as the four-lane hash it replaced.
    return XXH3_64bits(data, size);
}

bool GpuHolds(const Bridge& b, u32 begin, u32 end);

bool Palettized(u32 psm) {
    return psm == gs::PSMT8 || psm == gs::PSMT4 || psm == gs::PSMT8H || psm == gs::PSMT4HL || psm == gs::PSMT4HH;
}

/* The CLUT rows a palettized texture reads: all 16 for 8-bit, CSA's for 4-bit. */
u32 ClutRowsOf(u32 psm, u32 csa) {
    if (!Palettized(psm)) return 0;
    return (psm == gs::PSMT8 || psm == gs::PSMT8H) ? 0xFFFFu : 1u << (csa % 16);
}

/* The CLUT rows a palettized texture reads, as a hash: their entries where
   the GS model holds them, their generation where only the GPU does. */
u64 ClutHash(const Bridge& b, u32 psm, u32 csa) {
    const u32 rows = ClutRowsOf(psm, csa);
    if (!rows) return 0;
    // Hashed once a load: hundreds of thousands of palettized draws a frame.
    static u64 loads = ~0ull, row_hash[16];
    if (gs::TheGs().clut_loads() != loads) {
        loads = gs::TheGs().clut_loads();
        const auto& clut = gs::TheGs().Clut();
        for (u32 r = 0; r < 16; ++r) {
            u64 hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
            for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; ++i) hash = (hash ^ clut[r * 16 + i]) * 1099511628211ull;
            row_hash[r] = hash;
        }
    }
    u64 hash = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
    for (u32 r = 0; r < 16; ++r) {
        if (!(rows >> r & 1)) continue;
        const u64 row = (b.clut_cpu >> r & 1) ? row_hash[r] : ~(b.clut_generation[r] * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4Full);
        hash = (hash ^ row ^ r) * 0xFF51AFD7ED558CCDull;
    }
    return hash;
}

/* A CLUT load (on_clut_load): from the GPU's copy of local memory when the
   GPU holds its blocks newer - the race's crash and glow scenes load CLUTs
   from images just drawn, and bringing those back waited ~8 ms each - else
   left to the GS model. */
bool LoadClut(Bridge& b, u64 tex0, u64 texa) {
    ++g_mutations;
    const u32 psm = Bits(tex0, 20, 6), cbp = Bits(tex0, 37, 14), cpsm = Bits(tex0, 51, 4);
    // CSM2 (bit 55) loads from TEXCLUT's row, at entry 0 whatever CSA: the GS
    // model's load does it (the GPU's knows CSM1 only).
    const bool csm2 = Bits(tex0, 55, 1);
    const u32 csa = csm2 ? 0 : Bits(tex0, 56, 5);
    const u32 rows = ClutRowsOf(psm, csa);
    if (csm2 || !GpuHolds(b, cbp, cbp + 8)) {
        b.clut_cpu |= rows;
        b.clut_gpu &= ~rows;
        return false;
    }
    Timed timed(Section::GpuSync);
    const TimelineStep step("sync: a CLUT load");
    for (auto& [key, o] : b.owned)
        if (o.gpu_newer && o.dirty_begin < cbp + 8 && cbp < o.dirty_end) WriteBack(b, o);
    Coherent(b, cbp, cbp + 8, true);
    ps2gpu::GsClutLoad load;
    load.cbp = cbp;
    load.cpsm = cpsm;
    load.csa = csa;
    load.eight = psm == gs::PSMT8 || psm == gs::PSMT8H;
    load.texa_lo = u32(texa & 0x80FF);
    load.ta1 = Bits(texa, 32, 8);
    b.renderer->ClutFromMemory(load);
    b.clut_gpu |= rows;
    b.clut_cpu &= ~rows;
    for (u32 r = 0; r < 16; ++r)
        if (rows >> r & 1) ++b.clut_generation[r];
    ++b.gpu_clut_loads;
    return true;
}

/* The renderer's key for the texture the current primitive samples, decoded if
   need be (--gpu). */
/* Whether the GPU holds blocks [begin, end) newer than the CPU: an image drawn
   over them and not yet swizzled into GPU memory, or GPU memory newer. */
bool GpuHolds(const Bridge& b, u32 begin, u32 end) {
    for (const auto& [key, o] : b.owned)
        if (o.gpu_newer && o.dirty_begin < end && begin < o.dirty_end) return true;
    end = std::min(end, 16384u);
    for (u32 i = begin; i < end; ++i)
        if (b.blocks[i] == Bridge::kGpuNewer) return true;
    return false;
}

/* The renderer's key for the texture the current primitive samples, decoded if
   need be: by the CPU from its copy of local memory, or - when the GPU holds
   the texture's blocks newer (the race reads its own targets' alpha as
   PSMT8H textures, its depth buffer as PSMZ16) - by the GPU from its own,
   rather than wait for them to come back. */
void WriteBmp(const std::string& path, const std::vector<u32>& rgba, u32 stride, u32 w, u32 h, bool alpha = false);

// A texture pack's replacement for the texture, uploaded in its place if its
// file has been read (texture_pack::Find); false if not (yet).
bool Replace(Bridge& b, Cached& t) {
    bool pending = false;
    const std::shared_ptr<const texture_pack::Image> image = texture_pack::Find(t.pack_name, &pending);
    t.pack_pending = pending;
    if (!image) return false;
    // One image on the GPU for every texture it replaces.
    if (!b.renderer->HasReplacement(image->id) &&
        !b.renderer->UploadReplacement(image->id, image->format, image->width, image->height, image->levels,
```
