```cpp
        case PSMCT32: case PSMCT24: case PSMZ32: case PSMZ24: cw = 8; ch = 8; break;
        case PSMCT16: case PSMCT16S: case PSMZ16: case PSMZ16S: cw = 16; ch = 8; break;
        case PSMT8: cw = 16; ch = 16; break;
        case PSMT4: cw = 32; ch = 16; break;
        default: break;
    }
    if (!write || !on_write || !cw || !bw || x + w > bw * 64 || end > 16384 || end <= begin) {
        on_memory(begin, end, write);
        return;
    }
    std::vector<u8> cover(end - begin, 0);
    for (u32 cy = y / ch * ch; cy < y + h; cy += ch)
        for (u32 cx = x / cw * cw; cx < x + w; cx += cw) {
            u32 nibble = 0;
            const u32 block = Memory::Address(bp, bw, cx, cy, psm, &nibble) / 256;
            if (block < begin || block >= end) {        // (not expected: as before)
                on_memory(begin, end, write);
                return;
            }
            const bool whole = cx >= x && cx + cw <= x + w && cy >= y && cy + ch <= y + h;
            u8& c = cover[block - begin];
            c = std::max<u8>(c, whole ? 2 : 1);
        }
    on_write(begin, end, cover.data());
}

bool Gs::Picture(std::vector<u32>* pixels, u32* width, u32* height) const {
    Finish();
    // The read circuit shown: 2 if enabled, else 1.
    int circuit = Bits(pmode_, 1, 1) ? 1 : Bits(pmode_, 0, 1) ? 0 : -1;
    if (circuit < 0) {
        if (!dispfb_[1] && !dispfb_[0]) return false;
        circuit = dispfb_[1] ? 1 : 0;
    }
    const u64 fb = dispfb_[circuit], disp = display_[circuit];
    const u32 fbp = Bits(fb, 0, 9) * 32, fbw = Bits(fb, 9, 6), psm = Bits(fb, 15, 5);
    const u32 dbx = Bits(fb, 32, 11), dby = Bits(fb, 43, 11);
    const u32 magh = Bits(disp, 23, 4) + 1, magv = Bits(disp, 27, 2) + 1;
    u32 w = (Bits(disp, 32, 12) + 1) / magh, h = (Bits(disp, 44, 11) + 1) / magv;
    if (!w || w > 1024) w = 640;
    if (!h || h > 1024) h = 448;
    if (!fbw) return false;
    const u32 lines = ShownLines(), repeat = h / std::max(lines, 1u);
    Touch(fbp, fbw, psm, dbx, dby, w, lines, false);
    pixels->assign(std::size_t(w) * h, 0);
    for (u32 y = 0; y < h; ++y)
        for (u32 x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
            u32 c = memory.Read(fbp, fbw, dbx + x, dby + y / std::max(repeat, 1u), psm);
            if (psm == PSMCT16 || psm == PSMCT16S) c = From16(c, 0);
            // RGBA in memory, BGRA in the picture.
            (*pixels)[std::size_t(y) * w + x] = (c & 0xFF00FF00u) | ((c & 0xFF) << 16) | ((c >> 16) & 0xFF);
        }
    *width = w;
    *height = h;
    return true;
}

u32 Gs::ShownLines() const {
    const int circuit = Bits(pmode_, 1, 1) || (!Bits(pmode_, 0, 1) && dispfb_[1]) ? 1 : 0;
    const u64 disp = display_[circuit];
    u32 h = (Bits(disp, 44, 11) + 1) / (Bits(disp, 27, 2) + 1);
    if (!h || h > 1024) h = 448;
    const bool field = Bits(smode2_, 0, 1) && Bits(smode2_, 1, 1);    // interlaced, FFMD
    return field ? h / 2 : h;
}

bool Gs::FieldMode() const { return Bits(smode2_, 0, 1) && Bits(smode2_, 1, 1); }

bool Gs::WriteBmp(const std::string& path) const {
    std::vector<u32> pixels;
    u32 w = 0, h = 0;
    if (!Picture(&pixels, &w, &h)) return false;
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!f) return false;
    const u32 data = w * h * 4, file = 54 + data;
    u8 header[54] = {'B', 'M'};
    auto put32 = [&](int at, u32 v) { std::memcpy(header + at, &v, 4); };
    put32(2, file);
    put32(10, 54);
    put32(14, 40);
    put32(18, w);
    put32(22, u32(-s32(h)));                   // negative: top-down rows
    header[26] = 1;
    header[28] = 32;
    put32(34, data);
    std::fwrite(header, 1, 54, f);
    std::fwrite(pixels.data(), 4, pixels.size(), f);
    std::fclose(f);
    return true;
}

}  // namespace gs
}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/gs_draw.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * GS drawing (gs.h): primitives from the vertex queue, rasterized in software,
 * each pixel through the GS's pipeline (GS User's Manual, chapter 5):
 *
 *   scissor -> texture (TEX0/CLAMP/TEXA/CLUT; TFX modulate/decal/highlight)
 *   -> fog -> alpha test (TEST) -> depth test (ZBUF) -> blending (ALPHA,
 *   PABE, COLCLAMP) -> frame mask (FBMSK) -> FRAME and ZBUF writes.
 *
 * Primitives are queued with their decoded state (Setup, the CLUT they use)
 * and drawn in batches: the rows are dealt out in groups of 8 to worker
 * threads, each of which draws every queued primitive over its own rows, so
 * every pixel still sees the primitives in order and the picture is the same
 * as drawn one by one. A primitive that samples memory queued ones write waits
 * for them; one that samples what it writes itself is drawn alone, in order.
 * Whatever reads local memory - the picture, transfers, CLUT loads - finishes
 * the queue first (Gs::Finish).
 *
 * Stage one samples textures at the nearest texel or bilinearly and does not
 * dither; anti-aliasing is not modelled.
 */

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <thread>

#include "ps2host/gs.h"
#include "ps2host/profile.h"

namespace ps2host {
namespace gs {

namespace {

u32 Bits(u64 value, int low, int count) { return u32((value >> low) & ((1ull << count) - 1)); }

u32 Rgba(u32 r, u32 g, u32 b, u32 a) { return r | g << 8 | b << 16 | a << 24; }

u32 From16(u32 c, u64 texa) {
    const u32 r = (c & 31) << 3, g = ((c >> 5) & 31) << 3, b = ((c >> 10) & 31) << 3;
    const u32 a = (c & 0x8000) ? Bits(texa, 32, 8) : ((Bits(texa, 15, 1) && !(c & 0x7FFF)) ? 0 : Bits(texa, 0, 8));
    return Rgba(r, g, b, a);
}

u32 To16(u32 c) {
    return ((c >> 3) & 31) | (((c >> 11) & 31) << 5) | (((c >> 19) & 31) << 10) | ((c >> 31) << 15);
}

// Pixels drawn by this thread since it last reported them.
thread_local u64 t_pixels = 0;

int Wrap(int i, u32 size, u32 mode, u32 min, u32 max) {
    switch (mode) {
        case 0: return i & int(size - 1);                                   // REPEAT
        case 1: return std::clamp(i, 0, int(size) - 1);                     // CLAMP
        case 2: return std::clamp(i, int(min), int(max));                   // REGION_CLAMP
        default: return (i & int(min)) | int(max);                         // REGION_REPEAT
    }
}

u32 BitsPerPixel(u32 psm) {
    switch (psm) {
        case PSMCT16: case PSMCT16S: case PSMZ16: case PSMZ16S: return 16;
        case PSMT8: return 8;
        case PSMT4: return 4;
        default: return 32;
    }
}

// Whether row y belongs to band `band` of `bands`: rows go round in groups of 8.
bool Owned(int y, int band, int bands) { return bands <= 1 || (y >= 0 && ((y >> 3) % bands) == band); }

/* The worker threads a batch's bands are drawn on. Workers live for the
   process. */
class RowPool {
public:
    static RowPool& Get() {
        static RowPool* pool = new RowPool;     // never destroyed: its threads wait to the end
        return *pool;
    }
    int threads() const { return int(workers_) + 1; }
    /* body(i0, i1) over [begin, end), in chunks, on the workers and the caller. */
    void Run(int begin, int end, const std::function<void(int, int)>& body) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(lock_);
            body_ = &body;
            next_ = begin;
            end_ = end;
            chunk_ = 1;
            pending_ = workers_;
            ++generation_;
        }
        wake_.notify_all();
        int a, b;
        while (Take(&a, &b)) body(a, b);
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> hold(lock_);
        done_.wait(hold, [&] { return pending_ == 0; });
        body_ = nullptr;
    }

private:
    RowPool() {
        const unsigned cores = std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
        workers_ = cores > 2 ? std::min(cores - 1, 7u) : 1u;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < workers_; ++i) std::thread([this] { Work(); }).detach();
    }
    bool Take(int* a, int* b) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(lock_);
        if (next_ >= end_) return false;
        *a = next_;
        *b = std::min(end_, next_ + chunk_);
        next_ = *b;
        return true;
    }
    void Work() {
        u64 seen = 0;
        for (;;) {
            const std::function<void(int, int)>* body;
            {
                std::unique_lock<std::mutex> hold(lock_);
                wake_.wait(hold, [&] { return generation_ != seen; });
                seen = generation_;
                body = body_;
            }
            int a, b;
            while (body && Take(&a, &b)) (*body)(a, b);
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(lock_);
            if (--pending_ == 0) done_.notify_one();
        }
    }
    unsigned workers_ = 0;
    std::mutex lock_;
    std::condition_variable wake_, done_;
    const std::function<void(int, int)>* body_ = nullptr;
    int next_ = 0, end_ = 0, chunk_ = 1;
    unsigned pending_ = 0;
    u64 generation_ = 0;
};

// A batch is drawn when it holds this many primitives, or before anything
// reads local memory; one of fewer pixels than this is drawn on one thread.
constexpr std::size_t kBatchPrimitives = 1024;
constexpr long long kParallelPixels = 8192;

// Texture coordinates of a vertex in texels: UV directly (1/16 texel), or
// S/Q, T/Q scaled by the texture's size.
void Coords(const Vertex& v, bool fst, u32 tw, u32 th, float* u, float* t) {
    if (fst) { *u = float(v.u) / 16.0f; *t = float(v.v) / 16.0f; }
    else {
        const float q = v.q != 0.0f ? v.q : 1.0f;
        *u = v.s / q * float(tw);
        *t = v.t / q * float(th);
    }
}

}  // namespace

MipLevels LevelsOf(const Context& c) {
    MipLevels m;
    m.tbp[0] = Bits(c.tex0, 0, 14);
    m.tbw[0] = Bits(c.tex0, 14, 6);
    const u32 mxl = std::min(Bits(c.tex1, 2, 3), 6u), mmin = Bits(c.tex1, 6, 3);
    if (mxl == 0 || mmin < 2 || mmin > 5) return m;
    m.count = mxl + 1;
    const u32 tw = 1u << std::min(Bits(c.tex0, 26, 4), 10u), th = 1u << std::min(Bits(c.tex0, 30, 4), 10u);
    const u32 bits = BitsPerPixel(Bits(c.tex0, 20, 6));
    for (u32 n = 1; n <= mxl; ++n) {
        if (n <= 3 && Bits(c.tex1, 9, 1)) {
            const u32 w = std::max(1u, tw >> (n - 1)), h = std::max(1u, th >> (n - 1));
            m.tbp[n] = m.tbp[n - 1] + w * h * bits / 8 / 256;
            m.tbw[n] = std::max(1u, m.tbw[n - 1] / 2);
        } else {
            const u64 r = n <= 3 ? c.miptbp1 : c.miptbp2;
            const int shift = int((n - 1) % 3) * 20;
            m.tbp[n] = Bits(r, shift, 14);
            m.tbw[n] = Bits(r, shift + 14, 6);
        }
    }
    return m;
}

u32 MipMode(const Context& c) {
    static const bool off = std::getenv("PS2HOST_NO_MIPMAPS") != nullptr;     // to compare: level 0 alone, as before
    if (off) return 0;
    const int k = int(s32(Bits(c.tex1, 32, 12) << 20) >> 20);
    if (LevelsOf(c).count == 1 || (Bits(c.tex1, 0, 1) && k <= 0)) return 0;
    return 2u | std::min(Bits(c.tex1, 2, 3), 6u) << 2 | Bits(c.tex1, 6, 3) << 5 | Bits(c.tex1, 5, 1) << 8 |
           Bits(c.tex1, 0, 1) << 9 | Bits(c.tex1, 19, 2) << 10 | Bits(c.tex1, 32, 12) << 16;
}

MipChoice ChooseLevel(u32 m, float q) {
    MipChoice out;
    const int mxl = int((m >> 2) & 7), mmin = int((m >> 5) & 7);
    float lod = float(s32(m << 4) >> 20) / 16.0f;      // K, 4 fractional bits
    if (!((m >> 9) & 1)) lod += -std::log2(std::fabs(q)) * float(1u << ((m >> 10) & 3));
    if (!(lod > 0.0f)) {
        out.linear = (m >> 8) & 1;
        return out;
    }
    out.linear = mmin == 4 || mmin == 5;
    if (mmin == 2 || mmin == 4) {
        out.n0 = out.n1 = int(std::min(std::floor(lod + 0.5f), float(mxl)));
        return out;
    }
    lod = std::min(lod, float(mxl));
    out.n0 = int(std::floor(lod));
    out.f = lod - float(out.n0);
    out.n1 = out.n0 < mxl && out.f > 0.0f ? out.n0 + 1 : out.n0;
    return out;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- primitives

void Gs::Kick(bool draw) {
    const u32 type = Prim() & 7;
    auto shift = [&](int keep_first) {
        if (keep_first) { queue_[1] = queue_[2]; queued_ = 2; }
        else { queue_[0] = queue_[1]; queue_[1] = queue_[2]; queued_ = 2; }
    };
    switch (type) {
        case 0:                                         // point
            if (draw) Draw();
            queued_ = 0;
            break;
        case 1: case 6:                                 // line, sprite
            if (queued_ < 2) return;
            if (draw) Draw();
            queued_ = 0;
            break;
        case 2:                                         // line strip
            if (queued_ < 2) return;
            if (draw) Draw();
            queue_[0] = queue_[1];
            queued_ = 1;
            break;
        case 3:                                         // triangle
            if (queued_ < 3) return;
            if (draw) Draw();
            queued_ = 0;
            break;
        case 4:                                         // triangle strip
            if (queued_ < 3) return;
            if (draw) Draw();
            shift(0);
            break;
        case 5:                                         // triangle fan
            if (queued_ < 3) return;
            if (draw) Draw();
            shift(1);
            break;
        default:
            queued_ = 0;
            break;
    }
}

void Gs::DecodeTexture(std::vector<u32>* pixels, u32* width, u32* height) const {
    Finish();
    if (setup_stale_) const_cast<Gs*>(this)->Prepare();
    const Setup& s = setup_;
    pixels->resize(std::size_t(s.tw) * s.th);
    for (u32 v = 0; v < s.th; ++v)
        for (u32 u = 0; u < s.tw; ++u) (*pixels)[std::size_t(v) * s.tw + u] = TexelAt(s, int(u), int(v));
    *width = s.tw;
    *height = s.th;
}

bool Gs::Displayed(u32* fbp, u32* fbw, u32* psm) const {
    int circuit = Bits(pmode_, 1, 1) ? 1 : Bits(pmode_, 0, 1) ? 0 : -1;
    if (circuit < 0) {
        if (!dispfb_[1] && !dispfb_[0]) return false;
        circuit = dispfb_[1] ? 1 : 0;
    }
    const u64 fb = dispfb_[circuit];
    *fbp = Bits(fb, 0, 9);
    *fbw = Bits(fb, 9, 6);
    *psm = Bits(fb, 15, 5);
    return *fbw != 0;
}

u32 Gs::FramePixel(u32 fbp, u32 fbw, u32 psm, u32 x, u32 y) const {
    Finish();
    const u32 c = memory.Read(fbp * 32, fbw, x, y, psm);
    if (psm == PSMCT16 || psm == PSMCT16S) return From16(c, 0x80ull << 32);
    if (psm == PSMCT24) return (c & 0xFFFFFF) | 0x80000000u;
    return c;
}

void Gs::Finish() const { const_cast<Gs*>(this)->FinishJobs(); }

void Gs::Draw() {
    // Timed only when it rasterises: under --gpu the bridge times itself, and
    // a timer per primitive is a measurable share of a race.
    std::optional<Timed> timed;
    if (rasterize) timed.emplace(Section::GsDraw);
    ++primitives_;
    // The software rasteriser's state; without it (--gpu), made only if the
    // texture is decoded from it - a few thousand of 73 million primitives.
    if (rasterize) Prepare();
    else setup_stale_ = true;
    if (on_draw) {
        Finish();                               // the second renderer reads local memory as of now
        on_draw(DrawCall{Prim(), &Ctx(), texa_, queue_, queued_, fogcol_, (pabe_ & 1) != 0});
    }
    if (trace) {
        const Context& c = Ctx();
        const Vertex& v = queue_[0];
        const Vertex& w = queue_[queued_ - 1];
        std::fprintf(trace_out, "[gs] prim %llX tex0 tbp %X tbw %u psm %02X %ux%u cbp %X cpsm %u csm %u csa %u cld %u"
                     " | (%.1f,%.1f)-(%.1f,%.1f) uv (%u,%u)-(%u,%u) st (%.3f,%.3f)-(%.3f,%.3f) q %.3f-%.3f"
                     " rgba %02X%02X%02X%02X z %X-%X from %08X xyz %08X\n",
                     (unsigned long long)Prim(), Bits(c.tex0, 0, 14), Bits(c.tex0, 14, 6), Bits(c.tex0, 20, 6),
                     1u << Bits(c.tex0, 26, 4), 1u << Bits(c.tex0, 30, 4), Bits(c.tex0, 37, 14),
                     Bits(c.tex0, 51, 4), Bits(c.tex0, 55, 1), Bits(c.tex0, 56, 5), Bits(c.tex0, 61, 3),
                     v.x, v.y, w.x, w.y, v.u, v.v, w.u, w.v, v.s, v.t, w.s, w.t, v.q, w.q, w.r, w.g, w.b, w.a, v.z, w.z,
                     rgba_source_, xyz_source_);
        if (queued_ == 3)
            std::fprintf(trace_out, "[gs]   middle vertex (%.1f,%.1f) st (%.4f,%.4f) q %.4f\n", queue_[1].x,
                         queue_[1].y, queue_[1].s, queue_[1].t, queue_[1].q);
        std::fprintf(trace_out, "[gs]   tex1 %llX clamp %llX texa %llX tfx %u tcc %u\n", (unsigned long long)c.tex1,
                     (unsigned long long)c.clamp, (unsigned long long)texa_, Bits(c.tex0, 35, 2), Bits(c.tex0, 34, 1));
        std::fprintf(trace_out, "[gs]   frame fbp %X fbw %u psm %02X fbmsk %08X; zbuf zbp %X psm %02X zmsk %u; test %llX alpha %llX\n",
                     Bits(c.frame, 0, 9), Bits(c.frame, 16, 6), Bits(c.frame, 24, 6), Bits(c.frame, 32, 32),
                     Bits(c.zbuf, 0, 9), Bits(c.zbuf, 24, 4), Bits(c.zbuf, 32, 1),
                     (unsigned long long)c.test, (unsigned long long)c.alpha);
    }
    if (trace) {
        // PS2HOST_GS_DUMP_BEFORE=TBP,PSM (hex): local memory to gsmem_before.bin
        // as the traced stream's first primitive with that texture is drawn.
        static const char* want = std::getenv("PS2HOST_GS_DUMP_BEFORE");
        static bool dumped = false;
        if (want && !dumped) {
            unsigned tbp = 0, psm = 0;
            const Context& c = Ctx();
            if (std::sscanf(want, "%x,%x", &tbp, &psm) == 2 && Bits(c.tex0, 0, 14) == tbp &&
                Bits(c.tex0, 20, 6) == psm && (Prim() >> 4 & 1)) {
                dumped = true;
                if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen("gsmem_before.bin", "wb")) {
                    std::fwrite(memory.data(), 1, 4u << 20, f);
                    std::fclose(f);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    const u32 type = u32(Prim() & 7);
    if (type == 7 || !rasterize) return;
    Job job{setup_, {}, queued_, 0};
    for (u32 i = 0; i < queued_ && i < 3; ++i) job.v[i] = queue_[i];
    // About how many pixels: the box around it (half for a triangle).
    float x0 = job.v[0].x, x1 = x0, y0 = job.v[0].y, y1 = y0;
    for (u32 i = 1; i < queued_ && i < 3; ++i) {
        x0 = std::min(x0, job.v[i].x); x1 = std::max(x1, job.v[i].x);
        y0 = std::min(y0, job.v[i].y); y1 = std::max(y1, job.v[i].y);
    }
    const double box = double(x1 - x0 + 1) * double(y1 - y0 + 1);
    job.pixels = (long long)std::min(1e9, type >= 3 && type <= 5 ? box / 2 : box);
    const Setup& s = job.s;
    const bool textured = Bits(s.prim, 4, 1) != 0;
    if (textured) {
        // Sampling what queued primitives write: they go first.
        for (const Job& queued : jobs_) {
            const Setup& q = queued.s;
            if ((s.tbp < q.frame_end && q.fbp < s.tex_end) || (s.tbp < q.z_end && q.zbp < s.tex_end)) {
                FinishJobs();
                break;
            }
        }
        // Sampling what it writes itself: drawn alone, in order.
        if ((s.tbp < s.frame_end && s.fbp < s.tex_end) || ((s.zte || !s.zmsk) && s.tbp < s.z_end && s.zbp < s.tex_end)) {
            FinishJobs();
            DrawJob(job, 0, 1);
            pixels_ += t_pixels;
            t_pixels = 0;
            return;
        }
    }
    jobs_.push_back(job);
    if (jobs_.size() >= kBatchPrimitives) FinishJobs();
}

void Gs::FinishJobs() {
    if (jobs_.empty()) return;
    Timed timed(Section::GsDraw);
    long long pixels = 0;
    for (const Job& job : jobs_) pixels += job.pixels;
    if (pixels < kParallelPixels) {
        for (const Job& job : jobs_) DrawJob(job, 0, 1);
        pixels_ += t_pixels;
        t_pixels = 0;
    } else {
        RowPool& pool = RowPool::Get();
        const int bands = pool.threads();
        pool.Run(0, bands, [&](int b0, int b1) {
            for (int band = b0; band < b1; ++band)
                for (const Job& job : jobs_) DrawJob(job, band, bands);
            pixels_ += t_pixels;
            t_pixels = 0;
        });
    }
    jobs_.clear();
}

void Gs::DrawJob(const Job& job, int band, int bands) {
    switch (job.s.prim & 7) {
        case 0: DrawLine(job, band, bands); break;      // a point: the line from its vertex to itself
        case 1: case 2: DrawLine(job, band, bands); break;
        case 3: case 4: case 5: DrawTriangle(job, band, bands); break;
        case 6: DrawSprite(job, band, bands); break;
        default: break;
    }
}

void Gs::DrawSprite(const Job& job, int band, int bands) {
    const Setup& st = job.s;
    const Vertex& a = job.v[0];
    const Vertex& b = job.v[1];
    const bool tme = Bits(st.prim, 4, 1), fst = Bits(st.prim, 8, 1);
    float ua, va, ub, vb;
    Coords(a, fst, st.tw, st.th, &ua, &va);
    Coords(b, fst, st.tw, st.th, &ub, &vb);
    const float x0 = std::min(a.x, b.x), x1 = std::max(a.x, b.x);
    const float y0 = std::min(a.y, b.y), y1 = std::max(a.y, b.y);
    const int ix0 = int(std::ceil(x0)), ix1 = int(std::ceil(x1));
    const int iy0 = int(std::ceil(y0)), iy1 = int(std::ceil(y1));
    const float du = x1 > x0 ? (ub - ua) / (b.x - a.x) : 0, dv = y1 > y0 ? (vb - va) / (b.y - a.y) : 0;
    // Only what the scissor lets through (Plot would drop the rest).
    const int cx0 = std::max({ix0, st.sx0, 0}), cx1 = std::min(ix1, st.sx1 + 1);
    const int cy0 = std::max({iy0, st.sy0, 0}), cy1 = std::min(iy1, st.sy1 + 1);
    for (int y = cy0; y < cy1; ++y) {
        if (!Owned(y, band, bands)) continue;
        for (int x = cx0; x < cx1; ++x) {
            const float u = ua + (float(x) - a.x) * du, v = va + (float(y) - a.y) * dv;
            Plot(st, x, y, b.z, b.r, b.g, b.b, b.a, u, v, tme, b.fog);
        }
    }
}

void Gs::DrawTriangle(const Job& job, int band, int bands) {
    const Setup& st = job.s;
    const Vertex& a = job.v[0];
    const Vertex& b = job.v[1];
    const Vertex& c = job.v[2];
    const bool iip = Bits(st.prim, 3, 1), tme = Bits(st.prim, 4, 1), fst = Bits(st.prim, 8, 1);
    const u32 tw = st.tw, th = st.th;
    const float area = (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x);
    if (area == 0.0f) return;
    const int minx = std::max(int(std::floor(std::min({a.x, b.x, c.x}))), st.sx0);
    const int maxx = std::min(int(std::ceil(std::max({a.x, b.x, c.x}))), st.sx1);
    const int miny = std::max(int(std::floor(std::min({a.y, b.y, c.y}))), st.sy0);
    const int maxy = std::min(int(std::ceil(std::max({a.y, b.y, c.y}))), st.sy1);
    float ua = 0, va = 0, ub = 0, vb = 0, uc = 0, vc = 0;
    if (fst) { Coords(a, true, tw, th, &ua, &va); Coords(b, true, tw, th, &ub, &vb); Coords(c, true, tw, th, &uc, &vc); }
    // Edge functions in double: positions are 12.4 fixed point, so their
    // products are exact there and a pixel on an edge gives exactly 0. Such a
    // pixel is drawn only on a top or left edge (the GS's fill convention, as
    // its sprites' [ceil x0, ceil x1)): one where stepping right - or down, on
    // a horizontal edge - goes inside.
    const double ax = a.x, ay = a.y, bx = b.x, by = b.y, cx = c.x, cy = c.y;
    const double sign = area > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
    const auto top_left = [&](double x0, double y0, double x1, double y1) {
        const double gx = (y0 - y1) * sign, gy = (x1 - x0) * sign;    // the inside's direction
        return gx > 0 || (gx == 0 && gy > 0);
    };
    const bool tl0 = top_left(bx, by, cx, cy), tl1 = top_left(cx, cy, ax, ay), tl2 = top_left(ax, ay, bx, by);
    for (int y = miny; y <= maxy; ++y) {
        if (!Owned(y, band, bands)) continue;
        for (int x = minx; x <= maxx; ++x) {
            const double px = x, py = y;
            const double e0 = ((bx - px) * (cy - py) - (by - py) * (cx - px)) * sign;
            const double e1 = ((cx - px) * (ay - py) - (cy - py) * (ax - px)) * sign;
            const double e2 = ((ax - px) * (by - py) - (ay - py) * (bx - px)) * sign;
            if (e0 < 0 || e1 < 0 || e2 < 0) continue;
            if ((e0 == 0 && !tl0) || (e1 == 0 && !tl1) || (e2 == 0 && !tl2)) continue;
            const float w0 = float(e0 * sign / area), w1 = float(e1 * sign / area);
            const float w2 = 1.0f - w0 - w1;
            const Vertex& last = c;
            u8 r = last.r, g = last.g, bl = last.b, al = last.a;
            if (iip) {
                r = u8(w0 * a.r + w1 * b.r + w2 * c.r);
                g = u8(w0 * a.g + w1 * b.g + w2 * c.g);
                bl = u8(w0 * a.b + w1 * b.b + w2 * c.b);
                al = u8(w0 * a.a + w1 * b.a + w2 * c.a);
            }
            const u8 fog = u8(w0 * a.fog + w1 * b.fog + w2 * c.fog);
            // Depth in double, from the first vertex: 24 and 32-bit depths do not
            // survive float, and a flat 0xFFFFFF came out 0xFFFFFE, failing GEQUAL.
            const u32 z = u32(std::clamp(double(a.z) + double(w1) * (double(b.z) - double(a.z)) +
                                         double(w2) * (double(c.z) - double(a.z)), 0.0, 4294967295.0));
            if (fst) {
                Plot(st, x, y, z, r, g, bl, al, w0 * ua + w1 * ub + w2 * uc, w0 * va + w1 * vb + w2 * vc, tme, fog);
            } else {
                const float s = w0 * a.s + w1 * b.s + w2 * c.s, t = w0 * a.t + w1 * b.t + w2 * c.t;
                const float q = w0 * a.q + w1 * b.q + w2 * c.q;
                const float qq = q != 0.0f ? q : 1.0f;
                Plot(st, x, y, z, r, g, bl, al, s / qq * float(tw), t / qq * float(th), tme, fog, qq);
            }
        }
    }
}

void Gs::DrawLine(const Job& job, int band, int bands) {
    const Setup& st = job.s;
    // A point is the line from its (last) vertex to itself.
    const bool point = (st.prim & 7) == 0;
    const Vertex& a = point ? job.v[job.count ? job.count - 1 : 0] : job.v[0];
    const Vertex& b = point ? a : job.v[1];
    const bool iip = Bits(st.prim, 3, 1), tme = Bits(st.prim, 4, 1), fst = Bits(st.prim, 8, 1);
    const int steps = std::max(1, int(std::max(std::fabs(b.x - a.x), std::fabs(b.y - a.y))));
    float ua, va, ub, vb;
    Coords(a, fst, st.tw, st.th, &ua, &va);
    Coords(b, fst, st.tw, st.th, &ub, &vb);
    for (int i = 0; i <= steps; ++i) {
        const float f = float(i) / float(steps);
        const auto mix = [&](float p, float q) { return p + (q - p) * f; };
        const int y = int(std::lround(mix(a.y, b.y)));
        if (!Owned(y, band, bands)) continue;
        const u8 r = iip ? u8(mix(a.r, b.r)) : b.r, g = iip ? u8(mix(a.g, b.g)) : b.g;
        const u8 bl = iip ? u8(mix(a.b, b.b)) : b.b, al = iip ? u8(mix(a.a, b.a)) : b.a;
        Plot(st, int(std::lround(mix(a.x, b.x))), y, u32(double(a.z) + (double(b.z) - double(a.z)) * double(f)),
             r, g, bl, al, mix(ua, ub), mix(va, vb), tme, u8(mix(a.fog, b.fog)));
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- pixels

// The registers a primitive's pixels use, decoded once.
void Gs::Prepare() {
    const Context& c = Ctx();
    const u64 prim = Prim(), test = c.test;
    Setup& s = setup_;
    setup_stale_ = false;
    s.prim = prim;
    s.texa = texa_;
    s.clut = clut_;
    s.sx0 = int(Bits(c.scissor, 0, 11));
    s.sx1 = int(Bits(c.scissor, 16, 11));
    s.sy0 = int(Bits(c.scissor, 32, 11));
    s.sy1 = int(Bits(c.scissor, 48, 11));
    s.tfx = Bits(c.tex0, 35, 2);
    s.tcc = Bits(c.tex0, 34, 1) != 0;
    const int k = int(s32(Bits(c.tex1, 32, 12) << 20) >> 20);
    const u32 mmin = Bits(c.tex1, 6, 3);
    s.linear = k <= 0 ? Bits(c.tex1, 5, 1) != 0 : (mmin == 1 || mmin == 4 || mmin == 5);
    s.mip = MipMode(c);
    s.levels = LevelsOf(c);
    s.tbp = Bits(c.tex0, 0, 14);
    s.tbw = Bits(c.tex0, 14, 6);
    s.tpsm = Bits(c.tex0, 20, 6);
    s.tw = 1u << std::min(Bits(c.tex0, 26, 4), 10u);
    s.th = 1u << std::min(Bits(c.tex0, 30, 4), 10u);
    s.csa = Bits(c.tex0, 56, 5);
    s.wms = Bits(c.clamp, 0, 2);
    s.wmt = Bits(c.clamp, 2, 2);
    s.minu = Bits(c.clamp, 4, 10);
    s.maxu = Bits(c.clamp, 14, 10);
    s.minv = Bits(c.clamp, 24, 10);
    s.maxv = Bits(c.clamp, 34, 10);
    s.ate = Bits(test, 0, 1) != 0;
    s.atst = Bits(test, 1, 3);
    s.aref = Bits(test, 4, 8);
    s.afail = Bits(test, 12, 2);
    s.date = Bits(test, 14, 1) != 0;
    s.datm = Bits(test, 15, 1);
    s.zte = Bits(test, 16, 1) != 0;
    s.ztst = Bits(test, 17, 2);
    s.zbp = Bits(c.zbuf, 0, 9) * 32;
    s.zpsm = Bits(c.zbuf, 24, 4) | 0x30;
    s.zmsk = Bits(c.zbuf, 32, 1) != 0;
    s.fbp = Bits(c.frame, 0, 9) * 32;
    s.fbw = Bits(c.frame, 16, 6);
    s.fpsm = Bits(c.frame, 24, 6);
    s.fbmsk = u32(c.frame >> 32);
    s.abe = Bits(prim, 6, 1) != 0;
    s.pabe = Bits(pabe_, 0, 1) != 0;
    s.colclamp = Bits(colclamp_, 0, 1) != 0;
    s.fba = Bits(c.fba, 0, 1) != 0;
    s.a = Bits(c.alpha, 0, 2);
    s.b = Bits(c.alpha, 2, 2);
    s.c = Bits(c.alpha, 4, 2);
    s.d = Bits(c.alpha, 6, 2);
    s.fix = Bits(c.alpha, 32, 8);
    s.fge = Bits(prim, 5, 1) != 0;
    s.fcr = Bits(fogcol_, 0, 8);
    s.fcg = Bits(fogcol_, 8, 8);
    s.fcb = Bits(fogcol_, 16, 8);
    // The blocks it reads (its texture) and writes (frame and depth, down to
    // the scissor's last row).
    const u32 rows = u32(std::max(0, s.sy1 + 1));
    s.tex_end = s.tbp + std::max(1u, s.tbw * 64 * s.th * BitsPerPixel(s.tpsm) / 8 / 256);
    for (u32 n = 1; n < s.levels.count; ++n)        // and its mipmap levels'
        s.tex_end = std::max(s.tex_end, s.levels.tbp[n] + std::max(1u, std::max(1u, s.levels.tbw[n]) * 64 *
                                                                            std::max(1u, s.th >> n) *
                                                                            BitsPerPixel(s.tpsm) / 8 / 256));
    s.frame_end = s.fbp + std::max(1u, s.fbw * 64 * rows * BitsPerPixel(s.fpsm) / 8 / 256);
    s.z_end = s.zbp + std::max(1u, s.fbw * 64 * rows * BitsPerPixel(s.zpsm) / 8 / 256);
}

// TEX1: MMAG (bit 5) filters magnification, MMIN (6-8) minification, chosen by
// the level of detail: K (bits 32-43, 4 fractional bits) alone for the whole
// primitive, or per pixel by its Q when mipmapped (MipMode, ChooseLevel).
u32 Gs::Texel(const Setup& st, float fu, float fv, float q) const {
    if (!st.mip) return Texel(st, fu, fv, 0, st.linear);
    const MipChoice m = ChooseLevel(st.mip, q);
    const u32 c0 = Texel(st, fu, fv, m.n0, m.linear);
    if (m.n1 == m.n0) return c0;
    const u32 c1 = Texel(st, fu, fv, m.n1, m.linear);
    u32 out = 0;
    for (int shift = 0; shift < 32; shift += 8) {
        const float a = float((c0 >> shift) & 0xFF), b = float((c1 >> shift) & 0xFF);
        out |= u32(std::floor(a + (b - a) * m.f + 0.5f)) << shift;
    }
    return out;
}

// Level n's texel at (u, v) in level 0's texels: the nearest, or (linear) the
// four around (u - 0.5, v - 0.5), as the GS does.
u32 Gs::Texel(const Setup& st, float fu, float fv, int n, bool linear) const {
    if (n) {
        fu /= float(1 << n);
        fv /= float(1 << n);
    }
    if (!linear) return TexelAt(st, int(std::floor(fu)), int(std::floor(fv)), n);
    // The GS's coordinates have 4 fractional bits: the weights are sixteenths,
    // and each blend truncates. A game that filters its own last frame back
    // in, over and over, relies on that: Mister Mosquito's cutscene blur lets
    // an old picture fade only because each pass loses a little (rounded to
    // the nearest, a blurred picture stood for good).
    const int x = int(std::floor((fu - 0.5f) * 16.0f)), y = int(std::floor((fv - 0.5f) * 16.0f));
    const int u0 = x >> 4, v0 = y >> 4, a = x & 15, b = y & 15;
    const u32 t00 = TexelAt(st, u0, v0, n), t10 = TexelAt(st, u0 + 1, v0, n);
    const u32 t01 = TexelAt(st, u0, v0 + 1, n), t11 = TexelAt(st, u0 + 1, v0 + 1, n);
    u32 out = 0;
    for (int shift = 0; shift < 32; shift += 8) {
        const int c00 = int((t00 >> shift) & 0xFF), c10 = int((t10 >> shift) & 0xFF);
        const int c01 = int((t01 >> shift) & 0xFF), c11 = int((t11 >> shift) & 0xFF);
        const int top = c00 + (((c10 - c00) * a) >> 4), bottom = c01 + (((c11 - c01) * a) >> 4);
        out |= u32(top + (((bottom - top) * b) >> 4)) << shift;
    }
    return out;
}

u32 Gs::TexelAt(const Setup& s, int iu, int iv, int n) const {
    u32 raw;
    if (n == 0) {
        const int u = Wrap(iu, s.tw, s.wms, s.minu, s.maxu);
        const int v = Wrap(iv, s.th, s.wmt, s.minv, s.maxv);
        raw = memory.Read(s.tbp, s.tbw, u32(u) & 2047, u32(v) & 2047, s.tpsm);
    } else {
        // Level n: TW-n by TH-n, a region's bounds shifted as its coordinates.
        const u32 w = std::max(1u, s.tw >> n), h = std::max(1u, s.th >> n);
        const int u = std::clamp(Wrap(iu, w, s.wms, s.minu >> n, s.maxu >> n), 0, int(w) - 1);
        const int v = std::clamp(Wrap(iv, h, s.wmt, s.minv >> n, s.maxv >> n), 0, int(h) - 1);
        raw = memory.Read(s.levels.tbp[n], std::max(1u, s.levels.tbw[n]), u32(u), u32(v), s.tpsm);
    }
    // A Z-format texture reads as its CT counterpart (Burnout 3's race reads
    // its depth buffer as a PSMZ16 texture, into the frame's alpha).
    switch (s.tpsm) {
        case PSMCT32: case PSMZ32: return raw;
        case PSMCT24: case PSMZ24: {
            const u32 rgb = raw & 0xFFFFFF;
            const u32 a = (Bits(s.texa, 15, 1) && !rgb) ? 0 : Bits(s.texa, 0, 8);
            return rgb | a << 24;
        }
        case PSMCT16: case PSMCT16S: case PSMZ16: case PSMZ16S: return From16(raw, s.texa);
        case PSMT8: case PSMT8H: return (*s.clut)[raw & 0xFF];
        case PSMT4: case PSMT4HL: case PSMT4HH: return (*s.clut)[(s.csa * 16 + (raw & 15)) & 0xFF];
        default: return raw;
    }
}

void Gs::Plot(const Setup& st, int x, int y, u32 z, u8 r, u8 g, u8 b, u8 a, float u, float v, bool textured,
              u8 fog, float q) {
    // Scissor.
    if (x < st.sx0 || x > st.sx1 || y < st.sy0 || y > st.sy1 || x < 0 || y < 0) return;
    u32 cr = r, cg = g, cb = b, ca = a;
    if (textured) {
        const u32 texel = Texel(st, u, v, q);
        const u32 tr = texel & 0xFF, tg = (texel >> 8) & 0xFF, tb = (texel >> 16) & 0xFF, ta = texel >> 24;
        const bool tcc = st.tcc;
        switch (st.tfx) {
            case 0:                                    // MODULATE
                cr = std::min(255u, tr * r >> 7); cg = std::min(255u, tg * g >> 7); cb = std::min(255u, tb * b >> 7);
                ca = tcc ? std::min(255u, ta * a >> 7) : a;
                break;
            case 1:                                    // DECAL
                cr = tr; cg = tg; cb = tb; ca = tcc ? ta : a;
                break;
            case 2:                                    // HIGHLIGHT
                cr = std::min(255u, (tr * r >> 7) + a); cg = std::min(255u, (tg * g >> 7) + a);
                cb = std::min(255u, (tb * b >> 7) + a); ca = tcc ? std::min(255u, ta + a) : a;
                break;
            default:                                   // HIGHLIGHT2
                cr = std::min(255u, (tr * r >> 7) + a); cg = std::min(255u, (tg * g >> 7) + a);
                cb = std::min(255u, (tb * b >> 7) + a); ca = tcc ? ta : a;
                break;
        }
    }
    // Fog (PRIM.FGE): towards FOGCOL as F falls, colour only.
    if (st.fge) {
        cr = (fog * cr + (255 - fog) * st.fcr) >> 8;
        cg = (fog * cg + (255 - fog) * st.fcg) >> 8;
        cb = (fog * cb + (255 - fog) * st.fcb) >> 8;
    }
    // Alpha test.
    bool write_rgb = true, write_alpha = true, write_z = true;
    if (st.ate) {
        const u32 ref = st.aref;
        bool pass = true;
        switch (st.atst) {
            case 0: pass = false; break;
            case 1: pass = true; break;
            case 2: pass = ca < ref; break;
            case 3: pass = ca <= ref; break;
            case 4: pass = ca == ref; break;
            case 5: pass = ca >= ref; break;
            case 6: pass = ca > ref; break;
            default: pass = ca != ref; break;
        }
        if (!pass) {
            switch (st.afail) {
                case 0: return;                                         // KEEP
                case 1: write_z = false; break;                         // FB_ONLY
                case 2: write_rgb = write_alpha = false; break;         // ZB_ONLY
                default: write_alpha = false; write_z = false; break;   // RGB_ONLY
            }
        }
    }
    const u32 fbp = st.fbp, fbw = st.fbw, fpsm = st.fpsm;
    // Destination alpha test: the frame's alpha bit (31 for 32-bit, 15 for 16-bit
    // formats; 24-bit frames have none) must equal DATM - a stencil games draw
    // into alpha first.
    if (st.date && fpsm != PSMCT24) {
        const u32 here = memory.Read(fbp, fbw, u32(x), u32(y), fpsm);
        const u32 bit = (fpsm == PSMCT16 || fpsm == PSMCT16S) ? (here >> 15) & 1 : here >> 31;
        if (bit != st.datm) return;
    }
    // Depth test.
    const u32 zbp = st.zbp, zpsm = st.zpsm;
    if (st.zte) {
        const u32 old = memory.Read(zbp, fbw, u32(x), u32(y), zpsm);
        bool pass = true;
        switch (st.ztst) {
            case 0: pass = false; break;
            case 1: pass = true; break;
            case 2: pass = z >= old; break;
            default: pass = z > old; break;
        }
        if (!pass) return;
    } else {
        write_z = false;
    }
    if (st.zmsk) write_z = false;
    // Blending.
    u32 dest = memory.Read(fbp, fbw, u32(x), u32(y), fpsm);
    if (fpsm == PSMCT16 || fpsm == PSMCT16S) dest = From16(dest, 0x80ull << 32);
    if (fpsm == PSMCT24) dest |= 0x80u << 24;
    const bool blend = st.abe && !(st.pabe && !(ca & 0x80));
    if (blend) {
        const u32 dr = dest & 0xFF, dg = (dest >> 8) & 0xFF, db = (dest >> 16) & 0xFF, da = dest >> 24;
        const int factor = st.c == 0 ? int(ca) : st.c == 1 ? int(da) : int(st.fix);
        auto pick = [&](u32 sel, u32 src, u32 dst) { return sel == 0 ? int(src) : sel == 1 ? int(dst) : 0; };
        auto mix = [&](u32 src, u32 dst) {
            int value = ((pick(st.a, src, dst) - pick(st.b, src, dst)) * factor >> 7) + pick(st.d, src, dst);
            return st.colclamp ? u32(std::clamp(value, 0, 255)) : u32(value) & 0xFF;
        };
        cr = mix(cr, dr);
        cg = mix(cg, dg);
        cb = mix(cb, db);
    }
    if (st.fba) ca |= 0x80;
    u32 out = Rgba(cr, cg, cb, ca);
    u32 mask = st.fbmsk;
    if (!write_rgb) mask |= 0x00FFFFFF;
    if (!write_alpha) mask |= 0xFF000000;
    out = (out & ~mask) | (dest & mask);
    if (mask != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        if (fpsm == PSMCT16 || fpsm == PSMCT16S) memory.Write(fbp, fbw, u32(x), u32(y), fpsm, To16(out));
        else memory.Write(fbp, fbw, u32(x), u32(y), fpsm, out);
        ++t_pixels;
    }
    if (write_z) memory.Write(zbp, fbw, u32(x), u32(y), zpsm, z);
}

}  // namespace gs
}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/gs_memory.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * GS local memory layout (GS User's Manual, chapter 8: "Data format in local
 * memory").
 *
 * Memory is 4 MB of 8 KB pages, a page 32 blocks of 256 bytes, a block four
 * columns of 64 bytes. A buffer is a base block (bp) and a width in 64-pixel
 * units (bw); its pages run left to right, then down. Each format has a page
 * size in pixels and orders the blocks within a page, and the pixels within a
 * block, its own way - the tables below. The 8-bit formats PSMT8H, PSMT4HL and
 * PSMT4HH live in the top byte (or nibble) of a PSMCT32 pixel.
 *
 *   format          page       block    pixels per block
 *   PSMCT32/24, Z32 64 x 32    8 x 8    64 words
 *   PSMCT16/16S, Z  64 x 64   16 x 8    128 halfwords
 *   PSMT8           128 x 64  16 x 16   256 bytes
 *   PSMT4           128 x 128 32 x 16   512 nibbles
 */

#include "ps2host/gs.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace ps2host {
namespace gs {

namespace {

constexpr u32 kMask = (4u << 20) - 1;

const u8 kBlock32[4][8] = {
    {0, 1, 4, 5, 16, 17, 20, 21}, {2, 3, 6, 7, 18, 19, 22, 23},
    {8, 9, 12, 13, 24, 25, 28, 29}, {10, 11, 14, 15, 26, 27, 30, 31}};
const u8 kBlockZ32[4][8] = {
    {24, 25, 28, 29, 8, 9, 12, 13}, {26, 27, 30, 31, 10, 11, 14, 15},
    {16, 17, 20, 21, 0, 1, 4, 5}, {18, 19, 22, 23, 2, 3, 6, 7}};
const u8 kBlock16[8][4] = {
    {0, 2, 8, 10}, {1, 3, 9, 11}, {4, 6, 12, 14}, {5, 7, 13, 15},
    {16, 18, 24, 26}, {17, 19, 25, 27}, {20, 22, 28, 30}, {21, 23, 29, 31}};
const u8 kBlock16S[8][4] = {
    {0, 2, 16, 18}, {1, 3, 17, 19}, {8, 10, 24, 26}, {9, 11, 25, 27},
    {4, 6, 20, 22}, {5, 7, 21, 23}, {12, 14, 28, 30}, {13, 15, 29, 31}};
const u8 kBlockZ16[8][4] = {
    {24, 26, 16, 18}, {25, 27, 17, 19}, {28, 30, 20, 22}, {29, 31, 21, 23},
    {8, 10, 0, 2}, {9, 11, 1, 3}, {12, 14, 4, 6}, {13, 15, 5, 7}};

    {24, 26, 8, 10}, {25, 27, 9, 11}, {16, 18, 0, 2}, {17, 19, 1, 3},
    {28, 30, 12, 14}, {29, 31, 13, 15}, {20, 22, 4, 6}, {21, 23, 5, 7}};

// Within a block: the word (32-bit), halfword (16-bit), byte (8-bit) or
// nibble (4-bit) holding pixel (x, y).
const u8 kColumn32[8][8] = {
    {0, 1, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 13}, {2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11, 14, 15},
    {16, 17, 20, 21, 24, 25, 28, 29}, {18, 19, 22, 23, 26, 27, 30, 31},
    {32, 33, 36, 37, 40, 41, 44, 45}, {34, 35, 38, 39, 42, 43, 46, 47},
    {48, 49, 52, 53, 56, 57, 60, 61}, {50, 51, 54, 55, 58, 59, 62, 63}};
const u8 kColumn16[8][16] = {

    {100, 102, 108, 110, 116, 118, 124, 126, 101, 103, 109, 111, 117, 119, 125, 127}};

const u8 kColumn8[8][16] = {
    {0, 4, 16, 20, 32, 36, 48, 52, 2, 6, 18, 22, 34, 38, 50, 54},
    {8, 12, 24, 28, 40, 44, 56, 60, 10, 14, 26, 30, 42, 46, 58, 62},

     196, 204, 228, 236, 132, 140, 164, 172, 198, 206, 230, 238, 134, 142, 166, 174},
    {208, 216, 240, 248, 144, 152, 176, 184, 210, 218, 242, 250, 146, 154, 178, 186,
     212, 220, 244, 252, 148, 156, 180, 188, 214, 222, 246, 254, 150, 158, 182, 190},
    {129, 137, 161, 169, 193, 201, 225, 233, 131, 139, 163, 171, 195, 203, 227, 235,
     133, 141, 165, 173, 197, 205, 229, 237, 135, 143, 167, 175, 199, 207, 231, 239},
    {145, 153, 177, 185, 209, 217, 241, 249, 147, 155, 179, 187, 211, 219, 243, 251,
     149, 157, 181, 189, 213, 221, 245, 253, 151, 159, 183, 191, 215, 223, 247, 255}};

u32 Page(u32 bp, u32 pages_per_row, u32 page_x, u32 page_y) {
    return bp + 32 * (page_y * (pages_per_row ? pages_per_row : 1) + page_x);
}

}  // namespace

u32 Memory::AddressReference(u32 bp, u32 bw, u32 x, u32 y, u32 psm, u32* nibble) {
    *nibble = 0;
    switch (psm) {
        case PSMCT32: case PSMCT24: case PSMT8H: case PSMT4HL: case PSMT4HH: {
            const u32 block = Page(bp, bw, x / 64, y / 32) + kBlock32[(y % 32) / 8][(x % 64) / 8];
            return (block * 256 + kColumn32[y % 8][x % 8] * 4) & kMask;
        }
        case PSMZ32: case PSMZ24: {
            const u32 block = Page(bp, bw, x / 64, y / 32) + kBlockZ32[(y % 32) / 8][(x % 64) / 8];
            return (block * 256 + kColumn32[y % 8][x % 8] * 4) & kMask;
        }
        case PSMCT16: case PSMCT16S: case PSMZ16: case PSMZ16S: {
            const u8 (*table)[4] = psm == PSMCT16 ? kBlock16 : psm == PSMCT16S ? kBlock16S
                                 : psm == PSMZ16 ? kBlockZ16 : kBlockZ16S;
            const u32 block = Page(bp, bw, x / 64, y / 64) + table[(y % 64) / 8][(x % 64) / 16];
            return (block * 256 + kColumn16[y % 8][x % 16] * 2) & kMask;
        }
        case PSMT8: {
            const u32 block = Page(bp, bw / 2, x / 128, y / 64) + kBlock32[(y % 64) / 16][(x % 128) / 16];
            const u32 row = y % 16;
            return (block * 256 + kColumn8[row % 8][x % 16] + (row >= 8 ? 128 : 0)) & kMask;
        }
        case PSMT4: {
            const u32 block = Page(bp, bw / 2, x / 128, y / 128) + kBlock16[(y % 128) / 16][(x % 128) / 32];
            const u32 row = y % 16;
            const u32 index = kColumn4[row % 8][x % 32] + (row >= 8 ? 256 : 0);
            *nibble = index & 1;
            return (block * 256 + index / 2) & kMask;
        }
        default:
            return (bp * 256 + (y * bw * 64 + x) * 4) & kMask;
    }
}

namespace {

// A layout's pages, precomputed: for each pixel of a page, its byte within
// the page (times two, plus the nibble, for PSMT4). Every access to GS memory
// - transfers, CLUT loads, texture decoding, the software rasteriser - goes
// through Address, and the tables took most of its time.
struct PageTable {
    u32 width, height;                  // the page, in pixels
    bool half_width;                    // pages per row are BW / 2 (PSMT8, PSMT4)
    std::vector<std::uint16_t> offset;
};

PageTable Build(u32 psm, u32 width, u32 height, bool half_width) {
    PageTable t{width, height, half_width, std::vector<std::uint16_t>(std::size_t(width) * height)};
    for (u32 y = 0; y < height; ++y)
        for (u32 x = 0; x < width; ++x) {
            u32 nibble = 0;
            const u32 a = Memory::AddressReference(0, half_width ? 2 : 1, x, y, psm, &nibble);
            t.offset[std::size_t(y) * width + x] = std::uint16_t(psm == PSMT4 ? a * 2 + nibble : a);
        }
    return t;
}

// Built once at start-up (the reference tables they come from are constant),
// and found by PSM without a guard or a switch: Address runs per pixel.
struct PageTables {
    PageTable ct32 = Build(PSMCT32, 64, 32, false), z32 = Build(PSMZ32, 64, 32, false);
    PageTable ct16 = Build(PSMCT16, 64, 64, false), ct16s = Build(PSMCT16S, 64, 64, false);
    PageTable z16 = Build(PSMZ16, 64, 64, false), z16s = Build(PSMZ16S, 64, 64, false);
    PageTable t8 = Build(PSMT8, 128, 64, true), t4 = Build(PSMT4, 128, 128, true);
    const PageTable* by_psm[64] = {};
    PageTables() {
        for (u32 psm : {PSMCT32, PSMCT24, PSMT8H, PSMT4HL, PSMT4HH}) by_psm[psm] = &ct32;
        by_psm[PSMZ32] = by_psm[PSMZ24] = &z32;
        by_psm[PSMCT16] = &ct16;
        by_psm[PSMCT16S] = &ct16s;
        by_psm[PSMZ16] = &z16;
        by_psm[PSMZ16S] = &z16s;
        by_psm[PSMT8] = &t8;
        by_psm[PSMT4] = &t4;
    }
};
const PageTables g_page_tables;

inline const PageTable* TableFor(u32 psm) { return g_page_tables.by_psm[psm & 63]; }

}  // namespace

u32 Memory::Address(u32 bp, u32 bw, u32 x, u32 y, u32 psm, u32* nibble) {
    const PageTable* t = TableFor(psm);
    if (!t) return AddressReference(bp, bw, x, y, psm, nibble);
    const u32 page = Page(bp, t->half_width ? bw / 2 : bw, x / t->width, y / t->height);
    const u32 within = t->offset[std::size_t(y % t->height) * t->width + x % t->width];
    if (psm == PSMT4) {
        *nibble = within & 1;
        return (page * 256 + within / 2) & kMask;
    }
    *nibble = 0;
    return (page * 256 + within) & kMask;
}

u32 Memory::Read(u32 bp, u32 bw, u32 x, u32 y, u32 psm) const {
    u32 nibble = 0;
    const u32 a = Address(bp, bw, x, y, psm, &nibble);
    const u8* p = &bytes_[a];
    switch (psm) {
        case PSMCT32: case PSMZ32: return u32(p[0]) | u32(p[1]) << 8 | u32(p[2]) << 16 | u32(p[3]) << 24;
        case PSMCT24: case PSMZ24: return u32(p[0]) | u32(p[1]) << 8 | u32(p[2]) << 16;
        case PSMCT16: case PSMCT16S: case PSMZ16: case PSMZ16S: return u32(p[0]) | u32(p[1]) << 8;
        case PSMT8: return p[0];
        case PSMT4: return nibble ? p[0] >> 4 : p[0] & 15;
        case PSMT8H: return p[3];
        case PSMT4HL: return p[3] & 15;
        case PSMT4HH: return p[3] >> 4;
        default: return 0;
    }
}

namespace {

// One pixel's store at byte `a` (and nibble), as Memory::Write.
template <u32 Psm>
inline void Store(u8* bytes, u32 within, u32 page, u32 value) {
    if constexpr (Psm == PSMT4) {
        u8* p = &bytes[(page * 256 + within / 2) & kMask];
        *p = (within & 1) ? u8((*p & 0x0F) | (value << 4)) : u8((*p & 0xF0) | (value & 15));
    } else {
        u8* p = &bytes[(page * 256 + within) & kMask];
        if constexpr (Psm == PSMCT32 || Psm == PSMZ32) {
            std::memcpy(p, &value, 4);
        } else if constexpr (Psm == PSMCT24 || Psm == PSMZ24) {
            p[0] = u8(value); p[1] = u8(value >> 8); p[2] = u8(value >> 16);
        } else if constexpr (Psm == PSMT8) {
            p[0] = u8(value);
        } else if constexpr (Psm == PSMT8H) {
            p[3] = u8(value);
        } else if constexpr (Psm == PSMT4HL) {
            p[3] = u8((p[3] & 0xF0) | (value & 15));
        } else if constexpr (Psm == PSMT4HH) {
            p[3] = u8((p[3] & 0x0F) | (value << 4));
        } else {  // the 16-bit formats
            const std::uint16_t half = std::uint16_t(value);
            std::memcpy(p, &half, 2);
        }
    }
}

// A row's run: the page and the row of offsets within it found once a page,
// not once a pixel.
template <u32 Psm>
void StoreRun(u8* bytes, const PageTable& t, u32 bp, u32 bw, u32 x, u32 y, const u32* values, u32 count) {
    const u32 page_bw = t.half_width ? bw / 2 : bw;
    const std::uint16_t* row = &t.offset[std::size_t(y % t.height) * t.width];
    const u32 page_y = y / t.height;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < count;) {
        const u32 px = x + i;
        const u32 page = Page(bp, page_bw, px / t.width, page_y);
        const u32 in_page = std::min(count - i, t.width - px % t.width);
        for (u32 k = 0, wx = px % t.width; k < in_page; ++k, ++wx)
            Store<Psm>(bytes, row[wx], page, values[i + k]);
        i += in_page;
    }
}

}  // namespace

void Memory::WriteRun(u32 bp, u32 bw, u32 x, u32 y, u32 psm, const u32* values, u32 count) {
    const PageTable* t = TableFor(psm);
    u8* b = bytes_.data();
    switch (t ? psm : ~0u) {
        case PSMCT32: StoreRun<PSMCT32>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMZ32: StoreRun<PSMZ32>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMCT24: StoreRun<PSMCT24>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMZ24: StoreRun<PSMZ24>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMCT16: case PSMCT16S: case PSMZ16: case PSMZ16S:
            StoreRun<PSMCT16>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMT8: StoreRun<PSMT8>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMT4: StoreRun<PSMT4>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMT8H: StoreRun<PSMT8H>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMT4HL: StoreRun<PSMT4HL>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        case PSMT4HH: StoreRun<PSMT4HH>(b, *t, bp, bw, x, y, values, count); return;
        default:
            for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) Write(bp, bw, x + i, y, psm, values[i]);
    }
}

void Memory::Write(u32 bp, u32 bw, u32 x, u32 y, u32 psm, u32 value) {
    u32 nibble = 0;
    const u32 a = Address(bp, bw, x, y, psm, &nibble);
    u8* p = &bytes_[a];
    switch (psm) {
        case PSMCT32: case PSMZ32:
            p[0] = u8(value); p[1] = u8(value >> 8); p[2] = u8(value >> 16); p[3] = u8(value >> 24); break;
        case PSMCT24: case PSMZ24:
            p[0] = u8(value); p[1] = u8(value >> 8); p[2] = u8(value >> 16); break;
        case PSMCT16: case PSMCT16S: case PSMZ16: case PSMZ16S:
            p[0] = u8(value); p[1] = u8(value >> 8); break;
        case PSMT8: p[0] = u8(value); break;
        case PSMT4: p[0] = nibble ? u8((p[0] & 0x0F) | (value << 4)) : u8((p[0] & 0xF0) | (value & 15)); break;
        case PSMT8H: p[3] = u8(value); break;
        case PSMT4HL: p[3] = u8((p[3] & 0xF0) | (value & 15)); break;
        case PSMT4HH: p[3] = u8((p[3] & 0x0F) | (value << 4)); break;
        default: break;
    }
}

}  // namespace gs
}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/gs_thread.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The GS on a thread of its own (run.h: StartGsThread).
 *
 * On the console the GS draws while the EE and VU1 go on; to the EE it is a
 * sink - the host answers CSR reads itself, and nothing the GS does comes back
 * before the frame is shown. So the host's GS model (and the GPU bridge behind
 * it) can take its packets on another thread: the EE side writes each call -
 * a quadword, a run of words, a privileged register - into a ring, in order,
 * and the GS thread makes the same calls in the same order. Nothing reads the
 * GS's state but at the end of a frame (the picture, the GPU's frame, the
 * dumps) and of the run, and there SyncGs waits for the ring to empty: the GS
 * sees the same calls as without the thread, and a scripted run draws the
 * same pictures.
 *
 * One producer (the EE thread, which runs the DMA, VIF and VU1 that feed the
 * GS) and one consumer. An exception on the GS thread is handed to the EE
 * thread at its next call here.
 */

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <exception>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#include <intrin.h>
#endif

#include "ps2host/gs.h"
#include "ps2host/timeline.h"
#include "ps2host/profile.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

using u32 = std::uint32_t;
using u64 = std::uint64_t;

constexpr u32 kRing = 1u << 22;                 // words (16 MB)
// What wakes the GS thread at once: this much waiting (16 KB), or a frame's
// end, a privileged register, the producer waiting for it. Less waits for
// its next look (kLookMs): woken for every few packets, it slept and woke
// 10,000-13,000 times a second - 30% of a core in waits through gameplay.
constexpr u32 kWakeWords = 4096;
constexpr int kLookMs = 1;
constexpr u32 kMaxRun = kRing / 8;              // the longest run of words one entry carries
enum : u32 { kQword = 1, kWord = 2, kWords = 3, kPrivileged = 4, kWrap = 5, kFrame = 6 };

std::atomic<u64> g_gs_busy_us{0};       // the GS thread at work, not waiting for more (--frame-times)

// GsFrame's work, on the GS thread at the frame's place in the stream.
std::function<void(u64)> g_frame_handler;

// When the EE ended each of the last frames (GsFrame), by frame number.
std::atomic<u64> g_frame_ended[256];

// PS2HOST_HITCH: each frame's way to the screen - when the EE ended it (and
// its idle time and VIF1's worker's busy time then), when the worker passed
// it on, when the GS thread took and finished it - and a frame that came a
// period late, or took long on its way, told.
struct FrameWay { std::atomic<u64> ee{0}, worker{0}, idle{0}, worker_us{0}; };
FrameWay g_way[256];
const bool g_hitch = std::getenv("PS2HOST_HITCH") != nullptr;

void HitchFrame(u64 frame, u64 took, u64 done) {
    static u64 last_blank = 0, last_busy = 0;
    const u64 blank = g_frame_ended[frame & 255].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const u64 busy = g_gs_busy_us.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const u64 gap = blank && last_blank && blank > last_blank ? blank - last_blank : 0;
    const auto ms = [&](u64 t) { return t && blank ? (double(t) - double(blank)) / 1e6 : -1.0; };
    const FrameWay& w = g_way[frame & 255];
    const FrameWay& before = g_way[(frame - 1) & 255];
    const u64 idle = w.idle.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), idle_before = before.idle.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const u64 vu = w.worker_us.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), vu_before = before.worker_us.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const u64 ee = w.ee.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), ee_before = before.ee.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (ms(done) > 22.0 || gap > 20'000'000)
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[hitch] frame %llu: blank %+.1f ms after the last; EE %.1f, VIF1 %.1f, GS took %.1f done %.1f ms after it; GS busy %.1f ms; EE frame %.1f ms, idle %.1f, VIF1 worker busy %.1f\n",
                     (unsigned long long)frame, last_blank ? gap / 1e6 : 0.0, ms(ee),
                     ms(w.worker.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)), ms(took), ms(done),
                     (busy - last_busy) / 1e3, ee > ee_before ? (ee - ee_before) / 1e6 : -1.0,
                     idle >= idle_before ? (idle - idle_before) / 1e6 : -1.0,
                     vu >= vu_before ? (vu - vu_before) / 1e3 : -1.0);
    last_blank = blank;
    last_busy = busy;
}

// With VIF1 on its worker (vif1_worker.cpp) the worker feeds the GS: what
// the EE would feed it goes through the worker's queue, in turn (privileged
// registers, frame ends), or waits for the queue to empty first.
struct Producing {
    Producing() {
        if (Vif1Async() && !OnVif1Worker()) JoinVif1("producing");
    }
};

u32 Header(u32 type, int path, u32 count) { return type << 28 | u32(path & 0xF) << 24 | (count & 0xFFFFFF); }

void Pause() {
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
    _mm_pause();
#endif
}

struct Feed {
    std::vector<u32> ring = std::vector<u32>(kRing);
    // Positions in words, counted from the start (the ring index is mod kRing).
    std::atomic<u64> head{0};                   // written up to, by the EE thread
    std::atomic<u64> tail{0};                   // done up to, by the GS thread
    std::atomic<bool> stop{false};
    std::atomic<bool> sleeping{false};
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::condition_variable wake;
    std::exception_ptr failed;                  // set by the GS thread, taken by the EE's
    std::atomic<bool> has_failed{false};
    std::thread thread;

    ~Feed() { Stop(); }

    void Stop() {
        if (!thread.joinable()) return;
        stop = true;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
            wake.notify_one();
        }
        thread.join();
    }

    void Rethrow() {
        if (has_failed.load()) {
            has_failed = false;
            std::rethrow_exception(failed);
        }
    }

    /* Room for `words` contiguous words: their index in the ring. */
    u32* Reserve(u32 words) {
        Rethrow();
        u64 at = head.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (at % kRing + words > kRing) {       // no room before the end: wrap
            WaitFor(kRing - at % kRing);
            ring[at % kRing] = Header(kWrap, 0, 0);
            at += kRing - at % kRing;
            head.store(at, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        WaitFor(words);
        return &ring[at % kRing];
    }

    void WaitFor(u32 words) {
        const u64 at = head.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (at + words - tail.load(std::memory_order_acquire) <= kRing) return;
        Wake();
        Timed timed(Section::GsWait);
        while (at + words - tail.load(std::memory_order_acquire) > kRing) {
            Rethrow();
            std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    }

    void Publish(u32 words, bool now = false) {
        const u64 h = head.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) + words;
        head.store(h, std::memory_order_release);
        if (sleeping.load() && (now || h - tail.load(std::memory_order_acquire) >= kWakeWords)) Wake();
    }

    void Wake() {
        if (!sleeping.load()) return;
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        wake.notify_one();
    }

    void Sync() {
        const u64 target = head.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (tail.load(std::memory_order_acquire) >= target) return Rethrow();
        Wake();
        Timed timed(Section::GsWait);
        for (int spins = 0; tail.load(std::memory_order_acquire) < target; ++spins) {
            Rethrow();
            if (spins < 4096) Pause();
            else std::this_thread::yield();
        }
        Rethrow();
    }

    void Run() {
        gs::Gs& g = gs::TheGs();
        while (true) {
            u64 t = tail.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            u64 h = head.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            if (t == h) {
                // Briefly busy, then asleep until there is more. Briefly: a
                // pause is up to 140 cycles (Skylake on), and 200 of them each
                // time the ring ran dry were a third of the thread's time in
                // gameplay (20-26% of a core -> 14-16% with 16, the pictures'
                // pacing the same). PS2HOST_GS_SPIN to measure another.
                static const int kSpins = [] {
                    const char* n = std::getenv("PS2HOST_GS_SPIN");
                    return n ? std::atoi(n) : 16;
                }();
                for (int spins = 0; spins < kSpins && t == h; ++spins) {
                    Pause();
                    h = head.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
                }
                if (t == h) {
                    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
                    sleeping = true;
                    wake.wait_for(lock, std::chrono::milliseconds(kLookMs),
                                  [&] { return stop.load() || head.load() != tail.load(); });
                    sleeping = false;
                    if (stop.load() && head.load() == tail.load()) return;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            const auto began = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            struct Busy {
                std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point began;
                ~Busy() {
                    const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
                    g_gs_busy_us.fetch_add(u64(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(now - began).count()),
                                           std::memory_order_relaxed);
                    if (timeline::On())
                        timeline::Span("busy", u64(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(began.time_since_epoch()).count()),
                                       u64(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(now.time_since_epoch()).count()));
                }
            } busy{began};
            try {
                while (t < h) {
                    const u32 at = u32(t % kRing);
                    const u32* e = &ring[at];
                    const u32 type = e[0] >> 28, count = e[0] & 0xFFFFFF;
                    const int path = int((e[0] >> 24) & 0xF);
                    u32 size = 1;
                    switch (type) {
                        case kQword:
                            g.Qword(path, u64(e[1]) | u64(e[2]) << 32, u64(e[3]) | u64(e[4]) << 32);
                            size = 5;
                            break;
                        case kWord:
                            g.Word(path, e[1]);
                            size = 2;
                            break;
                        case kWords:
                            g.Words(path, e + 2, count, e[1]);
                            size = 2 + count;
                            break;
                        case kPrivileged:
                            g.SetPrivileged(e[1], u64(e[2]) | u64(e[3]) << 32);
                            size = 4;
                            break;
                        case kFrame:
                            if (g_frame_handler) {
                                const u64 frame = u64(e[1]) | u64(e[2]) << 32;
                                const u64 took = g_hitch ? ClockNs() : 0;
                                g_frame_handler(frame);
                                if (g_hitch) HitchFrame(frame, took, ClockNs());
                            }
                            size = 3;
                            break;
                        case kWrap:
                            size = kRing - at;
                            break;
                        default:
                            break;
                    }
                    t += size;
                    tail.store(t, std::memory_order_release);
                }
            } catch (...) {
                failed = std::current_exception();
                has_failed = true;
                // Skip what is left: the EE thread stops at its next call.
                tail.store(head.load(std::memory_order_acquire), std::memory_order_release);
            }
        }
    }
};

Feed* g_feed = nullptr;

Feed& TheFeed() {
    static Feed feed;
    return feed;
}

}  // namespace

void StartGsThread() {
    if (g_feed) return;
    g_feed = &TheFeed();
    g_feed->thread = std::thread([] {
        timeline::NameThread("GS");
        FastThread();
        if (SampleGsThread()) StartSampler();
        g_feed->Run();
    });
}

void GsDrain() {
    if (Vif1Async() && !OnVif1Worker()) JoinVif1("drain");
    if (g_feed) g_feed->Sync();
}

void StopGsThread() {
    if (!g_feed) return;
    // VIF1's worker first: what it still has queued (a VU1 program's XGKICKs,
    // DIRECT) feeds the GS thread, and a feed gone under it was a crash at the
    // run's end (GsWords between its check of g_feed and its use; seen with
    // the car select's garage at 60 pictures a second keeping VU1 busy). The
    // EE has stopped: nothing more is queued. A failure of the worker's at
    // this point changes nothing - the run is over.
    if (Vif1Async() && !OnVif1Worker()) {
        try {
            JoinVif1("stop");
        } catch (...) {
        }
    }
    g_feed->Sync();
    g_feed->Stop();
    g_feed = nullptr;
}

void SyncGs() {
    JoinVif1("syncgs");
    if (g_feed) g_feed->Sync();
}

void GsQword(int path, u64 low, u64 high) {
    if (!g_feed) return gs::TheGs().Qword(path, low, high);
    Producing producing;
    u32* e = g_feed->Reserve(5);
    e[0] = Header(kQword, path, 0);
    e[1] = u32(low);
    e[2] = u32(low >> 32);
    e[3] = u32(high);
    e[4] = u32(high >> 32);
    g_feed->Publish(5);
}

void GsWord(int path, u32 word) {
    if (!g_feed) return gs::TheGs().Word(path, word);
    Producing producing;
    u32* e = g_feed->Reserve(2);
    e[0] = Header(kWord, path, 0);
    e[1] = word;
    g_feed->Publish(2);
}

void GsWords(int path, const u32* words, u32 count, u32 from) {
    if (!g_feed) return gs::TheGs().Words(path, words, count, from);
    Producing producing;
    while (count) {
        const u32 run = count < kMaxRun ? count : kMaxRun;
        u32* e = g_feed->Reserve(2 + run);
        e[0] = Header(kWords, path, run);
        e[1] = from;
        std::memcpy(e + 2, words, std::size_t(run) * 4);
        g_feed->Publish(2 + run);
        words += run;
        count -= run;
        if (from != gs::Gs::kNoSource) from += 4 * run;
    }
}

void SetGsFrameHandler(std::function<void(u64)> handler) { g_frame_handler = std::move(handler); }


u64 FrameEndedNs(u64 frame) { return g_frame_ended[frame & 255].load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

/* The steady clock, as the vertical blank's timer and the display keep time
   (ClockNs goes on from a virtual clock's time after --real-time-from). */
u64 SteadyNowNs() {
    return u64(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
                   std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
}

u64 FrameDue(u64 frame) {
    // The delay each frame came with, the longest of the last 120 (two
    // seconds: a race's heavy moments come together) the one
    // every frame keeps to (and half a millisecond more), so frames go out
    // a frame's period apart however much each took on its way; never more
    // than a period and a half behind - a frame later than that goes at once.
    static u64 delays[120] = {};
    static int next = 0;
    const u64 ended = FrameEndedNs(frame);
    const u64 now = SteadyNowNs();
    if (!ended || now < ended) return now;
    delays[next] = now - ended;
    next = (next + 1) % 120;
    if (timeline::On()) timeline::Instant("frame's delay (us)", timeline::Now(), (now - ended) / 1000);
    u64 keep = 0;
    for (u64 d : delays) keep = std::max(keep, d);
    // At least 6 ms: a frame that alone takes longer on its way (a heavy
    // frame's VU1 work, 12 ms past its blank) still goes out on time, for
    // under a third of a frame's delay where all is quick.
    keep = std::min<u64>(std::max<u64>(keep + 500'000, 6'000'000), 25'000'000);
    return std::max(now, ended + keep);
}

u64 GsBusyMicroseconds() { return g_gs_busy_us.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

bool GsFrame(u64 frame) {
    if (!g_frame_handler) return false;
    if (!OnVif1Worker()) {
        // The frame's vertical blank as the timer had it: frames a period
        // apart however late the EE took each (a long loop runs on to its
        // next loop head first).
        const u64 blank = VirtualClock() ? 0 : LastVblankNs();
        g_frame_ended[frame & 255].store(blank ? blank : SteadyNowNs(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (g_hitch) {
            g_way[frame & 255].ee.store(ClockNs(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
            g_way[frame & 255].idle.store(IdleNanoseconds(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
            g_way[frame & 255].worker_us.store(Vif1BusyMicroseconds(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
        }
    } else if (g_hitch) {
        g_way[frame & 255].worker.store(ClockNs(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    if (Vif1Async() && !OnVif1Worker()) {
        Vif1RunFrame([frame] { GsFrame(frame); });
        return true;
    }
    if (!g_feed) {
        g_frame_handler(frame);
        return true;
    }
    u32* e = g_feed->Reserve(3);
    e[0] = Header(kFrame, 0, 0);
    e[1] = u32(frame);
    e[2] = u32(frame >> 32);
    g_feed->Publish(3, true);
    return true;
}

void GsPrivileged(u32 address, u64 value) {
    if (Vif1Async() && !OnVif1Worker()) {
        Vif1Run([address, value] { GsPrivileged(address, value); });
        return;
    }
    if (!g_feed) return gs::TheGs().SetPrivileged(address, value);
    u32* e = g_feed->Reserve(4);
    e[0] = Header(kPrivileged, 0, 0);
    e[1] = address;
    e[2] = u32(value);
    e[3] = u32(value >> 32);
    g_feed->Publish(4, true);
}

}  // namespace ps2host
```

```cpp
#include "ps2host/host.h"

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
```
