```cpp
                    const int r5 = std::clamp(red + d, 0, 255) >> 3, g5 = std::clamp(green + d, 0, 255) >> 3,
                              b5 = std::clamp(blue + d, 0, 255) >> 3;
                    packed[py * 16 + px] = u16(r5 | g5 << 5 | b5 << 10 | (alpha ? 0x8000 : 0));
                }
            }
        if (rgb16) Emit(reinterpret_cast<const u8*>(packed), sizeof packed);
        else Emit(reinterpret_cast<const u8*>(rgba), sizeof rgba);
        if (--left == 0) busy = false;
    }

    void Pack(Reader& r) {
        if (left == 0) { busy = false; return; }
        u32 rgba[256];
        for (u32& p : rgba) {
            u32 v = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) v |= r.Get(8) << (8 * i);
            p = v;
        }
        const bool rgb16 = (command >> 27) & 1;
        if (rgb16) {
            u16 packed[256];
            for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
                const u32 p = rgba[i];
                packed[i] = u16(((p >> 3) & 0x1F) | ((p >> 11) & 0x1F) << 5 | ((p >> 19) & 0x1F) << 10 |
                                ((p >> 31) ? 0x8000 : ((p >> 24) ? 0x8000 : 0)));
            }
            Emit(reinterpret_cast<const u8*>(packed), sizeof packed);
        } else {
            // INDX4: the nearest of VQCLUT's 16 colours (RGB 5-5-5).
            u8 indices[128] = {};
            for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
                const u32 p = rgba[i];
                const int pr = (p >> 3) & 0x1F, pg = (p >> 11) & 0x1F, pb = (p >> 19) & 0x1F;
                int best = 0, distance = 1 << 30;
                for (int c = 0; c < 16; ++c) {
                    const int dr = pr - (vqclut[c] & 0x1F), dg = pg - ((vqclut[c] >> 5) & 0x1F),
                              db = pb - ((vqclut[c] >> 10) & 0x1F);
                    const int d = dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db;
                    if (d < distance) { distance = d; best = c; }
                }
                indices[i / 2] |= u8(best << ((i & 1) * 4));
            }
            Emit(indices, sizeof indices);
        }
        if (--left == 0) busy = false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ running
    void Pump() {
        for (int guard = 0; guard < 1000000; ++guard) {
            Fill();
            Drain();
            if (!Step()) {
                Drain();
                if (!Step()) break;
            }
        }
        Fill();
        Drain();
    }

    u64 Top() {
        // Only what has arrived: the 32 bits from BP, in the bytes Peek reads.
        const u64 last_byte = (u64(bp) >> 3) + (u64(bp & 7) + 32 + 7) / 8 - 1;
        if ((last_byte >> 4) >= buffer.size() + fifo.size()) return 1ull << 63;
        Reader r(*this);
        r.source_on = false;
        return r.Peek(32);
    }
};

Ipu& Unit() {
    static Ipu ipu;
    return ipu;
}

}  // namespace

void InstallIpu() {
    Memory& m = GuestMemory();
    Ipu& ipu = Unit();
    // IPU_CMD.
    m.OnWrite(0x10002000u, [](u32, u64 value) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        u.Command(u32(value));
        u.Pump();
    });
    m.OnRead(0x10002000u, [](u32, u64) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        u.Pump();
        return u64(u.cmd_data) | (u64(u.busy) << 63);
    });
    m.OnRead(0x10002004u, [](u32, u64) { return u64(Unit().busy) << 31; });
    // IPU_CTRL.
    m.OnWrite(0x10002010u, [](u32, u64 value) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        const u32 written = u32(value);
        if (written & (1u << 30)) u.Reset();
        const u32 writable = (3u << 16) | (1u << 20) | (1u << 21) | (1u << 22) | (1u << 23) | (7u << 24);
        u.ctrl = (u.ctrl & ~writable) | (written & writable);
        u.Pump();
    });
    m.OnRead(0x10002010u, [](u32, u64) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        u.Pump();
        return u64(u.ctrl | u32(std::min<std::size_t>(u.fifo.size(), 8)) |
                   u32(std::min<std::size_t>(u.out.size(), 8)) << 4 | (u.busy ? 1u << 31 : 0));
    });
    // IPU_BP.
    m.OnRead(0x10002020u, [](u32, u64) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        u.Pump();
        return u64(u.bp | u32(std::min<std::size_t>(u.fifo.size(), 8)) << 8 | u32(u.buffer.size()) << 16);
    });
    // IPU_TOP.
    m.OnRead(0x10002030u, [](u32, u64) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        u.Pump();
        return u.Top() | (u64(u.busy) << 63);
    });
    m.OnRead(0x10002034u, [](u32, u64) { return u64(Unit().busy) << 31; });
    // The input FIFO, written a quadword at a time (the last word hands it over).
    m.OnWrite(0x1000701Cu, [](u32, u64) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        Qword q;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) q[i] = u32(GuestMemory().Read(0x10007010u + 4 * i, 4));
        u.fifo.push_back(q);
        u.Pump();
    });
    // The output FIFO, read a quadword at a time (the first word takes it).
    m.OnRead(0x10007000u, [](u32, u64) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        u.Pump();
        Qword q = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        if (!u.out.empty()) {
            q = u.out.front();
            u.out.pop_front();
        }
        for (u32 i = 1; i < 4; ++i) SetReg(0x10007000u + 4 * i, q[i]);
        u.Pump();
        return u64(q[0]) | u64(q[1]) << 32;
    });
    // The channels.
    m.OnWrite(kToIpu + kChcr, [](u32, u64 value) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        if (value & 0x100) u.StartTo(u32(value));
        else u.to_running = false;
        u.Pump();
    });
    m.OnWrite(kFromIpu + kChcr, [](u32, u64 value) {
        Ipu& u = Unit();
        u.from_running = (value & 0x100) != 0;
        u.Pump();
    });
    (void)ipu;
}

}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/kernel.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The EE kernel, as the game calls it: `syscall` with the service number in $v1
 * and arguments in $a0-$a3 ($t0, $t1 beyond). A negative number is the same
 * service called from interrupt context. Results come back in $v0.
 *
 * What a program needs to start - its stack and heap, cache flushes, the SIF
 * registers, the syscall table it may extend. Threads, semaphores and interrupt
 * handlers are threads.cpp's. Every service is noted the first time it is used,
 * so the report shows what the game asked for.
 */

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <map>
#include <string>

#include "ps2host/memory.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

struct Kernel {
    u32 heap_end = 0;
    u32 stack_base = 0;
    u64 gs_imr = 0;
    std::map<u32, u32> sif_registers;
    // The console's settings, as Get/SetOsdConfigParam pass them: bit 0 S/PDIF,
    // 1-2 screen (0 4:3), 3 video output, 4 non-Japanese language, 5-12 PS1
    // driver settings, 13-15 version, 16-20 language (1 English), 21-31 time
    // zone offset in minutes. A US console in English, at GMT.
    u32 osd_config = (1u << 4) | (1u << 13) | (1u << 16);
};

// The kernel's syscall table, in guest kernel RAM as on the console: SetSyscall
// writes a handler into it, and a program may find it there and read or patch it
// (Burnout 3's start-up searches kernel memory for the handlers it installed, to
// learn where the table is). An entry of zero is a service the host provides.
constexpr u32 kSyscallTable = 0x80001000u;
constexpr u32 kSyscallEntries = 256;

u32 TableEntry(s32 number) {
    return u32(number) < kSyscallEntries
               ? u32(GuestMemory().Read(kSyscallTable + 4 * u32(number), 4)) : 0;
}

Kernel& K() {
    static Kernel kernel;
    return kernel;
}

u32 Arg(const lifted::Context& c, int i) {
    static const int regs[] = {4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9};     // $a0-$a3, $t0, $t1
    return u32(c.r[regs[i]]);
}

void Return(lifted::Context& c, u64 value) { c.r[2] = u64(s64(s32(u32(value)))); }

struct Service {
    s32 number;
    const char* name;
};

// The documented EE kernel services (engine/data/ee_syscalls.csv names them for
// the analysis; these are the ones the host knows by name).
const Service kServices[] = {
    {0x04, "Exit"}, {0x05, "RFU005"}, {0x06, "LoadExecPS2"}, {0x07, "ExecPS2"},
    {0x0D, "SetVTLBRefillHandler"}, {0x0E, "SetVCommonHandler"},
    {0x10, "AddIntcHandler"}, {0x11, "RemoveIntcHandler"},
    {0x12, "AddDmacHandler"}, {0x13, "RemoveDmacHandler"},
    {0x14, "_EnableIntc"}, {0x15, "_DisableIntc"}, {0x16, "_EnableDmac"},
    {0x17, "_DisableDmac"}, {0x20, "CreateThread"}, {0x21, "DeleteThread"},
    {0x22, "StartThread"}, {0x23, "ExitThread"}, {0x24, "ExitDeleteThread"},
    {0x25, "TerminateThread"}, {0x29, "ChangeThreadPriority"},
    {0x2B, "RotateThreadReadyQueue"}, {0x2F, "GetThreadId"},
    {0x30, "ReferThreadStatus"}, {0x32, "SleepThread"}, {0x33, "WakeupThread"}, {0x34, "iWakeupThread"},
    {0x37, "SuspendThread"}, {0x39, "ResumeThread"}, {0x3C, "SetupThread"},
    {0x3D, "SetupHeap"}, {0x3E, "EndOfHeap"}, {0x40, "CreateSema"},
    {0x41, "DeleteSema"}, {0x42, "SignalSema"}, {0x43, "iSignalSema"},
    {0x44, "WaitSema"}, {0x45, "PollSema"}, {0x47, "ReferSemaStatus"},
    {0x4A, "SetOsdConfigParam"}, {0x4B, "GetOsdConfigParam"}, {0x5A, "kCopy"},
    {0x64, "FlushCache"},
    {0x70, "GsGetIMR"}, {0x71, "GsPutIMR"}, {0x73, "SetVSyncFlag"},
    {0x74, "SetSyscall"}, {0x76, "SifDmaStat"}, {0x77, "SifSetDma"},
    {0x78, "SifSetDChain"}, {0x79, "SifSetReg"}, {0x7A, "SifGetReg"},
    {0x7C, "Deci2Call"}, {0xFC, "SetAlarm"}, {0xFD, "ReleaseAlarm"},
    {0xFE, "iSetAlarm"}, {0xFF, "iReleaseAlarm"},
};

}  // namespace

const char* SyscallName(s32 service) {
    const s32 number = service < 0 ? -service : service;
    for (const Service& s : kServices)
        if (s.number == number) return s.name;
    return "?";
}

void KernelSyscall(lifted::Context& c) {
    const s32 service = s32(u32(c.r[3]));
    const s32 number = service < 0 ? -service : service;
    if (number < 0x100) ++RunStats().syscall_counts[service + 0x100];
    else ++RunStats().syscalls[service];
    // Only the first call of each service is noted (unless every call is): a game
    // makes hundreds of thousands a minute (Resident Evil Outbreak's thread
    // scheduler), and formatting each one's note cost 2-4% of the EE.
    static std::atomic<bool> noted[0x200];
    const bool first = number < 0x100 ? !noted[service + 0x100].exchange(true) : true;
    if (first || Tracing() || NotingAll()) {
        char text[160];
        std::snprintf(text, sizeof text, "kernel %s (0x%02X) a0=0x%08X a1=0x%08X a2=0x%08X a3=0x%08X",
                      SyscallName(service), unsigned(number), Arg(c, 0), Arg(c, 1), Arg(c, 2),
                      Arg(c, 3));
        if (Tracing()) std::fprintf(stderr, "[%s]\n", text);
        else Note("syscall " + std::to_string(service), text);
    }
    Kernel& k = K();
    // A service the program installed itself (SetSyscall) runs its own handler,
    // in kernel mode on the console - here, as any other guest function.
    if (const u32 handler = TableEntry(number)) {
        Dispatch(c, handler);
        return;
    }
    u64 result = 0;
    if (ThreadSyscall(c, service, result)) {
        Return(c, result);
        return;
    }
    switch (number) {
        case 0x04:                                   // Exit(status)
            throw GuestExit{s32(Arg(c, 0))};
        case 0x06: case 0x07:                        // LoadExecPS2 / ExecPS2
            throw Unimplemented{std::string("the kernel service ") + SyscallName(service) +
                                ", which starts another program"};
        case 0x64:                                   // FlushCache(which)
            // Invalidating the instruction cache (2): the program wrote code it is
            // about to run - an overlay loaded. 0 (writing back the data cache,
            // before a DMA) leaves code as it was; Resident Evil Outbreak issues it
            // every frame, and each emptied the whole call cache.
            if (Arg(c, 0) == 2) CodeChanged();
            Return(c, 0);
            return;
        case 0x3C: {                                 // SetupThread(gp, stack, size, args, root)
            const u32 stack = Arg(c, 1), size = Arg(c, 2);
            // A stack of -1 means "at the top of RAM"; the thread's stack pointer
            // is the top of its stack, less the kernel's argument area.
            const u32 base = stack == 0xFFFFFFFFu ? kRdramSize - size : stack;
            k.stack_base = base;
            Return(c, base + size - 0x2A0);
            return;
        }
        case 0x3D: {                                 // SetupHeap(start, size)
            const u32 start = Arg(c, 0), size = Arg(c, 1);
            k.heap_end = size == 0xFFFFFFFFu ? k.stack_base : start + size;
            Return(c, k.heap_end);
            return;
        }
        case 0x3E:                                   // EndOfHeap()
            Return(c, k.heap_end);
            return;
        case 0x70:                                   // GsGetIMR
            Return(c, k.gs_imr);
            return;
        case 0x71:                                   // GsPutIMR(imr)
            k.gs_imr = Arg(c, 0);
            Return(c, 0);
            return;
        case 0x74:                                   // SetSyscall(service, handler)
            // The SDK patches the kernel's alarms (SetAlarm, iSetAlarm, ReleaseAlarm,
            // iReleaseAlarm, and their timer 3 handler at 0x12C) with code that
            // drives the kernel's own interrupt dispatch. The host keeps those
            // calls: its alarms are the same API, run by its own scheduler.
            if (Arg(c, 0) >= 0xFC && Arg(c, 0) <= 0xFF) {
                char text[160];
                std::snprintf(text, sizeof text, "kernel: the program's patch of syscall 0x%02X is not "
                              "installed: the host's alarms stand", unsigned(Arg(c, 0)));
                Note("syscall patch " + std::to_string(Arg(c, 0)), text);
            } else if (Arg(c, 0) < kSyscallEntries) {
                GuestMemory().Write(kSyscallTable + 4 * Arg(c, 0), Arg(c, 1), 4);
            }
            Return(c, 0);
            return;
        case 0x5A: {                                 // kCopy(dest, src, size): from kernel memory
            Memory& m = GuestMemory();
            for (u32 i = 0; i + 4 <= Arg(c, 2); i += 4)
                m.Write(Arg(c, 0) + i, m.Read(Arg(c, 1) + i, 4), 4);
            Return(c, 0);
            return;
        }
        case 0x76:                                   // SifDmaStat(id): < 0 when done
            Return(c, u64(-1));
            return;
        case 0x77: {                                 // SifSetDma(transfers*, count)
            if (Tracing()) {
                // struct SifDmaTransfer { void* src; void* dest; int size; int attr; }
                Memory& m = GuestMemory();
                for (u32 i = 0; i < Arg(c, 1); ++i) {
                    const u32 t = Arg(c, 0) + 16 * i;
                    const u32 src = u32(m.Read(t, 4)), dest = u32(m.Read(t + 4, 4));
                    const u32 size = u32(m.Read(t + 8, 4)), attr = u32(m.Read(t + 12, 4));
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "  [sif dma] src=0x%08X dest=0x%08X size=%u attr=0x%X:",
                                 src, dest, size, attr);
                    for (u32 w = 0; w < size && w < 64; w += 4)
                        std::fprintf(stderr, " %08X", u32(m.Read(src + w, 4)));
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "\n");
                }
            }
            SifDma(Arg(c, 0), Arg(c, 1));
            Return(c, 1);
            return;
        }
        case 0x78:                                   // SifSetDChain
            Return(c, 1);
            return;
        case 0x79:                                   // SifSetReg(reg, value)
            k.sif_registers[Arg(c, 0)] = Arg(c, 1);
            Return(c, 1);
            return;
        case 0x7A:                                   // SifGetReg(reg)
            // Every status bit set: the IOP reports itself up and ready, as the
            // verification interpreter does (engine/ps2decomp/emu.py).
            Return(c, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
            return;
        case 0x4A:                                   // SetOsdConfigParam(config*)
            k.osd_config = u32(GuestMemory().Read(Arg(c, 0), 4));
            Return(c, 0);
            return;
        case 0x4B:                                   // GetOsdConfigParam(config*)
            GuestMemory().Write(Arg(c, 0), k.osd_config, 4);
            Return(c, 0);
            return;
        case 0x7C: {                                 // Deci2Call(function, params*)
            // DECI2 talks to a development tool's debugger. A retail console has
            // none attached, so every request fails - and code that sends its
            // TTY output over DECI2 gives up rather than waiting on a reply that
            // never comes. kputs (0x10) is the kernel's own debug print: the text
            // is the game's, so it goes to the log.
            if (Arg(c, 0) == 0x10) {
                Memory& m = GuestMemory();
                std::string text;
                for (u32 p = u32(m.Read(Arg(c, 1), 4)); text.size() < 1024; ++p) {
                    const char ch = char(m.Read(p, 1));
                    if (!ch) break;
                    text += ch;
                }
                while (!text.empty() && (text.back() == '\n' || text.back() == '\r')) text.pop_back();
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[guest] %s\n", text.c_str());
                Return(c, 0);
                return;
            }
            Return(c, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
            return;
        }
        default:
            // The rest - handler enables, cache flushes, thread status, priorities -
            // have no effect the program depends on yet: succeed quietly.
            Return(c, 0);
            return;
    }
}

}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/loadfile.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The IOP's module loader (server 0x80000006, loadfile), on the host.
 *
 * Nothing runs on an IOP here: what a module would provide, the host provides,
 * one RPC server at a time. So loading a module succeeds without running
 * anything - it is noted, given a module ID, and reported as having started
 * and stayed resident - and the servers it would have registered answer from
 * the host when the game binds them (or are noted as missing).
 *
 * The protocol, as Burnout 3's EE-side library (0x00113578-0x00113F98) speaks it:
 *   procedure 0xFF  the module's version, 4 characters: the library compares it
 *                   with the release it was built for and refuses to load
 *                   anything otherwise. "2800" is SDK release 2.8.
 *   procedure 0     load a module from a path. The request:
 *                     0x000  argument length       (the answer: module ID)
 *                     0x004  -                     (the answer: start result)
 *                     0x008  path, 252 bytes ("cdrom0:\\IOP\\USBD.IRX;1")
 *                     0x104  arguments, 252 bytes
 * Any other procedure is noted and fails.
 */

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "ps2host/disc.h"
#include "ps2host/host.h"
#include "ps2host/iop_vm.h"
#include "ps2host/memory.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

// The release the IOP's loadfile answers: until the game reboots the IOP with
// a replacement image, the one Burnout 3's ROM-booted IOP was taken to have.
char g_version[4] = {'2', '8', '0', '0'};
constexpr s32 kNoSuchProcedure = -1;
constexpr u32 kResidentEnd = 0;     // a module's start result: started, stays loaded

std::vector<u8> Words(s32 first, u32 second) {
    std::vector<u8> out(8);
    std::memcpy(&out[0], &first, 4);
    std::memcpy(&out[4], &second, 4);
    return out;
}

// A module the port runs (iop_vm.h): read from the disc and started.
std::vector<u8> RunFromDisc(s32 id, const std::string& path, const std::vector<u8>& data) {
    std::string disc_path = path;
    const std::size_t colon = disc_path.find(':');
    if (colon != std::string::npos) disc_path = disc_path.substr(colon + 1);
    Disc::File file;
    if (!GuestDisc().IsOpen() || !GuestDisc().Find(disc_path, &file))
        throw Unimplemented{"IOP: module " + path + " is to run, but is not on the disc"};
    std::vector<u8> image((file.size + kSectorSize - 1) / kSectorSize * kSectorSize);
    GuestDisc().Read(file.lsn, u32(image.size() / kSectorSize), image.data());
    image.resize(file.size);
    s32 arg_length = 0;
    std::memcpy(&arg_length, &data[0], 4);
    std::vector<u8> args;
    if (arg_length > 0 && data.size() >= 0x104 + std::size_t(arg_length))
        args.assign(data.begin() + 0x104, data.begin() + 0x104 + arg_length);
    s32 result = 0;
    if (!iop::LoadModule(path, image, args, &result))
        throw Unimplemented{"IOP: " + path + " is not a module the interpreter can load"};
    return Words(id, u32(result));
}

std::string Hex(u32 value) {
    char text[16];
    std::snprintf(text, sizeof text, "0x%08X", value);
    return text;
}

// A module the EE put in IOP memory (sceSifLoadModuleBuffer): its ELF image -
// as long as its program and section headers say - and the name its .iopmod
// section gives it ("sio2man"); empty when it is not a module.
std::vector<u8> ModuleInIopMemory(u32 address, std::string* name) {
    Memory& m = GuestMemory();
    auto u16at = [&](u32 o) { return u16(m.Read(kIopRamBase + address + o, 2)); };
    auto u32at = [&](u32 o) { return u32(m.Read(kIopRamBase + address + o, 4)); };
    name->clear();
    if (address >= kIopRamSize || u32at(0) != 0x464C457Fu) return {};
    const u32 phoff = u32at(0x1C), shoff = u32at(0x20);
    const u16 phentsize = u16at(0x2A), phnum = u16at(0x2C), shentsize = u16at(0x2E),
              shnum = u16at(0x30);
    u32 size = shoff + u32(shnum) * shentsize;
    for (u16 i = 0; i < phnum; ++i) {
        const u32 ph = phoff + u32(i) * phentsize;
        size = std::max(size, u32at(ph + 4) + u32at(ph + 16));
    }
    for (u16 i = 0; i < shnum; ++i) {
        const u32 sh = shoff + u32(i) * shentsize;
        size = std::max(size, u32at(sh + 16) + (u32at(sh + 4) == 8 ? 0 : u32at(sh + 20)));
    }
    if (size > kIopRamSize - address) return {};
    std::vector<u8> image(size);
    for (u32 i = 0; i < size; ++i) image[i] = u8(m.Read(kIopRamBase + address + i, 1));
    // .iopmod (type 0x70000080): module info, entry, gp, text, data and BSS
    // sizes, a 16-bit version, then the name.
    for (u16 i = 0; i < shnum; ++i) {
        const u32 sh = shoff + u32(i) * shentsize;
        if (u32at(sh + 4) != 0x70000080u) continue;
        const u32 at = u32at(sh + 16) + 0x1A;
        for (u32 k = at; k < size && image[k]; ++k) *name += char(image[k]);
    }
    // A module with no name (Resident Evil Outbreak's sound driver) is named by
    // its size, so a port can still ask for it to run: "unnamed-38664".
    if (name->empty()) *name = "unnamed-" + std::to_string(size);
    return image;
}

std::vector<u8> LoadFile(u32 procedure, const std::vector<u8>& data) {
    static s32 next_id = 1;
    if (procedure == 0xFF) return std::vector<u8>(g_version, g_version + 4);
    if (procedure == 0 && data.size() >= 0x104) {
        const char* begin = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&data[8]);
        const std::string path(begin, strnlen(begin, 252));
        const s32 id = next_id++;
        if (iop::RunsModule(path)) return RunFromDisc(id, path, data);
        Note("module " + path, "IOP: module " + path + " loaded as " + std::to_string(id) +
                                   " (its services are the host's)");
        return Words(id, kResidentEnd);
    }
    if (procedure == 6 && data.size() >= 8) {
        // A module from IOP memory: its address, the arguments' length, the
        // arguments from 0x104 - answered as procedure 0 is.
        u32 address = 0;
        s32 arg_length = 0;
        std::memcpy(&address, &data[0], 4);
        std::memcpy(&arg_length, &data[4], 4);
        address &= kIopRamSize - 1;
        std::string name;
        const std::vector<u8> image = ModuleInIopMemory(address, &name);
        if (image.empty()) {
            Note("module buffer " + std::to_string(address),
                 "IOP: no module at IOP address " + Hex(address) + " to load (failed)");
            return Words(-1, 0);
        }
        const s32 id = next_id++;
        if (iop::RunsModule(name)) {
            std::vector<u8> args;
            if (arg_length > 0 && data.size() >= 0x104 + std::size_t(arg_length))
                args.assign(data.begin() + 0x104, data.begin() + 0x104 + arg_length);
            s32 result = 0;
            if (!iop::LoadModule(name, image, args, &result))
                throw Unimplemented{"IOP: " + name + " is not a module the interpreter can load"};
            return Words(id, u32(result));
        }
        Note("module " + name, "IOP: module " + name +
                                   " from IOP memory at " + Hex(address) + " loaded as " +
                                   std::to_string(id) + " (its services are the host's)");
        return Words(id, kResidentEnd);
    }
    Note("loadfile " + std::to_string(procedure),
         "IOP: loadfile procedure " + std::to_string(procedure) + " is not implemented (failed)");
    return Words(kNoSuchProcedure, 0);
}

}  // namespace

void InstallLoadFile() { RegisterRpcServer(0x80000006u, LoadFile); }

// An IOP replacement image (IOPRPnnn.IMG) holds its modules, each with its
// library tag - eight characters of name, four of release: "loadfile2340".
// Its loadfile's release is what loadfile answers from then on.
void UseIopImage(const std::string& path) {
    std::string disc_path = path;
    const std::size_t colon = disc_path.find(':');
    if (colon != std::string::npos) disc_path = disc_path.substr(colon + 1);
    std::vector<u8> image;
    if (!GuestDisc().IsOpen() || !GuestDisc().ReadFile(disc_path, &image)) {
        Note("iop image " + path, "IOP: reboot image " + path + " is not on the disc");
        return;
    }
    static const char kTag[] = "loadfile";
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 12 <= image.size(); ++i) {
        if (std::memcmp(&image[i], kTag, 8) != 0) continue;
        bool digits = true;
        for (int k = 8; k < 12; ++k) digits = digits && image[i + k] >= '0' && image[i + k] <= '9';
        if (!digits) continue;
        std::memcpy(g_version, &image[i + 8], 4);
        Note("iop image " + path, "IOP: rebooted with " + path + ": loadfile " +
                                      std::string(g_version, 4));
        return;
    }
    Note("iop image " + path, "IOP: reboot image " + path + " has no loadfile tag");
}

const char* IopRelease() { return g_version; }

}  // namespace ps2host
```

`host/src/main.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * Every game port's entry point. The game supplies its translated functions (the
 * table engine/tools/port.py generates) and its overrides; the rest is shared.
 */

#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <io.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <commdlg.h>

#include "ps2host/disc.h"
#include "ps2host/host.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"
#include "ps2host/settings.h"

#if defined(_MSC_VER) && (defined(_M_X64) || defined(_M_IX86))
#include <intrin.h>
#endif

extern const ps2host::FunctionEntry kGuestFunctions[];
extern const std::size_t kGuestFunctionCount;
extern const ps2host::OverlayEntry kGuestOverlays[];
extern const std::size_t kGuestOverlayCount;

/* The game's host implementations of guest functions (its port's overrides.cpp). */
void RegisterGameOverrides();

namespace {

/* The port is built for AVX2 (engine/host/CMakeLists.txt; the VU's lanes and
   the rest take its three-operand forms): a processor without it is told so
   rather than stopped by an illegal instruction somewhere. */
bool HasAvx2() {
#if defined(_MSC_VER) && (defined(_M_X64) || defined(_M_IX86)) && defined(__AVX2__)
    int info[4];
    __cpuid(info, 0);
    if (info[0] < 7) return false;
    __cpuid(info, 1);
    const bool osxsave = (info[2] >> 27) & 1, avx = (info[2] >> 28) & 1;
    if (!osxsave || !avx) return false;
    if ((_xgetbv(0) & 6) != 6) return false;        // the OS saves the YMM registers
    __cpuidex(info, 7, 0);
    return (info[1] >> 5) & 1;
#else
    return true;
#endif
}

std::string g_log;     // the log a run started without arguments writes

#ifdef PS2HOST_GAME_EXECUTABLE
/* Whether `path` is an image of the game's disc: the executable it boots is
   the one the port was translated from (game.json's). */
bool IsGameDisc(const std::string& path) {
    ps2host::Disc disc;
    if (!disc.Open(path)) return false;
    std::string boot = disc.BootPath();
    const std::size_t semicolon = boot.find(';');
    if (semicolon != std::string::npos) boot.resize(semicolon);
    while (!boot.empty() && (boot[0] == '\\' || boot[0] == '/')) boot.erase(0, 1);
    return _stricmp(boot.c_str(), PS2HOST_GAME_EXECUTABLE) == 0;
}

/* The player's disc image, from a file dialog; "" if they cancel. */
std::string PickDisc() {
    char file[MAX_PATH] = {};
    OPENFILENAMEA dialog = {};
    dialog.lStructSize = sizeof dialog;
    dialog.lpstrFilter = "Disc images (*.iso; *.cue; *.bin)\0*.iso;*.cue;*.bin\0All files (*.*)\0*.*\0";
    dialog.lpstrFile = file;
    dialog.nMaxFile = MAX_PATH;
    dialog.lpstrTitle = "Choose your " PS2HOST_GAME_NAME " disc image";
    dialog.Flags = OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST | OFN_PATHMUSTEXIST | OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_NOCHANGEDIR;
    return GetOpenFileNameA(&dialog) ? std::string(file) : std::string();
}
#endif

/* Started without arguments - from Explorer, a shortcut - the port plays its
   game from the player's own disc image: the one chosen before (kept in the
   PC settings, beside the executable), or asked for and checked to be the
   game's disc; the memory card a directory beside it too. In a window, with
   sound, on the GPU, with no time limit (the default is for test runs).
   An empty list: the player gave none. */
std::vector<std::string> PlayArguments(const char* self) {
#ifdef PS2HOST_GAME_EXECUTABLE
    wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH] = {};
    GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH);
    const std::filesystem::path here = std::filesystem::path(exe).parent_path();
    ps2host::LoadSettings((here / "pc_settings.ini").string());     // where --memcard puts them
    std::string disc = ps2host::Setting("disc");
    // None chosen yet, or gone: an image of the game's disc beside the
    // executable is taken without asking.
    if (!IsGameDisc(disc)) {
        std::error_code error;
        for (const auto& entry : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(here, error)) {
            std::string ext = entry.path().extension().string();
            for (char& ch : ext) ch = char(tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)));
            if ((ext == ".iso" || ext == ".bin" || ext == ".cue") && IsGameDisc(entry.path().string())) {
                disc = entry.path().string();
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    while (!IsGameDisc(disc)) {
        if (!disc.empty() && GetFileAttributesA(disc.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES)
            MessageBoxA(nullptr, ("This is not an image of the " PS2HOST_GAME_NAME " disc "
                                  "(" PS2HOST_GAME_EXECUTABLE "):\n\n" + disc).c_str(),
                        PS2HOST_GAME_NAME, MB_OK | MB_ICONWARNING);
        disc = PickDisc();
        if (disc.empty()) return {};
    }
    if (disc != ps2host::Setting("disc")) ps2host::SetSetting("disc", disc);
    // No terminal to read: what the run says goes to a log beside it. Opened
    // once, shared (fopen's would lock the file to one stream), and given to
    // both: their lines in the order they were written.
    g_log = std::filesystem::path(exe).stem().string() + ".log";
    const std::string log = (here / g_log).string();
    std::FILE* stream = nullptr;
    freopen_s(&stream, "NUL", "w", stdout);    // streams with descriptors, in a windowed program
    freopen_s(&stream, "NUL", "w", stderr);
    const int file = _open(log.c_str(), _O_WRONLY | _O_CREAT | _O_TRUNC | _O_TEXT, _S_IREAD | _S_IWRITE);
    if (file >= 0) {
        _dup2(file, _fileno(stdout));
        _dup2(file, _fileno(stderr));
        _close(file);
    }
    std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);  // a run ended by force loses nothing
    std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[port] disc %s\n", disc.c_str());
    return {self, "--disc", disc, "--memcard", (here / "memcard").string(), "--window", "--gpu",
            "--audio", "--timeout", "315360000"};     // ten years
#else
    return {self};
#endif
}

}  // namespace

/* A port built as a windowed program has no console of its own. Started from
   a terminal its output goes to that one; redirected (a file, a pipe: the
   tools' runs), where it was sent. */
void AttachTerminal() {
    const HANDLE out = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE);
    if (out != nullptr && out != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    if (!AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS)) return;
    std::FILE* stream = nullptr;
    freopen_s(&stream, "CONOUT$", "w", stdout);
    freopen_s(&stream, "CONOUT$", "w", stderr);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    AttachTerminal();
    std::vector<std::string> play;
    std::vector<char*> play_argv;
    if (argc == 1) {
        play = PlayArguments(argv[0]);
        if (play.empty()) return 0;
        for (std::string& arg : play) play_argv.push_back(arg.data());
        play_argv.push_back(nullptr);
        argc = int(play.size());
        argv = play_argv.data();
    }
    if (!HasAvx2()) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "This build needs a processor with AVX2 (Intel Haswell, AMD Excavator or later).\n");
        return 70;
    }
#ifdef PS2HOST_GAME_TITLE
    ps2host::SetGameTitle(PS2HOST_GAME_TITLE);      // the window's (game.json's "title")
#endif
#ifdef PS2HOST_GAME_VERSION
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[port] %s, version %s\n", PS2HOST_GAME_TITLE, PS2HOST_GAME_VERSION);
#endif
    ps2host::RegisterFunctions(kGuestFunctions, kGuestFunctionCount);
    ps2host::RegisterOverlays(kGuestOverlays, kGuestOverlayCount);
    RegisterGameOverrides();
    const int code = ps2host::Main(argc, argv);
    if (!play.empty() && code != 0) {         // closing the window ends a run with 0
        std::fflush(nullptr);
        const std::string text = "The game stopped because of an error. What happened is in " +
                                 g_log + ", beside the game.";
        MessageBoxA(nullptr, text.c_str(), ps2host::GameTitle().empty() ? "PS2 port" : ps2host::GameTitle().c_str(),
                    MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    }
    // What must be finished is (the report written, the settings and the
    // memory card saved as they changed, the WAV's header here); the rest -
    // the window, the GPU device, the threads - goes with the process.
    // Taken down one by one at exit, the Vulkan device's could hang
    // (vkDestroyDevice with the driver's threads and the renderer's images
    // still about), leaving a window that never closed.
    ps2host::CloseAudio();
    ps2host::ReleaseController();
    std::fflush(nullptr);
    TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), UINT(code));
    return code;
}
```

`host/src/mc2.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * libmc2's handlers over a directory (mc2.h).
 */

#include "ps2host/mc2.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <system_error>
#include <vector>

#include "ps2host/memory.h"
#include "ps2rt/generated.h"

namespace ps2host {
namespace mc2 {

namespace {

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

constexpr u32 kFound = 0x81010011;        // EEXIST: the lookup's "here it is"
constexpr u32 kNoEntry = 0x81010002;      // ENOENT
constexpr u32 kNotDirectory = 0x81010014; // ENOTDIR
constexpr u32 kInvalid = 0x81010016;      // EINVAL
constexpr u32 kNoSpace = 0x8101001C;      // ENOSPC
constexpr u32 kBadName = 0x8101005B;
constexpr u32 kTooDeep = 0x81019004;      // a directory under a directory under the root
constexpr u32 kCardKb = 8000;             // an 8 MB card's clusters, less its file system
constexpr u16 kDirectoryMode = 0x8427, kFileMode = 0x8417, kWritten = 0x80;

// What a handler returns in $v0: a 32-bit value, sign-extended as the R5900
// keeps every word. Zero-extended, the codes with bit 31 set (all of them)
// were not the values the game compares with: Resident Evil Outbreak's card
// thread turns EEXIST into 0 with a `bne` against 0xFFFFFFFF81010011, saw
// 0x0000000081010011 instead, kept the code, and took a card holding its save
// for one that "cannot be found".
u64 Result(u32 value) { return u64(s64(s32(value))); }

std::string& Directory() {
    static std::string directory;
    return directory;
}

std::string GuestString(u32 address, u32 limit = 0x80) {
    std::string text;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < limit; ++i) {
        const char ch = char(generated::ReadU8(address + i));
        if (!ch) break;
        text += ch;
    }
    return text;
}

void CopyToGuest(u32 address, const u8* bytes, std::size_t size) {
    if (u8* p = GuestMemory().Translate(address, u32(size))) {
        std::memcpy(p, bytes, size);
        return;
    }
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) generated::Write8(address + u32(i), bytes[i]);
}

void CopyFromGuest(u32 address, u8* bytes, std::size_t size) {
    if (const u8* p = GuestMemory().Translate(address, u32(size))) {
        std::memcpy(bytes, p, size);
        return;
    }
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) bytes[i] = u8(generated::ReadU8(address + u32(i)));
}

// The card's path for `name` (relative to the root, '/' separated): its
// components, none of them "..". False for a name that is no path.
bool Components(const std::string& name, std::vector<std::string>* parts) {
    std::string part;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i <= name.size(); ++i) {
        if (i == name.size() || name[i] == '/') {
            if (part == "..") return false;
            if (!part.empty() && part != ".") parts->push_back(part);
            part.clear();
        } else {
            part += name[i];
        }
    }
    return true;
}

fs::path HostPath(const std::vector<std::string>& parts) {
    fs::path path = fs::u8path(Directory());
    for (const std::string& part : parts) path /= fs::u8path(part);
    return path;
}

// sceMc2StDateTime: reserved, second, minute, hour, day, month, year (u16).
void DateTime(const fs::path& path, u8 out[8]) {
    std::error_code error;
    const auto written = fs::last_write_time(path, error);
    std::time_t when = 0;
    if (!error) {
        // The file clock's time on the system clock (C++17 has no clock_cast).
        const auto system = std::chrono::time_point_cast<std::chrono::system_clock::duration>(
            written - fs::file_time_type::clock::now() + std::chrono::system_clock::now());
        when = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(system);
    }
    std::tm local{};
    localtime_s(&local, &when);
    const u32 year = u32(local.tm_year + 1900);
    const u8 bytes[8] = {0, u8(local.tm_sec), u8(local.tm_min), u8(local.tm_hour), u8(local.tm_mday),
                         u8(local.tm_mon + 1), u8(year), u8(year >> 8)};
    std::memcpy(out, bytes, 8);
}

struct Entry {
    std::string name;
    fs::path path;
    bool directory = false;
    u32 size = 0;
    u16 mode() const { return directory ? kDirectoryMode : u16(kFileMode | (size ? kWritten : 0)); }
};

Entry Describe(const fs::path& path) {
    Entry e;
    e.name = path.filename().u8string();
    e.path = path;
    std::error_code error;
    e.directory = fs::is_directory(path, error);
    if (!e.directory) e.size = u32(fs::file_size(path, error));
    return e;
}

u32 UsedKb() {
    u32 kb = 2;                                 // the root's own entries
    std::error_code error;
    for (auto it = fs::recursive_directory_iterator(fs::u8path(Directory()), error);
         !error && it != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); it.increment(error)) {
        if (it->is_directory(error)) kb += 2;
        else kb += u32((it->file_size(error) + 1023) / 1024);
    }
    return kb;
}

u32 FreeKb() {
    const u32 used = UsedKb();
    return used >= kCardKb ? 0 : kCardKb - used;
}

bool Matches(const char* pattern, const char* name) {
    if (!*pattern) return !*name;
    if (*pattern == '*') return Matches(pattern + 1, name) || (*name && Matches(pattern, name + 1));
    if (!*name) return false;
    return (*pattern == '?' || *pattern == *name) && Matches(pattern + 1, name + 1);
}

// The directory's entries in a fixed order (by name): a real card lists them
// in the order they were made, which a directory on the host does not keep.
std::vector<Entry> List(const fs::path& directory) {
    std::vector<Entry> entries;
    std::error_code error;
    for (auto it = fs::directory_iterator(directory, error); !error && it != fs::directory_iterator();
         it.increment(error))
        entries.push_back(Describe(it->path()));
    std::sort(entries.begin(), entries.end(), [](const Entry& a, const Entry& b) { return a.name < b.name; });
    return entries;
}

// SceMc2DirParam: created +0, modified +8, size +0x10, attributes +0x14, name +0x18.
void WriteDirParam(u32 address, const Entry& e) {
    u8 bytes[0x38] = {};
    DateTime(e.path, bytes);
    std::memcpy(bytes + 8, bytes, 8);           // the host keeps one time: modified stands for both
    const u32 size = e.size;
    std::memcpy(bytes + 0x10, &size, 4);
    const u16 mode = e.mode();
    std::memcpy(bytes + 0x14, &mode, 2);
    std::memcpy(bytes + 0x18, e.name.c_str(), std::min<std::size_t>(e.name.size(), 31));
    CopyToGuest(address, bytes, sizeof bytes);
}

// The common start: the name, as a path on the card. A result other than 0
// is the request's answer.
u32 Resolve(lifted::Context& c, std::vector<std::string>* parts) {
    const std::string name = GuestString(u32(c.r[5]), 0x80);
    if (!Components(name, parts)) return kInvalid;
    std::error_code error;
    fs::create_directories(fs::u8path(Directory()), error);
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace

const std::string& CardDirectory() { return Directory(); }
void SetCardDirectory(const std::string& directory) { Directory() = directory; }

void GetInfo(lifted::Context& c) {
    const u32 info = u32(c.r[5]);
    std::error_code error;
    fs::create_directories(fs::u8path(Directory()), error);
    if (info) {
        generated::Write32(info, 2);            // a PS2 memory card
        generated::Write32(info + 4, 1);        // formatted
        generated::Write32(info + 8, FreeKb());
    }
    c.r[2] = 0;
}

void Format(lifted::Context& c) { c.r[2] = 0; }

void ReadFile(lifted::Context& c) {
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    if (const u32 refused = Resolve(c, &parts)) { c.r[2] = Result(refused); return; }
    const u32 buffer = u32(c.r[6]), offset = u32(c.r[7]);
    u32 size = u32(c.r[8]);
    const fs::path path = HostPath(parts);
    std::error_code error;
    if (parts.empty() || !fs::exists(path, error) || fs::is_directory(path, error)) { c.r[2] = Result(kNoEntry); return; }
    const u32 length = u32(fs::file_size(path, error));
    if (offset > length) { c.r[2] = Result(kInvalid); return; }
    if (size == 0 || offset + size > length) size = length - offset;
    std::vector<u8> bytes(size);
    std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
    file.seekg(offset);
    file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes.data()), size);
    CopyToGuest(buffer, bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    c.r[2] = Result(size);
}

void WriteFile(lifted::Context& c) {
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    if (const u32 refused = Resolve(c, &parts)) { c.r[2] = Result(refused); return; }
    const u32 buffer = u32(c.r[6]), offset = u32(c.r[7]), size = u32(c.r[8]);
    const fs::path path = HostPath(parts);
    std::error_code error;
    if (parts.empty() || !fs::exists(path, error) || fs::is_directory(path, error)) { c.r[2] = Result(kNoEntry); return; }
    const u32 length = u32(fs::file_size(path, error));
    if (offset > length) { c.r[2] = Result(kInvalid); return; }
    const u32 grows = offset + size > length ? (offset + size + 1023) / 1024 - (length + 1023) / 1024 : 0;
    if (grows > FreeKb()) { c.r[2] = Result(kNoSpace); return; }
    std::vector<u8> bytes(size);
    CopyFromGuest(buffer, bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    std::fstream file(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::in | std::ios::out);
    file.seekp(offset);
    file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), size);
    c.r[2] = Result(size);
}

void Create(lifted::Context& c) {
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    if (const u32 refused = Resolve(c, &parts)) { c.r[2] = Result(refused); return; }
    const u32 mode = u32(c.r[6]) ? u32(c.r[6]) : kFileMode;
    const bool directory = (mode & 0x20) != 0;
    if (parts.empty() || parts.back().size() > 31) { c.r[2] = Result(kBadName); return; }
    if (directory && parts.size() > 1) { c.r[2] = Result(kTooDeep); return; }
    const fs::path path = HostPath(parts);
    std::error_code error;
    if (fs::exists(path, error)) { c.r[2] = Result(kFound); return; }
    if (!fs::is_directory(path.parent_path(), error)) { c.r[2] = Result(kNoEntry); return; }
    if (FreeKb() < (directory ? 2u : 1u)) { c.r[2] = Result(kNoSpace); return; }
    if (directory) fs::create_directory(path, error);
    else std::ofstream(path, std::ios::binary);
    c.r[2] = 0;
}

void GetDir(lifted::Context& c) {
    const std::string name = GuestString(u32(c.r[5]), 0x80);
    const u32 offset = u32(c.r[6]);
    const s32 maxent = s32(c.r[7]);
    const u32 entries = u32(c.r[8]), count = u32(c.r[9]);
    const std::size_t slash = name.rfind('/');
    const std::string directory = slash == std::string::npos ? "" : name.substr(0, slash);
    const std::string pattern = slash == std::string::npos ? name : name.substr(slash + 1);
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    if (pattern.empty() || !Components(directory, &parts)) { c.r[2] = Result(kInvalid); return; }
    const fs::path path = HostPath(parts);
    std::error_code error;
    fs::create_directories(fs::u8path(Directory()), error);
    if (!fs::exists(path, error)) { c.r[2] = Result(kNoEntry); return; }
    if (!fs::is_directory(path, error)) { c.r[2] = Result(kNotDirectory); return; }
    const std::vector<Entry> listed = List(path);
    u32 matched = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = offset; i < listed.size(); ++i) {
        if (!Matches(pattern.c_str(), listed[i].name.c_str())) continue;
        if (maxent > 0) {
            if (matched >= u32(maxent)) break;
            WriteDirParam(entries + matched * 0x38, listed[i]);
        }
        ++matched;
    }
    if (count) generated::Write32(count, matched);
    c.r[2] = 0;
}

void Lookup(lifted::Context& c) {
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    if (const u32 refused = Resolve(c, &parts)) { c.r[2] = Result(refused); return; }
    const u32 entry = u32(c.r[6]);
    const fs::path path = HostPath(parts);
    std::error_code error;
    if (parts.empty() || !fs::exists(path, error)) { c.r[2] = Result(kNoEntry); return; }
    const Entry e = Describe(path);
    if (entry) {
        u8 bytes[0x60] = {};
        const u16 mode = e.mode();
        std::memcpy(bytes, &mode, 2);
        std::memcpy(bytes + 4, &e.size, 4);
        DateTime(e.path, bytes + 8);
        DateTime(e.path, bytes + 0x18);
        std::memcpy(bytes + 0x40, e.name.c_str(), std::min<std::size_t>(e.name.size(), 31));
        CopyToGuest(entry, bytes, sizeof bytes);
    }
    c.r[2] = Result(kFound);
}

}  // namespace mc2
}  // namespace ps2host
```

`host/src/mcserv.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * libmc's memory card server (mcserv, RPC 0x80000400) over a directory: the
 * same card mc2.h keeps for libmc2's games (--memcard DIR; none given, no
 * card is in the slot).
 *
 * The protocol, as Mister Mosquito's libmc 2.3 speaks it (EE 0x0010DA80-
 * 0x0010F000). Each call is NOWAIT with a 0x30-byte request (0x414 when it
 * carries a path, at +0x14) and a one-word answer, the result; libmc's
 * sceMcSync finishes the call, and for some an end function copies what the
 * module DMA'd into an EE buffer of the library's:
 *
 *   0xFE  init: answer three words - result, mcserv's and mcman's versions
 *         (libmc wants at least 0x20A and 0x20E)
 *   0x01  getinfo: +4 port, +8 slot, +0xC/+0x10/+0x14 whether format, free
 *         and type are wanted, +0x1C the EE buffer they go to (+0 type,
 *         +4 free KB, +0x90 format); result 0 (the same card), -1 (a new,
 *         formatted card), -10 (no card)
 *   0x02  open: +0 port, +4 slot, +8 mode (1 read, 2 write, 3 both, 0x200
 *         create, 0x400 truncate; 0x40 makes a directory), +0x14 path;
 *         result a descriptor
 *   0x03  close: +0 fd           0x0A  flush: +0 fd
 *   0x04  seek: +0 fd, +0x10 offset, +0x14 origin (0 set, 1 current, 2 end)
 *   0x05  read: +0 fd, +0xC size, +0x18 EE buffer, +0x1C a record for the
 *         buffer's unaligned ends { size1, size2, dest1, dest2, bytes... }
 *         that the end function copies out - here every byte goes straight
 *         to the buffer and the record says none
 *   0x06  write: +0 fd, +0x14 the bytes before the buffer's 16-byte
 *         alignment, sent at +0x20, then +0xC bytes from EE address +0x18
 *   0x0C  chdir: +0 port, +4 slot, +0x10 an EE buffer for the directory left,
 *         +0x14 path
 *   0x0D  getdir: +0 port, +4 slot, +8 0 to start (1 to go on), +0xC entries
 *         at most, +0x10 the EE table (64 bytes an entry: created, modified,
 *         size, attributes, name at +0x20), +0x14 a path with * and ?
 *   0x0E  setfileinfo (accepted)  0x0F  delete: +0x14 path
 *   0x10  format (the directory is always formatted)
 *   0x14  accepted              0x15  slots on a port: 1
 *
 * Errors: -4 no such entry, -5 refused, -7 too many open.
 */

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>
#include <vector>

#include "ps2host/host.h"
#include "ps2host/mc2.h"
#include "ps2host/memory.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

constexpr s32 kNoCard = -10, kNewFormatted = -1, kNoEntry = -4, kRefused = -5, kTooMany = -7;
constexpr u32 kCardKb = 8000;

struct Open {
    fs::path path;
    u32 position = 0;
    bool write = false;
};

struct Card {
    std::map<s32, Open> files;
    std::string current = "/";
    bool seen = false;                      // a getinfo has reported the card once
    std::vector<fs::path> listing;          // getdir's matches, for "go on"
    std::size_t listed = 0;
};

Card& C() {
    static Card card;
    return card;
}

u32 At(const std::vector<u8>& data, std::size_t offset) {
    u32 value = 0;
    if (offset + 4 <= data.size()) std::memcpy(&value, &data[offset], 4);
    return value;
}

std::vector<u8> Result(s32 value) {
    std::vector<u8> out(4);
    std::memcpy(out.data(), &value, 4);
    return out;
}

std::string PathAt(const std::vector<u8>& data, std::size_t offset) {
    std::string path;
    for (std::size_t i = offset; i < data.size() && data[i]; ++i) path += char(data[i]);
    return path;
}

bool Present(u32 port, u32 slot) { return !mc2::CardDirectory().empty() && port == 0 && slot == 0; }

// A card path (absolute, or from the current directory) as a host path under
// the card's directory; false for one that would leave it.
bool HostPath(const std::string& card_path, fs::path* out) {
    std::string full = !card_path.empty() && card_path[0] == '/' ? card_path : C().current + "/" + card_path;
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    std::size_t at = 0;
    while (at <= full.size()) {
        std::size_t end = full.find('/', at);
        if (end == std::string::npos) end = full.size();
        const std::string part = full.substr(at, end - at);
        at = end + 1;
        if (part.empty() || part == ".") continue;
        if (part == "..") {
            if (parts.empty()) return false;
            parts.pop_back();
            continue;
        }
        parts.push_back(part);
    }
    fs::path path = fs::u8path(mc2::CardDirectory());
    for (const std::string& p : parts) path /= fs::u8path(p);
    *out = path;
    return true;
}

bool Matches(const char* pattern, const char* name) {
    if (!*pattern) return !*name;
    if (*pattern == '*') return Matches(pattern + 1, name) || (*name && Matches(pattern, name + 1));
    if (!*name) return false;
    return (*pattern == '?' || *pattern == *name) && Matches(pattern + 1, name + 1);
}

void PutDate(u8* out, const fs::path& path) {
    std::error_code error;
    std::time_t when = std::time(nullptr);
    const auto stamp = fs::last_write_time(path, error);
    if (!error)
        when = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(
            std::chrono::time_point_cast<std::chrono::system_clock::duration>(
                stamp - fs::file_time_type::clock::now() + std::chrono::system_clock::now()));
    std::tm t{};
    localtime_s(&t, &when);
    out[0] = 0;
    out[1] = u8(t.tm_sec);
    out[2] = u8(t.tm_min);
    out[3] = u8(t.tm_hour);
    out[4] = u8(t.tm_mday);
    out[5] = u8(t.tm_mon + 1);
    const u16 year = u16(t.tm_year + 1900);
    std::memcpy(out + 6, &year, 2);
}

// A getdir entry: created, modified, size, attributes, name.
void PutEntry(u32 address, const fs::path& path, const std::string& name) {
    std::error_code error;
    u8 entry[64] = {};
    PutDate(entry, path);
    PutDate(entry + 8, path);
    const bool directory = fs::is_directory(path, error);
    const u32 size = directory ? 0 : u32(fs::file_size(path, error));
    const u16 attributes = directory ? 0x8427 : 0x8417;
    std::memcpy(entry + 0x10, &size, 4);
    std::memcpy(entry + 0x14, &attributes, 2);
    std::memcpy(entry + 0x20, name.c_str(), std::min<std::size_t>(name.size(), 31));
    Memory& m = GuestMemory();
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 64; ++i) m.Write(address + i, entry[i], 1);
}

u32 UsedKb() {
    std::error_code error;
    u64 bytes = 0;
    for (const auto& e : fs::recursive_directory_iterator(fs::u8path(mc2::CardDirectory()), error))
        if (e.is_regular_file(error)) bytes += (e.file_size(error) + 1023) / 1024 * 1024;
    return u32(bytes / 1024);
}

std::vector<u8> Server(u32 procedure, const std::vector<u8>& data) {
    Card& card = C();
    Memory& m = GuestMemory();
    std::error_code error;
    switch (procedure) {
        case 0xFE: {
            std::vector<u8> out = Result(0);
            const std::vector<u8> serv = Result(0x20A), man = Result(0x20E);
            out.insert(out.end(), serv.begin(), serv.end());
            out.insert(out.end(), man.begin(), man.end());
            return out;
        }
        case 0x01: {
            const u32 port = At(data, 4), slot = At(data, 8), info = At(data, 0x1C);
            const bool present = Present(port, slot);
            if (present) fs::create_directories(fs::u8path(mc2::CardDirectory()), error);
            if (info) {
                m.Write(info + 0, present ? 2 : 0, 4);                     // a PS2 card
                m.Write(info + 4, present ? kCardKb - std::min(kCardKb, UsedKb()) : 0, 4);
                m.Write(info + 0x90, present ? 1 : 0, 4);                  // formatted
            }
            if (!present) return Result(kNoCard);
            const s32 result = card.seen ? 0 : kNewFormatted;
            card.seen = true;
            return Result(result);
        }
        case 0x02: {
            if (!Present(At(data, 0), At(data, 4))) return Result(kNoCard);
            const u32 mode = At(data, 8);
            const std::string name = PathAt(data, 0x14);
            fs::path path;
            if (!HostPath(name, &path)) return Result(kRefused);
            if (mode & 0x40) {                                  // a directory
                if (fs::exists(path, error)) return Result(kNoEntry);    // it is there already
                fs::create_directories(path, error);
                Note("mc mkdir " + name, "MC: made the directory " + name);
                return Result(error ? kRefused : 0);
            }
            const bool exists = fs::is_regular_file(path, error);
            if (!exists && !(mode & 0x200)) return Result(kNoEntry);
            if (!exists || (mode & 0x400)) {
                fs::create_directories(path.parent_path(), error);
                std::ofstream(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
            }
            s32 fd = 0;
            while (card.files.count(fd)) ++fd;
            if (fd >= 32) return Result(kTooMany);
            card.files[fd] = {path, 0, (mode & 2) != 0};
            Note("mc open " + name, "MC: opened " + name);
            return Result(fd);
        }
        case 0x03:
            card.files.erase(s32(At(data, 0)));
            return Result(0);
        case 0x04: {
            auto f = card.files.find(s32(At(data, 0)));
            if (f == card.files.end()) return Result(kNoEntry);
            const s32 offset = s32(At(data, 0x10));
            const u32 origin = At(data, 0x14);
            const s64 size = s64(fs::file_size(f->second.path, error));
            s64 to = origin == 0 ? offset : origin == 1 ? s64(f->second.position) + offset : size + offset;
            if (to < 0) to = 0;
            f->second.position = u32(to);
            return Result(s32(to));
        }
        case 0x05: {
            auto f = card.files.find(s32(At(data, 0)));
            if (f == card.files.end()) return Result(kNoEntry);
            const u32 size = At(data, 0xC), buffer = At(data, 0x18), ends = At(data, 0x1C);
            std::ifstream in(f->second.path, std::ios::binary);
            in.seekg(f->second.position);
            std::vector<char> bytes(size);
            in.read(bytes.data(), size);
            const u32 got = u32(in.gcount());
            for (u32 i = 0; i < got; ++i) m.Write(buffer + i, u8(bytes[i]), 1);
            if (ends)
                for (u32 k = 0; k < 16; ++k) m.Write(ends + k, 0, 1);
            f->second.position += got;
            return Result(s32(got));
        }
        case 0x06: {
            auto f = card.files.find(s32(At(data, 0)));
            if (f == card.files.end()) return Result(kNoEntry);
            const u32 head = At(data, 0x14), size = At(data, 0xC), from = At(data, 0x18);
            std::vector<char> bytes;
            for (u32 i = 0; i < head && 0x20 + i < data.size(); ++i) bytes.push_back(char(data[0x20 + i]));
            for (u32 i = 0; i < size; ++i) bytes.push_back(char(m.Read(from + i, 1)));
            std::fstream out(f->second.path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::in | std::ios::out);
            out.seekp(f->second.position);
            out.write(bytes.data(), std::streamsize(bytes.size()));
            f->second.position += u32(bytes.size());
            Note("mc write " + f->second.path.filename().string(),
                 "MC: wrote " + f->second.path.filename().u8string());
            return Result(s32(bytes.size()));
        }
        case 0x0A: case 0x0E: case 0x10: case 0x14:
            return Result(0);
        case 0x15:
            return Result(1);
        case 0x0C: {
            if (!Present(At(data, 0), At(data, 4))) return Result(kNoCard);
            const u32 left = At(data, 0x10);
            if (left)
                for (u32 i = 0; i <= card.current.size(); ++i)
                    m.Write(left + i, i < card.current.size() ? u8(card.current[i]) : 0, 1);
            const std::string name = PathAt(data, 0x14);
            fs::path path;
            if (!HostPath(name, &path) || !fs::is_directory(path, error)) return Result(kNoEntry);
            std::string next = !name.empty() && name[0] == '/' ? name : card.current + "/" + name;
            card.current = next.empty() ? "/" : next;
            return Result(0);
        }
        case 0x0D: {
            if (!Present(At(data, 0), At(data, 4))) return Result(kNoCard);
            const u32 go_on = At(data, 8), table = At(data, 0x10);
            const s32 most = s32(At(data, 0xC));
            const std::string name = PathAt(data, 0x14);
            if (!go_on) {
                card.listing.clear();
                card.listed = 0;
                const std::size_t slash = name.rfind('/');
                const std::string directory = slash == std::string::npos ? "" : name.substr(0, slash + 1);
                const std::string pattern = slash == std::string::npos ? name : name.substr(slash + 1);
                fs::path path;
                if (!HostPath(directory.empty() ? "." : directory, &path) || !fs::is_directory(path, error))
                    return Result(kNoEntry);
                if (directory != "/" && !directory.empty()) {
                    if (Matches(pattern.c_str(), ".")) card.listing.push_back(path / ".");
                    if (Matches(pattern.c_str(), "..")) card.listing.push_back(path / "..");
                }
                for (const auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(path, error))
                    if (Matches(pattern.c_str(), e.path().filename().u8string().c_str()))
                        card.listing.push_back(e.path());
            }
            s32 count = 0;
            while (card.listed < card.listing.size() && count < most) {
                const fs::path& p = card.listing[card.listed++];
                const std::string entry_name = p.filename().u8string();
                PutEntry(table + 64 * u32(count), entry_name == "." || entry_name == ".." ? p.parent_path() : p,
                         entry_name);
                ++count;
            }
            return Result(count);
        }
        case 0x0F: {
            if (!Present(At(data, 0), At(data, 4))) return Result(kNoCard);
            fs::path path;
            if (!HostPath(PathAt(data, 0x14), &path) || !fs::exists(path, error)) return Result(kNoEntry);
            fs::remove(path, error);
            return Result(error ? kRefused : 0);
        }
        default: {
            char text[96];
            std::snprintf(text, sizeof text, "MC: mcserv procedure 0x%X is not implemented (failed)",
                          unsigned(procedure));
            Note("mcserv " + std::to_string(procedure), text);
            return Result(kRefused);
        }
    }
}

}  // namespace

// PS2HOST_MC_LOG=1: every call and its result.
std::vector<u8> Logged(u32 procedure, const std::vector<u8>& data) {
    std::vector<u8> answer = Server(procedure, data);
    if (std::getenv("PS2HOST_MC_LOG")) {
        s32 result = 0;
        if (answer.size() >= 4) std::memcpy(&result, answer.data(), 4);
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[mc] procedure 0x%X: %08X %08X %08X %08X \"%s\" -> %d\n", unsigned(procedure),
                     unsigned(At(data, 0)), unsigned(At(data, 4)), unsigned(At(data, 8)), unsigned(At(data, 0xC)),
                     PathAt(data, 0x14).c_str(), int(result));
    }
    return answer;
}

void InstallMcserv() { RegisterRpcServer(0x80000400u, Logged); }

}  // namespace ps2host
```

`host/src/memory.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ps2host/memory.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include "ps2host/run.h"
#include "ps2host/vu.h"
#include "ps2rt/generated.h"

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

// Hooks are indexed by register word: the EE window's words, then the GS's.
constexpr u32 kEeWords = kEeRegisterSize / 4;
constexpr u32 kGsWords = kGsRegisterSize / 4;

// kseg0 and kseg1 addresses, as the physical address they reach.
u32 Physical(u32 address) {
    return (address >= 0x80000000u && address < 0xC0000000u) ? address & 0x1FFFFFFFu : address;
}

int HookIndex(u32 address) {
    if (address - kEeRegisterBase < kEeRegisterSize) return (address - kEeRegisterBase) / 4;
    if (address - kGsRegisterBase < kGsRegisterSize)
        return kEeWords + (address - kGsRegisterBase) / 4;
    return -1;
}

}  // namespace

Memory::Memory()
    : rdram_(kRdramSize), scratchpad_(kScratchpadSize), ee_registers_(kEeRegisterSize),
      vu_memory_(kVuMemorySize), gs_registers_(kGsRegisterSize), iop_ram_(kIopRamSize),
      bios_(kBiosSize),
      read_hooks_(kEeWords + kGsWords), write_hooks_(kEeWords + kGsWords),
      read_counts_(kEeWords + kGsWords), write_counts_(kEeWords + kGsWords) {}

std::map<u32, u64> Memory::RegisterCounts(bool written) const {
    const std::vector<u64>& counts = written ? write_counts_ : read_counts_;
    std::map<u32, u64> seen;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < counts.size(); ++i)
        if (counts[i])
            seen[i < kEeWords ? kEeRegisterBase + 4 * i : kGsRegisterBase + 4 * (i - kEeWords)] = counts[i];
    return seen;
}

u8* Memory::Translate(u32 address, u32 size) {
    // kseg0 (0x80000000) and kseg1 (0xA0000000) see the whole low 512 MB of the
    // physical address space - RDRAM and the device registers alike.
    address = Physical(address);
    const u32 last = address + size - 1;
    // RDRAM and its user-mode mirrors: the top bits select the window, the rest
    // the byte.
    switch (address >> 28) {
        case 0x0: case 0x2: case 0x3: {
            const u32 offset = address & 0x0FFFFFFFu;
            if (offset < kRdramSize && (last & 0x0FFFFFFFu) < kRdramSize)
                return rdram_.data() + offset;
            break;
        }
        default:
            break;
    }
    // The other windows, by the address's top byte (each lies within one):
    // the scratchpad and the device registers are reached a great deal.
    auto in = [&](u32 base, u32 size, std::vector<u8>& bytes) -> u8* {
        return address - base < size && last - base < size ? bytes.data() + (address - base) : nullptr;
    };
    switch (address >> 24) {
        case kScratchpadBase >> 24: return in(kScratchpadBase, kScratchpadSize, scratchpad_);
        case kEeRegisterBase >> 24: return in(kEeRegisterBase, kEeRegisterSize, ee_registers_);
        case kVuMemoryBase >> 24: return in(kVuMemoryBase, kVuMemorySize, vu_memory_);
        case kGsRegisterBase >> 24: return in(kGsRegisterBase, kGsRegisterSize, gs_registers_);
        case 0x1C: case 0x1D: return in(kIopRamBase, kIopRamSize, iop_ram_);
        case 0x1F: return in(kBiosBase, kBiosSize, bios_);
        default: return nullptr;
    }
}

namespace {
/* Registers and memory VIF1's worker changes or reads (vif1_worker.cpp):
   GIF and VIF1 registers and FIFOs, VU1's memories (not VU0's: the EE uses
   them all the time). Not the DMA channels and the DMAC's D_STAT: a transfer
   ends on the EE's thread, the worker running on from a copy of its data.
   Of the GIF's registers only GIF_STAT, the one the worker changes; VIF1's
   only written: VIF1's model keeps its state to itself, and what a read
   finds there is the same with the worker done or not. */
bool Vif1Sees(u32 a, bool write) {
    return (a - 0x10003020u < 4u) || (write && a - 0x10003C00u < 0x400u) || (a - 0x10005000u < 0x2000u) ||
           (a - 0x11008000u < 0x8000u);
}
}  // namespace

u64 Memory::Read(u32 address, u32 size) {
    address = Physical(address);
    // GIF_STAT, while VIF1's worker has work: what it will read once the
    // worker is done, worked out rather than waited for (Vif1Guess).
    const bool status = Vif1Guessable(address, size) && !OnVif1Worker();
    if (Vif1Busy() && Vif1Sees(address, false)) {
        u32 guess = 0;
        if (status && Vif1Guess(address, &guess)) return guess;
        JoinVif1("read", address);
    }
    u8* bytes = Translate(address, size);
    if (!bytes) throw MemoryFault{address, false};
    u64 value = 0;
    std::memcpy(&value, bytes, size);        // the EE and the host are both little-endian
    const int index = HookIndex(address & ~3u);
    if (index >= 0) {
        if (!OnVif1Worker()) ++read_counts_[index];
        if (read_hooks_[index]) value = read_hooks_[index](address, value);
    }
    if (status) Vif1Settled(address, u32(value));     // read with the queue run
    return value;
}

void Memory::WatchWrites(const std::vector<u32>& addresses) {
    watched_ = addresses;
    generated::ram_watched = !addresses.empty();     // writes come here to be seen
}

void Memory::Watched(u32 address, u64 value, u32 size) {
    const std::vector<u32>& calls = CurrentCalls();
    const u32 in = calls.empty() ? 0 : calls.back();
    // The callers too, innermost first: the function writing is often a helper.
    char chain[128] = "";
    for (std::size_t i = 1, n = 0; i < calls.size() && i <= 10; ++i)
        n += std::snprintf(chain + n, sizeof chain - n, " < %08X", unsigned(calls[calls.size() - 1 - i]));
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[write] 0x%08X <- 0x%llX (%u bytes) in 0x%08X%s\n", unsigned(address),
                 static_cast<unsigned long long>(value), unsigned(size), unsigned(in), chain);
}

void Memory::Write(u32 address, u64 value, u32 size) {
    address = Physical(address);
    // VIF1's FIFO excepted: a quadword stored there goes to the worker in turn (devices.cpp).
    if (Vif1Busy() && Vif1Sees(address, true) && address - 0x10005000u >= 0x1000u) JoinVif1("write", address);
    // Into VU0's or VU1's instruction memory: their compiled programs are
    // compared with it again (Vu::MicroWritten).
    if (address - 0x11000000u < 0x10000u && ((address >> 14) & 1) == 0) {
        if (address < 0x11008000u) Vu0().MicroWritten();
        else Vu1().MicroWritten();
    }
    if (!watched_.empty())
        for (u32 w : watched_)
            if (w >= address && w < address + size) Watched(address, value, size);
    u8* bytes = Translate(address, size);
    if (!bytes) throw MemoryFault{address, true};
    if (address >= kBiosBase && address - kBiosBase < kBiosSize) return;   // ROM
    std::memcpy(bytes, &value, size);
    // A write wider than a word reaches each register word it covers, in order.
    for (u32 offset = 0; offset < size; offset += 4) {
        const u32 word = (address & ~3u) + offset;
        const int index = HookIndex(word);
        if (index < 0) continue;
        if (!OnVif1Worker()) ++write_counts_[index];
        if (write_hooks_[index]) write_hooks_[index](word, offset ? value >> (8 * offset) : value);
    }
}

namespace {
/* Main RAM, the IOP's and the scratchpad: no hooks, no programs in them. */
bool Plain(u32 physical) {
    return physical < kRdramSize || (physical >= kIopRamBase && physical - kIopRamBase < kIopRamSize) ||
           (physical >= kScratchpadBase && physical - kScratchpadBase < kScratchpadSize);
}
}  // namespace

void Memory::ReadBytes(u32 address, u8* bytes, std::size_t count) {
    if (!count) return;
    if (Plain(Physical(address)) && count <= 0xFFFFFFFFu)
        if (const u8* from = Translate(address, u32(count))) {
            std::memcpy(bytes, from, count);
            return;
        }
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) bytes[i] = u8(Read(address + u32(i), 1));
}

void Memory::WriteBytes(u32 address, const u8* bytes, std::size_t count) {
    if (!count) return;
    // Not the device registers (their hooks), VU memory (its programs) or ROM.
    const bool plain = Plain(Physical(address));
    if (plain && watched_.empty() && count <= 0xFFFFFFFFu)
        if (u8* to = Translate(address, u32(count))) {
            std::memcpy(to, bytes, count);
            return;
        }
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) Write(address + u32(i), bytes[i], 1);
}

void Memory::OnRead(u32 address, ReadHook hook) {
    const int index = HookIndex(address & ~3u);
    if (index >= 0) read_hooks_[index] = std::move(hook);
}

void Memory::OnWrite(u32 address, WriteHook hook) {
    const int index = HookIndex(address & ~3u);
    if (index >= 0) write_hooks_[index] = std::move(hook);
}

Memory& GuestMemory() {
    static Memory memory;
    return memory;
}

// Main RAM for the derived code's inline loads and stores (generated.h).
namespace {
const bool g_ram_given = (generated::ram_base = GuestMemory().rdram(),
                          generated::scratchpad_base = GuestMemory().scratchpad(), true);
}  // namespace

}  // namespace ps2host

// What generated and lifted code reads and writes outside main RAM (main RAM
// itself it reaches inline, generated.h), through the devices' hooks.
namespace generated {

u8* ram_base = nullptr;
bool ram_watched = false;
u8* scratchpad_base = nullptr;

u64 PortRead(u32 address, u32 size, bool is_signed) {
    u64 value = ps2host::GuestMemory().Read(address, size);
    if (is_signed && size < 8) {
        const int shift = 64 - 8 * int(size);
        value = u64(s64(value << shift) >> shift);
    }
    return value;
}

void PortWrite(u32 address, u64 value, u32 size) { ps2host::GuestMemory().Write(address, value, size); }

}  // namespace generated
```
