`host/src/pc_menu.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The PC settings panel: F9 (or L3 + R3 on a controller) over any game.
 *
 * A port can put its PC settings in the game's own menus (Burnout 3's main
 * menu has PC SETTINGS); this panel is the engine's, for every port: the
 * settings the host itself applies, changed while the game runs and saved
 * with the PC settings (settings.h). While it is open the game gets no input.
 *
 *   Up / Down          choose
 *   Left / Right       change (Enter or Cross too)
 *   F9, Esc, Circle    close
 */

#include <array>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "ps2host/run.h"
#include "ps2host/settings.h"
#include "ps2host/texture_pack.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

bool g_open = false;
bool g_releasing = false;                // closed, the game's input held back until the keys are let go
int g_row = 0;

struct Choice {
    const char* label;
    std::vector<std::string> values;        // as the setting keeps them
    std::vector<std::string> shown;         // as the panel says them
    std::string (*get)();
    void (*set)(const std::string&);
    const char* game_label;                 // short and in capitals, for a game's own menu (PcSettings)
    std::vector<std::string> game_values;
    const char* help;
};

std::string OnOff(bool on) { return on ? "on" : "off"; }

const std::vector<Choice>& Choices() {
    static const std::vector<Choice> choices = {
        {"Resolution", {"original", "2x", "3x", "4x", "display"},
         {"Original (640x448)", "2x", "3x", "4x", "The screen's"},
         [] { return Setting("resolution", "original"); },
         [](const std::string& v) { SetSetting("resolution", v); },
         "RESOLUTION", {"1X", "2X", "3X", "4X", "AUTO"}, "The resolution the game is drawn at."},
        {"Aspect ratio", {"4:3", "16:9", "auto"}, {"4:3", "16:9", "Fill the window"},
         [] { return Setting("aspect", "4:3"); },
         [](const std::string& v) { SetWindowAspect(v); },
         "ASPECT", {"4:3", "16:9", "FILL"}, "The picture's shape: 4:3, 16:9 or the window's."},
        {"Fullscreen", {"off", "on"}, {"Off", "On"},
         [] { return OnOff(WindowFullscreen()); },
         [](const std::string& v) { SetWindowFullscreen(v == "on"); },
         "FULLSCREEN", {"OFF", "ON"}, "Play in a window or on the whole screen."},
        {"V-sync", {"off", "on"}, {"Off", "On"},
         [] { return OnOff(WindowVsync()); },
         [](const std::string& v) { SetWindowVsync(v == "on"); },
         "V-SYNC", {"OFF", "ON"}, "Wait for the screen's refresh: no tearing."},
        {"Frame pacing", {"on", "off"}, {"On", "Off"},
         [] { return OnOff(SettingOn("frame_pacing", FramePacingDefault())); },
         [](const std::string& v) { SetSettingOn("frame_pacing", v == "on"); },
         "PACING", {"ON", "OFF"}, "Frame pacing: pictures shown at an even pace."},
        {"Texture pack", {"on", "off"}, {"On", "Off"},
         [] { return OnOff(texture_pack::Enabled()); },
         [](const std::string& v) {
             texture_pack::SetEnabled(v == "on");
             SetSettingOn("texture_pack", v == "on");
         },
         "TEXTURES", {"ON", "OFF"}, "The texture pack's textures, or the game's own."},
    };
    return choices;
}

// The rows shown: a texture pack's only when one is loaded; then Close.
std::vector<int> Rows() {
    std::vector<int> rows;
    const auto& c = Choices();
    for (int i = 0; i < int(c.size()); ++i)
        if (std::string(c[i].label) != "Texture pack" || texture_pack::Count()) rows.push_back(i);
    rows.push_back(-1);
    return rows;
}

void Draw(bool force = false) {
    std::vector<std::string> lines = {"PC SETTINGS   (F9 closes)"};
    const std::vector<int> rows = Rows();
    for (int r = 0; r < int(rows.size()); ++r) {
        std::string text;
        if (rows[r] < 0) {
            text = "Close";
        } else {
            const Choice& c = Choices()[rows[r]];
            const std::string now = c.get();
            std::string shown = now;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < c.values.size(); ++i)
                if (c.values[i] == now) shown = c.shown[i];
            text = std::string(c.label) + std::string(16 - std::min<std::size_t>(15, std::string(c.label).size()), ' ') +
                   "< " + shown + " >";
        }
        lines.push_back((r == g_row ? "> " : "  ") + text);
    }
    lines.push_back("");
    lines.push_back("Up/Down choose, Left/Right change");
    static std::vector<std::string> shown;
    if (force || lines != shown) SetWindowOverlay(lines);     // drawn again only when it changes
    shown = lines;
}

void Change(int step) {
    const std::vector<int> rows = Rows();
    const int which = rows[std::size_t(g_row)];
    if (which < 0) {
        g_open = false;
        SetWindowOverlay({});
        return;
    }
    const Choice& c = Choices()[which];
    const std::string now = c.get();
    int at = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < int(c.values.size()); ++i)
        if (c.values[i] == now) at = i;
    const int count = int(c.values.size());
    c.set(c.values[std::size_t(((at + step) % count + count) % count)]);
}

// Keys and buttons, each acting when it goes down.
enum Input { kToggle, kUp, kDown, kLeft, kRight, kAccept, kBack, kInputs };

std::array<bool, kInputs> Held() {
    std::array<bool, kInputs> held{};
    const bool focused = WindowFocused();
#ifdef _WIN32
    auto key = [&](int vk) { return focused && HostKeyDown(vk); };
    held[kToggle] = key(VK_F9);
    held[kUp] = key(VK_UP);
    held[kDown] = key(VK_DOWN);
    held[kLeft] = key(VK_LEFT);
    held[kRight] = key(VK_RIGHT);
    held[kAccept] = key(VK_RETURN);
    held[kBack] = key(VK_ESCAPE);
#endif
    HostPadState pad;
    if (focused && HostPad(&pad)) {
        // DualShock 2 order: 1 L3, 2 R3, 4 up, 5 right, 6 down, 7 left, 13 circle, 14 cross.
        auto button = [&](int bit) { return (pad.buttons >> bit) & 1; };
        held[kToggle] = held[kToggle] || (button(1) && button(2));
        held[kUp] = held[kUp] || button(4);
        held[kDown] = held[kDown] || button(6);
        held[kLeft] = held[kLeft] || button(7);
        held[kRight] = held[kRight] || button(5);
        held[kAccept] = held[kAccept] || button(14);
        held[kBack] = held[kBack] || button(13);
    }
    return held;
}

}  // namespace

std::vector<PcSetting> PcSettings() {
    std::vector<PcSetting> settings;
    for (int i : Rows()) {
        if (i < 0) continue;
        const Choice& c = Choices()[std::size_t(i)];
        const std::string now = c.get();
        std::string value = now;
        for (std::size_t v = 0; v < c.values.size(); ++v)
            if (c.values[v] == now) value = c.game_values[v];
        settings.push_back({c.game_label, value, c.help});
    }
    return settings;
}

void StepPcSetting(int index, int step) {
    int n = 0;
    for (int i : Rows()) {
        if (i < 0) continue;
        if (n++ != index) continue;
        const Choice& c = Choices()[std::size_t(i)];
        const std::string now = c.get();
        int at = 0;
        for (int v = 0; v < int(c.values.size()); ++v)
            if (c.values[std::size_t(v)] == now) at = v;
        const int count = int(c.values.size());
        c.set(c.values[std::size_t(((at + step) % count + count) % count)]);
        return;
    }
}

bool PcMenuOpen() { return g_open || g_releasing; }

void OpenPcMenu() {
    if (g_open) return;
    g_open = true;
    g_row = 0;
    Draw(true);
}

void UpdatePcMenu() {
    static std::array<bool, kInputs> before{};
    const std::array<bool, kInputs> now = Held();
    const bool was_open = g_open;
    auto went_down = [&](Input i) { return now[i] && !before[i]; };
    if (went_down(kToggle) || (g_open && went_down(kBack))) {
        g_open = !g_open;
        g_row = 0;
        if (!g_open) SetWindowOverlay({});
        else Draw(true);
    } else if (g_open) {
        const int rows = int(Rows().size());
        if (went_down(kUp)) g_row = (g_row + rows - 1) % rows;
        if (went_down(kDown)) g_row = (g_row + 1) % rows;
        if (went_down(kLeft)) Change(-1);
        if (went_down(kRight) || went_down(kAccept)) Change(+1);
    }
    before = now;
    if (!g_open && was_open) g_releasing = true;
    if (g_releasing) {
        bool any = false;
        for (bool held : now) any = any || held;
        g_releasing = any;
    }
    if (g_open) Draw();
}

}  // namespace ps2host
```

`host/src/profile.cpp`:

```cpp
/* Timed sections for the report (profile.h). */

#include "ps2host/profile.h"
#include "ps2host/timeline.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#ifdef _WIN32
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <dbghelp.h>
#include <intrin.h>
#include <timeapi.h>
#endif

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;

// Sections are timed in the processor's timestamp counter - a clock read on
// every entry and exit, hundreds of thousands a frame, which the system clock
// made a tenth of the run - and turned into seconds against the steady clock
// when reported.
std::uint64_t Ticks() {
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
    return __rdtsc();
#else
    return std::uint64_t(Clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());
#endif
}

const Clock::time_point g_start = Clock::now();
const std::uint64_t g_start_ticks = Ticks();
// Each thread times its own sections (the GS has one: gs_thread.cpp): the
// sections open now, innermost last, when the innermost resumed, and the
// ticks spent in each. A thread's ticks are added up when it ends.
struct ThreadTicks;
std::mutex g_threads_mutex;
std::vector<ThreadTicks*> g_threads;
std::uint64_t g_ended[int(Section::Count)] = {};

struct ThreadTicks {
    std::uint64_t ticks[int(Section::Count)] = {};
    std::uint64_t began_ns[16] = {};        // the timeline's (PS2HOST_PROFILE): when each open section began
    Section stack[16];
    int depth = 0;
    std::uint64_t since = 0;
    ThreadTicks() {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_threads_mutex);
        g_threads.push_back(this);
    }
    ~ThreadTicks() {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_threads_mutex);
        for (int i = 0; i < int(Section::Count); ++i) g_ended[i] += ticks[i];
        g_threads.erase(std::find(g_threads.begin(), g_threads.end(), this));
    }
};

thread_local ThreadTicks t_ticks;

std::uint64_t SectionTicks(int section) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_threads_mutex);
    std::uint64_t total = g_ended[section];
    for (const ThreadTicks* t : g_threads) total += t->ticks[section];
    return total;
}

double Elapsed(Clock::time_point from, Clock::time_point to) {
    return std::chrono::duration<double>(to - from).count();
}

}  // namespace

const char* const kSectionNames[] = {"GS drawing", "GS image transfers", "VU1", "VU0",
                                     "GPU bookkeeping", "GPU drawing", "GPU and memory in step",
                                     "DMA and VIF", "IOP", "SPU2", "waiting for the GS thread"};

Timed::Timed(Section section) : section_(section) {
    ThreadTicks& t = t_ticks;
    const std::uint64_t now = Ticks();
    if (t.depth > 0) t.ticks[int(t.stack[t.depth - 1])] += now - t.since;
    if (t.depth < 16) t.stack[t.depth] = section;
    if (t.depth < 16 && timeline::On()) t.began_ns[t.depth] = timeline::Now();
    ++t.depth;
    t.since = now;
}

Timed::~Timed() {
    ThreadTicks& t = t_ticks;
    const std::uint64_t now = Ticks();
    t.ticks[int(section_)] += now - t.since;
    --t.depth;
    if (t.depth < 16 && t.began_ns[t.depth] && timeline::On())
        timeline::Span(kSectionNames[int(section_)], t.began_ns[t.depth], timeline::Now());
    if (t.depth < 16) t.began_ns[t.depth] = 0;
    t.since = now;
}

std::string ProfileSummary() {
    const char* const* kNames = kSectionNames;
    const double total = Elapsed(g_start, Clock::now());
    const double seconds_per_tick = total / double(std::max<std::uint64_t>(1, Ticks() - g_start_ticks));
    std::string out = "time:";
    char text[64];
    std::snprintf(text, sizeof text, " %.1f s;", total);
    out += text;
    for (int i = 0; i < int(Section::Count); ++i) {
        const std::uint64_t ticks = SectionTicks(i);
        if (i >= int(Section::GpuBridge) && ticks == 0) continue;   // the GPU's, when it ran
        const double seconds = double(ticks) * seconds_per_tick;
        std::snprintf(text, sizeof text, "%s %s %.1f%%", i ? "," : "", kNames[i],
                      total > 0 ? 100.0 * seconds / total : 0.0);
        out += text;
    }
    return out;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ --sample

namespace {

constexpr int kFrames = 8;              // the function running, and seven callers
constexpr int kGuest = 16;              // the guest functions running, innermost first

struct Sampler {
    std::atomic<bool> stop{false};
    std::thread thread;
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::vector<std::uint64_t> stacks;  // kFrames addresses a sample
    std::vector<std::uint64_t> times;   // when each was taken (steady clock ns)
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> guest;   // kGuest guest addresses a sample (0: none)
    // SampleOnly: the spans of time the report counts (none: all of it).
    std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, std::uint64_t>> spans;
};

std::uint64_t SteadyNs() {
    return std::uint64_t(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
                             Clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
}

Sampler& TheSampler() {
    static Sampler sampler;
    return sampler;
}

std::atomic<unsigned long long> g_sample_from{0};
std::atomic<bool> g_sampling{true};

}  // namespace

void SampleOnly(unsigned long long from_ns, unsigned long long to_ns) {
    Sampler& s = TheSampler();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
    s.spans.push_back({from_ns, to_ns});
}

void SetSampleFrom(unsigned long long frame) {
    g_sample_from = frame;
    g_sampling = frame == 0;
}

namespace {
std::atomic<bool> g_sample_gs{false};
}  // namespace
void SetSampleGsThread(bool on) { g_sample_gs = on; }
bool SampleGsThread() { return g_sample_gs; }
namespace {
std::atomic<bool> g_sample_vif1{false};
}  // namespace
void SetSampleVif1Thread(bool on) { g_sample_vif1 = on; }
bool SampleVif1Thread() { return g_sample_vif1; }

void SampleFrame(unsigned long long frame) {
    if (!g_sampling.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && frame >= g_sample_from.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
        g_sampling = true;
}

#ifdef _WIN32

void StartSampler() {
    Sampler& s = TheSampler();
    HANDLE target = nullptr;
    DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentThread(), GetCurrentProcess(), &target,
                    THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME | THREAD_GET_CONTEXT, FALSE, 0);
    if (!target) return;
    timeBeginPeriod(1);
    // The guest's call stack too, on the EE's thread only (the others run no
    // guest thread of their own).
    const bool sample_guest = !SampleGsThread() && !SampleVif1Thread();
    s.thread = std::thread([&s, target, sample_guest] {
        std::vector<std::uint64_t> local, local_times;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> local_guest;
        local.reserve(1 << 20);
        local_times.reserve(1 << 17);
        while (!s.stop.load()) {
            Sleep(1);
            if (!g_sampling.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) continue;
            // While the thread is suspended nothing here may allocate or take a
            // lock it could hold: the walk goes into a fixed array, through
            // the executable's unwind tables.
            std::uint64_t frames[kFrames] = {};
            std::uint32_t guest[kGuest] = {};
            CONTEXT ctx{};
            ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
            if (SuspendThread(target) == DWORD(-1)) break;
            if (GetThreadContext(target, &ctx)) {
                frames[0] = ctx.Rip;
                for (int n = 1; n < kFrames; ++n) {
                    DWORD64 base = 0;
                    PRUNTIME_FUNCTION entry = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(ctx.Rip, &base, nullptr);
                    if (entry) {
                        void* handler = nullptr;
                        DWORD64 frame = 0;
                        RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, base, ctx.Rip, entry, &ctx, &handler, &frame, nullptr);
                    } else {                // a leaf: its return address is on top of the stack
                        ctx.Rip = *reinterpret_cast<const DWORD64*>(ctx.Rsp);
                        ctx.Rsp += 8;
                    }
                    if (!ctx.Rip) break;
                    frames[n] = ctx.Rip;
                }
            }
            if (sample_guest) GuestCallsNow(guest, kGuest);
            ResumeThread(target);
            local.insert(local.end(), frames, frames + kFrames);
            local_times.push_back(SteadyNs());
            local_guest.insert(local_guest.end(), guest, guest + kGuest);
            if (local.size() >= (1u << 16)) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
                s.stacks.insert(s.stacks.end(), local.begin(), local.end());
                s.times.insert(s.times.end(), local_times.begin(), local_times.end());
                s.guest.insert(s.guest.end(), local_guest.begin(), local_guest.end());
                local.clear();
                local_times.clear();
                local_guest.clear();
            }
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
        s.stacks.insert(s.stacks.end(), local.begin(), local.end());
        s.times.insert(s.times.end(), local_times.begin(), local_times.end());
        s.guest.insert(s.guest.end(), local_guest.begin(), local_guest.end());
        CloseHandle(target);
    });
}

std::string SampleReport(int top) {
    Sampler& s = TheSampler();
    if (!s.thread.joinable()) return "";
    s.stop = true;
    s.thread.join();
    timeEndPeriod(1);
    HANDLE process = GetCurrentProcess();
    SymSetOptions(SYMOPT_UNDNAME | SYMOPT_DEFERRED_LOADS | SYMOPT_LOAD_LINES);
    // Symbols beside the executable (it names its PDB without a folder,
    // /PDBALTPATH), wherever the run was started from.
    char exe_dir[MAX_PATH] = "";
    GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, exe_dir, MAX_PATH);
    if (char* slash = std::strrchr(exe_dir, '\\')) *slash = 0;
    if (!SymInitialize(process, exe_dir, TRUE)) return "sample: no symbols";
    std::unordered_map<std::uint64_t, std::string> names;
    auto name = [&](std::uint64_t address) -> const std::string& {
        auto found = names.find(address);
        if (found != names.end()) return found->second;
        alignas(SYMBOL_INFO) char buffer[sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO) + 256];
        SYMBOL_INFO* symbol = reinterpret_cast<SYMBOL_INFO*>(buffer);
        symbol->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO);
        symbol->MaxNameLen = 255;
        DWORD64 displacement = 0;
        std::string text;
        if (SymFromAddr(process, address, &displacement, symbol)) {
            text = symbol->Name;
        } else {
            char hex[32];
            std::snprintf(hex, sizeof hex, "0x%llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(address));
            text = hex;
        }
        return names.emplace(address, text).first->second;
    };
    // The source line an address is on - for inlined code, the line of what
    // was inlined (a VU step in vu_core.h, not the block that called it).
    std::unordered_map<std::uint64_t, std::string> lines;
    auto line_of = [&](std::uint64_t address) -> const std::string& {
        auto found = lines.find(address);
        if (found != lines.end()) return found->second;
        IMAGEHLP_LINE64 info{};
        info.SizeOfStruct = sizeof info;
        DWORD displacement = 0;
        std::string text = "?";
        if (SymGetLineFromAddr64(process, address, &displacement, &info) && info.FileName) {
            std::string file = info.FileName;
            const std::size_t slash = file.find_last_of("/\\");
            if (slash != std::string::npos) file = file.substr(slash + 1);
            text = file + ":" + std::to_string(info.LineNumber);
        }
        return lines.emplace(address, text).first->second;
    };
    std::map<std::string, std::uint64_t> self, total, by_line, by_file;
    std::map<std::string, std::map<std::string, std::uint64_t>> callers;
    std::size_t samples = s.stacks.size() / kFrames;
    std::vector<bool> counted(samples, true);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
        if (!s.spans.empty()) {
            std::size_t kept = 0;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < samples; ++i) {
                const std::uint64_t t = i < s.times.size() ? s.times[i] : 0;
                bool in = false;
                for (const auto& [from, to] : s.spans) in = in || (t >= from && t <= to);
                counted[i] = in;
                kept += in;
            }
            std::fprintf(stderr, "sample: %zu of %zu samples in %zu spans\n", kept, samples, s.spans.size());
        }
    }
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < samples; ++i) {
        const std::uint64_t* f = &s.stacks[i * kFrames];
        if (!f[0] || !counted[i]) continue;
        const std::string& leaf = name(f[0]);
        ++self[leaf];
        const std::string& where = line_of(f[0]);
        ++by_line[where];
        ++by_file[where.substr(0, where.find(':'))];
        std::string seen[kFrames];
        for (int n = 0; n < kFrames && f[n]; ++n) {
            const std::string& fn = name(f[n]);
            if (std::find(seen, seen + n, fn) == seen + n) ++total[fn];
            seen[n] = fn;
        }
        if (f[1]) ++callers[leaf][name(f[1])];
    }
    SymCleanup(process);
    std::map<std::string, std::uint64_t> guest_total, guest_self, guest_stacks;
    std::size_t guest_samples = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < samples && (i + 1) * kGuest <= s.guest.size(); ++i) {
        if (!counted[i]) continue;
        const std::uint32_t* g = &s.guest[i * kGuest];
        if (!g[0]) continue;
        ++guest_samples;
        char hex[16];
        std::snprintf(hex, sizeof hex, "0x%08X", unsigned(g[0]));
        ++guest_self[hex];
        std::string stack;
        for (int n = 0; n < 6 && g[n]; ++n) {
            std::snprintf(hex, sizeof hex, n ? " < %08X" : "%08X", unsigned(g[n]));
            stack += hex;
        }
        ++guest_stacks[stack];
        std::uint32_t seen[kGuest];
        int n_seen = 0;
        for (int n = 0; n < kGuest && g[n]; ++n) {
            if (std::find(seen, seen + n_seen, g[n]) != seen + n_seen) continue;
            seen[n_seen++] = g[n];
            std::snprintf(hex, sizeof hex, "0x%08X", unsigned(g[n]));
            ++guest_total[hex];
        }
    }
    auto ranked = [](const std::map<std::string, std::uint64_t>& counts) {
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, std::string>> list;
        for (const auto& [fn, n] : counts) list.push_back({n, fn});
        std::sort(list.rbegin(), list.rend());
        return list;
    };
    std::string out;
    char line[512];
    if (guest_samples) {
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "sample: %zu with a guest call stack\n  guest, anywhere on the stack:\n",
                      guest_samples);
        out += line;
        const auto by_guest = ranked(guest_total);
        for (int i = 0; i < top && i < int(by_guest.size()); ++i) {
            std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "    %5.1f%%  %s\n", 100.0 * double(by_guest[i].first) / double(guest_samples),
                          by_guest[i].second.c_str());
            out += line;
        }
        out += "  guest stacks (innermost first):\n";
        const auto by_stack = ranked(guest_stacks);
        for (int i = 0; i < top && i < int(by_stack.size()); ++i) {
            std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "    %5.1f%%  %s\n", 100.0 * double(by_stack[i].first) / double(guest_samples),
                          by_stack[i].second.c_str());
            out += line;
        }
        out += "  guest, innermost:\n";
        const auto by_guest_self = ranked(guest_self);
        for (int i = 0; i < top && i < int(by_guest_self.size()); ++i) {
            std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "    %5.1f%%  %s\n",
                          100.0 * double(by_guest_self[i].first) / double(guest_samples), by_guest_self[i].second.c_str());
            out += line;
        }
    }
    std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "sample: %zu samples (1 ms apart)\n  self:\n", samples);
    out += line;
    const auto by_self = ranked(self);
    for (int i = 0; i < top && i < int(by_self.size()); ++i) {
        const auto& [n, fn] = by_self[i];
        std::string from;
        const auto by_caller = ranked(callers[fn]);
        for (int k = 0; k < 2 && k < int(by_caller.size()); ++k)
            from += (k ? ", " : "  <- ") + by_caller[k].second;
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "  %5.1f%%  %s%s\n", 100.0 * double(n) / double(samples ? samples : 1),
                      fn.substr(0, 90).c_str(), from.substr(0, 160).c_str());
        out += line;
    }
    out += "  by source file (where it was running):\n";
    const auto files = ranked(by_file);
    for (int i = 0; i < top && i < int(files.size()); ++i) {
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "  %5.1f%%  %s\n",
                      100.0 * double(files[i].first) / double(samples ? samples : 1), files[i].second.c_str());
        out += line;
    }
    out += "  by source line (where it was running):\n";
    const auto by_source = ranked(by_line);
    for (int i = 0; i < top && i < int(by_source.size()); ++i) {
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "  %5.1f%%  %s\n",
                      100.0 * double(by_source[i].first) / double(samples ? samples : 1),
                      by_source[i].second.substr(0, 120).c_str());
        out += line;
    }
    out += "  total (anywhere in the eight frames):\n";
    const auto by_total = ranked(total);
    for (int i = 0; i < top && i < int(by_total.size()); ++i) {
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "  %5.1f%%  %s\n",
                      100.0 * double(by_total[i].first) / double(samples ? samples : 1),
                      by_total[i].second.substr(0, 120).c_str());
        out += line;
    }
    return out;
}

namespace {

LONG WINAPI CrashFilter(EXCEPTION_POINTERS* info) {
    static std::atomic<bool> reported{false};
    if (reported.exchange(true)) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    const EXCEPTION_RECORD* r = info->ExceptionRecord;
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[crash] exception 0x%08lX at %p on thread %lu", r->ExceptionCode, r->ExceptionAddress,
                 GetCurrentThreadId());
    if (r->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && r->NumberParameters >= 2)
        std::fprintf(stderr, " (%s 0x%llX)", r->ExceptionInformation[0] ? "write" : "read",
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(r->ExceptionInformation[1]));
    std::fprintf(stderr, "\n");
    HANDLE process = GetCurrentProcess();
    SymSetOptions(SYMOPT_UNDNAME | SYMOPT_DEFERRED_LOADS | SYMOPT_LOAD_LINES);
    // Symbols beside the executable, wherever the run was started from.
    char exe_dir[MAX_PATH] = "";
    GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, exe_dir, MAX_PATH);
    if (char* slash = std::strrchr(exe_dir, '\\')) *slash = 0;
    SymInitialize(process, exe_dir, TRUE);
    CONTEXT context = *info->ContextRecord;
    STACKFRAME64 frame{};
    frame.AddrPC.Offset = context.Rip;
    frame.AddrPC.Mode = AddrModeFlat;
    frame.AddrStack.Offset = context.Rsp;
    frame.AddrStack.Mode = AddrModeFlat;
    frame.AddrFrame.Offset = context.Rbp;
    frame.AddrFrame.Mode = AddrModeFlat;
    for (int i = 0; i < 24; ++i) {
        if (!StackWalk64(IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64, process, GetCurrentThread(), &frame, &context, nullptr,
                         SymFunctionTableAccess64, SymGetModuleBase64, nullptr) || !frame.AddrPC.Offset)
            break;
        alignas(SYMBOL_INFO) char buffer[sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO) + 256];
        SYMBOL_INFO* symbol = reinterpret_cast<SYMBOL_INFO*>(buffer);
        symbol->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO);
        symbol->MaxNameLen = 255;
        DWORD64 displacement = 0;
        IMAGEHLP_LINE64 line{};
        line.SizeOfStruct = sizeof line;
        DWORD line_displacement = 0;
        const bool named = SymFromAddr(process, frame.AddrPC.Offset, &displacement, symbol);
        const bool lined = SymGetLineFromAddr64(process, frame.AddrPC.Offset, &line_displacement, &line);
        // The module and the offset in it, for a frame no symbol names.
        const DWORD64 base = SymGetModuleBase64(process, frame.AddrPC.Offset);
        char module[MAX_PATH] = "?";
        if (base) {
            GetModuleFileNameA(reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>(base), module, MAX_PATH);
            if (const char* slash = std::strrchr(module, '\\')) std::memmove(module, slash + 1, std::strlen(slash));
        }
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[crash]   %s+0x%llX %s%s%s:%lu\n", module,
                     static_cast<unsigned long long>(frame.AddrPC.Offset - base), named ? symbol->Name : "?",
                     lined ? "  " : "", lined ? line.FileName : "", lined ? line.LineNumber : 0ul);
    }
    std::fflush(stderr);
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

}  // namespace

void InstallCrashReport() { SetUnhandledExceptionFilter(CrashFilter); }

#else

void InstallCrashReport() {}
void StartSampler() {}
std::string SampleReport(int) { return ""; }

#endif

}  // namespace ps2host
```

`host/src/sdk.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * Host implementations of Sony SDK library routines, applied by name.
 *
 * Library routines that drive the hardware - wait for the graphics paths, poll
 * a DMA channel - are better replaced whole than emulated register by register:
 * the routine's contract is small, and on the host the hardware it waits for is
 * already done. A game's analysis names such routines (config/names.csv, from
 * diagnostic strings and the cross-game signature library); every routine named
 * here is overridden wherever the game's dispatch table gives that name, so a new
 * game gets these for free once its routines are named.
 */

#include <cstring>

#include "ps2host/host.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

void Return(lifted::Context& c, u64 value) { c.r[2] = u64(s64(s32(u32(value)))); }

// sceGsSyncPath(mode, timeout): wait until the paths to the GS are idle - VIF1,
// GIF and VU1 - and return 0, or a negative value on timeout. The host's
// transfers complete when they are started, so the paths are always idle.
void GsSyncPath(lifted::Context& c) { Return(c, 0); }

struct SdkRoutine {
    const char* name;
    GuestFunction function;
};

const SdkRoutine kRoutines[] = {
    {"sceGsSyncPath", GsSyncPath},
};

}  // namespace

void ApplySdkOverrides(const FunctionEntry* table, std::size_t count) {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        if (!table[i].name) continue;
        for (const SdkRoutine& routine : kRoutines) {
            if (std::strcmp(table[i].name, routine.name) == 0) {
                Override(table[i].address, routine.function, routine.name);
                Note(std::string("sdk ") + routine.name,
                     std::string("SDK routine ") + routine.name + " runs on the host");
            }
        }
    }
}

}  // namespace ps2host
```

`host/src/settings.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The port's settings (settings.h): a map of keys to values, read from and
 * written to one text file. Lines are `key=value`; anything else (comments,
 * blank lines) is left out when the file is written again.
 */

#include "ps2host/settings.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

std::mutex g_lock;
std::map<std::string, std::string> g_values;
std::string g_path;

std::string Trim(const std::string& text) {
    const auto first = text.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
    if (first == std::string::npos) return "";
    return text.substr(first, text.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n") - first + 1);
}

void Write() {
    if (g_path.empty()) return;
    std::ofstream out(g_path, std::ios::trunc);
    if (!out) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[settings] cannot write %s\n", g_path.c_str());
        return;
    }
    out << "# The PC port's settings (PC SETTINGS in the main menu).\n";
    for (const auto& [key, value] : g_values) out << key << '=' << value << '\n';
}

}  // namespace

void LoadSettings(const std::string& path) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(g_lock);
    g_path = path;
    g_values.clear();
    std::ifstream in(path);
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        const auto equals = line.find('=');
        if (line.empty() || line[0] == '#' || equals == std::string::npos) continue;
        const std::string key = Trim(line.substr(0, equals));
        if (!key.empty()) g_values[key] = Trim(line.substr(equals + 1));
    }
}

const std::string& SettingsPath() { return g_path; }

std::string Setting(const std::string& key, const std::string& fallback) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(g_lock);
    const auto found = g_values.find(key);
    return found == g_values.end() ? fallback : found->second;
}

bool SettingOn(const std::string& key, bool fallback) {
    const std::string value = Setting(key, fallback ? "on" : "off");
    return value == "on" || value == "1" || value == "true" || value == "yes";
}

void SetSetting(const std::string& key, const std::string& value) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(g_lock);
    if (g_values.count(key) && g_values[key] == value) return;
    g_values[key] = value;
    Write();
}

void SetSettingOn(const std::string& key, bool on) { SetSetting(key, on ? "on" : "off"); }

void RunSetting(const std::string& key, const std::string& value) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(g_lock);
    g_values[key] = value;
}

}  // namespace ps2host

```

```cpp
/*
 * The SPU2 (spu2.h): voices decoded, enveloped and mixed a sample at a time,
 * loop flags, ENDX, and the IRQA interrupt.

constexpr Spu2::u32 kRamMask = (2u << 20) - 1;
constexpr double kRate = 48000.0;
constexpr Spu2::u32 kSamplesPerBlock = 28, kBlockBytes = 16;
constexpr Spu2::u32 kBlockSpan = kSamplesPerBlock << 12;    // a block in counter units
constexpr Spu2::u32 kVmixl = 0x18 - 0x13, kVmixr = 0x1A - 0x13;
constexpr Spu2::u32 kVmixel = 0x19 - 0x13, kVmixer = 0x1B - 0x13;   // into the reverb

Spu2::s32 Clamp16(Spu2::s32 v) { return std::min(32767, std::max(-32768, v)); }

/* A voice's samples are interpolated as the hardware does, from the four
   latest by a 512-entry Gaussian table indexed by the pitch counter's bits
   4-11 (psx-spx, "4-Point Gaussian Interpolation"; the SPU2 kept the PS1

// A volume register's fixed value (bit 15 clear: 15 bits, signed). A sweep's
// (bit 15 set) is where it has brought the volume: Spu2::Level. Reverb's EVOL
// has no sweep.
Spu2::s32 Volume(Spu2::u32 v) {
    if (v & 0x8000) return 0x7FFF;
    return Spu2::s32(Spu2::s16(Spu2::u16(v << 1)));
}

struct Rate {
    Spu2::u32 shift, step;
    bool decreasing, exponential;
};

}  // namespace

void Spu2::Level::Set(u32 value) {
    reg = value & 0xFFFF;
    if (!(reg & 0x8000)) now = Volume(reg);         // fixed; a sweep goes on from where it is
    counter = 0;
}

/* A sample of a sweep, by the envelope's rules (Envelope): the rate's shift
   and step, slower near the top going up exponentially, in proportion going
   down; the phase bit makes the volume negative. Rate 0x7F holds it. */
void Spu2::Level::Sweep() {
    const u32 rate = reg & 0x7F;
    if (rate == 0x7F) return;
    const bool exponential = (reg & 0x4000) != 0, decreasing = (reg & 0x2000) != 0, negative = (reg & 0x1000) != 0;
    s32 magnitude = now < 0 ? -now : now;
    const u32 shift = rate >> 2;
    s32 step = decreasing ? -8 + s32(rate & 3) : 7 - s32(rate & 3);
    if (shift < 11) step <<= 11 - shift;
    u32 increment = shift > 11 ? (shift - 11 >= 16 ? 0 : 0x8000u >> (shift - 11)) : 0x8000u;
    if (exponential) {
        if (decreasing) {
            step = s32((std::int64_t(step) * magnitude) >> 15);
        } else if (magnitude >= 0x6000) {
            if (shift < 10) step >>= 2;
            else if (shift >= 11) increment >>= 2;
            else { step >>= 1; increment >>= 1; }
        }
    }
    counter += increment;
    if (counter < 0x8000) return;
    counter = 0;
    magnitude = std::min(0x7FFF, std::max(0, magnitude + step));
    now = negative ? -magnitude : magnitude;
}

void Spu2::DecodeBlock(const u8* block, s32 out[28], s32* older, s32* old) {
    static const s32 kF0[5] = {0, 60, 115, 98, 122}, kF1[5] = {0, 0, -52, -55, -60};
    u32 shift = block[0] & 15;
    if (shift > 12) shift = 9;                      // as the hardware treats 13-15
    const u32 filter = std::min<u32>((block[0] >> 4) & 7, 4);
    for (u32 i = 0; i < kSamplesPerBlock; ++i) {
        const u32 nibble = (block[2 + i / 2] >> ((i & 1) * 4)) & 15;
        s32 s = s32(s16(u16(nibble << 12))) >> shift;
        s += (*old * kF0[filter] + *older * kF1[filter] + 32) >> 6;
        s = Clamp16(s);
        *older = *old;
        *old = s;
        out[i] = s;
    }
}

void Spu2::SetInputVolume(u32 core, u32 percent) {
    Core& c = cores_[core & 1];
    const s32 target = s32(std::min<u32>(percent, 200) * 65536 / 100);
    if (target == c.input_gain_target) return;
    c.input_gain_target = target;
    c.input_gain_remaining = 240;
}

void Spu2::SetParam(u32 entry, u32 value) {
    Core& c = cores_[CoreOf(entry)];
    Voice& v = c.voices[VoiceOf(entry)];
    switch (entry >> 8) {
        case 0x00: v.voll = value; v.left.Set(value); break;
        case 0x01: v.volr = value; v.right.Set(value); break;
        case 0x02: v.pitch = value & 0x3FFF; break;
        case 0x03: v.adsr1 = value; break;
        case 0x04: v.adsr2 = value; break;
        case 0x09: c.mvoll = value; c.main_left.Set(value); break;     // SD_P_MVOLL
        case 0x0A: c.mvolr = value; c.main_right.Set(value); break;    // SD_P_MVOLR
        case 0x08: c.mmix = value & (CoreOf(entry) ? 0xFFF : 0xFF0); break;   // SD_P_MMIX (core 0: no external input)
        case 0x0D: c.avoll = value; break;             // SD_P_AVOLL: the external input
        case 0x0E: c.avolr = value; break;
        case 0x0F: c.bvoll = value; break;             // SD_P_BVOLL: the sound-data input
        case 0x10: c.bvolr = value; break;
        case 0x0B: c.evoll = value; break;             // SD_P_EVOLL: the reverb's output
        case 0x0C: c.evolr = value; break;             // SD_P_EVOLR
        default: break;
    }
}

Spu2::u32 Spu2::GetParam(u32 entry) const {
    const Core& c = cores_[CoreOf(entry)];
    const Voice& v = c.voices[VoiceOf(entry)];
    switch (entry >> 8) {
        case 0x00: return v.voll;
        case 0x01: return v.volr;
        case 0x02: return v.pitch;
        case 0x03: return v.adsr1;
        case 0x04: return v.adsr2;
        case 0x05: return u32(v.level);             // ENVX
        case 0x06: return u32(v.left.now) & 0xFFFF;    // VOLXL, VOLXR: the current volume
        case 0x07: return u32(v.right.now) & 0xFFFF;
        case 0x08: return c.mmix;
        case 0x0D: return c.avoll;
        case 0x0E: return c.avolr;
        case 0x0F: return c.bvoll;
        case 0x10: return c.bvolr;
        case 0x09: return c.mvoll;
        case 0x0A: return c.mvolr;
        case 0x0B: return c.evoll;
        case 0x0C: return c.evolr;
        default: return 0;
    }
}

void Spu2::Start(Voice& v) {
    v.nax = v.ssa & ~15u;
    v.counter = 0;
    v.older = v.old = 0;
    v.window[0] = v.window[1] = v.window[2] = 0;
    v.playing = true;
    v.phase = Phase::Attack;
    v.level = 0;
    v.envelope_counter = 0;
    Decode(v);
}

void Spu2::Decode(Voice& v) {
    const u32 block = v.nax & kRamMask & ~15u;
    if (ram_[(block + 1) & kRamMask] & 4) v.lsax = block;    // loop start: where a repeat returns
    // A silent voice runs on through its blocks (their flags, IRQA), but its
    // samples are never heard - a key-on starts it afresh (Start: the
    // decoder's history cleared, its block decoded again). Most of the 48
    // voices are silent most of the time.
    if (v.phase == Phase::Off) return;
    u8 bytes[kBlockBytes];
    for (u32 i = 0; i < kBlockBytes; ++i) bytes[i] = ram_[(block + i) & kRamMask];
    DecodeBlock(bytes, v.window + 3, &v.older, &v.old);
}

void Spu2::SetSwitch(u32 entry, u32 value) {
    Core& c = cores_[CoreOf(entry)];
    const u32 which = (entry >> 8) - 0x13;
    if (which < 16) c.switches[which] = value & 0xFFFFFF;
    switch (entry >> 8) {
        case 0x15:                              // KON: start from SSA
            for (u32 i = 0; i < 24; ++i)
                if (value & (1u << i)) {
                    Start(c.voices[i]);
                    c.endx &= ~(1u << i);
                }
            break;
        case 0x16:                              // KOFF: release
            for (u32 i = 0; i < 24; ++i)
                if ((value & (1u << i)) && c.voices[i].phase != Phase::Off)
                    c.voices[i].phase = Phase::Release;
            break;
        case 0x17: c.endx = value & 0xFFFFFF; break;
        default: break;
    }
}

Spu2::u32 Spu2::GetSwitch(u32 entry) const {
    const Core& c = cores_[CoreOf(entry)];
    if ((entry >> 8) == 0x17) return c.endx;
    const u32 which = (entry >> 8) - 0x13;
    return which < 16 ? c.switches[which] : 0;
}

void Spu2::SetAddr(u32 entry, u32 value) {
    Core& c = cores_[CoreOf(entry)];
    Voice& v = c.voices[VoiceOf(entry)];
    value &= kRamMask;
    switch (entry >> 8) {
        case 0x1C: c.esa = value; break;
        case 0x1D: c.eea = value; break;
        case 0x1E: c.tsa = value; break;
        case 0x1F: c.irqa = value; break;
        case 0x20: v.ssa = value; break;
        case 0x21: v.lsax = value; break;
        case 0x22: v.nax = value; break;
        default: break;
    }
}

Spu2::u32 Spu2::GetAddr(u32 entry) const {
    const Core& c = cores_[CoreOf(entry)];
    const Voice& v = c.voices[VoiceOf(entry)];
    switch (entry >> 8) {
        case 0x1C: return c.esa;
        case 0x1D: return c.eea;
        case 0x1E: return c.tsa;
        case 0x1F: return c.irqa;
        case 0x20: return v.ssa;
        case 0x21: return v.lsax;
        case 0x22: return v.nax;
        default: return 0;
    }
}

void Spu2::SetCoreAttr(u32 entry, u32 value) {
    Core& c = cores_[CoreOf(entry)];
    switch (entry & ~1u) {
        case 0x4: c.irq_enabled = value != 0; break;    // SD_CORE_IRQ_ENABLE
        default: break;
    }
    c.attr = (c.attr & ~(1u << (entry & ~1u))) | ((value ? 1u : 0u) << (entry & ~1u));
}

Spu2::u32 Spu2::GetCoreAttr(u32 entry) const {
    const Core& c = cores_[CoreOf(entry)];
    if ((entry & ~1u) == 0x4) return c.irq_enabled ? 1 : 0;
    return (c.attr >> (entry & ~1u)) & 1;
}

    {0x00A900E3, 0x4FA86F60, 0x4510BCE0, 0xA680BEF0, 0x52C05680, 0x0B580DFB, 0x0A3C0D09, 0x09730BD9,
```
