```cpp
    {0x013901A5, 0x50006000, 0xB8004C00, 0xC000BC00, 0x5C006000, 0x11BB15BA, 0x10BD14C2, 0x0DC111BC,
     0x0DC311C0, 0x09C10DC0, 0x07C10BC4, 0x06CD0A00, 0x05C109C2, 0x041A05C0, 0x013A0274, 0x80008000},
    {0x0231033D, 0x50007E00, 0xB000B400, 0xB0004C00, 0x54006000, 0x1A311ED6, 0x183B1D14, 0x16B21BC2,
     0x15EF1A32, 0x105515EE, 0x0F2D1334, 0x0C5D11F6, 0x0AE11056, 0x07A20AE0, 0x02320464, 0x80008000},
    {0x00030003, 0x7FFF7FFF, 0x00000000, 0x81000000, 0x00000000, 0x0FFD1FFD, 0x00091009, 0x00000000,
     0x00091009, 0x1FFF1FFF, 0x1FFE1FFE, 0x1FFE1FFE, 0x1FFE1FFE, 0x10041008, 0x00040008, 0x80008000},
    {0x00030003, 0x7FFF7FFF, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x0FFD1FFD, 0x00091009, 0x00000000,
     0x00091009, 0x1FFF1FFF, 0x1FFE1FFE, 0x1FFE1FFE, 0x1FFE1FFE, 0x10041008, 0x00040008, 0x80008000},
    {0x00130017, 0x4FA870F0, 0x4510BCE0, 0x8500BEF0, 0x54C05F80, 0x02AF0371, 0x01DF02E5, 0x01D702B0,
     0x026A0358, 0x011E01D6, 0x00B1012D, 0x0059011F, 0x00E301A0, 0x00400058, 0x00140028, 0x80008000},
};

// Where the registers sit in Core::reverb.
enum : int { kDApf1 = 0, kDApf2 = 1, kVIir = 2, kVComb1 = 3, kVComb2 = 4, kVComb3 = 5, kVComb4 = 6, kVWall = 7,
             kVApf1 = 8, kVApf2 = 9, kMLSame = 10, kMRSame = 11, kMLComb1 = 12, kMRComb1 = 13, kMLComb2 = 14,
             kMRComb2 = 15, kDLSame = 16, kDRSame = 17, kMLDiff = 18, kMRDiff = 19, kMLComb3 = 20, kMRComb3 = 21,
             kMLComb4 = 22, kMRComb4 = 23, kDLDiff = 24, kDRDiff = 25, kMLApf1 = 26, kMRApf1 = 27, kMLApf2 = 28,
             kMRApf2 = 29, kVLIn = 30, kVRIn = 31 };

/* The reverb runs at 24 kHz: what goes in is filtered down to it, what comes
   out filtered up from it, by the same 39-tap half-band FIR (psx-spx, "SPU
   Reverb Buffer Resampling"; the SPU2 kept the PS1's) - every other tap 0
   but the middle one's, the sum 32,766. Taken a pair a step and its output
   held for both, the reverb's tail had the 24 kHz images of everything in
   it (a metallic hiss). Here the taps from the middle out: kReverbFir[0] is
   the middle's, [1] the next ones' (the samples 1 from it either side), ... */
const Spu2::s32 kReverbFir[20] = {0x4000, 0x2806, 0, -0x0B90, 0, 0x0534, 0, -0x0268, 0, 0x010A,
                                  0, -0x0067, 0, 0x0023, 0, -0x000A, 0, 0x0002, 0, -0x0001};

// The FIR over a ring's last 39 (ending at `at`), its middle 19 back.
Spu2::s32 ReverbFir(const Spu2::s32* ring, Spu2::u32 at) {
    const Spu2::u32 middle = at - 19;
    std::int64_t sum = std::int64_t(ring[middle & 63]) * kReverbFir[0];
    for (Spu2::u32 k = 1; k < 20; k += 2)
        sum += std::int64_t(ring[(middle - k) & 63] + ring[(middle + k) & 63]) * kReverbFir[k];
    return Spu2::s32(sum >> 15);
}

Spu2::s32 Mul(Spu2::s32 a, Spu2::u16 coefficient) {
    return Spu2::s32((std::int64_t(a) * Spu2::s16(coefficient)) >> 15);
}

}  // namespace

int Spu2::SetEffectAttr(u32 core, u32 mode, s32 depth_left, s32 depth_right, u32 delay, u32 feedback) {
    Core& c = cores_[core & 1];
    const bool clear = (mode & 0x100) != 0;
    mode &= ~0x100u;
    if (mode > 9) return -1;
    u16 data[32];
    std::memcpy(data, kEffectParams[mode], sizeof data);
    c.effect_mode = mode;
    c.effect_depth_left = depth_left;
    c.effect_depth_right = depth_right;
    c.effect_delay = mode == 7 || mode == 8 ? 0x80 : 0;          // as libsd keeps them
    c.effect_feedback = mode == 7 ? 0x80 : 0;
    if (mode == 7 || mode == 8) {                               // echo, delay: their own delay and feedback
        const u16 d = u16((delay + 1) << 5);
        data[7] = u16((((feedback << 7) + feedback) << 1));
        data[10] = u16((d << 1) - data[0]);
        data[11] = u16(d - data[1]);
        data[16] = u16(data[17] + d);
        data[12] = u16(data[13] + d);
        data[27] = u16(data[29] + d);
        data[26] = u16(data[28] + d);
    }
    std::memcpy(c.reverb, data, sizeof data);
    c.evoll = u32(depth_left) & 0xFFFF;
    c.evolr = u32(depth_right) & 0xFFFF;
    const u32 eea = c.eea ? c.eea : (core & 1 ? 0x1FFFFFu : 0x1DFFFFu);
    c.esa = (eea - ((kEffectSizes[mode] << 4) - 2)) & kRamMask;
    c.reverb_position = 0;
    if (clear)
        for (u32 a = c.esa; a <= eea && a < ram_.size(); ++a) ram_[a] = 0;
    return 0;
}

void Spu2::GetEffectAttr(u32 core, u32* mode, s32* depth_left, s32* depth_right, u32* delay, u32* feedback) const {
    const Core& c = cores_[core & 1];
    *mode = c.effect_mode;
    *depth_left = c.effect_depth_left;
    *depth_right = c.effect_depth_right;
    *delay = c.effect_delay;
    *feedback = c.effect_feedback;
}

// The work area's end (EEA), libsd's default where the game set none.
Spu2::u32 Spu2::EffectEnd(const Core& c) const {
    return c.eea ? c.eea : (&c == &cores_[1] ? 0x1FFFFFu : 0x1DFFFFu);
}

// One step of the reverb (24 kHz): psx-spx's "SPU Reverb Formula". Offsets
// are in 8-byte units; "-2" there is the sample before (two bytes).
void Spu2::Reverb(Core& c, s32 in_left, s32 in_right) {
    const u16* r = c.reverb;
    const u32 size = EffectEnd(c) + 1 - c.esa;
    if (!size || size > ram_.size()) return;
    // A sample of the work area `offset` bytes past where the reverb is now,
    // wrapping within [ESA, EEA].
    const u32 position = c.reverb_position, esa = c.esa;
    u8* ram = ram_.data();
    auto place = [&](u32 offset) {
        u32 a = position + offset;
        if (a >= size) a = a - size < size ? a - size : a % size;
        return (esa + a) & kRamMask & ~1u;
    };
    auto ReverbRead = [&](const Core&, u32 offset) {
        const u32 a = place(offset);
        return s32(s16(u16(ram[a] | (ram[a + 1] << 8))));
    };
    auto ReverbWrite = [&](const Core&, u32 offset, s32 value) {
        const u32 a = place(offset);
        const u16 v = u16(s16(Clamp16(value)));
        ram[a] = u8(v);
        ram[a + 1] = u8(v >> 8);
    };
    // x % size, without the division where x is already within twice the
    // area (nearly always): ~40 a step, 48,000 steps a second.
    auto wrap = [size](u32 x) { return x < size ? x : x - size < size ? x - size : x % size; };
    auto at = [&](int reg) { return wrap(u32(r[reg]) * 8); };
    auto before = [&](int reg) { return wrap(at(reg) + size - 2); };
    const s32 lin = Mul(in_left, r[kVLIn]), rin = Mul(in_right, r[kVRIn]);
    // Same side, then the other side's reflection.
    const s32 lsame = Mul(lin + Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kDLSame)), r[kVWall]) - ReverbRead(c, before(kMLSame)),
                          r[kVIir]) + ReverbRead(c, before(kMLSame));
    const s32 rsame = Mul(rin + Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kDRSame)), r[kVWall]) - ReverbRead(c, before(kMRSame)),
                          r[kVIir]) + ReverbRead(c, before(kMRSame));
    const s32 ldiff = Mul(lin + Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kDRDiff)), r[kVWall]) - ReverbRead(c, before(kMLDiff)),
                          r[kVIir]) + ReverbRead(c, before(kMLDiff));
    const s32 rdiff = Mul(rin + Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kDLDiff)), r[kVWall]) - ReverbRead(c, before(kMRDiff)),
                          r[kVIir]) + ReverbRead(c, before(kMRDiff));
    ReverbWrite(c, at(kMLSame), lsame);
    ReverbWrite(c, at(kMRSame), rsame);
    ReverbWrite(c, at(kMLDiff), ldiff);
    ReverbWrite(c, at(kMRDiff), rdiff);
    // Early echo: the combs.
    s32 lout = Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kMLComb1)), r[kVComb1]) + Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kMLComb2)), r[kVComb2]) +
               Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kMLComb3)), r[kVComb3]) + Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kMLComb4)), r[kVComb4]);
    s32 rout = Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kMRComb1)), r[kVComb1]) + Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kMRComb2)), r[kVComb2]) +
               Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kMRComb3)), r[kVComb3]) + Mul(ReverbRead(c, at(kMRComb4)), r[kVComb4]);
    // Late reverb: two all-pass filters.
    const u32 apf1 = at(kDApf1), apf2 = at(kDApf2);
    auto delayed = [&](int reg, u32 by) { return wrap(at(reg) + size - wrap(by)); };
    lout = Clamp16(lout - Mul(ReverbRead(c, delayed(kMLApf1, apf1)), r[kVApf1]));
    ReverbWrite(c, at(kMLApf1), lout);
    lout = Mul(lout, r[kVApf1]) + ReverbRead(c, delayed(kMLApf1, apf1));
    rout = Clamp16(rout - Mul(ReverbRead(c, delayed(kMRApf1, apf1)), r[kVApf1]));
    ReverbWrite(c, at(kMRApf1), rout);
    rout = Mul(rout, r[kVApf1]) + ReverbRead(c, delayed(kMRApf1, apf1));
    lout = Clamp16(lout - Mul(ReverbRead(c, delayed(kMLApf2, apf2)), r[kVApf2]));
    ReverbWrite(c, at(kMLApf2), lout);
    lout = Mul(lout, r[kVApf2]) + ReverbRead(c, delayed(kMLApf2, apf2));
    rout = Clamp16(rout - Mul(ReverbRead(c, delayed(kMRApf2, apf2)), r[kVApf2]));
    ReverbWrite(c, at(kMRApf2), rout);
    rout = Mul(rout, r[kVApf2]) + ReverbRead(c, delayed(kMRApf2, apf2));
    c.reverb_out_left = Clamp16(lout);
    c.reverb_out_right = Clamp16(rout);
    c.reverb_position = (c.reverb_position + 2) % size;
}

void Spu2::CheckIrq(u32 core_hint, u32 from, u32 to, const std::function<void(u32)>& irq) {
    // IRQA is shared memory: either core with interrupts on sees it.
    (void)core_hint;
    for (u32 core = 0; core < 2; ++core) {
        Core& c = cores_[core];
        if (!c.irq_enabled) continue;
        if (c.irqa >= from && c.irqa < to) {
            c.irq_enabled = false;              // fires once; the driver re-arms it
            irq(core);
        }
    }
}

void Spu2::Write(u32 address, const u8* data, u32 size) {
    for (u32 i = 0; i < size; ++i) ram_[(address + i) & kRamMask] = data[i];
    pending_irqs_.push_back(address & kRamMask);
    pending_irqs_.push_back((address + size) & kRamMask);
}

void Spu2::Read(u32 address, u8* data, u32 size) const {
    for (u32 i = 0; i < size; ++i) data[i] = ram_[(address + i) & kRamMask];
}

// The end of a voice's block: its flags decide where it goes next. A voice never
// stops fetching: key-off and an unrepeated end only silence it, and its
// address runs on through the loop - drivers time things by silent looping
// voices.
void Spu2::NextBlock(Core& c, u32 index, const std::function<void(u32)>& irq) {
    Voice& v = c.voices[index];
    // The block's last three: the interpolation's history into the next.
    v.window[0] = v.window[3 + kSamplesPerBlock - 3];
    v.window[1] = v.window[3 + kSamplesPerBlock - 2];
    v.window[2] = v.window[3 + kSamplesPerBlock - 1];
    const u32 block = v.nax & kRamMask & ~15u;
    const u8 flags = ram_[(block + 1) & kRamMask];
    CheckIrq(0, block, block + kBlockBytes, irq);
    if (flags & 1) {
        c.endx |= 1u << index;
        if (!(flags & 2)) {                         // an end without repeat: silence
            v.playing = false;
            v.phase = Phase::Off;
            v.level = 0;
        }
        v.nax = v.lsax;
    } else {
        v.nax = (block + kBlockBytes) & kRamMask;
    }
    Decode(v);
}

// One step of the ADSR envelope (the PS1/PS2 SPU's: a rate is a shift and a
// step; exponential attack slows above 0x6000, exponential decrease is
// proportional to the level).
void Spu2::Envelope(Voice& v) {
    if (v.phase == Phase::Off) return;
    if (v.phase == Phase::Decay && v.level <= std::min(0x7FFF, s32(((v.adsr1 & 15) + 1) * 0x800))) {
        v.phase = Phase::Sustain;                   // already at the sustain level
        return;
    }
    // The phase's rate: worked out again only when the phase or ADSR1/2 change.
    const u64 key = u64(v.phase) | u64(v.adsr1 & 0xFFFF) << 8 | u64(v.adsr2 & 0xFFFF) << 24;
    if (key != v.rate_key) {
        Rate r{};
        switch (v.phase) {
            case Phase::Attack: {
                const u32 rate = (v.adsr1 >> 8) & 0x7F;
                r = {rate >> 2, rate & 3, false, (v.adsr1 & 0x8000) != 0};
                break;
            }
            case Phase::Decay:
                r = {(v.adsr1 >> 4) & 15, 0, true, true};
                break;
            case Phase::Sustain: {
                const u32 rate = (v.adsr2 >> 6) & 0x7F;
                r = {rate >> 2, rate & 3, (v.adsr2 & 0x4000) != 0, (v.adsr2 & 0x8000) != 0};
                break;
            }
            case Phase::Release:
                r = {v.adsr2 & 0x1F, 0, true, (v.adsr2 & 0x20) != 0};
                break;
            default: break;
        }
        s32 step = r.decreasing ? -8 + s32(r.step) : 7 - s32(r.step);
        v.rate_step = r.shift < 11 ? step << (11 - r.shift) : step;
        v.rate_increment = r.shift > 11 ? (r.shift - 11 >= 16 ? 0 : 0x8000u >> (r.shift - 11)) : 0x8000u;
        v.rate_shift = r.shift;
        v.rate_decreasing = r.decreasing;
        v.rate_exponential = r.exponential;
        v.rate_key = key;
    }
    s32 step = v.rate_step;
    u32 increment = v.rate_increment;
    if (v.rate_exponential) {
        if (v.rate_decreasing) {
            step = s32((std::int64_t(step) * v.level) >> 15);
        } else if (v.level >= 0x6000) {
            if (v.rate_shift < 10) step >>= 2;
            else if (v.rate_shift >= 11) increment >>= 2;
            else { step >>= 1; increment >>= 1; }
        }
    }
    v.envelope_counter += increment;
    if (v.envelope_counter < 0x8000) return;
    v.envelope_counter = 0;
    v.level = std::min(0x7FFF, std::max(0, v.level + step));
    switch (v.phase) {
        case Phase::Attack:
            if (v.level >= 0x7FFF) v.phase = Phase::Decay;
            break;
        case Phase::Decay: {
            const s32 sustain = std::min(0x7FFF, s32(((v.adsr1 & 15) + 1) * 0x800));
            if (v.level <= sustain) v.phase = Phase::Sustain;
            break;
        }
        case Phase::Release:
            if (v.level == 0) { v.phase = Phase::Off; v.playing = false; }
            break;
        default: break;
    }
}

void Spu2::SetInput(u32 core, const u8* data, u32 size) {
    Core& c = cores_[core & 1];
    c.input = size >= 0x400 ? data : nullptr;
    c.input_size = size;
    c.input_sample = 0;
    c.input_hash[0] = c.input_hash[1] = 0;
}

namespace {
// Samples in a core's input buffer (256 a 0x400-byte block).
Spu2::u32 InputFrames(Spu2::u32 size) { return size / 0x400 * 256; }
}  // namespace

Spu2::u32 Spu2::InputHalf(u32 core) const {
    const Core& c = cores_[core & 1];
    const u32 frames = InputFrames(c.input_size);
    if (!c.input || frames < 2) return 0;
    return c.input_sample >= frames / 2 ? 1 : 0;
}

void Spu2::Advance(u64 now_us, const std::function<void(u32 core)>& irq,
                   const std::function<void(u32 core)>& input_half) {
    // Transfers that touched IRQA.
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < pending_irqs_.size(); i += 2)
        CheckIrq(0, pending_irqs_[i], pending_irqs_[i + 1] > pending_irqs_[i] ? pending_irqs_[i + 1] : pending_irqs_[i] + 1, irq);
    pending_irqs_.clear();
    // Samples are counted from the clock's start - the first Advance at a time
    // past 0 (at 0 it has not begun) - those due by `now_us`, less those
    // played: exact, in whole samples (a stopped Advance's rest is due still).
    if (!start_us_) start_us_ = now_us;
    if (!start_us_) return;
    const u64 due = (now_us - std::min(now_us, start_us_)) * 48000 / 1000000;
    if (due <= clock_) return;
    // The voices, a sample at a time; at most a second's worth at once (a host
    // that stalled longer than that catches up the clock, not the sound).
    if (due - clock_ > u64(kRate)) clock_ = due - u64(kRate);
    u32 count = u32(due - clock_);
    const u64 first_sample = clock_;
    // PS2HOST_SPU_LOG=1: once a second, the voices sounding and how their
    // volumes are set (fixed, or a sweep), and the cores' main volumes.
    static const bool log = std::getenv("PS2HOST_SPU_LOG") != nullptr;
    if (log && clock_ / 48000 != logged_second_) {
        logged_second_ = clock_ / 48000;
        for (u32 core = 0; core < 2; ++core) {
            const Core& c = cores_[core];
            u32 sounding = 0, sweeping = 0;
            std::string sweeps;
            for (u32 i = 0; i < 24; ++i) {
                const Voice& v = c.voices[i];
                if (v.phase == Phase::Off || !v.pitch) continue;
                ++sounding;
                if ((v.voll | v.volr) & 0x8000) {
                    ++sweeping;
                    char one[48];
                    std::snprintf(one, sizeof one, " %u:%04X/%04X", unsigned(i), unsigned(v.voll), unsigned(v.volr));
                    sweeps += one;
                }
            }
            char input[96] = "";
            if (c.input_halves)
                std::snprintf(input, sizeof input, "; input: %u halves, %u stale", unsigned(c.input_halves),
                              unsigned(c.input_stale));
            // The second's peaks: the voices' sum, the input's, the reverb's,
            // and the loudest voice - where it plays from, how.
            u32 loudest = 0;
            for (u32 i = 1; i < 24; ++i)
                if (c.voice_peak[i] > c.voice_peak[loudest]) loudest = i;
            const Voice& lv = c.voices[loudest];
            char peaks[260];
            std::snprintf(peaks, sizeof peaks, "; mmix %03X avol %04X/%04X bvol %04X/%04X; peaks: voices %d, input %d, reverb %d; loudest %u (%d): "
                          "pitch %04X ssa %05X nax %05X adsr %04X/%04X vol %04X/%04X",
                          unsigned(c.mmix), unsigned(c.avoll), unsigned(c.avolr), unsigned(c.bvoll), unsigned(c.bvolr),
                          int(c.peak_voices), int(c.peak_input), int(c.peak_reverb), unsigned(loudest),
                          int(c.voice_peak[loudest]), unsigned(lv.pitch), unsigned(lv.ssa), unsigned(lv.nax),
                          unsigned(lv.adsr1), unsigned(lv.adsr2), unsigned(lv.voll), unsigned(lv.volr));
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[spu2] core %u: %u voices sounding, %u sweeping%s; main %04X/%04X, effect %04X/%04X%s%s\n",
                         unsigned(core), unsigned(sounding), unsigned(sweeping), sweeps.c_str(), unsigned(c.mvoll),
                         unsigned(c.mvolr), unsigned(c.evoll), unsigned(c.evolr), input, peaks);
            Core& w = cores_[core];
            w.input_halves = w.input_stale = 0;
            w.peak_voices = w.peak_input = w.peak_reverb = 0;
            std::memset(w.voice_peak, 0, sizeof w.voice_peak);
        }
    }
    mixed_.assign(std::size_t(count) * 2, 0);
    bool stop = false;
    u32 n = 0;
    for (; n < count && !stop; ++n) {
        // Core 0's output: core 1's external input.
        s32 ext_left = 0, ext_right = 0, left = 0, right = 0;
        // The capture rings (PCSX2's layout, byte addresses): 512 samples
        // each, written on the voices' clock - voices 1 and 3 of each core,
        // core 0's output, each core's dry and wet mixes. A driver reads them
        // back to process (Burnout 3's player engine, its wet mix). Each
        // write checks IRQA, as the hardware's do.
        const u32 capture_offset = u32((first_sample + n) & 511) * 2;
        auto capture = [&](u32 base, s32 sample) {
            const u32 address = base + capture_offset;
            const u16 value = u16(s16(Clamp16(sample)));
            ram_[address] = u8(value);
            ram_[address + 1] = u8(value >> 8);
            CheckIrq(0, address, address + 2, irq);
        };
        for (u32 core = 0; core < 2; ++core) {
            Core& c = cores_[core];
            // The voices' dry and wet sums (VMIX), then the core's: MMIX's.
            s32 core_left = 0, core_right = 0, wet_left = 0, wet_right = 0;
            for (u32 i = 0; i < 24; ++i) {
                Voice& v = c.voices[i];
                v.left.Step();
                v.right.Step();
                s32 shaped = 0;
                if (v.pitch && v.phase != Phase::Off) {
                    // A voice heard nowhere - silent (level 0), or swept to
                    // nothing both sides (Burnout 3 leaves some twenty so) -
                    // sends nothing, exactly: its sample is not worked out.
                    // Voices 1 and 3 are, for the capture rings.
                    const bool heard = v.level != 0 && (v.left.now != 0 || v.right.now != 0 || log);
                    if (heard || i == 1 || i == 3) {
                        // new, old, older, oldest: the sample at the counter and
                        // the three before it (the window's first three are the
                        // last block's).
                        const s32* s = v.window + (v.counter >> 12);
                        const u32 f = (v.counter >> 4) & 0xFF;
                        const s32 sample = ((kGauss[0x0FF - f] * s[0]) >> 15) + ((kGauss[0x1FF - f] * s[1]) >> 15) +
                                           ((kGauss[0x100 + f] * s[2]) >> 15) + ((kGauss[f] * s[3]) >> 15);
                        shaped = (sample * v.level) >> 15;
                    }
                    const s32 sent_left = (shaped * v.left.now) >> 15, sent_right = (shaped * v.right.now) >> 15;
                    if (log) c.voice_peak[i] = std::max(c.voice_peak[i], std::max(std::abs(sent_left), std::abs(sent_right)));
                    if (c.switches[kVmixl] & (1u << i)) core_left += sent_left;
                    if (c.switches[kVmixr] & (1u << i)) core_right += sent_right;
                    if (c.switches[kVmixel] & (1u << i)) wet_left += sent_left;
                    if (c.switches[kVmixer] & (1u << i)) wet_right += sent_right;
                    Envelope(v);
                }
                if (i == 1) capture(core == 0 ? 0x0800 : 0x1800, shaped);
                if (i == 3) capture(core == 0 ? 0x0C00 : 0x1C00, shaped);
                if (!v.pitch) continue;
                v.counter += v.pitch;
                while (v.counter >= kBlockSpan) {
                    v.counter -= kBlockSpan;
                    NextBlock(c, i, irq);
                }
            }
            if (log) c.peak_voices = std::max(c.peak_voices, std::max(std::abs(core_left), std::abs(core_right)));
            const u32 mix_base = core == 0 ? 0x2000 : 0x3000;
            capture(mix_base, core_left);
            capture(mix_base + 0x400, core_right);
            capture(mix_base + 0x800, wet_left);
            capture(mix_base + 0xC00, wet_right);
            const u32 mix = c.mmix;
            core_left = mix & 0x800 ? Clamp16(core_left) : 0;
            core_right = mix & 0x400 ? Clamp16(core_right) : 0;
            wet_left = mix & 0x200 ? Clamp16(wet_left) : 0;
            wet_right = mix & 0x100 ? Clamp16(wet_right) : 0;
            // AVOL and BVOL: signed 16-bit, no sweeps (0x8000 inverts).
            auto volume = [](u32 v) { return s32(s16(u16(v))); };
            if (core == 1) {
                const s32 in_left = (ext_left * volume(c.avoll)) >> 15, in_right = (ext_right * volume(c.avolr)) >> 15;
                if (mix & 0x8) core_left += in_left;
                if (mix & 0x4) core_right += in_right;
                if (mix & 0x2) wet_left += in_left;
                if (mix & 0x1) wet_right += in_right;
            }
            // The sound-data input: a stereo sample a tick from its ring in SPU
            // RAM (0x4000/0x4400 core 0, 0x4800/0x4C00 core 1), planar, at
            // BVOL - where a driver's own transfers write it (Burnout 3's
            // engine sound), and where a block transfer's PCM (sceSdBlockTrans)
            // lands, as the hardware's AutoDMA puts it there: its next sample
            // a tick, from the IOP's buffer.
            const u32 input_base = core == 0 ? 0x4000 : 0x4800;
            if (c.input) {
                const u32 at = c.input_sample;
                const u8* block = c.input + (at / 256) * 0x400 + (at % 256) * 2;
                for (u32 side = 0; side < 2; ++side) {
                    ram_[input_base + side * 0x400 + capture_offset] = block[side * 0x200];
                    ram_[input_base + side * 0x400 + capture_offset + 1] = block[side * 0x200 + 1];
                }
                const u32 frames = InputFrames(c.input_size);
                c.input_sample = (at + 1) % frames;
                if (frames >= 2 && c.input_sample % (frames / 2) == 0) {
                    InputHalfBegun(c);
                    if (input_half) {
                        input_half(core);
                        stop = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            auto pcm = [&](u32 base) {
                const u32 address = base + capture_offset;
                CheckIrq(0, address, address + 2, irq);
                return s32(s16(u16(ram_[address]) | u16(ram_[address + 1]) << 8));
            };
            const s32 in_left = pcm(input_base), in_right = pcm(input_base + 0x400);
            // PS2HOST_SPU_INPUT_DUMP=<file>: a block transfer's input as
            // played, raw 16-bit stereo - to compare a stream with its source.
            static std::FILE* const dump = [] {
                const char* path = std::getenv("PS2HOST_SPU_INPUT_DUMP");
                return path ? std::fopen(path, "wb") : nullptr;
            }();
            if (dump && c.input) {
                const s16 pair[2] = {s16(in_left), s16(in_right)};
                std::fwrite(pair, 2, 2, dump);
            }
            if (c.input_gain_remaining) {
                c.input_gain += (c.input_gain_target - c.input_gain) / s32(c.input_gain_remaining);
                --c.input_gain_remaining;
            }
            s32 sent_left = (in_left * volume(c.bvoll)) >> 15;
            s32 sent_right = (in_right * volume(c.bvolr)) >> 15;
            if (c.input_gain != 65536) {        // SetInputVolume: a port's own volume
                sent_left = s32((std::int64_t(sent_left) * c.input_gain) >> 16);
                sent_right = s32((std::int64_t(sent_right) * c.input_gain) >> 16);
            }
            if (log) c.peak_input = std::max(c.peak_input, std::max(std::abs(sent_left), std::abs(sent_right)));
            if (mix & 0x80) core_left += sent_left;
            if (mix & 0x40) core_right += sent_right;
            if (mix & 0x20) wet_left += sent_left;
            if (mix & 0x10) wet_right += sent_right;
            // The reverb (SD_CORE_EFFECT_ENABLE, attr bit 2): a step every
            // other sample, on the pair's first input; its output held for
            // the pair.
            static const bool no_reverb = std::getenv("PS2HOST_SPU_NO_REVERB") != nullptr;   // to hear without it
            if ((c.attr & 4) && !no_reverb) {
                // In at 48 kHz; every other sample a step of the reverb on the
                // input filtered down; out its steps filtered up (a zero
                // between each: twice the filter's gain).
                const u32 at = ++c.reverb_at;
                c.reverb_in[0][at & 63] = Clamp16(wet_left);
                c.reverb_in[1][at & 63] = Clamp16(wet_right);
                if ((first_sample + n) & 1) {
                    Reverb(c, Clamp16(ReverbFir(c.reverb_in[0], at)), Clamp16(ReverbFir(c.reverb_in[1], at)));
                    c.reverb_up[0][at & 63] = c.reverb_out_left;
                    c.reverb_up[1][at & 63] = c.reverb_out_right;
                } else {
                    c.reverb_up[0][at & 63] = c.reverb_up[1][at & 63] = 0;
                }
                const s32 wet_out_left = Clamp16(ReverbFir(c.reverb_up[0], at) * 2);
                const s32 wet_out_right = Clamp16(ReverbFir(c.reverb_up[1], at) * 2);
                if (log) c.peak_reverb = std::max(c.peak_reverb, std::max(std::abs(wet_out_left), std::abs(wet_out_right)));
                core_left += (wet_out_left * Volume(c.evoll)) >> 15;
                core_right += (wet_out_right * Volume(c.evolr)) >> 15;
            }
            c.main_left.Step();
            c.main_right.Step();
            const s32 out_left = (Clamp16(core_left) * c.main_left.now) >> 15;
            const s32 out_right = (Clamp16(core_right) * c.main_right.now) >> 15;
            if (core == 0) {
                capture(0x1000, out_left);
                capture(0x1400, out_right);
                ext_left = out_left;
                ext_right = out_right;
            } else {
                left = out_left;
                right = out_right;
            }
        }
        mixed_[2 * n] = s16(Clamp16(left));
        mixed_[2 * n + 1] = s16(Clamp16(right));
    }
    count = n;
    clock_ += count;
    if (output_ && count) output_(mixed_.data(), count);
}

// A half of a core's input buffer begun: counted, and whether it is as it
// was the last time round - not refilled (silence aside).
void Spu2::InputHalfBegun(Core& c) {
    const u32 frames = InputFrames(c.input_size), half = c.input_sample / (frames / 2);
    const u32 bytes = c.input_size / 2;
    const u8* p = c.input + half * bytes;
    u64 hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
    bool silent = true;
    for (u32 i = 0; i + 8 <= bytes; i += 8) {
        u64 word;
        std::memcpy(&word, p + i, 8);
        silent &= word == 0;
        hash = (hash ^ word) * 1099511628211ull;
    }
    ++c.input_halves;
    if (!silent && hash == c.input_hash[half]) ++c.input_stale;
    c.input_hash[half] = hash;
}

}  // namespace iop
}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/spu2.h`:

```h
/*
 * The SPU2, the PS2's sound processor, as libsd drives it (iop_libs.cpp).
 *
 * Voices play through SPU RAM in real time, a sample at a time at 48 kHz:
 * their ADPCM is decoded, shaped by the ADSR envelope and mixed by their
 * volumes into the stereo output (an Output sink - the host's audio device -
 * takes it). Games synchronise with the same machinery: loop flags, ENDX, and
 * the SPU2 interrupt raised when a voice's playback (or a transfer) reaches the
 * interrupt address IRQA - the clock sound drivers stream by.
 *
 * Voice data is the SPU's ADPCM: 16-byte blocks of 28 samples. Byte 0 holds
 * the shift (bits 0-3) and the prediction filter (bits 4-6); byte 1 the flags:
 * bit 0 loop end, bit 1 repeat (go back to the loop start rather than stop),
 * bit 2 loop start. A voice plays at pitch/4096 of 48 kHz.
 *
 * Reverb (the effect unit): each core's voices with VMIXEL/VMIXER set feed it;
 * it runs at 24 kHz on its work area at the top of SPU RAM, with the
 * registers libsd's presets set (SetEffectAttr: sceSdSetEffectAttr), and its
 * output joins the core's at EVOL. The algorithm is the PS1 SPU's, which the
 * SPU2 kept (no-cash psx-spx, "SPU Reverb Formula").
 *
 * Sound-data input: a core's ring in SPU RAM - planar 16-bit PCM, 512 left
 * samples at 0x4000 then 512 right at 0x4400 (core 0), 0x4800/0x4C00 (core
 * 1) - read a stereo sample per 48 kHz tick at the core's BVOL, into its dry
 * and wet mixes as MMIX bits 4-7 say. A driver writes it itself (Burnout 3's
 * engine sound), or a block transfer (sceSdBlockTrans - how CRI's ADX streams
 * its music) fills it from IOP memory a sample a tick, as the hardware's
 * AutoDMA does: 0x200 bytes of left samples, then 0x200 of right, looping
 * over the buffer.
 *
 * Capture: the SPU2 writes what it mixes back into SPU RAM, 512-sample rings
 * - voices 1 and 3 of each core, core 0's output, each core's dry and wet
 * mixes - and the writes raise IRQA, so a driver can read the sound back to
 * process it.
 *
 * The cores (PCSX2's mixer): each sums its voices (VMIX), its sound-data
 * input (BVOL) and its external input into a dry and a wet mix, as MMIX lets
 * each in; the wet goes through the reverb (EVOL); the sum, at MVOL, is the
 * core's output. Core 0's is core 1's external input (at core 1's AVOL), and
 * core 1's is what is heard.
 *
 * Not modelled yet: noise, pitch modulation.
 *
 * libsd's entries (ps2sdk libsd-common.h): a voice parameter or address is
 * (param << 8) | core | voice << 1; a switch or core address (n << 8) | core.
 */

#ifndef PS2HOST_SPU2_H
#define PS2HOST_SPU2_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <vector>

namespace ps2host {
namespace iop {

class Spu2 {
public:
    using u8 = std::uint8_t;
    using u16 = std::uint16_t;
    using s16 = std::int16_t;
    using u32 = std::uint32_t;
    using s32 = std::int32_t;
    using u64 = std::uint64_t;

    Spu2() : ram_(2u << 20) {
        cores_[0].mmix = 0xFF0;
        cores_[1].mmix = 0xFFC;
    }

    // Host gain for a core's PCM input, applied after the game's own volume.
    // A 5 ms ramp makes live menu changes click-free; capture RAM is unchanged.
    void SetInputVolume(u32 core, u32 percent);
    void SetParam(u32 entry, u32 value);
    u32 GetParam(u32 entry) const;
    void SetSwitch(u32 entry, u32 value);
    u32 GetSwitch(u32 entry) const;
    void SetAddr(u32 entry, u32 value);
    u32 GetAddr(u32 entry) const;
    void SetCoreAttr(u32 entry, u32 value);
    u32 GetCoreAttr(u32 entry) const;
    /* sceSdSetEffectAttr: a reverb preset (SD_EFFECT_MODE_*, 0x100 to clear
       the work area), its depth, and for echo and delay their delay and
       feedback - as libsd programs the registers. -1 for a bad mode. */
    int SetEffectAttr(u32 core, u32 mode, s32 depth_left, s32 depth_right, u32 delay, u32 feedback);
    /* What the last SetEffectAttr was given (libsd keeps it). */
    void GetEffectAttr(u32 core, u32* mode, s32* depth_left, s32* depth_right, u32* delay, u32* feedback) const;

    /* A core's sound-data input: `size` bytes of PCM at `data` (it stays
       there, the source's memory), from its start; null stops it. */
    void SetInput(u32 core, const u8* data, u32 size);

    /* Data into (or out of) SPU RAM at a byte address, as a transfer would. */
    void Write(u32 address, const u8* data, u32 size);
    void Read(u32 address, u8* data, u32 size) const;

    /* Advance playback to `now_us`; `irq(core)` for each interrupt raised.
       With `input_half`, a core's sound-data input reaching a half of its
       buffer calls it (the block transfer's interrupt: the half before is
       free to refill) and playback stops there, the rest owed (Behind): the
       IOP's handler and the stream's decoder run before the SPU2 reads on
       (PlayedUs: where it stopped). */
    void Advance(u64 now_us, const std::function<void(u32 core)>& irq,
                 const std::function<void(u32 core)>& input_half = nullptr);
    /* The time played to: the last Advance's, or short of it where it stopped. */
    u64 PlayedUs() const { return start_us_ + clock_ * 1000000 / 48000; }
    /* The half of its buffer a core's sound-data input is playing (0 or 1). */
    u32 InputHalf(u32 core) const;
    bool InputActive(u32 core) const { return cores_[core & 1].input != nullptr; }

    /* Where the mixed output goes: interleaved 16-bit stereo at 48 kHz. */
    using Output = std::function<void(const s16* frames, u32 count)>;
    void SetOutput(Output output) { output_ = std::move(output); }

    /* Exposed for tests: one ADPCM block decoded, with the filter history. */
    static void DecodeBlock(const u8* block, s32 out[28], s32* older, s32* old);

private:
    enum class Phase : u8 { Off, Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release };
    /* A volume as it is now (a voice's left or right, a core's main): set to
       a register's fixed value (bit 15 clear: 15 bits, signed), or moved a
       sample at a time by its sweep (bit 15 set: bit 14 exponential, 13
       decreasing, 12 the phase inverted, 0-6 the rate, as an envelope's)
       from where it was - the game fades a voice it leaves running so. */
    struct Level {
        u32 reg = 0;
        s32 now = 0;                    // -0x7FFF to 0x7FFF
        u32 counter = 0;
        explicit Level(u32 value = 0) { Set(value); }
        void Set(u32 value);
        // A sample of a sweep; a fixed volume (bit 15 clear) stays as it is.
        // Inline: 100 levels step at 48 kHz, nearly all of them fixed.
        void Step() {
            if (reg & 0x8000) Sweep();
        }
        void Sweep();
    };
    struct Voice {
        u32 pitch = 0, ssa = 0, lsax = 0, nax = 0;
        u32 adsr1 = 0, adsr2 = 0, voll = 0, volr = 0;
        Level left, right;              // VOLL, VOLR as they are now
        bool playing = false;           // sounding (a stopped voice still runs on)
        u32 counter = 0;                // 4.12 fixed point: samples into the block
        // The last block's last three samples (the Gaussian interpolation's
        // history), then the current block, decoded: one run, so the four
        // taps are read straight from it.
        s32 window[3 + 28] = {};
        s32 older = 0, old = 0;         // the decoder's history
        Phase phase = Phase::Off;
        s32 level = 0;                  // the envelope, 0-0x7FFF
        u32 envelope_counter = 0;
        // The phase's rate as Envelope works it out from ADSR1/2, kept while
        // the phase and the registers stay (a voice's every sample asked).
        u64 rate_key = ~0ull;
        s32 rate_step = 0;
        u32 rate_increment = 0, rate_shift = 0;
        bool rate_decreasing = false, rate_exponential = false;
    };
    struct Core {
        Voice voices[24];
        u32 endx = 0, irqa = 0, attr = 0, esa = 0, eea = 0, tsa = 0;
        u32 switches[16] = {};          // by switch number - 0x13
        s32 input_gain = 65536, input_gain_target = 65536;   // SetInputVolume's, 16.16
        u32 input_gain_remaining = 0;
        u32 mvoll = 0x3FFF, mvolr = 0x3FFF;
        // The inputs' volumes: AVOL the external input's (core 1's: core 0's
        // output), BVOL the sound-data input's - at their maximum until set.
        u32 avoll = 0x7FFF, avolr = 0x7FFF, bvoll = 0x7FFF, bvolr = 0x7FFF;
        // MMIX, what goes where, wet R, wet L, dry R, dry L in each four bits:
        // 0-3 the external input, 4-7 the sound-data input, 8-11 the core's
        // voices (PCSX2's gates). After sceSdInit 0xFF0 and 0xFFC (Spu2()).
        u32 mmix = 0xFFF;
        const u8* input = nullptr;      // the sound-data input, while a block transfer runs
        u32 input_size = 0, input_sample = 0;
        // PS2HOST_SPU_LOG: halves begun, and those begun as they were the
        // last time round (not refilled: the decoder behind its reader).
        u32 input_halves = 0, input_stale = 0;
        u64 input_hash[2] = {};
        s32 peak_voices = 0, peak_input = 0, peak_reverb = 0, voice_peak[24] = {};   // PS2HOST_SPU_LOG: the second's
        Level main_left{0x3FFF}, main_right{0x3FFF};     // MVOLL, MVOLR as they are now
        bool irq_enabled = false;
        // Reverb: the registers (libsd's order: dAPF1, dAPF2, vIIR, vCOMB1-4,
        // vWALL, vAPF1, vAPF2, then the 20 buffer offsets in 8-byte units,
        // vLIN, vRIN), EVOL, where it is in its work area, what feeds it.
        u16 reverb[32] = {};
        u32 evoll = 0, evolr = 0;
        u32 effect_mode = 0, effect_delay = 0, effect_feedback = 0;
        s32 effect_depth_left = 0, effect_depth_right = 0;
        u32 reverb_position = 0;        // bytes into the work area
        s32 reverb_out_left = 0, reverb_out_right = 0;   // the last step's
        // The reverb's resampling (ReverbResample): the last 64 samples into
        // it at 48 kHz, and out of it - its steps, a zero between each.
        s32 reverb_in[2][64] = {}, reverb_up[2][64] = {};
        u32 reverb_at = 0;
    };
    Core cores_[2];
    std::vector<u8> ram_;
    u64 start_us_ = 0;               // the clock's start: the first Advance past 0
    u64 clock_ = 0;                  // samples since then, played (or passed over)
    u64 logged_second_ = ~0ull;      // PS2HOST_SPU_LOG: the last second logged
    Output output_;
    std::vector<s16> mixed_;

    void InputHalfBegun(Core& c);
    static u32 CoreOf(u32 entry) { return entry & 1; }
    static u32 VoiceOf(u32 entry) { return ((entry >> 1) & 0x1F) % 24; }
    void CheckIrq(u32 core_hint, u32 from, u32 to, const std::function<void(u32)>& irq);
    void Start(Voice& v);
    void Decode(Voice& v);
    void NextBlock(Core& c, u32 index, const std::function<void(u32)>& irq);
    void Envelope(Voice& v);
    void Reverb(Core& c, s32 in_left, s32 in_right);
    u32 EffectEnd(const Core& c) const;
    std::vector<u32> pending_irqs_;
};

}  // namespace iop
}  // namespace ps2host

#endif  /* PS2HOST_SPU2_H */
```

`host/src/texture_pack.cpp`:

```cpp
/* Texture packs (texture_pack.h): PCSX2's names, the pack's index, its files
   read in the background. */

#include "ps2host/texture_pack.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <deque>
#include <filesystem>
#include <list>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

#define XXH_INLINE_ALL
#include "xxhash.h"
#define BCDEC_IMPLEMENTATION
#include "bcdec.h"
#define STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION
#define STBI_ONLY_PNG
#define STBI_NO_STDIO
#include "stb_image.h"

namespace ps2host {
namespace texture_pack {

using gs::u32;
using gs::u64;
using gs::u8;

namespace {

u32 Bits(u64 value, int low, int count) { return u32((value >> low) & ((1ull << count) - 1)); }

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ names

enum : u32 {
    kCT32 = 0x00, kCT24 = 0x01, kCT16 = 0x02, kCT16S = 0x0A, kT8 = 0x13, kT4 = 0x14, kT8H = 0x1B,
    kT4HL = 0x24, kT4HH = 0x2C, kZ32 = 0x30, kZ24 = 0x31, kZ16 = 0x32, kZ16S = 0x3A,
};

/* What PCSX2's psm_t says of a format: its block's size, its CLUT's entries
   (0: none), whether every bit of a texel is the texture's (fmsk all ones),
   and its colour's size in bits (32, 24, 16). */
struct PsmInfo {
    u32 bw = 8, bh = 8, pal = 0;
    bool full = false;
    u32 colour = 32;
    bool known = false;
};

PsmInfo FormatOf(u32 psm) {
    switch (psm) {
        case kCT32: case kZ32: return {8, 8, 0, true, 32, true};
        case kCT24: case kZ24: return {8, 8, 0, false, 24, true};
        case kCT16: case kCT16S: case kZ16: case kZ16S: return {16, 8, 0, false, 16, true};
        case kT8: return {16, 16, 256, true, 32, true};
        case kT4: return {32, 16, 16, true, 32, true};
        case kT8H: return {8, 8, 256, false, 32, true};
        case kT4HL: case kT4HH: return {8, 8, 16, false, 32, true};
        default: return {};
    }
}

/* PCSX2's SourceRegion::Create: the part of the texture CLAMP's region modes
   read, on each axis that has one ([min, max), 0 and 0 for none). */
struct Region {
    u32 min_x = 0, max_x = 0, min_y = 0, max_y = 0;
    bool HasX() const { return min_x != 0 || max_x != 0; }
    bool HasY() const { return min_y != 0 || max_y != 0; }
};

Region RegionOf(u64 tex0, u64 clamp) {
    Region r;
    const u32 tw = 1u << Bits(tex0, 26, 4), th = 1u << Bits(tex0, 30, 4);
    const u32 wms = Bits(clamp, 0, 2), wmt = Bits(clamp, 2, 2);
    const u32 minu = Bits(clamp, 4, 10), maxu = Bits(clamp, 14, 10);
    const u32 minv = Bits(clamp, 24, 10), maxv = Bits(clamp, 34, 10);
    if (wms == 2 && maxu >= minu) {
        if (maxu - minu + 1 < tw || maxu >= tw) r.min_x = minu, r.max_x = maxu + 1;
    } else if (wms == 3 && minu != 0) {
        const u32 rw = ((minu | maxu) - maxu) + 1;
        if (rw < tw || (maxu != 0 && rw <= tw)) r.min_x = maxu, r.max_x = (minu | maxu) + 1;
    }
    if (wmt == 2 && maxv >= minv) {
        if (maxv - minv + 1 < th || maxv >= th) r.min_y = minv, r.max_y = maxv + 1;
    } else if (wmt == 3 && minv != 0) {
        const u32 rh = ((minv | maxv) - maxv) + 1;
        if (rh < th || (maxv != 0 && rh <= th)) r.min_y = maxv, r.max_y = (minv | maxv) + 1;
    }
    return r;
}

/* A texel as PCSX2's rtx expands it for hashing: RGBA (R in the low byte). */
u32 Expand(u32 psm, u32 raw, u64 texa) {
    const u32 ta0 = Bits(texa, 0, 8), aem = Bits(texa, 15, 1), ta1 = Bits(texa, 32, 8);
    const PsmInfo f = FormatOf(psm);
    if (f.colour == 24) return (raw & 0xFFFFFF) | ((aem && (raw & 0xFFFFFF) == 0) ? 0u : ta0 << 24);
    if (f.colour == 16) {
        const u32 rgb = (raw & 31) << 3 | ((raw >> 5) & 31) << 11 | ((raw >> 10) & 31) << 19;
        const u32 a = (raw & 0x8000) ? ta1 : (aem && raw == 0) ? 0u : ta0;
        return rgb | a << 24;
    }
    return raw;
}

/* PCSX2's HashTextureLevel, level 0. */
u64 TextureHash(const gs::Memory& memory, u64 tex0, u64 texa, const Region& region) {
    const u32 psm = Bits(tex0, 20, 6), tbp = Bits(tex0, 0, 14), tbw = Bits(tex0, 14, 6);
    const PsmInfo f = FormatOf(psm);
    const int tw = region.HasX() ? int(region.max_x - region.min_x) : 1 << Bits(tex0, 26, 4);
    const int th = region.HasY() ? int(region.max_y - region.min_y) : 1 << Bits(tex0, 30, 4);
    // GetRect: the region's bounds on an axis that has one, else 0 to the size.
    const int left = region.HasX() ? int(region.min_x) : 0, top = region.HasY() ? int(region.min_y) : 0;
    const int right = region.HasX() ? int(region.max_x) : tw, bottom = region.HasY() ? int(region.max_y) : th;
    const int bl = left / int(f.bw) * int(f.bw), bt = top / int(f.bh) * int(f.bh);
    const int br = (right + int(f.bw) - 1) / int(f.bw) * int(f.bw);
    const int bb = (bottom + int(f.bh) - 1) / int(f.bh) * int(f.bh);
    XXH3_state_t state;
    XXH3_64bits_reset(&state);
    const bool expanded = tw < int(f.bw) || th < int(f.bh) || !f.full || region.max_x > 0 || region.min_y > 0;
    if (!expanded) {
        // The blocks as memory holds them, a row of blocks at a time.
        for (int y = bt; y < bb; y += int(f.bh))
            for (int x = bl; x < br; x += int(f.bw)) {
                u32 nibble = 0;
                const u32 block = (gs::Memory::Address(tbp, tbw, u32(x), u32(y), psm, &nibble) / 256) & 0x3FFF;
                XXH3_64bits_update(&state, memory.data() + std::size_t(block) * 256, 256);
            }
        return XXH3_64bits_digest(&state);
    }
    // Expanded: indices a byte each, or RGBA - laid out as PCSX2's temporary
    // buffer is (its pitch from the block rectangle's right edge, aligned to
    // 32 bytes), the rows hashed from the rectangle's left edge - in bytes,
    // even for four-byte texels (as PCSX2 does).
    const bool pal = f.pal != 0;
    const u32 texel_bytes = pal ? 1 : 4;
    const std::size_t pitch = (std::size_t(br) * texel_bytes + 31) & ~std::size_t(31);
    std::vector<u8> buffer(pitch * std::size_t(bb - bt) + 64, 0);
    for (int y = bt; y < bb; ++y) {
        u8* row = buffer.data() + pitch * std::size_t(y - bt);
        for (int x = bl; x < br; ++x) {
            const u32 raw = memory.Read(tbp, tbw, u32(x), u32(y), psm);
            if (pal) {
                row[x - bl] = u8(raw);
            } else {
                const u32 c = Expand(psm, raw, texa);
                std::memcpy(row + std::size_t(x - bl) * 4, &c, 4);
            }
        }
    }
    const u8* at = buffer.data() + pitch * std::size_t(top - bt) + std::size_t(left - bl);
    const std::size_t row_size = std::size_t(tw) * texel_bytes;
    for (int y = 0; y < th; ++y, at += pitch) XXH3_64bits_update(&state, at, row_size);
    return XXH3_64bits_digest(&state);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ files

struct NameHash {
    std::size_t operator()(const Name& n) const {
        return std::size_t(n.texture * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull ^ n.clut ^ (u64(n.bits) << 32 | n.region_w << 16 |
                                                                           n.region_h));
    }
};

bool ParseHex(const std::string& s, u64* out) {
    if (s.empty() || s.size() > 16) return false;
    u64 v = 0;
    for (char ch : s) {
        int d;
        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') d = ch - '0';
        else if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'f') d = ch - 'a' + 10;
        else if (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'F') d = ch - 'A' + 10;
        else return false;
        v = v << 4 | u64(d);
    }
    *out = v;
    return true;
}

/* A file's name (without its extension) as PCSX2's parser reads it. */
bool ParseName(const std::string& stem, Name* name) {
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    std::size_t start = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i <= stem.size(); ++i)
        if (i == stem.size() || stem[i] == '-') {
            parts.push_back(stem.substr(start, i - start));
            start = i + 1;
        }
    if (parts.size() < 2 || parts.size() > 4) return false;
    for (const std::string& part : parts)
        if (part.empty()) return false;
    Name n;
    u64 value = 0;
    if (!ParseHex(parts[0], &n.texture) || !ParseHex(parts.back(), &value) || parts.back().size() != 8) return false;
    n.bits = u32(value) & ~0x4000u;                     // TCC: PCSX2 clears it
    std::size_t next = 1;
    if (next + 1 < parts.size() && parts[next][0] != 'r') {
        if (!ParseHex(parts[next], &n.clut)) return false;
        ++next;
    }
    if (next + 1 < parts.size()) {
        const std::string& r = parts[next];
        const std::size_t x = r.find('x');
        if (r[0] != 'r' || x == std::string::npos) return false;     // (the old r<64-bit> form: not read)
        u64 w = 0, h = 0;
        try {
            w = std::stoull(r.substr(1, x - 1));
            h = std::stoull(r.substr(x + 1));
        } catch (...) {
            return false;
        }
        n.region_w = u32(w);
        n.region_h = u32(h);
        ++next;
    }
    if (next + 1 != parts.size()) return false;
    *name = n;
    return true;
}

/* Halves an RGBA level (a box filter), down to 1 x 1. */
void Halve(const std::vector<u32>& from, u32 w, u32 h, std::vector<u32>* to, u32* nw, u32* nh) {
    *nw = std::max(1u, w / 2);
    *nh = std::max(1u, h / 2);
    to->assign(std::size_t(*nw) * *nh, 0);
    for (u32 y = 0; y < *nh; ++y)
        for (u32 x = 0; x < *nw; ++x) {
            u32 sum[4] = {};
            for (u32 dy = 0; dy < 2; ++dy)
                for (u32 dx = 0; dx < 2; ++dx) {
                    const u32 c = from[std::size_t(std::min(h - 1, y * 2 + dy)) * w + std::min(w - 1, x * 2 + dx)];
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) sum[k] += (c >> (8 * k)) & 255;
                }
            u32 c = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) c |= ((sum[k] + 2) / 4) << (8 * k);
            (*to)[std::size_t(y) * *nw + x] = c;
        }
}

std::atomic<bool> g_block_compression{false};

/* RGBA levels (largest first) as one image; more made by halving, down to
   1 x 1 or 8 in all, when there are fewer. */
std::shared_ptr<Image> Rgba(std::vector<std::vector<u32>> levels, u32 width, u32 height) {
    constexpr u32 kMaxLevels = 8;
    u32 w = width, h = height;
    for (std::size_t n = 1; n < levels.size(); ++n) w = std::max(1u, w / 2), h = std::max(1u, h / 2);
    while (levels.size() < kMaxLevels && (w > 1 || h > 1)) {
        std::vector<u32> next;
        u32 nw, nh;
        Halve(levels.back(), w, h, &next, &nw, &nh);
        levels.push_back(std::move(next));
        w = nw;
        h = nh;
    }
    levels.resize(std::min<std::size_t>(levels.size(), kMaxLevels));
    auto image = std::make_shared<Image>();
    image->format = kRgba8;
    image->width = width;
    image->height = height;
    image->levels = u32(levels.size());
    for (const std::vector<u32>& level : levels) {
        const std::size_t at = image->data.size();
        image->data.resize(at + level.size() * 4);
        std::memcpy(image->data.data() + at, level.data(), level.size() * 4);
    }
    return image;
}

u32 Le32(const u8* p) { return u32(p[0]) | u32(p[1]) << 8 | u32(p[2]) << 16 | u32(p[3]) << 24; }

std::shared_ptr<Image> LoadDds(const std::vector<u8>& file) {
    if (file.size() < 128 || std::memcmp(file.data(), "DDS ", 4) != 0) return nullptr;
    const u8* h = file.data() + 4;
    const u32 height = Le32(h + 8), width = Le32(h + 12), flags = Le32(h + 4);
    const u32 mips = (flags & 0x20000) ? std::max(1u, Le32(h + 24)) : 1;
    const u8* pf = h + 72;
    const u32 pf_flags = Le32(pf + 4), fourcc = Le32(pf + 8), bitcount = Le32(pf + 12);
    std::size_t offset = 128;
    // Block compression (a Format), or -1 RGBA8, -2 BGRA8.
    int bc = 0;
    if (pf_flags & 0x4) {
        if (fourcc == 0x31545844) bc = kBc1;                    // DXT1
        else if (fourcc == 0x33545844) bc = kBc2;               // DXT3
        else if (fourcc == 0x35545844) bc = kBc3;               // DXT5
        else if (fourcc == 0x30315844) {                        // DX10
            if (file.size() < 148) return nullptr;
            const u32 dxgi = Le32(file.data() + 128);
            offset = 148;
            if (dxgi == 71 || dxgi == 72) bc = kBc1;
            else if (dxgi == 74 || dxgi == 75) bc = kBc2;
            else if (dxgi == 77 || dxgi == 78) bc = kBc3;
            else if (dxgi == 98 || dxgi == 99) bc = kBc7;
            else if (dxgi == 28 || dxgi == 29) bc = -1;
            else if (dxgi == 87 || dxgi == 91) bc = -2;
            else return nullptr;
        } else {
            return nullptr;
        }
    } else if ((pf_flags & 0x40) && bitcount == 32) {
        bc = Le32(pf + 16) == 0x00FF0000 ? -2 : -1;             // RGB masks: BGRA or RGBA
    } else {
        return nullptr;
    }
    if (width == 0 || height == 0 || width > 8192 || height > 8192) return nullptr;
    // The levels the file has, as many as are whole.
    std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t>> spans;     // offset, bytes
    u32 w = width, hh = height;
    for (u32 n = 0; n < mips && n < 14; ++n) {
        const std::size_t bytes = bc > 0 ? std::size_t((w + 3) / 4) * ((hh + 3) / 4) * (bc == kBc1 ? 8 : 16)
                                         : std::size_t(w) * hh * 4;
        if (offset + bytes > file.size()) break;
        spans.emplace_back(offset, bytes);
        offset += bytes;
        if (w == 1 && hh == 1) break;
        w = std::max(1u, w / 2);
        hh = std::max(1u, hh / 2);
    }
    if (spans.empty()) return nullptr;
    if (bc > 0 && g_block_compression) {
        auto image = std::make_shared<Image>();
        image->format = u32(bc);
        image->width = width;
        image->height = height;
        image->levels = u32(spans.size());
        image->data.assign(file.begin() + std::ptrdiff_t(spans.front().first),
                           file.begin() + std::ptrdiff_t(spans.back().first + spans.back().second));
        return image;
    }
    std::vector<std::vector<u32>> levels;
    w = width;
    hh = height;
    for (const auto& [at, bytes] : spans) {
        std::vector<u32> level(std::size_t(w) * hh);
        if (bc > 0) {
            const u32 bx = (w + 3) / 4, by = (hh + 3) / 4;
            const std::size_t block = bc == kBc1 ? 8 : 16;
            u32 tile[16];
            for (u32 y = 0; y < by; ++y)
                for (u32 x = 0; x < bx; ++x) {
                    const u8* src = file.data() + at + (std::size_t(y) * bx + x) * block;
                    if (bc == kBc1) bcdec_bc1(src, tile, 16);
                    else if (bc == kBc2) bcdec_bc2(src, tile, 16);
                    else if (bc == kBc3) bcdec_bc3(src, tile, 16);
                    else bcdec_bc7(src, tile, 16);
                    for (u32 j = 0; j < 4 && y * 4 + j < hh; ++j)
                        for (u32 i = 0; i < 4 && x * 4 + i < w; ++i)
                            level[std::size_t(y * 4 + j) * w + x * 4 + i] = tile[j * 4 + i];
                }
        } else {
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < level.size(); ++i) {
                u32 c = Le32(file.data() + at + i * 4);
                if (bc == -2) c = (c & 0xFF00FF00u) | (c >> 16 & 0xFF) | (c & 0xFF) << 16;
                level[i] = c;
            }
        }
        levels.push_back(std::move(level));
        w = std::max(1u, w / 2);
        hh = std::max(1u, hh / 2);
    }
    // (Decoded here, a compressed file's levels below its own are made too.)
    return Rgba(std::move(levels), width, height);
}

std::shared_ptr<Image> LoadPng(const std::vector<u8>& file) {
    int w = 0, h = 0, channels = 0;
    unsigned char* data = stbi_load_from_memory(file.data(), int(file.size()), &w, &h, &channels, 4);
    if (!data) return nullptr;
    std::vector<u32> level(std::size_t(w) * h);
    std::memcpy(level.data(), data, level.size() * 4);
    stbi_image_free(data);
    // A PNG without alpha: 0x80, the GS's 1.0 (as PCSX2 gives it).
    if (channels == 3 || channels == 1)
        for (u32& c : level) c = (c & 0xFFFFFF) | 0x80000000u;
    return Rgba({std::move(level)}, u32(w), u32(h));
}

std::shared_ptr<Image> Load(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::FILE* f = _wfopen(path.wstring().c_str(), L"rb");
    if (!f) return nullptr;
    std::vector<u8> bytes;
    std::fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    const long size = std::ftell(f);
    std::fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    if (size > 0) {
        bytes.resize(std::size_t(size));
        if (std::fread(bytes.data(), 1, bytes.size(), f) != bytes.size()) bytes.clear();
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    if (bytes.empty()) return nullptr;
    std::string ext = path.extension().string();
    std::transform(ext.begin(), ext.end(), ext.begin(), [](char ch) { return char(std::tolower(ch)); });
    return ext == ".dds" ? LoadDds(bytes) : LoadPng(bytes);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the pack

/* The images read stay while they come to under this many bytes (the least
   recently drawn go first: read again if drawn again). */
constexpr std::size_t kKeptBytes = std::size_t(1536) << 20;

struct Pack {
    std::mutex lock;
    std::condition_variable wake;
    struct File {
        std::filesystem::path path;
        u64 id = 0;                     // the renderer's name for its image (UploadReplacement)
    };
    std::unordered_map<Name, File, NameHash> files;
    struct Kept {
        std::shared_ptr<const Image> image;
        std::list<Name>::iterator lru;
    };
    std::unordered_map<Name, Kept, NameHash> kept;
    std::list<Name> lru;
    std::size_t kept_bytes = 0;
    std::unordered_set<Name, NameHash> failed, queued;
    std::deque<Name> queue;
    std::thread reader;
    bool stop = false;

    ~Pack() {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(lock);
            stop = true;
        }
        wake.notify_all();
        if (reader.joinable()) reader.join();
    }

    void Read() {
        for (;;) {
            Name name;
            File file;
            {
                std::unique_lock<std::mutex> hold(lock);
                wake.wait(hold, [&] { return stop || !queue.empty(); });
                if (stop) return;
                name = queue.front();
                queue.pop_front();
                file = files[name];
            }
            std::shared_ptr<Image> loaded = Load(file.path);
            if (loaded) loaded->id = file.id;
            std::shared_ptr<const Image> image = loaded;
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(lock);
            queued.erase(name);
            if (!image) {
                failed.insert(name);
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[texture pack] could not read %s\n", file.path.string().c_str());
                continue;
            }
            lru.push_front(name);
            kept[name] = {image, lru.begin()};
            kept_bytes += image->data.size();
            while (kept_bytes > kKeptBytes && lru.size() > 1) {
                auto old = kept.find(lru.back());
                kept_bytes -= old->second.image->data.size();
                kept.erase(old);
                lru.pop_back();
            }
        }
    }
};

Pack& ThePack() {
    static Pack pack;
    return pack;
}

std::atomic<bool> g_enabled{true};
std::atomic<u64> g_generation{1};
std::atomic<std::size_t> g_count{0};

}  // namespace

std::string Name::Text() const {
    char text[96];
    int n = std::snprintf(text, sizeof text, "%llx", static_cast<unsigned long long>(texture));
    if (clut) n += std::snprintf(text + n, sizeof text - n, "-%llx", static_cast<unsigned long long>(clut));
    if (region_w || region_h) n += std::snprintf(text + n, sizeof text - n, "-r%ux%u", region_w, region_h);
    std::snprintf(text + n, sizeof text - n, "-%08x", bits);
    return text;
}

std::size_t Open(const std::string& directory) {
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    Pack& pack = ThePack();
    std::error_code error;
    std::size_t count = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(pack.lock);
        pack.files.clear();
        const fs::path root = fs::u8path(directory);
        if (fs::is_directory(root, error)) {
            for (fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(root, fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, error), end;
                 it != end; it.increment(error)) {
                if (error) break;
                if (!it->is_regular_file(error)) continue;
                std::string ext = it->path().extension().string();
                std::transform(ext.begin(), ext.end(), ext.begin(), [](char ch) { return char(std::tolower(ch)); });
                if (ext != ".dds" && ext != ".png") continue;
                Name name;
                if (!ParseName(it->path().stem().string(), &name)) continue;
                pack.files.emplace(name, Pack::File{it->path(), pack.files.size() + 1});    // the first found, as PCSX2
            }
        }
        count = pack.files.size();
        if (count && !pack.reader.joinable()) pack.reader = std::thread([&pack] { pack.Read(); });
    }
    g_count = count;
    ++g_generation;
    return count;
}

std::size_t Count() { return g_count; }
void SetBlockCompression(bool on) { g_block_compression = on; }
bool Enabled() { return g_enabled; }
void SetEnabled(bool on) {
    if (g_enabled.exchange(on) != on) ++g_generation;
}
u64 Generation() { return g_generation; }

Name NameOf(const gs::Memory& memory, u64 tex0, u64 clamp, u64 texa, const u32* clut) {
    Name name;
    const u32 psm = Bits(tex0, 20, 6);
    const PsmInfo f = FormatOf(psm);
    if (!f.known) return name;
    const Region region = RegionOf(tex0, clamp);
    name.texture = TextureHash(memory, tex0, texa, region);
    name.bits = psm | Bits(tex0, 26, 4) << 6 | Bits(tex0, 30, 4) << 10;
    if (!f.pal && f.colour != 32)
        name.bits |= Bits(texa, 0, 8) << 15 | Bits(texa, 15, 1) << 23 | Bits(texa, 32, 8) << 24;
    name.region_w = region.HasX() ? region.max_x - region.min_x : 0;
    name.region_h = region.HasY() ? region.max_y - region.min_y : 0;
    if (f.pal) {
        // The CLUT as PCSX2's Read32 gives it: a 4-bit texture's 16 entries
        // from CSA's, an 8-bit one's 256.
        const u32 csa = Bits(tex0, 56, 5);
        const u32* entries = f.pal == 16 ? clut + (csa * 16) % 256 : clut;
        name.clut = XXH3_64bits(entries, std::size_t(f.pal) * 4);
    }
    return name;
}

namespace {

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ overrides

struct Overrides {
    std::mutex lock;
    std::unordered_map<Name, std::shared_ptr<const Image>, NameHash> images;
    std::unordered_map<const void*, std::shared_ptr<const Image>> decoded;     // by the PNG's address
    u64 next_id = 1ull << 40;           // past any pack file's id
};
Overrides& TheOverrides() {
    static Overrides overrides;
    return overrides;
}
// Wanted's test: a bit per PSM | TW << 6 | TH << 10 an override has.
std::atomic<u64> g_override_bits[(1u << 14) / 64];
std::atomic<bool> g_any_override{false};

void IndexOverrides(Overrides& o) {
    for (auto& word : g_override_bits) word = 0;
    for (const auto& [name, image] : o.images) {
        const u32 bits = name.bits & 0x3FFFu;
        g_override_bits[bits / 64] |= 1ull << (bits % 64);
    }
    g_any_override = !o.images.empty();
    ++g_generation;
}

}  // namespace

bool SetOverride(const std::string& text, const std::uint8_t* png, std::size_t bytes) {
    Name name;
    if (!ParseName(text, &name)) return false;
    Overrides& o = TheOverrides();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(o.lock);
    if (!png) {
        if (o.images.erase(name)) IndexOverrides(o);
        return true;
    }
    std::shared_ptr<const Image>& image = o.decoded[png];
    if (!image) {
        std::shared_ptr<Image> loaded = LoadPng(std::vector<u8>(png, png + bytes));
        if (!loaded) {
            o.decoded.erase(png);
            return false;
        }
        loaded->id = o.next_id++;
        image = loaded;
    }
    auto found = o.images.find(name);
    if (found != o.images.end() && found->second == image) return true;
    o.images[name] = image;
    IndexOverrides(o);
    return true;
}

std::shared_ptr<const Image> MakeImage(std::vector<u32> rgba, u32 width, u32 height) {
    if (!width || !height || rgba.size() != std::size_t(width) * height) return nullptr;
    std::shared_ptr<Image> image = Rgba({std::move(rgba)}, width, height);
    Overrides& o = TheOverrides();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(o.lock);
    image->id = o.next_id++;
    return image;
}

bool SetOverride(const std::string& text, std::shared_ptr<const Image> image) {
    Name name;
    if (!ParseName(text, &name)) return false;
    Overrides& o = TheOverrides();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(o.lock);
    auto found = o.images.find(name);
    if (!image) {
        if (found != o.images.end()) {
            o.images.erase(found);
            IndexOverrides(o);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (found != o.images.end() && found->second == image) return true;
    o.images[name] = std::move(image);
    IndexOverrides(o);
    return true;
}

void ClearOverrides() {
    Overrides& o = TheOverrides();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(o.lock);
    if (o.images.empty()) return;
    o.images.clear();
    IndexOverrides(o);
}

bool Active() { return g_any_override || (g_count != 0 && g_enabled); }

bool Wanted(u32 bits) {
    if (g_count != 0 && g_enabled) return true;
    if (!g_any_override) return false;
    bits &= 0x3FFFu;
    return (g_override_bits[bits / 64] >> (bits % 64)) & 1;
}

std::shared_ptr<const Image> Find(const Name& name, bool* pending) {
    *pending = false;
    if (g_any_override) {
        Overrides& o = TheOverrides();
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(o.lock);
        auto found = o.images.find(name);
        if (found != o.images.end()) return found->second;
    }
    if (g_count == 0 || !g_enabled) return nullptr;
    Pack& pack = ThePack();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(pack.lock);
    auto kept = pack.kept.find(name);
    if (kept != pack.kept.end()) {
        pack.lru.splice(pack.lru.begin(), pack.lru, kept->second.lru);
        return kept->second.image;
    }
    if (pack.failed.count(name) || !pack.files.count(name)) return nullptr;
    *pending = true;
    if (pack.queued.insert(name).second) {
        pack.queue.push_back(name);
        pack.wake.notify_one();
    }
    return nullptr;
}

}  // namespace texture_pack
}  // namespace ps2host

```

`host/src/threads.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * EE threads, semaphores and interrupts, as the EE kernel schedules them.
 *
 * Each guest thread is a host fiber with its own register context and native
 * stack; translated code takes its context as an argument, so it runs unchanged
 * on any of them. Scheduling follows the kernel: the ready thread with the best
 * (lowest) priority runs, first-come among equals, and keeps running until it
 * blocks (WaitSema on zero, SleepThread), yields (RotateThreadReadyQueue), exits,
 * or makes a better thread ready - there is no time slicing.
 *
 * Interrupts run the handlers the game registered, in interrupt context, at a
 * safe point: the running thread's next loop head (lifted::loop_head_hook, which
 * a spent budget reaches - the host spends it to get control there), or between
 * threads. Two sources:
 *   - DMA completion (PostDmac), posted by the transfer and delivered after the
 *     store that started it, since code goes on to set up for its interrupt;
 *   - the vertical blank, start and end, 60 times a second in real time, as the
 *     display raises it whatever the processor is doing - code busy-waiting on
 *     work a vblank handler does depends on it. When every thread waits, frames
 *     are delivered at once instead, so idle time costs nothing. Runs with an
 *     explicit --budget have no real-time vblank, so they are deterministic.
 * If no thread becomes ready even after many frames, the program is deadlocked
 * here, and the run stops with each thread's state in the report.
 *
 * A fault inside a fiber cannot unwind across fibers, so it is caught there and
 * rethrown by the scheduler, on the host's own stack.
 */

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <timeapi.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "synchronization.lib")

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <mutex>
#include <cstdio>
#include <exception>
#include <thread>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "ps2host/host.h"
#include "ps2host/timeline.h"
#include "ps2host/iop_vm.h"
#include "ps2host/memory.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"
#include "ps2host/profile.h"

namespace ps2host {

namespace {

enum class State { Dormant, Ready, Running, Waiting, Sleeping };

const char* StateName(State s) {
    switch (s) {
        case State::Dormant: return "dormant";
        case State::Ready: return "ready";
        case State::Running: return "running";
        case State::Waiting: return "waiting on a semaphore";
        case State::Sleeping: return "sleeping";
    }
    return "?";
}

struct Thread {
    u32 id = 0;
    u32 entry = 0, stack = 0, stack_size = 0, gp = 0;
    s32 priority = 0;
    s32 initial_priority = 0;       // CreateThread's, for ReferThreadStatus
    State state = State::Dormant;
    u64 queued = 0;                 // order among ready threads of equal priority
    u32 waiting_on = 0;             // the semaphore, while Waiting
    s32 wakeups = 0;                // WakeupThread calls not yet consumed by a sleep
    bool suspended = false;         // SuspendThread: not run, whatever its state, until resumed
    u64 runs = 0;                   // times the scheduler switched to it, for the report
    lifted::Context context = NewContext();
    std::vector<u32> calls;         // the guest call stack, for the report
    LPVOID fiber = nullptr;         // the fiber it runs on now (a coroutine's, while one runs)
    // Guest coroutines (run.h): the thread's own fiber while one of them runs,
    // which runs, and the thread's own call stack meanwhile.
    LPVOID home = nullptr;
    Coroutine* coroutine = nullptr;
    std::vector<u32> home_calls;
};

}  // namespace

struct Coroutine {
    LPVOID fiber = nullptr;
    std::function<void()> body;
    std::vector<u32> calls;         // its guest call stack, while it is not running
    bool finished = false;
};

namespace {

struct Semaphore {
    s32 count = 0, max = 0;
};

struct Handler {
    u32 cause, function, argument;      // cause: the INTC cause, or the DMA channel
};

// INTC causes the frame delivers: vertical blank start and end.
constexpr u32 kVblankStart = 2, kVblankEnd = 3;
// Frames that may pass with every thread waiting before the run is called stuck.
constexpr u64 kIdleFrames = 600;

struct Scheduler {
    std::map<u32, std::unique_ptr<Thread>> threads;
    u32 next_thread = 1;
    Thread* current = nullptr;
    LPVOID host_fiber = nullptr;
    u64 counter = 0;
    std::exception_ptr stop;
    std::map<u32, Semaphore> semaphores;
    u32 next_semaphore = 1;
    std::map<u32, Handler> handlers;        // INTC handlers, by id
    std::map<u32, Handler> dmac_handlers;   // DMA-completion handlers, by id
    u32 next_handler = 1;
    u32 intc_mask = 0;
    u32 dmac_mask = 0;
    s64 loop_budget = 0;
    u64 frames = 0;
    bool in_interrupt = false;
    lifted::Context interrupt_context = NewContext();
    u32 pending_dmac = 0;                   // channels whose interrupt waits
    u32 dmac_missed = 0;                    // channels that ended while their interrupt was off
    bool realtime = false;                  // a vblank timer runs (unlimited budget)
    // --virtual-time: the scheduler keeps the clock. A thread runs a slice of
    // loop iterations at a time; each slice is a fixed span of time.
    bool virtual_time = false;
    u64 next_vblank_ns = 0;
    std::atomic<bool> vblank_due{false};    // set by the timer, taken by LoopHead
    std::atomic<u32> vblank_owed{0};        // real time: more that came while one was due (TakeVblank)
    std::atomic<bool> timer_due{false};     // an EE timer's interrupt time has come
    std::atomic<lifted::Context*> running{nullptr};     // the thread on the processor
    bool delivery_requested = false;        // the current thread's budget was zeroed
    s64 saved_budget = 0;                   // ...and this is what it was
    std::vector<u32> interrupt_calls;
    // SetAlarm: a callback after a number of horizontal blanks (15,734 a
    // second, NTSC), run in interrupt context when the host clock passes it.
    // The timer thread wakes for the next one, as for a timer interrupt.
    struct Alarm { u32 callback, common, time; u64 due_ns; };
    std::map<s32, Alarm> alarms;
    s32 next_alarm = 1;
    std::mutex alarms_lock;                 // the timer thread reads the next due time
};

Scheduler& S() {
    static Scheduler scheduler;
    return scheduler;
}

void MakeReady(Thread& t) {
    t.state = State::Ready;
    t.queued = ++S().counter;
}

Thread* Find(u32 id) {
    auto found = S().threads.find(id);
    return found == S().threads.end() ? nullptr : found->second.get();
}

// Give the processor back to the scheduler; returns when this thread runs again.
void GiveWay() {
    Scheduler& s = S();
    if (s.in_interrupt || !s.current) return;     // handlers never block
    SwitchToFiber(s.host_fiber);
}

// Called after a thread became ready: run it now if it is better than this one.
void Preempt(Thread& woken) {
    Scheduler& s = S();
    if (s.in_interrupt || !s.current || woken.priority >= s.current->priority) return;
    MakeReady(*s.current);
    GiveWay();
}

void CALLBACK ThreadMain(void* parameter) {
    Thread& t = *static_cast<Thread*>(parameter);
    try {
        Dispatch(t.context, t.entry);
        t.state = State::Dormant;               // returning from its entry ends a thread
    } catch (...) {
        S().stop = std::current_exception();
    }
    SwitchToFiber(S().host_fiber);              // never resumed
}

Thread* PickReady() {
    Thread* best = nullptr;
    for (auto& [id, t] : S().threads) {
        if (t->state != State::Ready || t->suspended) continue;
        if (!best || t->priority < best->priority ||
            (t->priority == best->priority && t->queued < best->queued))
            best = t.get();
    }
    return best;
}

// Run the handlers registered for `cause` among `handlers`, in interrupt context.
bool RunHandlers(const std::map<u32, Handler>& handlers, u32 cause) {
    Scheduler& s = S();
    bool ran = false;
    for (const auto& [id, h] : handlers) {
        if (h.cause != cause) continue;
        lifted::Context& c = s.interrupt_context;
        c.r[4] = cause;
        c.r[5] = h.argument;
        c.r[29] = 0x01F80000u;                  // an interrupt stack clear of the threads'
        c.r[31] = 0;
        // The kernel leaves $gp as the interrupted code had it: the program's.
        if (s.current) c.r[28] = s.current->context.r[28];
        else if (!s.threads.empty()) c.r[28] = s.threads.begin()->second->context.r[28];
        c.budget = StopRequested() ? -1 : s.loop_budget;     // a handler stops too
        const bool nested = s.in_interrupt;
        s.in_interrupt = true;
        Dispatch(c, h.function);
        s.in_interrupt = nested;
        ran = true;
    }
    return ran;
}

// Alarms whose time has come: each callback(id, time, common), in interrupt
// context, once.
u64 NowNs() { return ClockNs(); }

bool DeliverAlarms() {
    Scheduler& s = S();
    bool ran = false;
    for (;;) {
        s32 id = 0;
        Scheduler::Alarm alarm{};
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(s.alarms_lock);
            const u64 now = NowNs();
            auto it = s.alarms.begin();
            while (it != s.alarms.end() && it->second.due_ns > now) ++it;
            if (it == s.alarms.end()) break;
            id = it->first;
            alarm = it->second;
            s.alarms.erase(it);
        }
        lifted::Context& c = s.interrupt_context;
        c.r[4] = u64(s64(id));
        c.r[5] = alarm.time;
        c.r[6] = alarm.common;
        c.r[29] = 0x01F80000u;
        c.r[31] = 0;
        if (s.current) c.r[28] = s.current->context.r[28];
        else if (!s.threads.empty()) c.r[28] = s.threads.begin()->second->context.r[28];
        c.budget = StopRequested() ? -1 : s.loop_budget;
        const bool nested = s.in_interrupt;
        s.in_interrupt = true;
        Dispatch(c, alarm.callback);
        s.in_interrupt = nested;
        ran = true;
    }
    return ran;
}

// Host time to the next alarm, < 0 when none is set.
s64 NanosToNextAlarm() {
    Scheduler& s = S();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hold(s.alarms_lock);
    if (s.alarms.empty()) return -1;
    u64 next = ~u64(0);
    for (const auto& [id, a] : s.alarms) next = std::min(next, a.due_ns);
    const u64 now = NowNs();
    return next > now ? s64(next - now) : 0;
}

void StartRealTime();
u64 g_real_time_from = 0;               // SetRealTimeFrom

// INTC_STAT (0x1000F000): the causes raised since the game last cleared them
// (writing 1 clears). libgraph's sceGsSyncV clears VBLANK_START and polls for
// it - read as plain memory, the 1 it wrote, it never waited: Mister Mosquito's
// main loop ran five times a frame, its clocks with it.
std::atomic<u32> g_intc_stat{0};

void SleepUntil(std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point when);
bool g_paced = false;                   // SetPaced

// One frame's interrupts, delivered to the handlers registered for them.
bool DeliverFrame() {
    Scheduler& s = S();
    ++s.frames;
    if (g_paced && s.virtual_time) {
        // No sooner than the display's next blank (NTSC's 59.94 a second): the
        // run stays exact, only slowed to where it can be played.
        static auto next = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        next += std::chrono::nanoseconds(16683350);
        const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        if (next < now - std::chrono::milliseconds(100)) next = now;   // fell behind: no catching up
        SleepUntil(next);
    }
    g_intc_stat.fetch_or((1u << kVblankStart) | (1u << kVblankEnd), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (s.virtual_time && g_real_time_from && s.frames >= g_real_time_from) StartRealTime();
    {
        Timed timed(Section::Iop);
        iop::Run();                         // the IOP's timers and sound interrupts
    }
    FrameDone(s.frames);
    bool ran = false;
    for (u32 cause : {kVblankStart, kVblankEnd})
        if (s.intc_mask & (1u << cause)) ran |= RunHandlers(s.handlers, cause);
    ran |= DeliverAlarms();
    return ran;
}

void DeliverPendingDmac() {
    Scheduler& s = S();
    while (s.pending_dmac) {
        u32 channel = 0;
        while (!((s.pending_dmac >> channel) & 1)) ++channel;
        s.pending_dmac &= s.pending_dmac - 1;
        RaiseDmac(channel);
    }
}

void SpendBudget(lifted::Context& c) {
    *static_cast<volatile u32*>(&c.attention) = 1;   // read at its next loop head (lifted::Tick)
    reinterpret_cast<std::atomic<s64>*>(&c.budget)->store(0);
}

std::atomic<u64> g_lost_vblanks{0};
std::atomic<u64> g_idle_ns{0};      // real time: the EE asleep, every thread waiting (--frame-times)

// The EE's wait, on the profiler's timeline (timeline.h).
void IdleSpan(std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point from) {
    if (!timeline::On()) return;
    const u64 from_ns = u64(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(from.time_since_epoch()).count());
    timeline::Span("idle", from_ns, timeline::Now());
}
bool g_vif1_worker_wanted = true;   // --vif1-sync turns it off

// A vertical blank that comes while the last is still undelivered is owed,
// not dropped: the game counts blanks for its time (a movie's pictures
// among it) while the sound keeps the real clock, so each one lost put the
// picture further behind. Up to this many wait; past them the EE is that far
// behind, and they are lost (--frame-times counts them).
constexpr u32 kOwedVblanks = 3;
```
