`runtime/include/ps2rt/vu_math.h`:

```h
/*
 * The VU's arithmetic model (engine/ps2decomp/vu0.py documents it, and where it
 * departs from the hardware): clean operands, results narrowed to single
 * precision and saturated. Inline, so that the macro-mode COP2 (vu0.cpp) and
 * the micro-mode interpreter (engine/host/src/vu.cpp) compute each lane
 * without a call per step.
 */

#ifndef PS2RT_VU_MATH_H
#define PS2RT_VU_MATH_H

#include <cstring>

#include "ps2rt/types.h"

/* The model's steps, inlined into the interpreter and compiled microprograms. */
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#define PS2RT_VU_INLINE __forceinline
#else
#define PS2RT_VU_INLINE inline __attribute__((always_inline))
#endif

#if defined(__SSE2__) || defined(_M_X64) || (defined(_M_IX86_FP) && _M_IX86_FP >= 2)
#include <emmintrin.h>
#define PS2RT_VU_SSE 1
#else
#define PS2RT_VU_SSE 0
#endif
/* SSE4.1 (pminud): every x86-64 processor a Vulkan port runs on has it; MSVC
   takes its intrinsics without /arch, and other compilers say so with
   __SSE4_1__. */
#if PS2RT_VU_SSE && (defined(__SSE4_1__) || defined(_M_X64))
#include <smmintrin.h>
#define PS2RT_VU_SSE41 1
#else
#define PS2RT_VU_SSE41 0
#endif



namespace lifted {

inline constexpr u32 kSign = 0x80000000u;
inline constexpr u32 kMax = 0x7F7FFFFFu;
inline constexpr u32 kOne = 0x3F800000u;
inline constexpr int kRegR = 20, kRegI = 21, kRegQ = 22;

PS2RT_VU_INLINE u32 Clean(u32 bits) {
    const u32 exponent = bits & 0x7F800000u;
    if (exponent == 0) return bits & kSign;
    if (exponent == 0x7F800000u) return (bits & kSign) | kMax;
    return bits;
}

PS2RT_VU_INLINE double Value(u32 bits) {
    const u32 cleaned = Clean(bits);
    float value;
    std::memcpy(&value, &cleaned, sizeof value);
    return value;
}

PS2RT_VU_INLINE u32 Result(double number) {
    if (number != number) return kMax;
    const float narrowed = static_cast<float>(number);
    u32 bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &narrowed, sizeof bits);
    if ((bits & 0x7F800000u) == 0x7F800000u) return (bits & kSign) | kMax;
    if ((bits & 0x7F800000u) == 0) return bits & kSign;
    return bits;
}

enum Op { kAdd, kSub, kMul, kMadd, kMsub, kMax_, kMini };

/* One operation, chosen at compile time: RunFmac picks it once an
   instruction rather than once a lane. */
/* MAX's and MINI's key: the bits as a sign-and-magnitude integer. They
   compare so and hand back an operand as it is - no Clean: a denormal stays
   (programs build integer constants with LOI and MAXI). */
PS2RT_VU_INLINE s32 Order(u32 bits) {
    const s32 magnitude = s32(bits & 0x7FFFFFFFu);
    return (bits & kSign) ? -magnitude : magnitude;
}

template <int Op>
inline u32 BinaryOf(u32 a, u32 b, u32 acc) {
    if constexpr (Op == kMax_) return Order(a) < Order(b) ? b : a;
    else if constexpr (Op == kMini) return Order(b) < Order(a) ? b : a;
    const double x = Value(a), y = Value(b);
    if constexpr (Op == kAdd) return Result(x + y);
    else if constexpr (Op == kSub) return Result(x - y);
    else if constexpr (Op == kMul) return Result(x * y);
    else if constexpr (Op == kMadd) return Result(Value(acc) + Value(Result(x * y)));
    else return Result(Value(acc) - Value(Result(x * y)));
}

inline u32 Binary(int op, u32 a, u32 b, u32 acc) {
    switch (op) {
        case kAdd: return BinaryOf<kAdd>(a, b, acc);
        case kSub: return BinaryOf<kSub>(a, b, acc);
        case kMul: return BinaryOf<kMul>(a, b, acc);
        case kMadd: return BinaryOf<kMadd>(a, b, acc);
        case kMsub: return BinaryOf<kMsub>(a, b, acc);
        case kMax_: return BinaryOf<kMax_>(a, b, acc);
        case kMini: return BinaryOf<kMini>(a, b, acc);
    }
    return 0;
}

#if PS2RT_VU_SSE
/*
 * All four lanes at once in single precision. The model computes in double
 * and narrows (BinaryOf); that is the same number: the operands are clean -
 * no infinities, NaNs or denormals - and double's 53 bits are at least
 * 2 x 24 + 2, so rounding an add, a subtract or a multiply first to double
 * and then to single gives the single-precision result rounded once (and an
 * overflow the infinity Result saturates). Result is Clean's transform of
 * the bits. RunFmacScalar is the model; VuLanesAreTheModel (host tests)
 * compares the two.
 */
PS2RT_VU_INLINE __m128i CleanLanes(__m128i v) {
#if PS2RT_VU_SSE41
    // The magnitude clamped to the largest finite (an exponent of 255 is
    // above it, whatever the mantissa), zero below the smallest normal, and
    // the sign put back: Clean's three cases in six operations.
    const __m128i magnitude = _mm_and_si128(v, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7FFFFFFF));
    const __m128i sign = _mm_xor_si128(v, magnitude);
    const __m128i clamped = _mm_min_epu32(magnitude, _mm_set1_epi32(int(kMax)));
    const __m128i denormal = _mm_cmpgt_epi32(_mm_set1_epi32(0x00800000), magnitude);
    return _mm_or_si128(sign, _mm_andnot_si128(denormal, clamped));
#else
    const __m128i exponent = _mm_and_si128(v, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7F800000));
    const __m128i sign = _mm_and_si128(v, _mm_set1_epi32(int(kSign)));
    const __m128i zero = _mm_cmpeq_epi32(exponent, _mm_setzero_si128());
    const __m128i huge = _mm_cmpeq_epi32(exponent, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7F800000));
    const __m128i saturated = _mm_or_si128(sign, _mm_set1_epi32(int(kMax)));
    v = _mm_or_si128(_mm_andnot_si128(zero, v), _mm_and_si128(zero, sign));
    return _mm_or_si128(_mm_andnot_si128(huge, v), _mm_and_si128(huge, saturated));
#endif
}

/* Clean for code that runs with the SSE control word's DAZ and FTZ on (a VU
   run: VuRounding in vu.cpp): the processor takes a denormal operand as a
   zero of its sign and gives a zero of its sign for a result that would be
   one - Clean's two lower cases - so of Clean only the exponent of 255 is
   left to do: the magnitude clamped to the largest finite, the sign kept.
   For values going into arithmetic, or coming out of it; a denormal stays
   as it was. */
PS2RT_VU_INLINE __m128i ClampLanes(__m128i v) {
#if PS2RT_VU_SSE41
    const __m128i magnitude = _mm_and_si128(v, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7FFFFFFF));
    const __m128i sign = _mm_xor_si128(v, magnitude);
    return _mm_or_si128(sign, _mm_min_epu32(magnitude, _mm_set1_epi32(int(kMax))));
#else
    return CleanLanes(v);
#endif
}

inline __m128 AsFloats(__m128i v) { return _mm_castsi128_ps(v); }
inline __m128i AsBits(__m128 v) { return _mm_castps_si128(v); }

/* `Known` says which operands the caller knows to be clean already (bit 0
   a, bit 1 b, bit 2 acc) in the lanes it keeps: Clean would leave them as
   they are. Compiled VU code knows it of fields an FMAC wrote earlier in
   the same block (vurecomp.py, `clean`). */
PS2RT_VU_INLINE __m128i OrderLanes(__m128i v) {
    const __m128i negative = _mm_srai_epi32(v, 31);
    const __m128i magnitude = _mm_and_si128(v, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7FFFFFFF));
    return _mm_sub_epi32(_mm_xor_si128(magnitude, negative), negative);
}

/* `Daz`: the caller runs with DAZ and FTZ on (compiled VU code), so
   ClampLanes does what CleanLanes would. */
template <int Op, int Known = 0, bool Daz = false>
PS2RT_VU_INLINE __m128i LanesSse(__m128i a, __m128i b, __m128i acc) {
    if constexpr (Op == kMax_ || Op == kMini) {
        // MAX takes b where a < b, MINI where b < a; otherwise a - by Order,
        // the operands as they are.
        const __m128i take_b = Op == kMax_ ? _mm_cmplt_epi32(OrderLanes(a), OrderLanes(b))
                                           : _mm_cmplt_epi32(OrderLanes(b), OrderLanes(a));
        return _mm_or_si128(_mm_andnot_si128(take_b, a), _mm_and_si128(take_b, b));
    }
    const auto clean = [](__m128i v) { return Daz ? ClampLanes(v) : CleanLanes(v); };
    if constexpr ((Known & 1) == 0) a = clean(a);
    if constexpr ((Known & 2) == 0) b = clean(b);
    if constexpr (Op == kAdd) return clean(AsBits(_mm_add_ps(AsFloats(a), AsFloats(b))));
    else if constexpr (Op == kSub) return clean(AsBits(_mm_sub_ps(AsFloats(a), AsFloats(b))));
    else if constexpr (Op == kMul) return clean(AsBits(_mm_mul_ps(AsFloats(a), AsFloats(b))));
    else if constexpr (Op == kMadd || Op == kMsub) {
        const __m128i product = clean(AsBits(_mm_mul_ps(AsFloats(a), AsFloats(b))));
        const __m128 total = AsFloats((Known & 4) != 0 ? acc : clean(acc));
        return clean(AsBits(Op == kMadd ? _mm_add_ps(total, AsFloats(product))
                                        : _mm_sub_ps(total, AsFloats(product))));
    }
}
#endif

inline u32 FloatToInt(double number) {
    if (number >= 2147483647.0) return 0x7FFFFFFFu;
    if (number <= -2147483648.0) return 0x80000000u;
    return (u32)(s32)number;
}

}  // namespace lifted

#endif  /* PS2RT_VU_MATH_H */

```

`runtime/src/eefpu.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The Emotion Engine's single-precision FPU, as the derived code relies on it.
 *
 * The derived functions in src/generated/ do float arithmetic through these
 * helpers rather than with `float` operators, because the EE's FPU is not
 * IEEE-754 and a port that uses the host's arithmetic directly will drift:
 *
 *  - There are no infinities or NaNs. A result too large to represent saturates
 *    to the largest finite magnitude (bit pattern 0x7F7FFFFF), and a NaN - which
 *    can only enter as a bit pattern loaded from memory - becomes zero.
 *  - Division by zero does not trap and yields zero.
 *
 * These definitions are the reference: they reproduce the R5900 interpreter in
 * tools/ps2decomp/emu.py exactly, and the compiled-code check (tools/ps2decomp/cppcheck.py)
 * runs every derived function against that interpreter through them. Each
 * operation is computed in double precision and then rounded once to single,
 * which gives the correctly rounded single-precision result for +, -, *, / and
 * square root (double has more than twice the precision of float, so the double
 * rounding is innocuous).
 *
 *  - Results are rounded toward zero, not to nearest, and denormal operands and
 *    results are flushed to zero - the EE's FPU, as PCSX2 runs it by default
 *    ("Chop/Zero"). The VUs round so too (ps2host's Vu::Run): Burnout 3 leans on
 *    it there. PS2RT_EE_ROUND_NEAREST=1 rounds to nearest and keeps denormals,
 *    as tools/ps2decomp/emu.py's interpreter does (what cppcheck compares
 *    against).
 */

#include "ps2rt/generated.h"

#include <cfloat>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

namespace generated {

namespace {

const double kFloatMax = 3.4028234663852886e38;   // bit pattern 0x7F7FFFFF

const bool kNearest = std::getenv("PS2RT_EE_ROUND_NEAREST") != nullptr;

float FromBits(u32 bits) {
    if (!kNearest && (bits & 0x7F800000u) == 0) bits &= 0x80000000u;     // a denormal operand is zero
    float value;
    std::memcpy(&value, &bits, sizeof value);
    return value;
}

u32 ToBits(double value) { return FloatNarrow(value); }

}  // namespace

u32 FloatNarrow(double value) {
    if (value != value) {
        value = 0.0;
    } else if (value > kFloatMax) {
        value = kFloatMax;
    } else if (value < -kFloatMax) {
        value = -kFloatMax;
    }
    float narrowed = static_cast<float>(value);
    if (!kNearest) {
        // Toward zero: a value rounded away from it steps back one.
        if (std::fabs(double(narrowed)) > std::fabs(value)) narrowed = std::nextafter(narrowed, 0.0f);
        if (std::fabs(narrowed) < FLT_MIN) narrowed = std::copysign(0.0f, narrowed);
    }
    u32 bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &narrowed, sizeof bits);
    return bits;
}

u32 FloatAdd(u32 a, u32 b) { return ToBits(double(FromBits(a)) + double(FromBits(b))); }
u32 FloatSub(u32 a, u32 b) { return ToBits(double(FromBits(a)) - double(FromBits(b))); }
u32 FloatMul(u32 a, u32 b) { return ToBits(double(FromBits(a)) * double(FromBits(b))); }

u32 FloatMulAdd(u32 acc, u32 a, u32 b) {
    return ToBits(double(FromBits(acc)) + double(FromBits(a)) * double(FromBits(b)));
}

u32 FloatMulSub(u32 acc, u32 a, u32 b) {
    return ToBits(double(FromBits(acc)) - double(FromBits(a)) * double(FromBits(b)));
}

u32 FloatDiv(u32 a, u32 b) {
    const double divisor = FromBits(b);
    if (divisor == 0.0) {
        return ToBits(0.0);
    }
    return ToBits(double(FromBits(a)) / divisor);
}

/* Written to match how the interpreter picks between equal or unordered operands:
   the first operand wins unless the second is strictly smaller (larger). */
u32 FloatMin(u32 a, u32 b) {
    const double x = FromBits(a), y = FromBits(b);
    return ToBits(y < x ? y : x);
}

u32 FloatMax(u32 a, u32 b) {
    const double x = FromBits(a), y = FromBits(b);
    return ToBits(y > x ? y : x);
}

u32 FloatNeg(u32 a) { return ToBits(-double(FromBits(a))); }
u32 FloatAbs(u32 a) { return ToBits(std::fabs(double(FromBits(a)))); }

/* The square root of a negative number - and of -0.0 - is zero here. */
u32 FloatSqrt(u32 a) {
    const double x = FromBits(a);
    return ToBits(x > 0.0 ? std::sqrt(x) : 0.0);
}

/* `mov.s` as the interpreter runs it: the value passes through the FPU, so a NaN
   pattern comes out as zero rather than being copied bit for bit. */
u32 FloatMove(u32 a) { return ToBits(FromBits(a)); }

u32 FloatFromInt(u32 bits_as_int) {
    return ToBits(static_cast<double>(static_cast<s32>(bits_as_int)));
}

/* Truncates toward zero below 2**31 in magnitude (an exponent up to 2**30's)
   and saturates beyond, by the sign alone: the EE's cvt.w.s (emu.py's
   float_to_word). */
u32 IntFromFloat(u32 float_bits) {
    if ((float_bits & 0x7F800000u) <= 0x4E800000u)
        return static_cast<u32>(static_cast<s32>(FromBits(float_bits)));
    return (float_bits & 0x80000000u) ? 0x80000000u : 0x7FFFFFFFu;
}

float FloatValue(u32 bits) { return FromBits(bits); }

u32 FloatBits(float value) {
    u32 bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof bits);
    return bits;
}

}  // namespace generated

```

`runtime/src/eeint.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * Integer operations whose EE result C++ leaves undefined, for derived code.
 * They follow engine/ps2decomp/emu.py, divide(), which documents the rules.
 */

#include "ps2rt/generated.h"

namespace generated {

namespace {

u64 Sx32(s64 value) { return (u64)(s64)(s32)(u32)(u64)value; }

}  // namespace

u64 DivQuot(u64 a, u64 b) {
    const s64 x = (s32)(u32)a, y = (s32)(u32)b;
    if (y == 0) return x < 0 ? 1 : ~0ull;
    return Sx32(x / y);
}

u64 DivRem(u64 a, u64 b) {
    const s64 x = (s32)(u32)a, y = (s32)(u32)b;
    if (y == 0) return (u64)x;
    return Sx32(x - y * (x / y));
}

u64 DivQuotU(u64 a, u64 b) {
    const u32 x = (u32)a, y = (u32)b;
    if (y == 0) return ~0ull;
    return Sx32((s64)(x / y));
}

u64 DivRemU(u64 a, u64 b) {
    const u32 x = (u32)a, y = (u32)b;
    if (y == 0) return Sx32((s64)x);
    return Sx32((s64)(x % y));
}

}  // namespace generated

```

`runtime/src/lifted_support.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * The lifted code's arithmetic helpers, written to match engine/ps2decomp/emu.py.
 */

#include "ps2rt/lifted.h"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#if defined(__SSE2__) || defined(_M_X64)
#include <emmintrin.h>
#endif

namespace lifted {

void (*loop_head_hook)(Context& c, u32 address) = nullptr;

void BudgetSpent(Context& c, u32 address) {
    if (loop_head_hook) loop_head_hook(c, address);
    else throw Abort{address, 2};
}

void Multiply(u64& hi, u64& lo, u64 a, u64 b, bool is_signed, bool accumulate) {
    const u64 product = is_signed
        ? (u64)((s64)(s32)(u32)a * (s64)(s32)(u32)b)
        : (u64)(u32)a * (u64)(u32)b;
    u64 total = product;
    if (accumulate) {
        total += ((hi & 0xFFFFFFFFull) << 32) | (lo & 0xFFFFFFFFull);
    }
    lo = Sx32(total);
    hi = Sx32(total >> 32);
}

/* As the EE divides (emu.divide): a zero divisor gives LO = 1 for a negative
   signed dividend, else -1, and the dividend in HI. The signed case is computed in
   64 bits, where INT_MIN / -1 is defined. */
void Divide(u64& hi, u64& lo, u64 a, u64 b, bool is_signed) {
    if (is_signed) {
        const s64 x = (s32)(u32)a, y = (s32)(u32)b;
        if (y == 0) {
            lo = x < 0 ? 1 : ~0ull;
            hi = (u64)x;
            return;
        }
        const s64 q = x / y;
        lo = Sx32((u64)q);
        hi = Sx32((u64)(x - y * q));
    } else {
        const u32 x = (u32)a, y = (u32)b;
        if (y == 0) {
            lo = ~0ull;
            hi = Sx32(x);
            return;
        }
        lo = Sx32(x / y);
        hi = Sx32(x % y);
    }
}

u32 FloatMulAdd(u32 acc, u32 a, u32 b, bool subtract) {
    // Operands as the FPU reads them (a denormal is zero), the result as every
    // FPU result is narrowed (eefpu.cpp).
    const auto operand = [](u32 bits) { return double(generated::FloatValue(generated::FloatMove(bits))); };
    const double x = operand(acc);
    const double product = operand(a) * operand(b);
    return generated::FloatNarrow(subtract ? x - product : x + product);
}

void AddBytes(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 alo, u64 ahi, u64 blo, u64 bhi, bool subtract) {
    u64 out[2] = {0, 0};
    const u64 a[2] = {alo, ahi}, b[2] = {blo, bhi};
    for (int half = 0; half < 2; ++half) {
        for (int lane = 0; lane < 8; ++lane) {
            const u32 x = (u32)(a[half] >> (lane * 8)) & 0xFF;
            const u32 y = (u32)(b[half] >> (lane * 8)) & 0xFF;
            const u32 z = (subtract ? x - y : x + y) & 0xFF;
            out[half] |= (u64)z << (lane * 8);
        }
    }
    lo = out[0];
    hi = out[1];
}

namespace {

u32 Lane32(int op, u32 a, u32 b) {
    switch (op) {
        case kPmaxw: return (s32)a >= (s32)b ? a : b;
        case kPminw: return (s32)a <= (s32)b ? a : b;
        case kPsubw: return a - b;
        case kPaddw: return a + b;
        case kPadduw: { const u64 sum = (u64)a + b; return sum > 0xFFFFFFFFull ? 0xFFFFFFFFu : (u32)sum; }
        case kPabsw: { const s64 x = (s32)b; const s64 m = x < 0 ? -x : x;
                       return m > 0x7FFFFFFF ? 0x7FFFFFFFu : (u32)m; }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Comparisons and halfword max/min, lane by lane at `width` bits. */
u64 NarrowLanes(int op, u64 a, u64 b, u32 width) {
    const u64 mask = width == 64 ? ~0ull : (1ull << width) - 1, sign = 1ull << (width - 1);
    u64 out = 0;
    for (u32 shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += width) {
        const u64 x = (a >> shift) & mask, y = (b >> shift) & mask;
        const s64 sx = (s64)(x ^ sign) - (s64)sign, sy = (s64)(y ^ sign) - (s64)sign;
        u64 lane = 0;
        switch (op) {
            case kPcgtb: case kPcgth: case kPcgtw: lane = sx > sy ? mask : 0; break;
            case kPceqb: case kPceqh: case kPceqw: lane = x == y ? mask : 0; break;
            case kPmaxh: lane = sx >= sy ? x : y; break;
            case kPminh: lane = sx <= sy ? x : y; break;
        }
        out |= lane << shift;
    }
    return out;
}

u64 LanesOf(int op, u64 a, u64 b) {
    u64 out = 0;
    switch (op) {
        case kPcgtb: case kPceqb: return NarrowLanes(op, a, b, 8);
        case kPcgth: case kPceqh: case kPmaxh: case kPminh: return NarrowLanes(op, a, b, 16);
        case kPcgtw: case kPceqw: return NarrowLanes(op, a, b, 32);
        default: break;
    }
    if (op == kPaddh) {
        for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += 16)
            out |= ((((a >> shift) & 0xFFFF) + ((b >> shift) & 0xFFFF)) & 0xFFFF) << shift;
        return out;
    }
    if (op == kPaddub) {
        for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += 8) {
            const u32 sum = (u32)((a >> shift) & 0xFF) + (u32)((b >> shift) & 0xFF);
            out |= (u64)(sum > 0xFF ? 0xFF : sum) << shift;
        }
        return out;
    }
    for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += 32) {
        out |= (u64)Lane32(op, (u32)(a >> shift), (u32)(b >> shift)) << shift;
    }
    return out;
}

}  // namespace

#if defined(__SSE2__) || defined(_M_X64)
/* The same lanes in SSE2 for the operations it has exactly (signed compares,
   halfword max and min, wrapping and unsigned-saturating adds); `done` false
   for the rest. LanesAreScalar (host tests) compares the two. */
bool LanesSse2(int op, u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 alo, u64 ahi, u64 blo, u64 bhi) {
    const __m128i a = _mm_set_epi64x(s64(ahi), s64(alo)), b = _mm_set_epi64x(s64(bhi), s64(blo));
    __m128i r;
    switch (op) {
        case kPcgtb: r = _mm_cmpgt_epi8(a, b); break;
        case kPcgth: r = _mm_cmpgt_epi16(a, b); break;
        case kPcgtw: r = _mm_cmpgt_epi32(a, b); break;
        case kPceqb: r = _mm_cmpeq_epi8(a, b); break;
        case kPceqh: r = _mm_cmpeq_epi16(a, b); break;
        case kPceqw: r = _mm_cmpeq_epi32(a, b); break;
        case kPmaxh: r = _mm_max_epi16(a, b); break;
        case kPminh: r = _mm_min_epi16(a, b); break;
        case kPaddh: r = _mm_add_epi16(a, b); break;
        case kPaddub: r = _mm_adds_epu8(a, b); break;
        case kPaddw: r = _mm_add_epi32(a, b); break;
        case kPsubw: r = _mm_sub_epi32(a, b); break;
        default: return false;
    }
    lo = u64(_mm_cvtsi128_si64(r));
    hi = u64(_mm_cvtsi128_si64(_mm_unpackhi_epi64(r, r)));
    return true;
}
#endif

void LanesScalar(int op, u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 alo, u64 ahi, u64 blo, u64 bhi) {
    lo = LanesOf(op, alo, blo);
    hi = LanesOf(op, ahi, bhi);
}

void Lanes(int op, u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 alo, u64 ahi, u64 blo, u64 bhi) {
#if defined(__SSE2__) || defined(_M_X64)
    if (LanesSse2(op, lo, hi, alo, ahi, blo, bhi)) return;
#endif
    LanesScalar(op, lo, hi, alo, ahi, blo, bhi);
}

void ShiftLanesScalar(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 blo, u64 bhi, u32 width, u32 kind, u32 amount) {
    const u64 mask = (1ull << width) - 1;
    amount &= width - 1;
    const u64 in[2] = {blo, bhi};
    u64 out[2] = {0, 0};
    for (int half = 0; half < 2; ++half) {
        for (u32 shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += width) {
            u64 lane = (in[half] >> shift) & mask;
            if (kind == 0) {
                lane = (lane << amount) & mask;
            } else if (kind == 1) {
                lane >>= amount;
            } else {
                const u64 sign = 1ull << (width - 1);
                const s64 value = (s64)(lane ^ sign) - (s64)sign;   /* sign-extend the lane */
                lane = (u64)(value >> amount) & mask;
            }
            out[half] |= lane << shift;
        }
    }
    lo = out[0];
    hi = out[1];
}

/* Halfword and word lanes in SSE2 (psllw/psrlw/psraw, and the d forms): the
   same shifts, eight or four lanes at once; a movie's decoder makes them by
   the million (Resident Evil Outbreak's Sofdec). */
void ShiftLanes(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 blo, u64 bhi, u32 width, u32 kind, u32 amount) {
#if defined(__SSE2__) || defined(_M_X64)
    if ((width == 16 || width == 32) && kind <= 2) {
        const __m128i x = _mm_set_epi64x(s64(bhi), s64(blo));
        const __m128i n = _mm_cvtsi32_si128(int(amount & (width - 1)));
        __m128i r;
        if (width == 16) r = kind == 0 ? _mm_sll_epi16(x, n) : kind == 1 ? _mm_srl_epi16(x, n) : _mm_sra_epi16(x, n);
        else r = kind == 0 ? _mm_sll_epi32(x, n) : kind == 1 ? _mm_srl_epi32(x, n) : _mm_sra_epi32(x, n);
        lo = u64(_mm_cvtsi128_si64(r));
        hi = u64(_mm_cvtsi128_si64(_mm_unpackhi_epi64(r, r)));
        return;
    }
#endif
    ShiftLanesScalar(lo, hi, blo, bhi, width, kind, amount);
}

void ShiftHalfwordsRight(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 blo, u64 bhi, u32 amount) {
    ShiftLanes(lo, hi, blo, bhi, 16, 1, amount);
}

void InterleaveScalar(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 a, u64 b, u32 width) {
    const u64 mask = (1ull << width) - 1;
    u64 out[2] = {0, 0};
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 64 / width; ++i) {
        const u32 even = 2 * i * width, odd = (2 * i + 1) * width;
        out[even / 64] |= ((b >> (i * width)) & mask) << (even % 64);
        out[odd / 64] |= ((a >> (i * width)) & mask) << (odd % 64);
    }
    lo = out[0];
    hi = out[1];
}

/* PEXTLB, PEXTLH, PEXTLW: SSE2's unpack does the same (b's lanes even). */
void Interleave(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 a, u64 b, u32 width) {
#if defined(__SSE2__) || defined(_M_X64)
    if (width == 8 || width == 16 || width == 32) {
        const __m128i x = _mm_cvtsi64_si128(s64(b)), y = _mm_cvtsi64_si128(s64(a));
        const __m128i r = width == 8 ? _mm_unpacklo_epi8(x, y) : width == 16 ? _mm_unpacklo_epi16(x, y)
                                                                             : _mm_unpacklo_epi32(x, y);
        lo = u64(_mm_cvtsi128_si64(r));
        hi = u64(_mm_cvtsi128_si64(_mm_unpackhi_epi64(r, r)));
        return;
    }
#endif
    InterleaveScalar(lo, hi, a, b, width);
}

void PackHalfwords(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 alo, u64 ahi, u64 blo, u64 bhi) {
    u64 low = 0, high = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        low |= ((blo >> (32 * i)) & 0xFFFF) << (16 * i);
        low |= ((bhi >> (32 * i)) & 0xFFFF) << (16 * (i + 2));
        high |= ((alo >> (32 * i)) & 0xFFFF) << (16 * i);
        high |= ((ahi >> (32 * i)) & 0xFFFF) << (16 * (i + 2));
    }
    lo = low;
    hi = high;
}

void PackBytes(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 alo, u64 ahi, u64 blo, u64 bhi) {
    u64 low = 0, high = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        low |= ((blo >> (16 * i)) & 0xFF) << (8 * i);
        low |= ((bhi >> (16 * i)) & 0xFF) << (8 * (i + 4));
        high |= ((alo >> (16 * i)) & 0xFF) << (8 * i);
        high |= ((ahi >> (16 * i)) & 0xFF) << (8 * (i + 4));
    }
    lo = low;
    hi = high;
}

void FunnelShift(u64& lo, u64& hi, u64 alo, u64 ahi, u64 blo, u64 bhi, u32 sa) {
    /* The 256-bit value ahi:alo:bhi:blo, shifted right by sa bits; the low 128. */
    const u64 words[4] = {blo, bhi, alo, ahi};
    sa &= 0xFF;
    const u32 skip = sa / 64, bits = sa % 64;
    u64 out[2];
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        const u64 low = skip + i < 4 ? words[skip + i] : 0;
        const u64 high = skip + i + 1 < 4 ? words[skip + i + 1] : 0;
        out[i] = bits ? (low >> bits) | (high << (64 - bits)) : low;
    }
    lo = out[0];
    hi = out[1];
}

u32 FloatRsqrt(u32 fs, u32 ft) {
    const double root = std::sqrt(std::fabs((double)generated::FloatValue(ft)));
    if (root == 0.0) return (fs & 0x80000000u) | 0x7F7FFFFFu;
    double value = (double)generated::FloatValue(fs) / root;
    const double kFloatMax = 3.4028234663852886e38;
    if (value != value) value = 0.0;
    else if (value > kFloatMax) value = kFloatMax;
    else if (value < -kFloatMax) value = -kFloatMax;
    const float narrowed = static_cast<float>(value);
    u32 bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &narrowed, sizeof bits);
    return bits;
}

u64 LoadWordLeft(u32 address, u64 old) {
    const u32 keep = (3 - (address & 3)) * 8;
    const u32 word = (u32)generated::ReadU32(address & ~3u);
    const u32 low = keep ? (u32)old & ((1u << keep) - 1) : 0;
    return Sx32((keep ? word << keep : word) | low);
}

u64 LoadWordRight(u32 address, u64 old) {
    const u32 drop = (address & 3) * 8;
    const u32 word = (u32)generated::ReadU32(address & ~3u);
    const u32 merged = (word >> drop) | ((u32)old & ~(0xFFFFFFFFu >> drop));
    return drop == 0 ? Sx32(merged) : (old & 0xFFFFFFFF00000000ull) | merged;
}

u64 LoadDoubleLeft(u32 address, u64 old) {
    const u32 keep = (7 - (address & 7)) * 8;
    const u64 value = generated::ReadU64(address & ~7u);
    return keep ? (value << keep) | (old & ((1ull << keep) - 1)) : value;
}

u64 LoadDoubleRight(u32 address, u64 old) {
    const u32 drop = (address & 7) * 8;
    const u64 value = generated::ReadU64(address & ~7u);
    return (value >> drop) | (old & ~(~0ull >> drop));
}

void StoreLeft(u32 address, u64 value, u32 size) {
    const u32 offset = address & (size - 1), count = offset + 1;
    const u64 data = (size == 8 ? value : value & 0xFFFFFFFFull) >> (8 * (size - count));
    for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        generated::Write8(address - offset + i, (u32)(data >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF);
}

void StoreRight(u32 address, u64 value, u32 size) {
    const u32 count = size - (address & (size - 1));
    for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        generated::Write8(address + i, (u32)(value >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF);
}

}  // namespace lifted

```

`runtime/src/vu0.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * VU0 macro mode for lifted code: a line-for-line mirror of engine/ps2decomp/vu0.py,
 * which documents the arithmetic model (and where it departs from the hardware).
 * The two are tested against each other through the lifted-code check.
 */

#include "ps2rt/lifted.h"
#include "ps2rt/vu_math.h"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <xmmintrin.h>

namespace lifted {

namespace {

/* The special1 FMAC table: (operation, operand: 0-3 a lane of ft, 4 Q, 5 I, 6 ft). */
struct Fmac { int op; int operand; bool to_acc; };

bool Special1(u32 funct, Fmac* out) {
    static const int kBroadcast[7] = {kAdd, kSub, kMadd, kMsub, kMax_, kMini, kMul};
    if (funct <= 0x1B) { *out = {kBroadcast[funct >> 2], (int)(funct & 3), false}; return true; }
    switch (funct) {
        case 0x1C: *out = {kMul, 4, false}; return true;
        case 0x1D: *out = {kMax_, 5, false}; return true;
        case 0x1E: *out = {kMul, 5, false}; return true;
        case 0x1F: *out = {kMini, 5, false}; return true;
        case 0x20: *out = {kAdd, 4, false}; return true;
        case 0x21: *out = {kMadd, 4, false}; return true;
        case 0x22: *out = {kAdd, 5, false}; return true;
        case 0x23: *out = {kMadd, 5, false}; return true;
        case 0x24: *out = {kSub, 4, false}; return true;
        case 0x25: *out = {kMsub, 4, false}; return true;
        case 0x26: *out = {kSub, 5, false}; return true;
        case 0x27: *out = {kMsub, 5, false}; return true;
        case 0x28: *out = {kAdd, 6, false}; return true;
        case 0x29: *out = {kMadd, 6, false}; return true;
        case 0x2A: *out = {kMul, 6, false}; return true;
        case 0x2B: *out = {kMax_, 6, false}; return true;
        case 0x2C: *out = {kSub, 6, false}; return true;
        case 0x2D: *out = {kMsub, 6, false}; return true;
        case 0x2F: *out = {kMini, 6, false}; return true;
    }
    return false;
}

/* The special2 accumulator forms, by their index. */
bool AccumulatorForm(u32 index, Fmac* out) {
    static const int kBroadcast[4] = {kAdd, kSub, kMadd, kMsub};
    if (index <= 0x0F) { *out = {kBroadcast[index >> 2], (int)(index & 3), true}; return true; }
    if (index >= 0x18 && index <= 0x1B) { *out = {kMul, (int)(index & 3), true}; return true; }
    switch (index) {
        case 0x1C: *out = {kMul, 4, true}; return true;
        case 0x1E: *out = {kMul, 5, true}; return true;
        case 0x20: *out = {kAdd, 4, true}; return true;
        case 0x21: *out = {kMadd, 4, true}; return true;
        case 0x22: *out = {kAdd, 5, true}; return true;
        case 0x23: *out = {kMadd, 5, true}; return true;
        case 0x24: *out = {kSub, 4, true}; return true;
        case 0x25: *out = {kMsub, 4, true}; return true;
        case 0x26: *out = {kSub, 5, true}; return true;
        case 0x27: *out = {kMsub, 5, true}; return true;
        case 0x28: *out = {kAdd, 6, true}; return true;
        case 0x29: *out = {kMadd, 6, true}; return true;
        case 0x2A: *out = {kMul, 6, true}; return true;
        case 0x2C: *out = {kSub, 6, true}; return true;
        case 0x2D: *out = {kMsub, 6, true}; return true;
    }
    return false;
}

}  // namespace

}  // namespace lifted

namespace generated {

u32 VuAdd(u32 a, u32 b) { return lifted::Binary(lifted::kAdd, a, b, 0); }
u32 VuSub(u32 a, u32 b) { return lifted::Binary(lifted::kSub, a, b, 0); }
u32 VuMul(u32 a, u32 b) { return lifted::Binary(lifted::kMul, a, b, 0); }
u32 VuMax(u32 a, u32 b) { return lifted::Binary(lifted::kMax_, a, b, 0); }
u32 VuMin(u32 a, u32 b) { return lifted::Binary(lifted::kMini, a, b, 0); }
u32 VuMadd(u32 acc, u32 a, u32 b) { return lifted::Binary(lifted::kMadd, a, b, acc); }
u32 VuMsub(u32 acc, u32 a, u32 b) { return lifted::Binary(lifted::kMsub, a, b, acc); }
u32 VuAbs(u32 a) { return lifted::Clean(a) & ~lifted::kSign; }
u32 VuItof(u32 a, u32 shift) { return lifted::Result((double)(s32)a / (double)(1u << shift)); }
u32 VuFtoi(u32 a, u32 shift) {
    return lifted::FloatToInt(lifted::Value(a) * (double)(1u << shift));
}
u32 VuDiv(u32 num, u32 den) {
    return lifted::Value(den) == 0.0 ? ((num ^ den) & lifted::kSign) | lifted::kMax
                                     : lifted::Result(lifted::Value(num) / lifted::Value(den));
}
u32 VuSqrt(u32 a) { return lifted::Result(std::sqrt(std::fabs(lifted::Value(a)))); }
u32 VuRsqrt(u32 num, u32 den) {
    const double root = std::sqrt(std::fabs(lifted::Value(den)));
    return root == 0.0 ? (num & lifted::kSign) | lifted::kMax
                       : lifted::Result(lifted::Value(num) / root);
}

}  // namespace generated

namespace lifted {

bool DecodeFmac(u32 word, FmacOp* out) {
    const u32 funct = word & 0x3F;
    Fmac fmac;
    const bool is_fmac = funct < 0x3C ? Special1(funct, &fmac)
                                      : AccumulatorForm((word & 3) | ((word >> 4) & 0x7C), &fmac);
    if (!is_fmac) return false;
    out->op = fmac.op;
    out->operand = fmac.operand;
    out->to_acc = fmac.to_acc;
    out->fd = (word >> 6) & 0x1F;
    out->fs = (word >> 11) & 0x1F;
    out->ft = (word >> 16) & 0x1F;
    out->dest = (word >> 21) & 0xF;
    return true;
}

namespace {

#if PS2RT_VU_SSE
template <int Op>
void Lanes(const Context& c, const FmacOp& f, u32 out[4]) {
    const __m128i a = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(c.vf[f.fs]));
    __m128i b;
    if (f.operand == 6) b = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(c.vf[f.ft]));
    else b = _mm_set1_epi32(int(f.operand < 4 ? c.vf[f.ft][f.operand]
                              : f.operand == 4 ? c.vc[kRegQ] : c.vc[kRegI]));
    const __m128i acc = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(c.vacc));
    _mm_storeu_si128(reinterpret_cast<__m128i*>(out), LanesSse<Op>(a, b, acc));
}
#else
template <int Op>
void Lanes(const Context& c, const FmacOp& f, u32 out[4]) {
    const u32* fs = c.vf[f.fs];
    const u32 broadcast = f.operand < 4 ? c.vf[f.ft][f.operand]
                        : f.operand == 4 ? c.vc[kRegQ] : c.vf[f.ft][0];
    const u32 each = f.operand == 5 ? c.vc[kRegI] : broadcast;
    for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane) {
        if (!(f.dest & (8u >> lane))) continue;
        const u32 b = f.operand == 6 ? c.vf[f.ft][lane] : each;
        out[lane] = BinaryOf<Op>(fs[lane], b, c.vacc[lane]);
    }
}
#endif

}  // namespace

void RunFmacScalar(Context& c, const FmacOp& f) {
    u32 out[4];
    const u32 broadcast = f.operand < 4 ? c.vf[f.ft][f.operand]
                        : f.operand == 4 ? c.vc[kRegQ] : f.operand == 5 ? c.vc[kRegI] : 0;
    for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane) {
        if (!(f.dest & (8u >> lane))) continue;
        out[lane] = Binary(f.op, c.vf[f.fs][lane], f.operand == 6 ? c.vf[f.ft][lane] : broadcast, c.vacc[lane]);
    }
    u32* to = f.to_acc ? c.vacc : f.fd ? c.vf[f.fd] : nullptr;
    if (!to) return;
    for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane)
        if (f.dest & (8u >> lane)) to[lane] = out[lane];
}

void FmacResult(const Context& c, const FmacOp& f, u32 out[4]) {
    u32 lanes[4] = {};
    switch (f.op) {
        case kAdd: Lanes<kAdd>(c, f, lanes); break;
        case kSub: Lanes<kSub>(c, f, lanes); break;
        case kMul: Lanes<kMul>(c, f, lanes); break;
        case kMadd: Lanes<kMadd>(c, f, lanes); break;
        case kMsub: Lanes<kMsub>(c, f, lanes); break;
        case kMax_: Lanes<kMax_>(c, f, lanes); break;
        default: Lanes<kMini>(c, f, lanes); break;
    }
    for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane) out[lane] = (f.dest & (8u >> lane)) ? lanes[lane] : 0;
}

void RunFmac(Context& c, const FmacOp& f) {
    // Every lane is read before any is written (fd may be fs or ft); a lane
    // dest leaves alone is not computed at all - the arithmetic has no other
    // effect.
    u32 out[4];
    switch (f.op) {
        case kAdd: Lanes<kAdd>(c, f, out); break;
        case kSub: Lanes<kSub>(c, f, out); break;
        case kMul: Lanes<kMul>(c, f, out); break;
        case kMadd: Lanes<kMadd>(c, f, out); break;
        case kMsub: Lanes<kMsub>(c, f, out); break;
        case kMax_: Lanes<kMax_>(c, f, out); break;
        default: Lanes<kMini>(c, f, out); break;
    }
    u32* to = f.to_acc ? c.vacc : f.fd ? c.vf[f.fd] : nullptr;
    if (!to) return;
    for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane)
        if (f.dest & (8u >> lane)) to[lane] = out[lane];
}

/* The VU's float arithmetic rounds toward zero and flushes denormals: the
   host's SSE control word set so for an instruction, as ps2host's Vu::Run sets
   it for a microprogram (VuRounding) - macro mode is the same VU0, called from
   EE code, which runs with the host's default (to nearest).
   PS2RT_EE_ROUND_NEAREST=1 leaves it to nearest, as emu.py's interpreter
   (eefpu.cpp: what verification compares against). */
const bool kMacroNearest = std::getenv("PS2RT_EE_ROUND_NEAREST") != nullptr;

struct MacroRounding {
    unsigned saved = _mm_getcsr();
    MacroRounding() { if (!kMacroNearest) _mm_setcsr((saved & ~0x6000u) | 0x6000u | 0x8000u | 0x0040u); }
    ~MacroRounding() { if (!kMacroNearest) _mm_setcsr(saved); }
};

void Cop2(Context& c, u32 word) {
    MacroRounding rounding;
    const u32 fd = (word >> 6) & 0x1F, fs = (word >> 11) & 0x1F, ft = (word >> 16) & 0x1F;
    const u32 dest = (word >> 21) & 0xF;
    const bool lane_on[4] = {(dest & 8) != 0, (dest & 4) != 0, (dest & 2) != 0, (dest & 1) != 0};
    auto write = [&](u32 index, const u32 values[4]) {
        if (index == 0) return;
        for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane)
            if (lane_on[lane]) c.vf[index][lane] = values[lane];
    };

    const u32 funct = word & 0x3F;
    const u32 index = funct < 0x3C ? 0 : (word & 3) | ((word >> 4) & 0x7C);
    FmacOp fmac;
    if (DecodeFmac(word, &fmac)) {
        RunFmac(c, fmac);
        return;
    }

    const u32* a = c.vf[fs];
    if (funct == 0x2E) {                                   /* vopmsub */
        const u32* bb = c.vf[ft];
        const u32 out[3] = {Binary(kMsub, a[1], bb[2], c.vacc[0]),
                            Binary(kMsub, a[2], bb[0], c.vacc[1]),
                            Binary(kMsub, a[0], bb[1], c.vacc[2])};
        if (fd != 0)
            for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; ++lane)
                if (lane_on[lane]) c.vf[fd][lane] = out[lane];
        return;
    }
    if (funct >= 0x30 && funct <= 0x35) {                  /* integer unit */
        const u32 x = c.vc[fs], y = c.vc[ft];
        if (funct == 0x32) {
            const s32 imm = (fd & 0x10) ? (s32)fd - 32 : (s32)fd;
            if (ft > 0 && ft < 16) c.vc[ft] = (u32)(c.vc[fs] + imm) & 0xFFFF;
            return;
        }
        const u32 out = funct == 0x30 ? x + y : funct == 0x31 ? x - y
                      : funct == 0x34 ? (x & y) : (x | y);
        if (fd > 0 && fd < 16) c.vc[fd] = out & 0xFFFF;
        return;
    }
    const u32 fsf = (word >> 21) & 3, ftf = (word >> 23) & 3;
    switch (index) {
        case 0x2E: {                                       /* vopmula */
            const u32* bb = c.vf[ft];
            const u32 out[3] = {Result(Value(a[1]) * Value(bb[2])),
                                Result(Value(a[2]) * Value(bb[0])),
                                Result(Value(a[0]) * Value(bb[1]))};
            for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; ++lane)
                if (lane_on[lane]) c.vacc[lane] = out[lane];
            return;
        }
        case 0x30: { const u32 v[4] = {a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3]}; write(ft, v); return; }
        case 0x31: { const u32 v[4] = {a[1], a[2], a[3], a[0]}; write(ft, v); return; }
        case 0x1D: {
            u32 v[4];
            for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane) v[lane] = Clean(a[lane]) & ~kSign;
            write(ft, v);
            return;
        }
        case 0x10: case 0x11: case 0x12: case 0x13: {
            static const double kScale[4] = {1.0, 16.0, 4096.0, 32768.0};
            u32 v[4];
            for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane)
                v[lane] = Result((double)(s32)a[lane] / kScale[index & 3]);
            write(ft, v);
            return;
        }
        case 0x14: case 0x15: case 0x16: case 0x17: {
            static const double kScale[4] = {1.0, 16.0, 4096.0, 32768.0};
            u32 v[4];
            for (int lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane)
                v[lane] = FloatToInt(Value(a[lane]) * kScale[index & 3]);
            write(ft, v);
            return;
        }
        case 0x2F: case 0x3B: case 0x1F:                   /* vnop, vwaitq, vclipw */
            return;
        case 0x38: {                                       /* vdiv */
            const u32 num = c.vf[fs][fsf], den = c.vf[ft][ftf];
            c.vc[kRegQ] = Value(den) == 0.0 ? ((num ^ den) & kSign) | kMax
                                            : Result(Value(num) / Value(den));
            return;
        }
        case 0x39:                                         /* vsqrt */
            c.vc[kRegQ] = Result(std::sqrt(std::fabs(Value(c.vf[ft][ftf]))));
            return;
        case 0x3A: {                                       /* vrsqrt */
            const u32 num = c.vf[fs][fsf];
            const double root = std::sqrt(std::fabs(Value(c.vf[ft][ftf])));
            c.vc[kRegQ] = root == 0.0 ? (num & kSign) | kMax : Result(Value(num) / root);
            return;
        }
        case 0x3C:                                         /* vmtir */
            if (ft != 0 && ft < 16) c.vc[ft] = c.vf[fs][fsf] & 0xFFFF;
            return;
        case 0x3D: {                                       /* vmfir */
            u32 x = c.vc[fs] & 0xFFFF;
            if (x & 0x8000) x |= 0xFFFF0000u;
            const u32 v[4] = {x, x, x, x};
            write(ft, v);
            return;
        }
        case 0x42:                                         /* vrinit */
            c.vc[kRegR] = kOne | (c.vf[fs][fsf] & 0x7FFFFF);
            return;
        case 0x43:                                         /* vrxor */
            c.vc[kRegR] = kOne | ((c.vc[kRegR] ^ c.vf[fs][fsf]) & 0x7FFFFF);
            return;
        case 0x41: { const u32 v[4] = {c.vc[kRegR], c.vc[kRegR], c.vc[kRegR], c.vc[kRegR]};
                     write(ft, v); return; }
        case 0x40: {                                       /* vrnext */
            if (ft == 0) return;
            const u32 r = c.vc[kRegR];
            const u32 bit = ((r >> 4) & 1) ^ ((r >> 22) & 1);
            c.vc[kRegR] = kOne | (((r << 1) ^ bit) & 0x7FFFFF);
            const u32 v[4] = {c.vc[kRegR], c.vc[kRegR], c.vc[kRegR], c.vc[kRegR]};
            write(ft, v);
            return;
        }
    }
    throw Abort{word, 5};
}

void Cop2Move(Context& c, u32 word, u32 rt) {
    const u32 kind = (word >> 21) & 0x1F, index = (word >> 11) & 0x1F;
    switch (kind) {
        case 0x05:                                         /* qmtc2 */
            if (index) {
                c.vf[index][0] = (u32)c.r[rt];
                c.vf[index][1] = (u32)(c.r[rt] >> 32);
                c.vf[index][2] = (u32)c.rh[rt];
                c.vf[index][3] = (u32)(c.rh[rt] >> 32);
            }
            return;
        case 0x06:                                         /* ctc2 */
            if (index < 16) {
                if (index) c.vc[index] = (u32)c.r[rt] & 0xFFFF;
            } else if (index == (u32)kRegR) {
                c.vc[kRegR] = kOne | ((u32)c.r[rt] & 0x7FFFFF);
            } else {
                c.vc[index] = (u32)c.r[rt];
            }
            return;
        case 0x01:                                         /* qmfc2 */
            if (rt) {
                const u32* v = c.vf[index];
                c.r[rt] = (u64)v[0] | ((u64)v[1] << 32);
                c.rh[rt] = (u64)v[2] | ((u64)v[3] << 32);
            }
            return;
        case 0x02:                                         /* cfc2 */
            /* VPU-STAT (29): no VU program runs here, so both units are idle. */
            if (rt) c.r[rt] = index == 29 ? 0 : Sx32(c.vc[index]);
            return;
    }
    throw Abort{word, 5};
}

}  // namespace lifted

`templates/game/port/CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
# @TITLE@, native. Build with engine/tools/port.py, which generates the
# dispatch table and drives this file. (From engine/templates/game.)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(@TARGET@_port LANGUAGES CXX RC)     # RC: the icon and version

set(PS2_GENERATED_DIR "" CACHE PATH "dispatch.cpp, from engine/tools/port.py")

# The C and C++ runtime linked in (/MT): the executable runs on a Windows
# without the Visual C++ redistributable - every library here built so too.
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
# Source files' names (__FILE__) from the repository's root, not the folder it
# was built in: a release names no one's folders.
if(MSVC)
    get_filename_component(repo_root ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.. ABSOLUTE)
    file(TO_NATIVE_PATH "${repo_root}/" repo_root_native)
    add_compile_options("/d1trimfile:${repo_root_native}")
endif()

add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../engine/host ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ps2host)

ps2_add_port(@TARGET@
    GAME ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/..
    GENERATED ${PS2_GENERATED_DIR}
    TRANSLATED ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../src/lifted
    SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/overrides.cpp)

```

`templates/game/port/overrides.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * @TITLE@'s host implementations of guest functions.
 *
 * An override replaces the translated function at its address: the way a port
 * redirects code that drives hardware the host provides differently, and the
 * way the PC features hook in (a settings menu in the game's own menus,
 * widescreen, the mouse's targets). Register them here with
 * ps2host::Override(address, function, "why"); the original stays callable as
 * F_<ADDRESS>(c). See the engine's docs/PORTING.md and the ps2-port skill.
 *
 * Override as little as possible: the game's own code is the point.
 */

#include "ps2host/host.h"
#include "ps2host/run.h"

void RegisterGameOverrides() {
    // ps2host::Override(0x00123456u, SomeHook, "what it does and why");
}

@TITLE@ - PC port, version {version}
==================================================

An unofficial, fan-made native Windows port of @TITLE@ (PS2). The game's

This download contains NO game content. You need your own copy of the
game: an ISO disc image you made from your own disc (@EXECUTABLE@).
Nothing of the game - no textures, sounds, music, movies or data - is
included, and none is downloaded: everything comes from your disc image.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the game's publisher or
developer. Its trademarks belong to their owners.

This is an ALPHA: expect bugs.


What you need

* Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit

* A graphics card with a Vulkan 1.3 driver
* Your own disc image of @TITLE@ (@EXECUTABLE@)


Getting started

Files beside the executable

  *.log             what the last run did (useful in a bug report)

Licences

`templates/game/port/runs/README.md`:

```md
# Scripted runs

Each `.args` file is a set of port options that drives the game to a known
point. With `--virtual-time` the run is the same on any machine, under any
load: the same presses land on the same frames and the pictures come out
byte-identical - a regression test, and a way to get somewhere in the game
without playing.

```sh
<exe> <executable> --disc <iso> $(cat games/@GAME@/port/runs/<run>.args) --frames out/ --frames-every 200
python engine/tools/regress.py --game games/@GAME@ <run> --gpu            # check against the recorded CRCs
python engine/tools/regress.py --game games/@GAME@ <run> --gpu --update   # record them (an intended change only)
```

Record runs that reach the game's main places - boot, the menus, gameplay -
and say here what each reaches and at which frames:

| file | reaches | frames |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

`python engine/tools/regress_all.py` runs every one of them (and every other
game's, given their repositories) - before an engine version is tagged.

```
